      push_cast; ring

      (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).add
        (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℤ) (1 / 4 : ℝ)).summable
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hg_sum

        nlinarith [hn_abs, sq_abs (n : ℝ)]

      have h_pi_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_denom : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := (one_mul _).symm
          _ ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by

      exact inv_anti₀ hn_pos h_denom

      exact le_rfl

      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]

      (toHm1T q : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by

          Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)) := by

  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ = ‖f x‖ := by
    intro f n x
    have h_exp : -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(2 * π * n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖) ^ 2 * (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro f n
    have h_fc : ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖ := by
      dsimp [fourierCircle]
      calc
        ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖
          ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ :=
            intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖ := by
            simp only [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 = (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq, mul_comm]
    gcongr
  have h_rpow_two : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have : (2 : ENNReal).toReal = (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [this, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ENNReal).toReal)]
    simp only [h_rpow_two]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ?_
    exact h_sum_weight.mul_left ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) ^ 2)
  have h_toHm1T_apply : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ), (toHm1T q : ℤ → ℂ) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro q n
    dsimp [toHm1T]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_int_fourier : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ))
        volume 0 1 := by
    intro q n
    have hq_cont : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h_sub_apply : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      ((toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n =
        hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, h_toHm1T_apply q₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply q₂ n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle]
    rw [← mul_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier q₁ n) (h_int_fourier q₂ n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  let S₀ : ℝ := ∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹
  have h_norm_sub_le : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT),
      ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ≤ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) * Real.sqrt S₀ := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    let I_diff : ℝ := ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
    have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ I_diff :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have h_norm_sq : ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_lp := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ENNReal).toReal) (toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂)
      simp only [h_rpow_two, h_sub_apply q₁ q₂] at h_lp
      exact h_lp
    have h_sum_lhs : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n‖ ^ 2) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _)
        (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x)) ?_
      exact h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2)
    have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ I_diff ^ 2 * S₀ := by
      rw [h_norm_sq, ← tsum_mul_left]
      exact h_sum_lhs.tsum_le_tsum (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x))
        (h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2))
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hI_nonneg] at h_sqrt
  have h_cont_toHm1T : Continuous (fun t => toHm1T (u t)) := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    let f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t x => ‖(u t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
    have hf_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) := by
      have hU : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) := hu.1.continuous
      have hU₀ : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) :=
        hU.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
      exact (hU.sub hU₀).norm
    have hF_cont : Continuous (fun t => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t x) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf_cont 0 1
    have hF_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t₀ x) = 0 := by
      simp [f]
    have h_rhs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t x) * Real.sqrt S₀) (nhds t₀) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [hF_zero, zero_mul] using (hF_cont.tendsto t₀).mul tendsto_const_nhds
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_rhs_tendsto
      (fun t => norm_nonneg _) (fun t => h_norm_sub_le (u t) (u t₀))
  exact h_cont_toHm1T.subtype_mk _

informal_problem.statement:
(h_exists : ∀ q : CinfT, ∃ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → CinfT,
      IsSmoothSolutionT u → IsSmoothSolutionT v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v) :
    (∀ q : Hm1T, ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ u : ℝ → CinfT,
      IsSmoothSolutionT u → ‖ιT (u 0) - q‖ < 1 →
      ∀ (t : ℝ) (κ : ℝ), κ₀ ≤ κ →
        (∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
          ‖(ιT (u t) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * ∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
            ‖(ιT (u 0) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (q : Hm1T) (T : ℝ), 0 < T → ∀ ε > 0, ∃ η > 0,
      ∀ u v : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u → IsSmoothSolutionT v →
      ‖ιT (u 0) - q‖ < η → ‖ιT (v 0) - q‖ < η →
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T → ‖ιT (u t) - ιT (v t)‖ < ε)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_hm1_le, h_tail⟩ := hm1KappaSq_tail_controlT
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, K_alpha, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, hK_alpha,
    h_alpha_eq, h_alpha_ratio, h_interp_all⟩ := diagGreen_alpha_and_interpolationT
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  obtain ⟨δ₀_kdv, hδ₀_kdv_pos, hδ₀_kdv_le, h_kdv⟩ :=
    kdv_alpha_conservation_small_dataT h_exists h_unique δ₁ hδ₁
  obtain ⟨δ₀_reg, hδ₀_reg_pos, hδ₀_reg_le, h_reg_all⟩ :=
    regularized_flow_approximationT h_exists h_unique δ₁ hδ₁
  set δ₀ := min δ₀_kdv δ₀_reg
  have hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hδ₀_kdv_pos hδ₀_reg_pos
  have hδ₀_ne : δ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ₀
  have h_init_small : ∀ (q : Hm1T) (w : CinfT),
      ‖ιT w - q‖ < 1 →
      hm1KappaSqT (max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2)) (ιT w) ≤
        δ₀_kdv ^ 2 * max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2) ∧
      hm1KappaSqT (max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2)) (ιT w) ≤
        δ₀_reg ^ 2 * max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2) := by
    intro q w hw
    set R := ‖q‖ + 1
    set κ₀ := max 1 ((R / δ₀) ^ 2)
    have hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀ := le_max_left _ _
    have hκ₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ κ₀ := by linarith
    have hw_norm : ‖ιT w‖ ≤ R := by
      have h_tri : ‖ιT w‖ ≤ ‖q‖ + ‖ιT w - q‖ := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (ιT w) q
      linarith
    have hw_sq : ‖ιT w‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw_norm 2
    have h_hm1_R : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w) ≤ R ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (h_hm1_le κ₀ hκ₀ (ιT w)).2 hw_sq
    have h_R_eq : R ^ 2 = δ₀ ^ 2 * (R / δ₀) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    have h_R_κ₀ : R ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * κ₀ := by
      rw [h_R_eq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right 1 ((R / δ₀) ^ 2)) (sq_nonneg δ₀)
    have h_hm1_δ₀ : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w) ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
      le_trans h_hm1_R h_R_κ₀
    have h_kdv_sq : δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀_kdv ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ₀) (min_le_left _ _) 2
    have h_reg_sq : δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀_reg ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ₀) (min_le_right _ _) 2
    exact ⟨le_trans h_hm1_δ₀ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_kdv_sq hκ₀_nonneg),
      le_trans h_hm1_δ₀ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_reg_sq hκ₀_nonneg)⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    set κ₀ := max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2)
    have hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀ := le_max_left _ _
    refine ⟨κ₀, hκ₀, c₂ / c₁, div_pos hc₂ hc₁, ?_⟩
    intro u hu hu0 t κ hκ
    change hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u t)) ≤ (c₂ / c₁) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u 0))
    have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ := le_trans hκ₀ hκ
    have hu0_kdv : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (u 0)) ≤ δ₀_kdv ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
      (h_init_small q (u 0) hu0).1
    have h_u_cons := h_kdv κ₀ hκ₀ u hu hu0_kdv
    have hut_δ₁ : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u t)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ := h_u_cons.1 t κ hκ
    have hu0_δ₁ : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u 0)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ := h_u_cons.1 0 κ hκ
    have h_cons_eq : alphaFunctionalT κ (u t : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT κ (u 0 : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      h_u_cons.2 κ hκ t
    have h_low := (h_alpha_eq κ hκ_ge1 (u t) hut_δ₁).1
    have h_high := (h_alpha_eq κ hκ_ge1 (u 0) hu0_δ₁).2
    have h_c1_c2 : c₁ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u t)) ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (u 0)) := by
      have h_eq : κ * alphaFunctionalT κ (u t : ℝ → ℝ) = κ * alphaFunctionalT κ (u 0 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        rw [h_cons_eq]
      linarith
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀' hc₁]
    exact h_c1_c2
  · intro q T hT ε hε
    set κ₀ := max 1 (((‖q‖ + 1) / δ₀) ^ 2)
    have hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀ := le_max_left _ _
    have hκ₀_pos : 0 < κ₀ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨C_int, hC_int, h_interp⟩ := h_interp_all κ₀ hκ₀
    obtain ⟨C_rem, Φ_reg, hC_rem, h_reg_inv, h_reg_lip, h_reg_rem⟩ := h_reg_all κ₀ hκ₀
    set θ_M := ε / (12 * C_int * K_alpha)
    have hθ_M : 0 < θ_M := by positivity
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀_ge2, η_M, hη_M, h_tail_M⟩ := h_tail q θ_M hθ_M
    set M := max κ₀ M₀
    have hM_ge_κ₀ : κ₀ ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have hM_ge_M₀ : M₀ ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    have hM_ge1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans hκ₀ hM_ge_κ₀
    set F_M := C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 * C_rem * T
    have hF_M : 0 < F_M := by positivity
    set θ_κ := ε / (12 * F_M)
    have hθ_κ : 0 < θ_κ := by positivity
    obtain ⟨κ₁, hκ₁_ge2, η_κ, hη_κ, h_tail_κ⟩ := h_tail q θ_κ hθ_κ
    set κ := max (2 * κ₀) (max κ₁ (1 / θ_κ + 2))
    have hκ_ge_2κ₀ : 2 * κ₀ ≤ κ := le_max_left _ _
    have hκ_ge_κ₁ : κ₁ ≤ κ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hκ_ge2 : 2 ≤ κ := le_trans hκ₁_ge2 hκ_ge_κ₁
    have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
    have hκ_gt_inv : 1 / θ_κ < κ := by
      have : 1 / θ_κ + 2 ≤ κ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      linarith
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have h_inv_κ : 1 / κ < θ_κ := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hκ_pos]
      have : (1 / θ_κ) * θ_κ < κ * θ_κ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hκ_gt_inv hθ_κ
      rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hθ_κ)] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨L_κ, hL_κ, h_lip_κ⟩ := h_reg_lip κ hκ_ge_2κ₀ T hT
    set η := min (min 1 (min η_M η_κ)) (ε / (6 * L_κ))
    have hη : 0 < η := by positivity
    have hη_le1 : η ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hη_le_M : η ≤ η_M :=
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hη_le_κ : η ≤ η_κ :=
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hη_le_lip : η ≤ ε / (6 * L_κ) := min_le_right _ _
    refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu hv hu0 hv0 t ht
    have h_single : ∀ w : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT w → ‖ιT (w 0) - q‖ < η →
        ‖ιT (w t) - ιT (Φ_reg κ t (w 0))‖ < ε / 3 ∧
        hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₀_reg ^ 2 * κ₀ := by
      intro w hw hw0
      have hw0_lt1 : ‖ιT (w 0) - q‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hw0 hη_le1
      have hw0_kdv : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₀_kdv ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
        (h_init_small q (w 0) hw0_lt1).1
      have hw0_reg : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₀_reg ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
        (h_init_small q (w 0) hw0_lt1).2
      have h_kdv_w := h_kdv κ₀ hκ₀ w hw hw0_kdv
      have hwt_κ₀ : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
        h_kdv_w.1 t κ₀ le_rfl
      have hwt_M : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M :=
        h_kdv_w.1 t M hM_ge_κ₀
      have hw0_M : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M :=
        h_kdv_w.1 0 M hM_ge_κ₀
      have hwt_alpha : alphaFunctionalT M (w t : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) :=
        h_kdv_w.2 M hM_ge_κ₀ t
      have h_reg_w := h_reg_inv κ hκ_ge_2κ₀ (w 0) hw0_reg t
      have hreg_κ₀ : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (Φ_reg κ t (w 0))) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ₀ :=
        h_reg_w.1 κ₀ le_rfl
      have hreg_M : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (Φ_reg κ t (w 0))) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M :=
        h_reg_w.1 M hM_ge_κ₀
      have hreg_alpha : alphaFunctionalT M (Φ_reg κ t (w 0) : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) :=
        h_reg_w.2 M hM_ge_κ₀
      have h_M_w0 : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0))) < θ_M :=
        h_tail_M M hM_ge_M₀ (w 0) (lt_of_lt_of_le hw0 hη_le_M)
      have h_M_wt : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t))) < K_alpha * θ_M := by
        calc Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)))
          _ ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0))) :=
            h_alpha_ratio M hM_ge1 (w t) (w 0) hwt_M hw0_M hwt_alpha
          _ < K_alpha * θ_M := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_M_w0 hK_alpha
      have h_M_reg : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (Φ_reg κ t (w 0)))) < K_alpha * θ_M := by
        calc Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (Φ_reg κ t (w 0))))
          _ ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0))) :=

by
  have h_summable : ∀ f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖f n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro f
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two] using
      (memℓp_gen_iff (p := 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal)).mp (lp.memℓp f)
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two] using
      (lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (p := 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal) f)
  have h_w_nonneg : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      0 ≤ (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    positivity
  have h_w_le_one : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have h_den : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt h_den)
  have h_sum_w : ∀ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro f κ hκ
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ?_ ?_ (h_summable f)
    · intro n
      exact mul_nonneg (h_w_nonneg κ hκ n) (sq_nonneg _)
    · intro n
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_w_le_one κ hκ n)
  have s1 : ∀ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (h : ℝ), |h| < κ⁻¹ →
      translateDiffSqT f h ≤
        8 * ∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f κ hκ h hh
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have h_abs_lt : |h| * κ < 1 := by
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, lt_div_iff₀ hκ_pos] at hh
      exact hh
    have h_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |h| * κ := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg h) (le_of_lt hκ_pos)
    have h_κh : κ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h_sq : (|h| * κ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_abs_sq : h ^ 2 = |h| ^ 2 := (sq_abs h).symm
      nlinarith
    have h_sin : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 = 4 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      have h_exp : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = Complex.I * ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one (ξ * h), Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc
        |2 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)| ^ 2 = (2 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
        _ = 4 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_low : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 ≤ ξ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      have h1 : |Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)| ≤ |ξ * h / 2| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
      have h2 : Real.sin (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs (Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)), ← sq_abs (ξ * h / 2)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
      rw [h_sin ξ]
      linarith
    have h_high : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
      intro ξ
      have h1 : |Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one (ξ * h / 2)
      have h2 : Real.sin (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs (Real.sin (ξ * h / 2))]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
      rw [h_sin ξ]
      linarith
    have h_pw : ∀ n : ℤ,
        ‖(Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1) * f n‖ ^ 2 ≤
          8 * ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro n
      set ξ : ℝ := 2 * π * n
      set M := ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2
      have hM_low : M ≤ ξ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := h_low ξ
      have hM_high : M ≤ 4 := h_high ξ
      have h_denom_pos : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_clear : M * (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 8 * (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
        have h_4k2 : 0 ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 := by positivity
        have h_xi2 : 0 ≤ ξ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg ξ
        have h_part1 : 4 * κ ^ 2 * M ≤ 4 * (κ ^ 2 * h ^ 2) * ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have h_part2 : 4 * (κ ^ 2 * h ^ 2) * ξ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have h_part3 : ξ ^ 2 * M ≤ 4 * ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        linarith
      have h_mult : M ≤ 8 * (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos).mpr h_clear
      have h_eq : 8 * (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2 =
          8 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, ← h_eq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mult (sq_nonneg ‖f n‖)
    have h_sum_lhs : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖(Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1) * f n‖ ^ 2) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) h_pw ((h_sum_w f κ hκ).mul_left 8)
    unfold translateDiffSqT
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_pw h_sum_lhs ((h_sum_w f κ hκ).mul_left 8)
  have s2 : ∀ (f g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
      (∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * ‖f - g‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f g κ hκ
    have h_pw : ∀ n : ℤ,
        (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖f n‖ ^ 2 ≤

            2 * ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      have h_tri : ‖f n‖ ≤ ‖(f - g) n‖ + ‖g n‖ := by
        have h_eq : f n = (f n - g n) + g n := (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
        have h_add := norm_add_le (f n - g n) (g n)
        rw [← h_eq] at h_add
        exact h_add

      have h_g_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖g n‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have h_fg_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖(f - g) n‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have h_sq_diff : 0 ≤ (‖g n‖ - ‖(f - g) n‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h_sq_bound : ‖f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖g n‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hw0 := h_w_nonneg κ hκ n
      have hw1 := h_w_le_one κ hκ n
      have h_fg_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have h_sum_g2 : Summable (fun n : ℤ => 2 * ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2)) :=
      (h_sum_w g κ hκ).mul_left 2
    have h_sum_fg2 : Summable (fun n : ℤ => 2 * ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2) :=
      (h_summable (f - g)).mul_left 2
    have h_tsum_le := Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_pw (h_sum_w f κ hκ) (h_sum_g2.add h_sum_fg2)
    rw [Summable.tsum_add h_sum_g2 h_sum_fg2, tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left, ← h_norm_sq (f - g)] at h_tsum_le
    exact h_tsum_le
  have s3 : ∀ (g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) (κ₀ ε₁ : ℝ), 0 < ε₁ →
      ∃ κ : ℝ, max 1 κ₀ ≤ κ ∧
        (∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) < ε₁ := by
    intro g κ₀ ε₁ hε₁
    let M : ℝ := max 1 κ₀
    have hM₁ : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left 1 κ₀
    let F : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ := fun m n =>
      (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * (M + (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2
    let B : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => ‖g n‖ ^ 2
    have hF_lim : ∀ n : ℤ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => F m n) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro n
      dsimp [F]
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => M + (m : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ M tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (M + (m : ℝ)) ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
        simpa only [sq] using Filter.Tendsto.atTop_mul_atTop₀ h1 h1
      have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 4 * (M + (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add (Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num) h2) tendsto_const_nhds
      have h4 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun m : ℕ => ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) / (4 * (M + (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        Filter.Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds h3
      simpa only [div_mul_eq_mul_div] using h4
    have hF_bound : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ n : ℤ, ‖F m n‖ ≤ B n := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m n => ?_)
      have hm : 1 ≤ M + (m : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) m]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_w_nonneg (M + (m : ℝ)) hm n) (sq_nonneg _))]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_w_le_one (M + (m : ℝ)) hm n)
    have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∑' n : ℤ, F m n) Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' _ : ℤ, (0 : ℝ))) :=
      tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence (h_summable g) hF_lim hF_bound
    rw [tsum_zero] at h_tendsto
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (∑' n : ℤ, F m n) < ε₁ :=
      h_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε₁)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_ev.exists
    refine ⟨M + (N : ℝ), ?_, hN⟩
    have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
    dsimp [M]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨κ₀, _hκ₀, C, hC, h_cons_q⟩ := h_cons q
  have hε₁ : 0 < ε / (64 * C) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ_max, h_q⟩ := s3 (q : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) κ₀ (ε / (64 * C)) hε₁
  have hκ₁ : 1 ≤ κ := (max_le_iff.mp hκ_max).1
  have hκ₀_le : κ₀ ≤ κ := (max_le_iff.mp hκ_max).2
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  refine ⟨min 1 (ε / (64 * C)), lt_min one_pos hε₁, κ⁻¹, inv_pos.mpr hκ_pos, ?_⟩

by
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  let m : ℤ → ℂ := fun n => Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1
  have hm_bound : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖m n‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro n
    dsimp [m]
    have h_tri : ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ≤
        ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ :=
      norm_sub_le _ _
    have h_exp : ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I)‖ = 1 := by
      have h_arg : ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = ((2 * π * n * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    rw [h_exp, norm_one] at h_tri
    linarith
  have hm_sq : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro n z
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]

      nlinarith [hm_bound n, norm_nonneg (m n)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2 (sq_nonneg _)
  have h_sum_lp : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖g n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro g
    have hg := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp g.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_mem : ∀ f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Memℓp (fun n : ℤ => m n * f n) 2 := by
    intro f

    simp_rw [h_rpow]
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => hm_sq n (f n))
      ((h_sum_lp f).mul_left 4)
  let T_h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
    fun f => ⟨fun n => m n * f n, h_mem f⟩
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖g‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖g n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have hg := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos g
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_eq : ∀ f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, translateDiffSqT f h = ‖T_h f‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    rw [h_norm_sq (T_h f)]
    rfl
  have h_lip : LipschitzWith 2 T_h := by
    refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun f g => ?_
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have h_sub_pt : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖(T_h f - T_h g) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      have h1 : (T_h f - T_h g) n = m n * (f - g) n := by
        change (T_h f) n - (T_h g) n = m n * (f n - g n)

      Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_sub_pt (h_sum_lp (T_h f - T_h g)) ((h_sum_lp (f - g)).mul_left 4)
    rw [tsum_mul_left, ← h_norm_sq (f - g)] at h_tsum_le

  rw [h_fun_eq]

      have h_sq_bound : ‖f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖g n‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖(f - g) n‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h_den_pos (by linarith)

          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_dG_bd m a x
        _ = (B_d * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) * Real.exp (-(κ₀ / 2) * |a - x|) := by
          rw [tsum_mul_right, tsum_mul_left]

    have h_tend_LR : ∀ a : ℝ,

        squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => (1 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ₀ / 2) * |a - x|))

            have h0 := (h_exp_abs_bot a).const_mul ((4 / 3) * B_d)

      have h_tsum_GR : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ₀ w₀ (m + 1) a x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => (1 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ₀ / 2) * |a - x|))
          (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_tail_G a x)
          (by
            have h0 := (h_exp_abs_top a).const_mul (1 / 3)

      have h_tsum_dGR : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ₀ w₀ (m + 1) a x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_fc_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      fourierCircle (fun x => c * f x) n = (c : ℂ) * fourierCircle f n := by
    intro c f n
    dsimp [fourierCircle]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((c * f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => (c : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ))) := by
      ext x; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have h_fc_add : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → ∀ (n : ℤ),
      fourierCircle (fun x => f x + g x) n = fourierCircle f n + fourierCircle g n := by
    intro f g hf hg n
    dsimp [fourierCircle]
    have hf_int : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) volume 0 1 := by
      have h_cont : Continuous
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
        fun_prop
      exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) volume 0 1 := by
      have h_cont : Continuous
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) := by
        fun_prop
      exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f x + g x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ) +
          Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_int hg_int]
  have h_h1_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      h1NormSqT (fun x => c * f x) = c ^ 2 * h1NormSqT f := by
    intro c f
    dsimp [h1NormSqT]
    have h_eq : (fun n : ℤ => (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (fun x => c * f x) n‖ ^ 2) =
        (fun n : ℤ => c ^ 2 * ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2)) := by
      ext n
      rw [h_fc_smul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow |c|, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [h_eq, tsum_mul_left]
  have h_hm1_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      hm1NormSqT (fun x => c * f x) = c ^ 2 * hm1NormSqT f := by
    intro c f
    dsimp [hm1NormSqT]
    have h_eq : (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle (fun x => c * f x) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) =
        (fun n : ℤ => c ^ 2 * (‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))) := by
      ext n
      rw [h_fc_smul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow |c|, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [h_eq, tsum_mul_left]
  have h_sum_weight : Summable (fun n : ℤ => 1 / (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)) := by
    let g : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + if n = 0 then (1 / 4 : ℝ) else 0
    have hg_sum : Summable g :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).add
        (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℤ) (1 / 4 : ℝ)).summable
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hg_sum
    dsimp [g]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn; norm_num
    · rw [if_neg hn, add_zero]
      have hn_abs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(n : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hn
      have hn_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hn_abs, sq_abs (n : ℝ)]
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hpi : (2 : ℝ) ≤ π := Real.two_le_pi
      have h_pi_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_denom : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := (one_mul _).symm
          _ ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            linarith [show (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 by ring]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hn_pos h_denom
  have h_hm1_sum : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f →

      (h_psi1_cont.add h_psi2_cont).add (continuous_const.mul h_prod_cont)
    have h_Q_per : Function.Periodic Q 1 :=
      h_per_add _ _ (h_per_add _ _ h_psi1_per h_psi2_per) (h_per_smul (-1) _ h_prod_per)
    obtain ⟨h_Q_sum, h_Q_norm_le, _⟩ :=
      h_add (fun x => psi1_tilde x + psi2_tilde x)
        (fun x => (-1 : ℝ) * (psi1_tilde x * psi2_tilde x))
        (h_psi1_cont.add h_psi2_cont) (continuous_const.mul h_prod_cont)
        h_psi12_sum h_nprod_sum
    have h_psi1_nn : 0 ≤ h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi1_tilde :=
      tsum_nonneg (fun n => by positivity)
    have h_psi2_nn : 0 ≤ h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi2_tilde :=
      tsum_nonneg (fun n => by positivity)
    have h_prod_small : (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => psi1_tilde x * psi2_tilde x) ≤
        (1 / 1024) * (1 / 1024) := by
      have h1 : ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi1_tilde) *
          ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi2_tilde) ≤ (1 / 1024) * (1 / 1024) :=
        mul_le_mul h_psi1_small h_psi2_small (by positivity) (by norm_num)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_norm_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 169 / κ₀)
      have h3 : (169 / κ₀) * ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi1_tilde * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi2_tilde) =
          ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi1_tilde) * ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ psi2_tilde) := by
        ring
      linarith
    have h_Q_small : (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Q ≤ 1 / 72 := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Q_norm_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 169 / κ₀)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_psi12_norm_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 169 / κ₀)
      have h3 : (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => (-1 : ℝ) * (psi1_tilde x * psi2_tilde x)) =
          (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => psi1_tilde x * psi2_tilde x) := by
        rw [h_nprod_norm_eq]; ring
      linarith [h_psi1_small, h_psi2_small, h_prod_small]
    have h_ΔR₂_eq : ΔR₂ = (fun x : ℝ => U x * Q x) := by
      ext x
      have h_U_simp : U x = -2 * (g1_tilde x - g2_tilde x) := by
        dsimp [U, ΔL, ΔR₁, r2_1_tilde, r2_2_tilde]; ring
      have hb1 := (abs_le.mp (h_g1_bd x)).1
      have hb2 := (abs_le.mp (h_g2_bd x)).1
      dsimp [g1_tilde] at hb1
      dsimp [g2_tilde] at hb2
      have h_dg1_pos : 0 < 2 * κ₀ * diagGreen κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by linarith
      have h_dg2_pos : 0 < 2 * κ₀ * diagGreen κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by linarith
      have h_dg1_ne : diagGreen κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h_z; rw [h_z, mul_zero] at h_dg1_pos; linarith
      have h_dg2_ne : diagGreen κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h_z; rw [h_z, mul_zero] at h_dg2_pos; linarith
      dsimp [ΔR₂, Q, psi1_tilde, psi2_tilde, recipGreenDiffT, g1_tilde, g2_tilde] at h_U_simp ⊢
      rw [h_U_simp]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_ΔR₂_cont : Continuous ΔR₂ := by
      rw [h_ΔR₂_eq]; exact h_U_cont.mul h_Q_cont
    obtain ⟨_, _, h_UQ_sum, h_UQ_norm_le⟩ :=
      h_mul U Q h_U_cont h_U_per h_Q_cont h_Q_per h_U_sum h_Q_sum
    have h_ΔR₂_sum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle ΔR₂ n‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [h_ΔR₂_eq]; exact h_UQ_sum
    have h_Q_nn : 0 ≤ h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Q :=
      tsum_nonneg (fun n => by positivity)
    have h_ΔR₂_norm : h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ ΔR₂ ≤ (1 / 8) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) := by
      rw [h_ΔR₂_eq]
      have h_mul_le : h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ U * ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Q) ≤
          (9 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂)) * (1 / 72) :=
        mul_le_mul h_U_norm h_Q_small (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have h_assoc : (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ U * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Q =
          h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ U * ((169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Q) := by ring
      linarith [h_UQ_norm_le]
    set ΔR : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ΔR₁ x + ΔR₂ x
    have h_ΔR_cont : Continuous ΔR := h_ΔR₁_cont.add h_ΔR₂_cont
    obtain ⟨h_ΔR_sum, h_ΔR_norm_le, _⟩ :=
      h_add ΔR₁ ΔR₂ h_ΔR₁_cont h_ΔR₂_cont h_ΔR₁_sum h_ΔR₂_sum
    have h_ΔR_norm : h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ ΔR ≤ (1 / 2) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) := by
      linarith [h_ΔR_norm_le, h_ΔR₁_norm, h_ΔR₂_norm]
    obtain ⟨h_dpsi_tilde_sum, h_dpsi_tilde_upper, h_dpsi_tilde_lower⟩ :=
      h_add ΔL ΔR h_ΔL_cont h_ΔR_cont h_ΔL_sum h_ΔR_sum
    have h_dpsi_tilde_eq : (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => ΔL x + ΔR x) := by
      ext x; dsimp [ΔL, ΔR, ΔR₁, ΔR₂, r2_1_tilde, r2_2_tilde]; ring
    rw [← h_dpsi_tilde_eq] at h_dpsi_tilde_sum h_dpsi_tilde_upper h_dpsi_tilde_lower
    have h_dpsi_tilde_low :
        hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) ≤
          h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) := by
      linarith [h_dpsi_tilde_lower, h_ΔL_norm, h_ΔR_norm, h_hm1_diff_nn]
    have h_dpsi_tilde_high :
        h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) ≤
          9 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) := by
      linarith [h_dpsi_tilde_upper, h_ΔL_norm, h_ΔR_norm, h_hm1_diff_nn]
    set ΔΨ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x
    have h_ΔΨ_eq : ΔΨ = (fun x : ℝ => κ₀ * (psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x)) := by
      ext x
      dsimp [ΔΨ, psi1_tilde, psi2_tilde]
      field_simp
    obtain ⟨h_ΔΨ_sum_k, h_ΔΨ_norm_k⟩ :=
      h_smul κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) h_dpsi_tilde_sum
    rw [← h_ΔΨ_eq] at h_ΔΨ_sum_k h_ΔΨ_norm_k
    obtain ⟨h_ΔΨ_sum, h_ΔΨ_equiv_low, h_ΔΨ_equiv_high⟩ := h_h1_equiv ΔΨ h_ΔΨ_sum_k
    refine ⟨h_ΔΨ_sum, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ‖ιT w₁ - ιT w₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ κ₀ ^ 2 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) := by
        have h_mul_k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hm1_low (sq_nonneg κ₀)
        have h_cancel : κ₀ ^ 2 * ((1 / κ₀ ^ 2) * ‖ιT w₁ - ιT w₂‖ ^ 2) = ‖ιT w₁ - ιT w₂‖ ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
        linarith
      have h2 : κ₀ ^ 2 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) ≤
          κ₀ ^ 2 * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dpsi_tilde_low (sq_nonneg κ₀)
      linarith [h_ΔΨ_norm_k, h_ΔΨ_equiv_high]
    · have h1 : κ₀ ^ 2 * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => psi1_tilde x - psi2_tilde x) ≤
          κ₀ ^ 2 * (9 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_dpsi_tilde_high (sq_nonneg κ₀)
      have h2 : κ₀ ^ 2 * (9 * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂)) ≤
          9 * κ₀ ^ 2 * ‖ιT w₁ - ιT w₂‖ ^ 2 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hm1_high (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * κ₀ ^ 2)
        linarith
      linarith [h_ΔΨ_equiv_low, h_ΔΨ_norm_k]

subgoal_signatures.name: cinfT_fourierCircle_summable_and_hasSum
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(w : CinfT) :

    (∀ z : ℝ,
      HasSum (fun n : ℤ =>
        fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n *

subgoal_signatures.name: h1KappaNormSqT_mul_and_tsum_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ₀ : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀)
    (h_bf0 : Summable (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (0 - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ∧
      (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (0 - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ≤ 41 / κ₀) :
    (∀ u v : ℝ → ℝ,
      Continuous u → Function.Periodic u 1 →
      Continuous v → Function.Periodic v 1 →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle u n‖ ^ 2) →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle v n‖ ^ 2) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) 1 ∧
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (fun x => u x * v x) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => u x * v x) ≤
        (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ u * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ v) ∧
    (∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (A B ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ ρ₁ → ρ₁ ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 ≤ ρ₂ → 4 * ρ₂ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (F m) ∧ Function.Periodic (F m) 1 ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, |F m x| ≤ A * ρ₁ ^ m) ∧
        Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (F m) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
        h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (F m) ≤ B * ρ₂ ^ m) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) ∧
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) 1 ∧

          2 * ‖fourierCircle F₁ n‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierCircle F₂ n‖ ^ 2 :=
        le_trans h_sq_tri h_quad
      have h_weight_nn : 0 ≤ ((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
        positivity
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm_sq_le h_weight_nn
      linarith [(by ring : ((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
          ‖fourierCircle F₁ n - fourierCircle F₂ n‖ ^ 2 =
          ((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) *
            ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle F₁ n - fourierCircle F₂ n‖ ^ 2)),
        (by ring : ((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
          (2 * ‖fourierCircle F₁ n‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierCircle F₂ n‖ ^ 2) =
          2 * (((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) *
            ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle F₁ n‖ ^ 2)) +
          2 * (((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) *
            ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle F₂ n‖ ^ 2)))]
    have h_sum_sub : Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
        ((2 * (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) *
          ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (fun x => F₁ x - F₂ x) n‖ ^ 2)) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) h_pw (h_sum₁.add h_sum₂)
    dsimp [h1HighFreqSqT]
    rw [← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left, ← h_sum₁.tsum_add h_sum₂]
    exact h_sum_sub.tsum_le_tsum h_pw (h_sum₁.add h_sum₂)
  have h_single_bound : ∀ (w : CinfT), hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w) ≤ δ_lip ^ 2 * κ₀ →
      h1HighFreqSqT M (recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ≤ 18 * κ₀ ^ 2 * hm1KappaSqT M (ιT w) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hF_cont, hF_per, hF_h1_sum⟩ := h_single w hw
    let A : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) n‖ ^ 2
    let B : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2
    have hA_nn : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ A n := fun n => by dsimp [A]; positivity
    have hB_nn : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ B n := fun n => by dsimp [B]; positivity
    have hB_sum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => B n / (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)) := (h_mem_and_sum w).2
    have h_shift : ∀ h : ℝ,
        (∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * A n) ≤
          9 * κ₀ ^ 2 * (∑' n : ℤ, ‖Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 *
            (B n / (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2))) := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨w_h, hw_h_eval, hw_h_recip⟩ := s1 w h
      obtain ⟨hw_h_kappa, hw_h_diff⟩ := h_iota_diff_sq w w_h h hw_h_eval
      have hw_h_le : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w_h) ≤ δ_lip ^ 2 * κ₀ := by
        rw [hw_h_kappa]
        exact hw
      have h_lip_h := h_lip w_h w hw_h_le hw
      have h_lhs_fn : (fun x : ℝ => recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w_h : ℝ → ℝ) x - recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) =
          (fun x : ℝ => recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + h) - recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by
        ext x
        rw [hw_h_recip x]
      rw [h_lhs_fn, h1NormSqT_shift_sub (recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) hF_cont hF_per h, hw_h_diff] at h_lip_h
      exact h_lip_h
    have h_bound := s3 A B hA_nn hB_nn hF_h1_sum hB_sum h_shift
    rw [← h_kappa_eq M w] at h_bound
    exact h_bound
  have h_w₁ := h_single_bound w₁ hw₁
  have h_w₂ := h_single_bound w₂ hw₂
  have h_sub := s4 (recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ)) (recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ))
    (h_single w₁ hw₁).1 (h_single w₂ hw₂).1
    (h_single w₁ hw₁).2.2 (h_single w₂ hw₂).2.2
  linarith

by
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_summable : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖g n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro g
    have hg := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp g.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖g‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖g n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have hg := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos g
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_w_nonneg : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      0 ≤ (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    positivity
  have h_w_le_one : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have h_den : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2 := by positivity

    · intro n

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro κ₀ κ hκ₀ hκ₀κ f

    have h_sq_le : κ₀ ^ 2 ≤ κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_div : (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ≤

    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div (sq_nonneg _)
  · intro κ hκ u hu
    let w : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)
    let m : ℤ → ℂ := fun n => ((Real.sqrt (w n) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hm_sq_eq : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 = w n * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      dsimp [m]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (w n)),
        mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (h_w_nonneg κ hκ n)]
    have hm_sq_le : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      rw [hm_sq_eq n z]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_w_le_one κ hκ n)
    have h_mem_T : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Memℓp (fun n : ℤ => m n * g n) 2 := by
      intro g
      rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => hm_sq_le n (g n))
        (h_summable g)
    let T_κ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
      fun g => ⟨fun n => m n * g n, h_mem_T g⟩
    have h_eq : ∀ f : Hm1T, hm1KappaSqT κ f = ‖T_κ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro f
      rw [h_norm_sq (T_κ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2))]
      unfold hm1KappaSqT
      congr 1
      ext n
      exact (hm_sq_eq n ((f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n)).symm
    have h_lip : LipschitzWith 1 T_κ := by
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun g₁ g₂ => ?_
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      have h_sub_pt : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖(T_κ g₁ - T_κ g₂) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(g₁ - g₂) n‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro n
        have h1 : (T_κ g₁ - T_κ g₂) n = m n * (g₁ - g₂) n := by

          dsimp [T_κ]
          ring
        rw [h1]
        exact hm_sq_le n ((g₁ - g₂) n)
      have h_tsum_le : (∑' n : ℤ, ‖(T_κ g₁ - T_κ g₂) n‖ ^ 2) ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖(g₁ - g₂) n‖ ^ 2 :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_sub_pt (h_summable (T_κ g₁ - T_κ g₂)) (h_summable (g₁ - g₂))
      rw [← h_norm_sq (g₁ - g₂)] at h_tsum_le
      apply lp.norm_le_of_tsum_le hp_pos (by positivity)
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      calc
        (∑' i : ℤ, ‖(T_κ g₁ - T_κ g₂) i‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖g₁ - g₂‖ ^ 2 := h_tsum_le
        _ = ((1 : NNReal) * ‖g₁ - g₂‖) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
    have h_cont_hm1 : Continuous (fun f : Hm1T => hm1KappaSqT κ f) := by
      have h_fun_eq : (fun f : Hm1T => hm1KappaSqT κ f) =
          (fun f : Hm1T => ‖T_κ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2) := funext h_eq
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      exact ((continuous_pow 2).comp (continuous_norm.comp h_lip.continuous)).comp continuous_subtype_val
    have h_sum_weight : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      have h_sum_g : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (if n = 0 then (1 / 4 : ℝ) else 0) + 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
        (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℤ) (1 / 4 : ℝ)).summable.add (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr one_lt_two)
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) h_sum_g
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst hn
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hn, zero_add, one_div]
        apply inv_anti₀
        · have : 1 ≤ |n| := Int.one_le_abs hn
          have h_cast : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(n : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
          have h_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs (n : ℝ)]
          linarith
        · have h_pi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
          have h_eq_pi : (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
          have : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (n : ℝ)
          nlinarith
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ = ‖f x‖ := by
      intro f n x
      have h_exp : -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(2 * π * n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),

              intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
          _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖ := by
              simp only [norm_fourier_integrand]
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 = (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq, mul_comm]
      gcongr
    have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
      intro q
      rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]

      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ?_

    let S₀ : ℝ := ∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹
    have h_norm_sub_le : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT),
        ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ≤ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) * Real.sqrt S₀ := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      let I_diff : ℝ := ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖

        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => norm_nonneg _)

        have h_lp := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos (toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂)
        simp only [h_rpow, h_sub_apply q₁ q₂] at h_lp
        exact h_lp
      have h_sum_lhs : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n‖ ^ 2) := by
        refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _)
          (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x)) ?_
        exact h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2)
      have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ I_diff ^ 2 * S₀ := by
        rw [h_norm_sq_diff, ← tsum_mul_left]
        exact h_sum_lhs.tsum_le_tsum (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x))
          (h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2))
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hI_nonneg] at h_sqrt
    have h_cont_toHm1T : Continuous (fun t => toHm1T (u t)) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro t₀
      rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      let f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t x => ‖(u t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
      have hf_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) := by
        have hU : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) := hu.1.continuous
        have hU₀ : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) :=
          hU.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        exact (hU.sub hU₀).norm
      have hF_cont : Continuous (fun t => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t x) :=
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf_cont 0 1
      have hF_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t₀ x) = 0 := by
        simp [f]
      have h_rhs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t x) * Real.sqrt S₀) (nhds t₀) (nhds 0) := by

  refine ⟨1 / 26, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_leibniz := shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrenceT κ hκ w
  have h_h1_step := freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_periodic_stepT κ hκ
  obtain ⟨h_smooth_diag, h_per_diag, h_tsum⟩ :=
    diagGreen_smooth_periodic_and_deriv_tsumT κ hκ w hw h_leibniz h_h1_step
  have h_off_diag := greenIterKernel_offDiag_and_diag_hasDerivAtT κ hκ w
  obtain ⟨h_derivY_diag, h_mixed_diag⟩ :=
    greenIterDerivY_and_mixedDiag_hasDerivAtT κ hκ w h_off_diag
  let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw₀_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w₀ := w.2.1
  have hw₀_per : Function.Periodic w₀ 1 := w.2.2
  let h : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y y
  have hh0_eq : h 0 = fun _ => 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    ext y
    dsimp [h, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hh_deriv_at : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt (h ℓ) (deriv (h ℓ) y) y := by
    intro ℓ y
    cases ℓ with
    | zero =>
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt (h 0) 0 y := by
        rw [hh0_eq]
        exact hasDerivAt_const y (1 / (2 * κ))
      rw [hd0.deriv]
      exact hd0
    | succ m =>
      have hdm : HasDerivAt (h (m + 1)) (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) y y) y :=
        h_off_diag.2.2 m y
      rw [hdm.deriv]
      exact hdm
  have hh_deriv_eq : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
      deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) = fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) y y := by
    intro ℓ
    ext y
    exact (h_off_diag.2.2 ℓ y).deriv
  have hh_deriv2_eq : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
      iteratedDeriv 2 (h (ℓ + 1)) =
        fun y => 2 * κ ^ 2 * h (ℓ + 1) y + 2 * w₀ y * h ℓ y + 2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ ℓ y := by
    intro ℓ
    ext y
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (deriv (h (ℓ + 1)))
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * h (ℓ + 1) y + 2 * w₀ y * h ℓ y + 2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ ℓ y) y := by
      rw [hh_deriv_eq ℓ]
      exact h_derivY_diag ℓ y
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    exact hd2.deriv
  have h_ode_iter : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv 3 (h (ℓ + 1)) x =
        2 * deriv w₀ x * h ℓ x +
        4 * w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x := by
    intro ℓ x
    have hw_deriv : HasDerivAt w₀ (deriv w₀ x) x :=
      (hw₀_smooth.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
    have hd_term1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * κ ^ 2 * h (ℓ + 1) y)
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x) x :=
      (hh_deriv_at (ℓ + 1) x).const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2)
    have hd_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * w₀ y * h ℓ y)
        (2 * (deriv w₀ x * h ℓ x + w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x)) x := by
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt (fun y => w₀ y * h ℓ y)
          (deriv w₀ x * h ℓ x + w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x) x :=
        hw_deriv.mul (hh_deriv_at ℓ x)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hd_prod.const_mul 2
    have hd_term3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ ℓ y)
        (2 * (κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x + w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x)) x :=
      (h_mixed_diag ℓ x).const_mul 2
    have hd3 : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv 2 (h (ℓ + 1)))
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x +
          2 * (deriv w₀ x * h ℓ x + w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x) +
          2 * (κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x + w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x)) x := by
      rw [hh_deriv2_eq ℓ]
      exact (hd_term1.add hd_term2).add hd_term3
    have h_it3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (h (ℓ + 1)) x = deriv (iteratedDeriv 2 (h (ℓ + 1))) x := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    rw [h_it3, hd3.deriv]
    ring
  have h_appell : ∀ x : ℝ,
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        2 * deriv w₀ x * diagGreen κ w₀ x +
        4 * w₀ x * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨h_sum0, h_sum1, h_sum2, h_d1_eq0, h_d1_eq1, h_d3_eq⟩ := h_tsum x
    change iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (h (ℓ + 1)) x at h_d3_eq
    change deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (h ℓ) x at h_d1_eq0
    change deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x at h_d1_eq1
    rw [h_d3_eq]
    simp_rw [h_ode_iter _ x]
    have hs0 : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => 2 * deriv w₀ x * h ℓ x) := h_sum0.mul_left (2 * deriv w₀ x)
    have hs1 : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => 4 * w₀ x * deriv (h ℓ) x) := h_sum1.mul_left (4 * w₀ x)
    have hs2 : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (h (ℓ + 1)) x) := h_sum2.mul_left (4 * κ ^ 2)
    rw [(hs0.add hs1).tsum_add hs2, hs0.tsum_add hs1]
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]
    rw [← h_d1_eq0, ← h_d1_eq1]
    rfl
  refine ⟨h_smooth_diag, h_per_diag, h_appell, ?_⟩
  let g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)
  have hg_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g_tilde := h_smooth_diag.sub contDiff_const
  have hg_per : Function.Periodic g_tilde 1 := by
    intro x
    dsimp [g_tilde]
    rw [h_per_diag x]
  have h_iter_hasDerivAt : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv k f) (iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f x) x := by
    intro f hf k x
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) x :=
      (hf.differentiable_iteratedDeriv k (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top k))).differentiableAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact hd.hasDerivAt
  have h_iter_per : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, Function.Periodic f 1 →
      ∀ (k : ℕ), iteratedDeriv k f 1 = iteratedDeriv k f 0 := by
    intro f hf k
    have h_shift : (fun y => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hf
    have h_per_k : iteratedDeriv k f (0 + 1) = iteratedDeriv k f 0 := by
      calc iteratedDeriv k f (0 + 1)
        _ = iteratedDeriv k (fun y => f (y + 1)) 0 :=
          congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const k f 1).symm 0
        _ = iteratedDeriv k f 0 := by rw [h_shift]
    simpa using h_per_k
  let w0 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 0 w₀
  let w1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 w₀
  let w2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 w₀
  let w3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 w₀
  let g0 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 0 g_tilde
  let g1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 g_tilde
  let g2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 g_tilde
  let g3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 g_tilde
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
    (g0 x * w2 x - g1 x * w1 x + g2 x * w0 x) -
    (4 * (w0 x * w0 x * g0 x) + (1 / (2 * κ)) * (w0 x * w0 x)) -
    2 * κ ^ 2 * (g2 x - 2 * (w0 x * g0 x) - (1 / κ) * w0 x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * g0 x)
  have hΨ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt Ψ ((1 / (2 * κ) - diagGreen κ w₀ x) * kdvRHS w₀ x) x := by
    intro x
    have hw0 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hw₀_smooth 0 x
    have hw1 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hw₀_smooth 1 x
    have hw2 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hw₀_smooth 2 x
    have hg0 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hg_smooth 0 x
    have hg1 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hg_smooth 1 x
    have hg2 := h_iter_hasDerivAt hg_smooth 2 x
    have hd : HasDerivAt Ψ
        (((g1 x * w2 x + g0 x * w3 x) - (g2 x * w1 x + g1 x * w2 x) + (g3 x * w0 x + g2 x * w1 x)) -
        (4 * ((w1 x * w0 x + w0 x * w1 x) * g0 x + (w0 x * w0 x) * g1 x) +
          (1 / (2 * κ)) * (w1 x * w0 x + w0 x * w1 x)) -
        2 * κ ^ 2 * (g3 x - 2 * (w1 x * g0 x + w0 x * g1 x) - (1 / κ) * w1 x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * g1 x)) x :=
      (((hg0.mul hw2).sub (hg1.mul hw1)).add (hg2.mul hw0)).sub
        (((hw0.mul hw0).mul hg0).const_mul 4 |>.add ((hw0.mul hw0).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ)))) |>.sub
        (((hg2.sub ((hw0.mul hg0).const_mul 2)).sub (hw0.const_mul (1 / κ))).sub
          (hg0.const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2)) |>.const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2))
    convert hd using 1
    dsimp only [kdvRHS, w0, w1, w2, w3, g0, g1, g2, g3]
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_one]
    have h_app : iteratedDeriv 3 g_tilde x =
        2 * deriv w₀ x * diagGreen κ w₀ x +
        4 * w₀ x * deriv g_tilde x +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv g_tilde x := h_appell x
    have h_gt : g_tilde x = diagGreen κ w₀ x - 1 / (2 * κ) := rfl
    rw [h_app, h_gt]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hΨ_per : Ψ 1 = Ψ 0 := by
    dsimp only [Ψ, w0, w1, w2, g0, g1, g2]
    rw [h_iter_per hw₀_per 0, h_iter_per hw₀_per 1, h_iter_per hw₀_per 2,
        h_iter_per hg_per 0, h_iter_per hg_per 1, h_iter_per hg_per 2]
  have h_cont_integrand : Continuous (fun x => (1 / (2 * κ) - diagGreen κ w₀ x) * kdvRHS w₀ x) := by
    have h_cont_g : Continuous (diagGreen κ w₀) := h_smooth_diag.continuous
    have h_cont_w0 : Continuous w₀ := hw₀_smooth.continuous
    have h_cont_w1 : Continuous (deriv w₀) := hw₀_smooth.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
    have h_cont_w3 : Continuous (iteratedDeriv 3 w₀) :=
      hw₀_smooth.continuous_iteratedDeriv 3 (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have h_cont_kdv : Continuous (kdvRHS w₀) := by
      unfold kdvRHS
      exact h_cont_w3.neg.add ((continuous_const.mul h_cont_w0).mul h_cont_w1)
    exact (continuous_const.sub h_cont_g).mul h_cont_kdv
  have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun x _ => hΨ_deriv x) (h_cont_integrand.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  rw [h_ftc, hΨ_per, sub_self]

subgoal_signatures.name: shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrenceT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x u)) ∧
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u))

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_periodic_stepT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (freeGreenKernel κ 0) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (W : CinfT) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f η‖ ≤ M) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
        (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        (13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT W))) * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
        ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
        (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_smooth_periodic_and_deriv_tsumT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT)
    (hw : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 * κ)
    (h_leibniz :
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x u)) ∧
      (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
      (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n x u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)))
    (h_h1_step :
      (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (freeGreenKernel κ 0) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ (W : CinfT) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f η‖ ≤ M) →
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
          (13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT W))) * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
          ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) →
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    Function.Periodic (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x) ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x ∧
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_and_diag_hasDerivAtT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) :
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y x) ∧
      (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y| ≤ B)) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ,
      (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) z y)) ∧
      (∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ z y : ℝ, |greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) z y| ≤ L) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a y)
          (greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a y)
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x +
            (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m a x) x)) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x x) x)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterDerivY_and_mixedDiag_hasDerivAtT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT)
    (h_off_diag :
      (∀ ℓ : ℕ,
        Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
        (∀ x y : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y x) ∧
        (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y| ≤ B)) ∧

        (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) := by

      apply setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
      intro u hu
      dsimp [g]
      have hu_pos : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu.1
      have hu_le : |u| ≤ r := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_pos]; exact hu.2
      rw [max_eq_right hu_le]
      have : -2 * κ * r - 2 * κ * r = -4 * κ * r := by ring
      rw [this, sub_self]
    have h_ioi_r : (∫ u in Set.Ioi r, g u) =
        (∫ u in Set.Ioi r, (Real.exp (-2 * κ * r) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * u) - Real.exp (-(4 * κ) * u))) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro u hu
      dsimp [g]
      have hu_r : r < u := hu
      have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u := by linarith

        rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn]
        exact max_eq_left (le_of_lt hu_r)

    have h_int1 : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * r) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * u)) (Set.Ioi r) volume :=
      (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi r (by positivity : 0 < 2 * κ)).const_mul _
    have h_int2 : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(4 * κ) * u)) (Set.Ioi r) volume :=
      exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi r (by positivity : 0 < 4 * κ)
    rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_split_r, h_ioc_zero, zero_add, h_ioi_r,
        integral_sub h_int1 h_int2, integral_const_mul,
        integral_exp_neg_mul_Ioi r (2 * κ) (by positivity),
        integral_exp_neg_mul_Ioi r (4 * κ) (by positivity)]
    have h_exp_prod : Real.exp (-2 * κ * r) * (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * r) / (2 * κ)) =

      have he3 : -2 * κ * r + -(2 * κ) * r = -(4 * κ) * r := by ring

      dsimp [r]
      ring
    rw [h_exp_prod, h_4r]
    have : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
    field_simp
    ring
  have s2 : ∀ (y z : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * (|x - y| + |y - z| + |z - x|))) volume ∧

        (|y - z| + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) := by
    intro y z
    let m : ℝ := (y + z) / 2
    let r : ℝ := |y - z| / 2

      rw [h_sum1]
      have he1 : -κ * (2 * r + 2 * max |x - m| r) = -2 * κ * r - 2 * κ * max |x - m| r := by ring

      rw [h_eq_shift]
      exact hg_int.comp_sub_right m
    refine ⟨h_int_lhs, ?_⟩
    rw [h_eq_shift, integral_sub_right_eq_self g m]
    have h_split0 : ∫ u : ℝ, g u = (∫ u in Set.Iic 0, g u) + (∫ u in Set.Ioi 0, g u) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg_int.integrableOn hg_int.integrableOn).symm
    have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ u in Set.Iic 0, g u) = ∫ u in Set.Ioi 0, g u := by
      have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g

      rw [← h_neg]

      exact (hg_even u).symm
    have h_split_r : (∫ u in Set.Ioi 0, g u) = (∫ u in Set.Ioc 0 r, g u) + (∫ u in Set.Ioi r, g u) := by
      rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hr_nn]
      exact setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hg_int.integrableOn hg_int.integrableOn
    have h_ioc_val : (∫ u in Set.Ioc 0 r, g u) = r * Real.exp (-4 * κ * r) := by
      have h_congr : (∫ u in Set.Ioc 0 r, g u) = ∫ u in Set.Ioc 0 r, Real.exp (-4 * κ * r) := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc ?_
        intro u hu
        dsimp [g]
        have hu_pos : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu.1
        have hu_le : |u| ≤ r := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_pos]; exact hu.2
        rw [max_eq_right hu_le]
        have : -2 * κ * r - 2 * κ * r = -4 * κ * r := by ring
        rw [this]
      rw [h_congr, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, Measure.real_def, Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero,

        ∫ u in Set.Ioi r, Real.exp (-2 * κ * r) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * u) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_

        rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn]

      rw [h_max]
      have he1 : -2 * κ * r - 2 * κ * u = -2 * κ * r + -(2 * κ) * u := by ring
      rw [he1, Real.exp_add]
    rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_split_r, h_ioc_val, h_ioi_r,

    have h_exp_prod : Real.exp (-2 * κ * r) * (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * r) / (2 * κ)) =
        Real.exp (-4 * κ * r) / (2 * κ) := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      have he3 : -2 * κ * r + -(2 * κ) * r = -4 * κ * r := by ring
      rw [he3]
    have h_4r : -4 * κ * r = -2 * κ * |y - z| := by
      dsimp [r]
      ring
    have h_2r : 2 * r = |y - z| := by
      dsimp [r]
      ring
    rw [h_exp_prod, h_4r]
    calc (r * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) + Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) / (2 * κ)) +

      _ = (2 * r + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) := by
          field_simp
          ring
      _ = (|y - z| + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) := by rw [h_2r]
  have h1 := s1 0 s
  have h2 := s2 0 s
  have h_fn1 :
      (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * (|u| + |s| + |u - s|)) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * (|u| + |u - s|))) =
      (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * (|x - 0| + |0 - s| + |s - x|)) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * (|x - 0| + |x - s|))) := by
    ext u

      (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * (|u| + |s| + |u - s|))) =
      (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * (|x - 0| + |0 - s| + |s - x|))) := by
    ext u
    rw [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_sub_comm s u]
  rw [← h_fn1] at h1
  rw [← h_fn2] at h2
  rw [zero_sub, abs_neg] at h1 h2

proof.tactics:
by
  set w_fn : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw_cont : Continuous w_fn := w.2.1.continuous
  have hw_per : Function.Periodic w_fn 1 := w.2.2
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  obtain ⟨x₀, _, hx₀_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
    (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) (hw_cont.abs.continuousOn)
  set B_w : ℝ := |w_fn x₀|
  have hBw_nn : 0 ≤ B_w := abs_nonneg _
  have hw_bound : ∀ z : ℝ, |w_fn z| ≤ B_w := by
    intro z
    have h_eq : w_fn z = w_fn (Int.fract z) := by
      have h1 := hw_per.int_mul ⌊z⌋ (Int.fract z)
      have h2 : Int.fract z + (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) * 1 = z := by
        linarith [Int.self_sub_floor z]
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hx₀_max ⟨Int.fract_nonneg z, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one z)⟩
  have hw_prod_bound : ∀ y z : ℝ, |w_fn y * w_fn z| ≤ B_w ^ 2 := by
    intro y z
    rw [abs_mul, sq]
    exact mul_le_mul (hw_bound y) (hw_bound z) (abs_nonneg _) hBw_nn
  let E_κ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (-κ * |u|)
  have hE_cont : Continuous E_κ := by dsimp [E_κ]; fun_prop
  have hE_nn : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ E_κ u := fun u => (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hE_Ici : IntegrableOn E_κ (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * u)) (Set.Ici 0) volume :=
      (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
    refine h1.congr_fun (fun u hu => ?_) measurableSet_Ici
    dsimp [E_κ]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Set.mem_Ici.mp hu)]
  have hE_Iic : IntegrableOn E_κ (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
    have h1 := hE_Ici.comp_neg
    rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h1
    refine h1.congr_fun (fun u _ => ?_) measurableSet_Iic
    dsimp [E_κ]
    rw [abs_neg]
  have hE_int : Integrable E_κ volume := by
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact hE_Iic.union (hE_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  let Kt1 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u v =>
    Real.exp (-κ * (|u| + |u - v| + |v|)) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * (|u| + |v|))
  let Kt2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u v =>
    Real.exp (-κ * (|u| + |u - v| + |v|))
  have hK1_nn : ∀ u v : ℝ, 0 ≤ Kt1 u v := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [Kt1]
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have h_tri : |u - v| ≤ |u| + |v| := by
      simpa [sub_zero] using abs_sub_le u 0 v

  have hK2_le : ∀ u v : ℝ, Kt2 u v ≤ E_κ u * E_κ v := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [Kt2, E_κ]
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (u - v)]
  have hK1_le : ∀ u v : ℝ, Kt1 u v ≤ E_κ u * E_κ v := by
    intro u v
    have h_pos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-2 * κ * (|u| + |v|)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    linarith [hK2_le u v]
  have h_exp2_le : ∀ u v : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * (|u| + |v|)) ≤ E_κ u * E_κ v := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [E_κ]
    rw [← Real.exp_add]

  have h_g1_shift : ∀ x z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w_fn 1 x z =
      -(1 / (4 * κ ^ 2)) * ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-κ * (|u| + |x + u - z|)) * w_fn (x + u) := by

      (fun y : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x y * w_fn y * freeGreenKernel κ y z) x

    have h_fn : (fun u : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x (x + u) * w_fn (x + u) * freeGreenKernel κ (x + u) z) =

      ext u

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · let J₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |s|)

      intro s

      have h1 : 1 / (2 * κ) ≤ 1 / κ := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hκ_pos]
        linarith
      have h2 : Real.exp (-2 * κ * |s|) ≤ Real.exp (-κ * |s|) := by

    have h_fold1 := h_fold Kt1 J₁ hK1_cont hK1_nn hK1_le hK1_ker hJ1_le
    dsimp [alphaQuadFunctionalT]
    have h_dens_fn : (fun x : ℝ => alphaQuadDensity κ w_fn x) =

    field_simp

    have hK2_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry Kt2) := by

        rw [sub_sub_cancel]

    have hJ2_le : ∀ s : ℝ, J₂ s ≤ (1 / κ) * E_κ s := by
      intro s
      dsimp [J₂, E_κ]
      have h_alg : |s| + 1 / κ = (1 / κ) * (κ * |s| + 1) := by

      have h_exp_bound : κ * |s| + 1 ≤ Real.exp (κ * |s|) :=

        _ = (1 / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * |s|) := by

          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
    have h_fold2 := h_fold Kt2 J₂ hK2_cont hK2_nn hK2_le hK2_ker hJ2_le

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have laplace_cos_integral_Ioi :
      ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v) =
        2 * κ / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    have h_den : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by positivity
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
      Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * (-2 * κ * Real.cos (b * v) + b * Real.sin (b * v)) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
      dsimp [F]
      fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * x)) (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * (-(2 * κ))) v := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -(2 * κ) * x) (-(2 * κ)) v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-(2 * κ))
        exact h1.exp
      have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => b * x) b v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul b
      have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (b * x)) (-Real.sin (b * v) * b) v := hd_lin.cos
      have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (b * x)) (Real.cos (b * v) * b) v := hd_lin.sin
      have hd_trig : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -2 * κ * Real.cos (b * x) + b * Real.sin (b * x))
          (-2 * κ * (-Real.sin (b * v) * b) + b * (Real.cos (b * v) * b)) v :=
        (hd_cos.const_mul (-2 * κ)).add (hd_sin.const_mul b)
      have hd_prod := (hd_exp.mul hd_trig).div_const (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
      convert hd_prod using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have hf_int : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) := by fun_prop
      refine (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 (by positivity : 0 < 2 * κ)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v _
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * |Real.cos (b * v)|
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) := mul_one _
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      let C : ℝ := (2 * κ + |b|) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
      apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun v => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * C)
      · intro v

                  abs_of_pos hκ_pos]

              gcongr
              · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
              · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
          _ = 2 * κ + |b| := by ring
      · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = 0 * C by ring]
        apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const
        apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
        have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (2 * κ) * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by positivity) Filter.tendsto_id
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -(2 * κ) * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -((2 * κ) * x)) := by ext x; ring
        change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -(2 * κ) * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv hf_int hF_lim
    rw [h_res]
    dsimp [F]
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]

  have laplace_linear_cos_integral_Ioi :
      ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v) =
        (12 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    let D : ℝ := 4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2
