    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * P v / (κ * D ^ 2)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
      dsimp [F, P, D]
      fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F ((v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * x)) (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * (-(2 * κ))) v := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -(2 * κ) * x) (-(2 * κ)) v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-(2 * κ))
        exact h1.exp
      have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => b * x) b v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul b
      have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (b * x)) (-Real.sin (b * v) * b) v := hd_lin.cos
      have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (b * x)) (Real.cos (b * v) * b) v := hd_lin.sin
      have hd_kv1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (κ * x + 1) * D) (κ * 1 * D) v := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => κ * x + 1) (κ * 1) v :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul κ).add_const 1
        exact h1.mul_const D
      have hd_trig1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -2 * κ * Real.cos (b * x) + b * Real.sin (b * x))
          (-2 * κ * (-Real.sin (b * v) * b) + b * (Real.cos (b * v) * b)) v :=
        (hd_cos.const_mul (-2 * κ)).add (hd_sin.const_mul b)
      have hd_trig2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => κ * ((4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * x) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * x)))
          (κ * ((4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * (-Real.sin (b * v) * b) - 4 * κ * b * (Real.cos (b * v) * b))) v :=
        ((hd_cos.const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2)).sub (hd_sin.const_mul (4 * κ * b))).const_mul κ
      have hd_P : HasDerivAt P
          (κ * 1 * D * (-2 * κ * Real.cos (b * v) + b * Real.sin (b * v)) +

        (hd_kv1.mul hd_trig1).sub hd_trig2
      have hd_prod := (hd_exp.mul hd_P).div_const (κ * D ^ 2)
      convert hd_prod using 1
      dsimp [P, D]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_lin_exp_le : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) ≤ (1 / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * v) := by
      intro v hv
      have h1 : κ * v + 1 ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) := by
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (κ * v)]
      have h2 : v + 1 / κ = (κ * v + 1) / κ := by field_simp
      rw [h2, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_div_mul_eq_div]
      gcongr
      calc (κ * v + 1) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v)
        _ ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-κ * v) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            congr 1
            ring
    have hf_int : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v)) := by fun_prop
      refine ((exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hκ_pos).const_mul (1 / κ)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v hv
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt hv

        _ = (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) := mul_one _
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * v) := h_lin_exp_le v hv_nn
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      let C_P : ℝ := D * (2 * κ + |b|) + κ * (D + 4 * κ * |b|)
      let C_F : ℝ := C_P / (κ * D ^ 2)
      apply squeeze_zero_norm' (a := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * v) * C_F)
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with v hv
        dsimp [F, C_F]
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < κ * D ^ 2), ← mul_div_assoc]
        have h_P_bound : |P v| ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) * C_P := by
          dsimp [P, C_P]
          have h_kv_nn : 0 ≤ κ * v + 1 := by positivity
          have h_kv_exp : κ * v + 1 ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (κ * v)]
          have h_exp_ge_one : 1 ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)

                  · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _

            rw [abs_le]

          have h_trig2 : |(4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * v) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * v)| ≤ D + 4 * κ * |b| := by
            calc |(4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * v) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * v)|

              _ = |4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2| * |Real.cos (b * v)| + 4 * κ * |b| * |Real.sin (b * v)| := by
                  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4), abs_of_pos hκ_pos]
              _ ≤ D * 1 + 4 * κ * |b| * 1 := by
                  gcongr
                  · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
                  · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
              _ = D + 4 * κ * |b| := by ring
          calc |(κ * v + 1) * D * (-2 * κ * Real.cos (b * v) + b * Real.sin (b * v)) -
                κ * ((4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * v) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * v))|
            _ ≤ |(κ * v + 1) * D * (-2 * κ * Real.cos (b * v) + b * Real.sin (b * v))| +
                |κ * ((4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * v) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * v))| := abs_sub _ _
            _ = (κ * v + 1) * D * |-2 * κ * Real.cos (b * v) + b * Real.sin (b * v)| +
                κ * |(4 * κ ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * Real.cos (b * v) - 4 * κ * b * Real.sin (b * v)| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h_kv_nn, abs_of_pos hD_pos, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hκ_pos]
            _ ≤ Real.exp (κ * v) * D * (2 * κ + |b|) + (Real.exp (κ * v) * κ) * (D + 4 * κ * |b|) := by
                gcongr
                exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) h_exp_ge_one
            _ = Real.exp (κ * v) * (D * (2 * κ + |b|) + κ * (D + 4 * κ * |b|)) := by ring
        have h_num : Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * |P v| ≤ Real.exp (-κ * v) * C_P :=
          calc Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * |P v|
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * (Real.exp (κ * v) * C_P) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_P_bound (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = (Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.exp (κ * v)) * C_P := by ring
            _ = Real.exp (-κ * v) * C_P := by
                rw [← Real.exp_add]
                congr 2
                ring
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
      · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = 0 * C_F by ring]
        apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const
        apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
        have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hκ_pos Filter.tendsto_id
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(κ * x)) := by ext x; ring
        change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv hf_int hF_lim
    rw [h_res]
    dsimp [F, P, D]
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · let f_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |v|)

      refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      dsimp [g_cos]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
      calc f_R v * |Real.cos (b * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
      _ = f_R v := mul_one _
    have h_cos_val : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = 4 * κ / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
      have h_even : ∀ v : ℝ, g_cos (-v) = g_cos v := by
        intro v
        dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
        rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
      have h_split0 : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) :=

      have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v := by
        have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g_cos

        rw [← h_neg]
        congr 1 with v
        exact (h_even v).symm

          ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v) := by

      have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))

      intro v hv

      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]

      have h_neg := h_exp_Ici.comp_neg

    have hf_R_int : Integrable f_R volume := by
      refine (h_exp_int.const_mul (1 / κ)).mono' hf_R_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
      exact hf_R_le v
    let g_cos : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.cos (b * v)
    have hg_cos_int : Integrable g_cos volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous g_cos := by dsimp [g_cos, f_R]; fun_prop
      refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      dsimp [g_cos]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
      calc f_R v * |Real.cos (b * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
      _ = f_R v := mul_one _
    have h_cos_val : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = 2 * (12 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h_even : ∀ v : ℝ, g_cos (-v) = g_cos v := by
        intro v
        dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
        rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
      have h_split0 : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg_cos_int.integrableOn hg_cos_int.integrableOn).symm
      have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v := by
        have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g_cos
        rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
        rw [← h_neg]
        congr 1 with v
        exact (h_even v).symm
      have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) =
          ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, (v + 1 / κ) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * v) * Real.cos (b * v) := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
        intro v hv
        dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
        have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv
        rw [abs_of_pos hv_pos]
        have : -2 * κ * v = -(2 * κ) * v := by ring
        rw [this]
      rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_ioi_eq, laplace_linear_cos_integral_Ioi]
      ring
    have h_bound : 2 * (12 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 8 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
      have h_num : 2 * (12 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ 8 * (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg κ, sq_nonneg b]
      calc 2 * (12 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2
        _ ≤ 8 * (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = 8 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
            have : 4 * κ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
            field_simp
    exact ⟨hg_cos_int, h_cos_val, h_bound⟩

    let f₁ : ℤ → ℝ := fun m => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)
    let f₂ : ℤ → ℝ := fun m => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2)
    have hf₁ : Summable f₁ ∧ (∑' m : ℤ, f₁ m) ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ := h_single_add η
    have hf₂_eq : f₂ = (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ((η - 2 * π * n) + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) := by
      ext m
      dsimp [f₂]
      congr 2
      ring
    have hf₂ : Summable f₂ ∧ (∑' m : ℤ, f₂ m) ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ := by
      rw [hf₂_eq]
      exact h_single_add (η - 2 * π * n)
    have h_pw : ∀ m : ℤ, f₁ m * f₂ m ≤ (2 / D_n) * (f₁ m + f₂ m) := by
      intro m
      dsimp [f₁, f₂]
      set A : ℝ := η + 2 * π * (m : ℝ)
      set B : ℝ := η + 2 * π * ((m : ℝ) - (n : ℝ))
      have hAB : A - B = 2 * π * (n : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [A, B]
        ring
      have h_ineq : D_n ≤ 2 * (κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) + 2 * (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2) := by
        have h_id : 2 * (κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) + 2 * (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2) - D_n = (A + B) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [D_n]
          rw [← hAB]
          ring
        linarith [sq_nonneg (A + B)]
      have hA_pos : 0 < κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2 := h_denom_pos A
      have hB_pos : 0 < κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2 := h_denom_pos B
      have h_lhs_eq : (1 / (κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2)) * (1 / (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2)) =
          1 / ((κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2)) := one_div_mul_one_div _ _
      have h_rhs_eq : (2 / D_n) * (1 / (κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) + 1 / (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2)) =
          (2 * (κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) + 2 * (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2)) /
            (D_n * ((κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2))) := by
        have : D_n ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDn_pos
        have : κ ^ 2 + A ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA_pos
        have : κ ^ 2 + B ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB_pos
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq, div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hA_pos hB_pos) (mul_pos hDn_pos (mul_pos hA_pos hB_pos))]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hA_pos hB_pos]
    have h_dom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℤ => (2 / D_n) * (f₁ m + f₂ m)) :=
      (hf₁.1.add hf₂.1).mul_left (2 / D_n)
    have h_prod_sum : Summable (fun m : ℤ => f₁ m * f₂ m) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => by dsimp [f₁, f₂]; positivity) h_pw h_dom_sum
    have h_pi_169 : 4 * (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) ≤ 169 := by
      nlinarith [hpi_pos, hpi_lt]
    refine ⟨h_prod_sum, ?_⟩
    calc (∑' m : ℤ, f₁ m * f₂ m)
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℤ, (2 / D_n) * (f₁ m + f₂ m) :=
          h_prod_sum.tsum_le_tsum h_pw h_dom_sum
      _ = (2 / D_n) * ∑' m : ℤ, (f₁ m + f₂ m) := tsum_mul_left
      _ = (2 / D_n) * ((∑' m : ℤ, f₁ m) + (∑' m : ℤ, f₂ m)) := by
          rw [hf₁.1.tsum_add hf₂.1]
      _ ≤ (2 / D_n) * ((4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ + (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hf₁.2 hf₂.2) (by positivity)
      _ = (4 * (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ) * (1 / D_n) := by ring
      _ ≤ (169 / κ) * (1 / D_n) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_pi_169 (by positivity)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ξ
    let f : ℤ → ℝ := fun m => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)
    have hf : Summable f ∧ (∑' m : ℤ, f m) ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ := h_single_add ξ
    have h_comp : (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) = f ∘ (Equiv.neg ℤ) := by
      ext m
      dsimp [f, Equiv.neg]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_sum : Summable (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) := by
      rw [h_comp]
      exact (Equiv.summable_iff (Equiv.neg ℤ)).mpr hf.1
    have h_pi_41 : 4 * π ^ 2 + 1 ≤ 41 := by
      nlinarith [hpi_pos, hpi_lt]
    refine ⟨h_sum, ?_⟩
    calc (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * m) ^ 2))
      _ = ∑' m : ℤ, f (Equiv.neg ℤ m) := by
          congr 1
      _ = ∑' m : ℤ, f m := Equiv.tsum_eq (Equiv.neg ℤ) f
      _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 + 1) / κ := hf.2
      _ ≤ 41 / κ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_pi_41 (by positivity)
  · intro η c hc_nn hc_sum
    let K : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ := fun m n =>
      (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
        (c n / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))
    have hK_nn : ∀ m n : ℤ, 0 ≤ K m n := by
      intro m n
      dsimp [K]
      have := hc_nn n
      positivity
    have hK_eq : ∀ m n : ℤ, K m n = c n *
        ((1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
          (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) := by
      intro m n
      dsimp [K]
      ring
    have hK_sum_m : ∀ n : ℤ, Summable (fun m : ℤ => K m n) := by
      intro n
      have h_fn : (fun m : ℤ => K m n) =
          (fun m : ℤ => c n * ((1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
            (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2)))) := by
        ext m; exact hK_eq m n
      rw [h_fn]
      exact (h_prod_bound η n).1.mul_left (c n)
    have hK_tsum_m : ∀ n : ℤ,
        (∑' m : ℤ, K m n) ≤ (169 / κ) * (c n / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by
      intro n
      have h_fn : (fun m : ℤ => K m n) =
          (fun m : ℤ => c n * ((1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
            (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2)))) := by
        ext m; exact hK_eq m n
      calc (∑' m : ℤ, K m n)
        _ = ∑' m : ℤ, c n * ((1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
              (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) := by rw [h_fn]
        _ = c n * ∑' m : ℤ, ((1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
              (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) := tsum_mul_left
        _ ≤ c n * ((169 / κ) * (1 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_prod_bound η n).2 (hc_nn n)
        _ = (169 / κ) * (c n / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by ring
    have hc_w : Summable (fun n : ℤ => c n / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by have := hc_nn n; positivity) (fun n => ?_) hc_sum
      have h_ge1 : 1 ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))]
      exact div_le_self (hc_nn n) h_ge1
    have h_sum_n_tsum_m : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ∑' m : ℤ, K m n) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => tsum_nonneg (fun m => hK_nn m n))
        hK_tsum_m
        (hc_w.mul_left (169 / κ))
    have hK_swap : Summable (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => K p.2 p.1) :=
      (summable_prod_of_nonneg (f := fun p : ℤ × ℤ => K p.2 p.1)
        (fun p => hK_nn p.2 p.1)).mpr ⟨hK_sum_m, h_sum_n_tsum_m⟩
    have hK_uncurry : Summable (Function.uncurry K) := by
      have h_comp : (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => K p.2 p.1) = (Function.uncurry K) ∘ (Equiv.prodComm ℤ ℤ) :=
        rfl
      rw [h_comp] at hK_swap
      exact (Equiv.summable_iff (Equiv.prodComm ℤ ℤ)).mp hK_swap
    have hK_prod := (summable_prod_of_nonneg (f := Function.uncurry K)
      (fun p => hK_nn p.1 p.2)).mp hK_uncurry
    have h_inner_eq : (fun m : ℤ =>
        (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
          (∑' n : ℤ, c n / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) =
        (fun m : ℤ => ∑' n : ℤ, K m n) := by
      ext m
      dsimp [K]
      exact tsum_mul_left.symm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_inner_eq]
      exact hK_prod.2
    · calc (∑' m : ℤ,
          (1 / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
            (∑' n : ℤ, c n / (κ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2)))
        _ = ∑' m : ℤ, ∑' n : ℤ, K m n := by rw [h_inner_eq]
        _ = ∑' n : ℤ, ∑' m : ℤ, K m n := hK_uncurry.tsum_comm.symm
        _ ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, (169 / κ) * (c n / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) :=
            h_sum_n_tsum_m.tsum_le_tsum hK_tsum_m (hc_w.mul_left (169 / κ))
        _ = (169 / κ) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := tsum_mul_left

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 := fun η => by positivity
  have h_denom_ge1 : ∀ η : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 := fun η => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (κ - 1)]
  have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) volume :=
    (KdV.freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq κ hκ).1.1
  let c : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2
  have hc_nn : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ c n := fun n => sq_nonneg _
  have hc_sum : Summable c := by
    set S₁ := ∑' m : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) m‖
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hc_nn (fun n => ?_) (h_fc.1.mul_left S₁)
    dsimp [c]
    have h_le : ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ≤ S₁ :=
      h_fc.1.le_tsum n (fun m _ => norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2
      _ = ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ := sq _
      _ ≤ S₁ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le (norm_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨M_ℓ, hM_ℓ_nn, hM_ℓ⟩ := h_pkt_ℓ.2
  obtain ⟨M_succ, hM_succ_nn, hM_succ⟩ := h_pkt_succ.2
  
  have h_s3 : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ≤
        ∑' n : ℤ,
          ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ *
            ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
    intro ξ
    have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
        ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ *
          ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) (h_fc.1.mul_left M_ℓ)
      have h_num : ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ≤
          M_ℓ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM_ℓ _) (norm_nonneg _)
      calc ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ /
            (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * n) ^ 2)
        _ ≤ ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ / 1 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) zero_lt_one (h_denom_ge1 _)
        _ = ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ := div_one _
        _ ≤ M_ℓ * ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ := h_num
    let F : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n z =>
      fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n *
        (Complex.exp (-(((ξ - 2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) *
          (greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x z : ℂ))
    let bound : ℤ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n z =>
      ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ * ‖greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x z‖
    let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun z =>
      Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) *
        ((greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x z * (w : ℝ → ℝ) z : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hF_meas : ∀ n : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) volume := by
      intro n
      refine Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine continuous_const.mul (Continuous.mul ?_ (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_G.1))
      exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).neg).mul continuous_const)
    have hF_bound : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F n z‖ ≤ bound n z := by
      intro n
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_
      dsimp [F, bound]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul,
          show -(((ξ - 2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-((ξ - 2 * π * n) * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,

    rw [h_UV_eq_h_tsum, ← integral_const_mul]
    exact integral_mono hh_tsum_int (hA_sq_int.const_mul K_c) hh_tsum_le
  
  have h_A_succ_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      ((h_pkt_succ.1.norm).pow 2).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ))
    refine (h_inv_int.const_mul (M_succ ^ 2)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))]
    have h_sq : ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_succ ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hM_succ ξ) 2
    calc ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
      _ ≤ M_succ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
      _ = M_succ ^ 2 * (1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by ring
  have h_pw_le : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤
        U ξ * (V ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro ξ
    have h_sq_le : ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ U ξ * V ξ := by
      calc ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2
        _ ≤ (∑' n : ℤ,
              ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * n)‖ *
                ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ / (κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * n) ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h_s3 ξ) 2
        _ ≤ U ξ * V ξ :=
          h_s4 (fun n => A (ξ - 2 * π * n)) (fun n => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖)
            (fun n => κ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * n) ^ 2)
            (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ => h_denom_pos _)
            (hα_sum ξ) (hβ_sum ξ)
    calc ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
      _ ≤ (U ξ * V ξ) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq_le (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
      _ = U ξ * (V ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by ring
  have h_int_le :
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
        K_c * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
    le_trans (integral_mono h_A_succ_int h_UV_int h_pw_le) h_s5
  intro r
  have h_hm1_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
    rw [h_fc.2.2.2]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (tsum_nonneg (fun n => div_nonneg (hc_nn n) (by positivity)))
  have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = K_c := by
    dsimp [r, K_c, c]
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h_hm1_nn, h_fc.2.2.2]
    ring
  rw [hr_sq]
  calc (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
    _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) * (K_c * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (by positivity)
    _ = K_c * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(δ_ode : ℝ)
    (h_ode : ∀ (E : ℝ), 1 ≤ E → ∀ (w : CinfT),
      hm1KappaSqT E (ιT w) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * E →
      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
      Function.Periodic (diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * E)) x =
          2 * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          4 * (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (fun y => diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * E)) x +
          4 * E ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => diagGreen E (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * E)) x)
    (κ M : ℝ) (hκ : 2 ≤ κ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (w : CinfT)
    (hwM : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT w) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * M)
    (hwκ : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * κ) :
    Continuous (regFlowRHS κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    Function.Periodic (regFlowRHS κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      (1 / (2 * M) - diagGreen M (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) * regFlowRHS κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_cont_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (j : ℕ),
      Continuous (iteratedDeriv j f) := by
    intro f hf j
    exact hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (le_of_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top j)))
  have h_hasDerivAt_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv j f) (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) f x) x := by
    intro f hf j x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact (hf.differentiable_iteratedDeriv j (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top j)) x).hasDerivAt
  have h_hasDerivAt_zero : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt f (iteratedDeriv 1 f x) x := by
    intro f hf x
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_hasDerivAt_iter f hf 0 x
  have h_per_deriv : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → Function.Periodic (deriv f) 1 := by
    intro f hf x
    have h_shift : (fun y : ℝ => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hf
    have h_comp := deriv_comp_add_const f 1 x
    rw [h_shift] at h_comp
    exact h_comp.symm
  have h_per_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → ∀ (j : ℕ),
      Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv j f) 1 := by
    intro f hf j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact hf
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact h_per_deriv (iteratedDeriv j f) ih
  have h_per_one_eq_zero : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → f 1 = f 0 := by
    intro f hf
    simpa using hf 0
  have h_ftc_per : ∀ (F f : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (f x) x) →
      Continuous f →
      F 1 = F 0 →
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x) = 0 := by
    intro F f hF hf_cont hF_per
    have h_eq := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun x _ => hF x) (hf_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [h_eq, hF_per, sub_self]
  let w0 : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w0 := w.property.1
  have hw_per : Function.Periodic w0 1 := w.property.2
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hgM_smooth, hgM_per, hgM_ode⟩ := h_ode M hM w hwM
  obtain ⟨hgκ_smooth, hgκ_per, hgκ_ode⟩ := h_ode κ hκ1 w hwκ
  have h_cont_rhs : Continuous (regFlowRHS κ w0) := by
    unfold regFlowRHS
    have hd_gκ : Continuous (deriv (diagGreen κ w0)) := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact h_cont_iter (diagGreen κ w0) hgκ_smooth 1
    have hd_w0 : Continuous (deriv w0) := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact h_cont_iter w0 hw_smooth 1
    exact (continuous_const.mul hd_gκ).add (continuous_const.mul hd_w0)
  have h_per_rhs : Function.Periodic (regFlowRHS κ w0) 1 := by
    intro x
    unfold regFlowRHS
    have hd_gκ := h_per_deriv (diagGreen κ w0) hgκ_per x
    have hd_w0 := h_per_deriv w0 hw_per x
    rw [hd_gκ, hd_w0]
  refine ⟨h_cont_rhs, h_per_rhs, ?_⟩
  let m0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => diagGreen M w0 y - 1 / (2 * M)
  let k0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => diagGreen κ w0 y - 1 / (2 * κ)
  have hm0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) m0 := hgM_smooth.sub contDiff_const
  have hk0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) k0 := hgκ_smooth.sub contDiff_const
  have hm0_per : Function.Periodic m0 1 := by
    intro x
    dsimp [m0]
    rw [hgM_per x]
  have hk0_per : Function.Periodic k0 1 := by
    intro x
    dsimp [k0]
    rw [hgκ_per x]
  let w1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 w0
  let m1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 m0
  let m2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 m0
  let m3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 m0
  let k1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 k0
  let k2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 k0
  let k3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 k0
  have hw0_cont : Continuous w0 := hw_smooth.continuous
  have hw1_cont : Continuous w1 := h_cont_iter w0 hw_smooth 1
  have hm0_cont : Continuous m0 := hm0_smooth.continuous
  have hk0_cont : Continuous k0 := hk0_smooth.continuous
  have hk1_cont : Continuous k1 := h_cont_iter k0 hk0_smooth 1
  have hw0_eq1 : w0 1 = w0 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero w0 hw_per
  have hm0_eq1 : m0 1 = m0 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero m0 hm0_per
  have hm1_eq1 : m1 1 = m1 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero m1 (h_per_iter m0 hm0_per 1)
  have hm2_eq1 : m2 1 = m2 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero m2 (h_per_iter m0 hm0_per 2)
  have hk0_eq1 : k0 1 = k0 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero k0 hk0_per
  have hk1_eq1 : k1 1 = k1 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero k1 (h_per_iter k0 hk0_per 1)
  have hk2_eq1 : k2 1 = k2 0 := h_per_one_eq_zero k2 (h_per_iter k0 hk0_per 2)
  have hgM_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen M w0 x = m0 x + 1 / (2 * M) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [m0]
    ring
  have hgκ_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w0 x = k0 x + 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [k0]
    ring
  have hw1_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv w0 x = w1 x := by
    intro x
    dsimp [w1]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
  have hm1_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv m0 x = m1 x := by
    intro x
    dsimp [m1]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
  have hk1_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv k0 x = k1 x := by
    intro x
    dsimp [k1]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
  have h_deriv_gκ : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (diagGreen κ w0) x = k1 x := by
    intro x
    have h_sub : deriv k0 x = deriv (diagGreen κ w0) x := by
      dsimp [k0]
      exact deriv_sub_const (1 / (2 * κ))
    rw [← h_sub, hk1_eq x]
  have hm3_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, m3 x =
      2 * w1 x * (m0 x + 1 / (2 * M)) + 4 * w0 x * m1 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * m1 x := by
    intro x
    have hx := hgM_ode x
    change m3 x = 2 * deriv w0 x * diagGreen M w0 x +
      4 * w0 x * deriv m0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * deriv m0 x at hx
    rw [hw1_eq x, hgM_eq x, hm1_eq x] at hx
    exact hx
  have hk3_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, k3 x =
      2 * w1 x * (k0 x + 1 / (2 * κ)) + 4 * w0 x * k1 x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * k1 x := by
    intro x
    have hx := hgκ_ode x
    change k3 x = 2 * deriv w0 x * diagGreen κ w0 x +
      4 * w0 x * deriv k0 x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv k0 x at hx
    rw [hw1_eq x, hgκ_eq x, hk1_eq x] at hx
    exact hx
  have h_integrand : (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * M) - diagGreen M w0 x) * regFlowRHS κ w0 x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => -16 * κ ^ 5 * (m0 x * k1 x) - 4 * κ ^ 2 * (m0 x * w1 x)) := by
    ext x
    unfold regFlowRHS
    rw [hgM_eq x, h_deriv_gκ x, hw1_eq x]
    ring
  rw [h_integrand]
  have h_drift : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, m0 x * w1 x) = 0 := by
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      2 * (w0 x * m0 x) - (1 / 2) * m2 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * w0 x + 2 * M ^ 2 * m0 x
    have hΦ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt Φ (m0 x * w1 x) x := by
      intro x
      have hw0_d : HasDerivAt w0 (w1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero w0 hw_smooth x
      have hm0_d : HasDerivAt m0 (m1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero m0 hm0_smooth x
      have hm2_d : HasDerivAt m2 (m3 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_iter m0 hm0_smooth 2 x
      have hd : HasDerivAt Φ
          (2 * (w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) - (1 / 2) * m3 x +
            (1 / (2 * M)) * w1 x + 2 * M ^ 2 * m1 x) x :=
        ((((hw0_d.mul hm0_d).const_mul 2).sub (hm2_d.const_mul (1 / 2))).add
          (hw0_d.const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add (hm0_d.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2))
      convert hd using 1
      rw [hm3_eq x]
      have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      ring
    have hΦ_per : Φ 1 = Φ 0 := by
      dsimp [Φ]
      rw [hw0_eq1, hm0_eq1, hm2_eq1]
    exact h_ftc_per Φ (fun x => m0 x * w1 x) hΦ_deriv (hm0_cont.mul hw1_cont) hΦ_per
  have h_bilin : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, m0 x * k1 x) = 0 := by
    by_cases hMκ : M = κ
    · have hm0_eq_k0 : m0 = k0 := by
        dsimp [m0, k0]
        subst hMκ
        rfl
      have h_eq_fn : (fun x : ℝ => m0 x * k1 x) = (fun x : ℝ => k0 x * k1 x) := by
        ext x
        rw [hm0_eq_k0]
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      let S : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (1 / 2) * (k0 x * k0 x)
      have hS_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt S (k0 x * k1 x) x := by
        intro x
        have hk0_d : HasDerivAt k0 (k1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero k0 hk0_smooth x
        have hd : HasDerivAt S ((1 / 2) * (k1 x * k0 x + k0 x * k1 x)) x :=
          (hk0_d.mul hk0_d).const_mul (1 / 2)
        convert hd using 1
        ring
      have hS_per : S 1 = S 0 := by
        dsimp [S]
        rw [hk0_eq1]
      exact h_ftc_per S (fun x => k0 x * k1 x) hS_deriv (hk0_cont.mul hk1_cont) hS_per
    · let Ω : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
        ((1 / (2 * κ)) * m2 x + m2 x * k0 x - m1 x * k1 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * k2 x + m0 x * k2 x) -
        ((1 / (M * κ)) * w0 x + (2 / M) * (w0 x * k0 x) + (2 / κ) * (w0 x * m0 x) +
          4 * (w0 x * m0 x * k0 x)) -
        ((2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m0 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m0 x * k0 x))
      have hΩ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt Ω (4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) * (m0 x * k1 x)) x := by
        intro x
        have hw0_d : HasDerivAt w0 (w1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero w0 hw_smooth x
        have hm0_d : HasDerivAt m0 (m1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero m0 hm0_smooth x
        have hm1_d : HasDerivAt m1 (m2 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_iter m0 hm0_smooth 1 x
        have hm2_d : HasDerivAt m2 (m3 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_iter m0 hm0_smooth 2 x
        have hk0_d : HasDerivAt k0 (k1 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_zero k0 hk0_smooth x
        have hk1_d : HasDerivAt k1 (k2 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_iter k0 hk0_smooth 1 x
        have hk2_d : HasDerivAt k2 (k3 x) x := h_hasDerivAt_iter k0 hk0_smooth 2 x
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (1 / (2 * κ)) * m2 x + m2 x * k0 x - m1 x * k1 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * k2 x + m0 x * k2 x)
            ((1 / (2 * κ)) * m3 x + (m3 x * k0 x + m2 x * k1 x) - (m2 x * k1 x + m1 x * k2 x) +
              (1 / (2 * M)) * k3 x + (m1 x * k2 x + m0 x * k3 x)) x :=
          (((((hm2_d.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))).add (hm2_d.mul hk0_d)).sub (hm1_d.mul hk1_d)).add
            (hk2_d.const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add (hm0_d.mul hk2_d))
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (1 / (M * κ)) * w0 x + (2 / M) * (w0 x * k0 x) + (2 / κ) * (w0 x * m0 x) +
              4 * (w0 x * m0 x * k0 x))
            ((1 / (M * κ)) * w1 x + (2 / M) * (w1 x * k0 x + w0 x * k1 x) +
              (2 / κ) * (w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) +
              4 * ((w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) * k0 x + (w0 x * m0 x) * k1 x)) x :=
          ((((hw0_d.const_mul (1 / (M * κ))).add ((hw0_d.mul hk0_d).const_mul (2 / M))).add
            ((hw0_d.mul hm0_d).const_mul (2 / κ))).add (((hw0_d.mul hm0_d).mul hk0_d).const_mul 4))
        have hd3 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m0 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m0 x * k0 x))
            ((2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m1 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k1 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m1 x * k0 x + m0 x * k1 x)) x :=
          (((hm0_d.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2 / κ)).add (hk0_d.const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2 / M))).add
            ((hm0_d.mul hk0_d).const_mul (4 * M ^ 2)))
        have hd : HasDerivAt Ω _ x := (hd1.sub hd2).sub hd3
        convert hd using 1
        rw [hm3_eq x, hk3_eq x]
        have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp
        ring
      have hΩ_per : Ω 1 = Ω 0 := by
        dsimp [Ω]
        rw [hw0_eq1, hm0_eq1, hm1_eq1, hm2_eq1, hk0_eq1, hk1_eq1, hk2_eq1]
      have h_ftc := h_ftc_per Ω (fun x => 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) * (m0 x * k1 x))
        hΩ_deriv (continuous_const.mul (hm0_cont.mul hk1_cont)) hΩ_per
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_ftc
      have h_coeff_ne : 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
        have h_diff_ne : κ - M ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hMκ)
        have h_sum_ne : κ + M ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have h_fac : 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) = 4 * (κ - M) * (κ + M) := by ring
        rw [h_fac]
        exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) h_diff_ne) h_sum_ne
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_ftc).resolve_left h_coeff_ne
  have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => -16 * κ ^ 5 * (m0 x * k1 x)) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hm0_cont.mul hk1_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 4 * κ ^ 2 * (m0 x * w1 x)) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hm0_cont.mul hw1_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, h_bilin, h_drift]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_summable : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖g n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro g
    have hg := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp g.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖g‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖g n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have hg := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos g
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hg
    exact hg
  have h_w_nonneg : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      0 ≤ (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    positivity
  have h_w_le_one : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ n : ℤ,
      (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ n
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have h_den : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt h_den)
  have h_cont_hm1_lp : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M →
      Continuous (fun g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 =>
        ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro M hM
    let w : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)
    let m : ℤ → ℂ := fun n => ((Real.sqrt (w n) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hm_sq_eq : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 = w n * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      dsimp [m]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (w n)),
        mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (h_w_nonneg M hM n)]
    have hm_sq_le : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      rw [hm_sq_eq n z]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_w_le_one M hM n)
    have h_mem_T : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Memℓp (fun n : ℤ => m n * g n) 2 := by
      intro g
      rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => hm_sq_le n (g n))
        (h_summable g)
    let T_M : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
      fun g => ⟨fun n => m n * g n, h_mem_T g⟩
    have h_eq : ∀ g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2,
        (∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) = ‖T_M g‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro g
      rw [h_norm_sq (T_M g)]
      congr 1
      ext n
      exact (hm_sq_eq n (g n)).symm
    have h_lip : LipschitzWith 1 T_M := by
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun g₁ g₂ => ?_
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      have h_sub_pt : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖(T_M g₁ - T_M g₂) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(g₁ - g₂) n‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro n
        have h1 : (T_M g₁ - T_M g₂) n = m n * (g₁ - g₂) n := by
          change (T_M g₁) n - (T_M g₂) n = m n * (g₁ n - g₂ n)
          dsimp [T_M]
          ring
        rw [h1]
        exact hm_sq_le n ((g₁ - g₂) n)
      have h_tsum_le : (∑' n : ℤ, ‖(T_M g₁ - T_M g₂) n‖ ^ 2) ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖(g₁ - g₂) n‖ ^ 2 :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_sub_pt (h_summable (T_M g₁ - T_M g₂)) (h_summable (g₁ - g₂))
      rw [← h_norm_sq (g₁ - g₂)] at h_tsum_le
      apply lp.norm_le_of_tsum_le hp_pos (by positivity)
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      calc
        (∑' i : ℤ, ‖(T_M g₁ - T_M g₂) i‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖g₁ - g₂‖ ^ 2 := h_tsum_le
        _ = ((1 : NNReal) * ‖g₁ - g₂‖) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
    have h_fun_eq : (fun g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 =>
        ∑' n : ℤ, ((4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) * ‖g n‖ ^ 2) =
        (fun g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 => ‖T_M g‖ ^ 2) := funext h_eq
    rw [h_fun_eq]
    exact (continuous_pow 2).comp (continuous_norm.comp h_lip.continuous)
  have h_sum_weight : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    have h_sum_g : Summable (fun n : ℤ => (if n = 0 then (1 / 4 : ℝ) else 0) + 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℤ) (1 / 4 : ℝ)).summable.add (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr one_lt_two)
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) h_sum_g
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hn, zero_add, one_div]
      apply inv_anti₀
      · have : 1 ≤ |n| := Int.one_le_abs hn
        have h_cast : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(n : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        have h_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs (n : ℝ)]
        linarith
      · have h_pi : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        have h_eq_pi : (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
        have : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (n : ℝ)
        nlinarith
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ = ‖f x‖ := by
    intro f n x
    have h_exp : -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(2 * π * n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖) ^ 2 * (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro f n
    have h_fc : ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖ := by
      dsimp [fourierCircle]
      calc
        ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖
          ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ :=
            intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖f x‖ := by
            simp only [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 = (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq, mul_comm]
    gcongr
  have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
    simp only [h_rpow]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _) (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ?_
    exact h_sum_weight.mul_left ((∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) ^ 2)
  have h_toHm1T_apply : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ), (toHm1T q : ℤ → ℂ) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro q n
    dsimp [toHm1T]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_int_fourier : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ))
        volume 0 1 := by
    intro q n
    have hq_cont : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h_sub_apply : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      ((toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n =
        hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, h_toHm1T_apply q₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply q₂ n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle]
    rw [← mul_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier q₁ n) (h_int_fourier q₂ n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  let S₀ : ℝ := ∑' n : ℤ, (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹
  have h_norm_sub_le : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT),
      ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ≤ (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) * Real.sqrt S₀ := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    let I_diff : ℝ := ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
    have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ I_diff :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have h_norm_sq_diff : ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ^ 2 =
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h_lp := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos (toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂)
      simp only [h_rpow, h_sub_apply q₁ q₂] at h_lp
      exact h_lp
    have h_sum_lhs : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖hm1ProfileT (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) n‖ ^ 2) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => sq_nonneg _)
        (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x)) ?_
      exact h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2)
    have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ I_diff ^ 2 * S₀ := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_diff, ← tsum_mul_left]
      exact h_sum_lhs.tsum_le_tsum (hm1ProfileT_norm_sq_le (fun x => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x))
        (h_sum_weight.mul_left (I_diff ^ 2))
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hI_nonneg] at h_sqrt
  have h_cinf_bounded : ∀ q : CinfT, ∃ B_q : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_q ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |(q : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ B_q := by
    intro q
    have hq_cont : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have hq_per : Function.Periodic (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 := q.2.2
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hq_cont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0, fun y => ?_⟩
    let y₀ : ℝ := Int.fract y
    have hy₀_mem : y₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨Int.fract_nonneg y, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one y)⟩
    have h_eq : (q : ℝ → ℝ) y = (q : ℝ → ℝ) y₀ := by
      have h_p : (q : ℝ → ℝ) (y - (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1) = (q : ℝ → ℝ) y :=
        hq_per.sub_int_mul_eq (⌊y⌋)
      rw [mul_one] at h_p
      exact h_p.symm
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_le_C : |(q : ℝ → ℝ) y₀| ≤ C := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC y₀ hy₀_mem
    exact le_trans h_le_C (le_max_left C 0)
  have h_cinf_cont_and_taylor : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → ∀ (w : ℝ → CinfT) (v : CinfT) (s : ℝ),
      HasCinfDerivAtT w v s →
      ContinuousAt (fun τ : ℝ => hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w τ))) s ∧
      ∃ B_v : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_v ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, |(v : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ B_v) ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - s| < η →
            (∀ y : ℝ, |(w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ (B_v + 1) * |τ - s|) ∧
            (∀ y : ℝ, |(w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ ε * |τ - s|) := by
    intro M hM w v s hv
    obtain ⟨B_v, hBv_nn, hv_bd⟩ := h_cinf_bounded v
    have h_n0 : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - s| < η → ∀ y : ℝ,
          |(w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ ε * |τ - s| := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨η, hη, h_bd⟩ := hv 0 ε hε
      refine ⟨η, hη, fun τ hτ y => ?_⟩
      have h_y := h_bd τ hτ y
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h_y
      exact h_y
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, h_bd₁⟩ := h_n0 1 zero_lt_one
    have h_diff_bd₁ : ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - s| < η₁ → ∀ y : ℝ,
        |(w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ (B_v + 1) * |τ - s| := by
      intro τ hτ y
      have h1 := h_bd₁ τ hτ y
      have h2 : |(τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ |τ - s| * B_v := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv_bd y) (abs_nonneg _)
      have h_id : (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y =
          ((w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y) +
          (τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y := by ring
      have h_tri := abs_add_le ((w τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y)
        ((τ - s) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) y)
      rw [← h_id] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_contAt_toHm1T : ContinuousAt (fun τ : ℝ => toHm1T (w τ)) s := by
      rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      let C_lip : ℝ := (B_v + 1) * Real.sqrt S₀
      have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => C_lip * |τ - s|) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
        have h_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => C_lip * |τ - s|) :=
          continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)
        simpa using h_cont.tendsto s
      have h_ball_nhds : Metric.ball s η₁ ∈ nhds s := Metric.ball_mem_nhds s hη₁
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => norm_nonneg _) ?_
      filter_upwards [h_ball_nhds] with τ hτ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hτ
      have h_int_le : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖(w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) ≤ (B_v + 1) * |τ - s| := by

      have h_rhs_eq : (300 * M ^ 3 * B_lin + 700000 * M ^ 3 * B_Δ ^ 2) =
          (300 * M ^ 3 * ε' + 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s|) * |τ - s| := by
        dsimp [B_lin, B_Δ]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs_eq] at h_bound
      have h_mul_inv : |τ - s|⁻¹ * |alphaFunctionalT M (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) - alphaFunctionalT M (w s : ℝ → ℝ) - (τ - s) * D| ≤
          300 * M ^ 3 * ε' + 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s| := by
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_bound (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h_abs_pos))
        have h2 : |τ - s|⁻¹ * ((300 * M ^ 3 * ε' + 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s|) * |τ - s|) =
            300 * M ^ 3 * ε' + 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s| := by
          field_simp [h_abs_ne]
        linarith
      have h_part1 : 300 * M ^ 3 * ε' < ε / 2 := by
        dsimp [ε']
        have h_den : 0 < 2 * (300 * M ^ 3 + 1) := by positivity
        rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_div_iff₀ h_den two_pos]
        nlinarith
      have h_part2 : 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s| < ε / 2 := by
        have h1 : |τ - s| < ε / (2 * (700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 + 1)) :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hτ hδ_le_quad
        have h_den : 0 < 2 * (700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 + 1) := by positivity
        have h2 : 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * |τ - s| ≤
            700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * (ε / (2 * (700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 + 1))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h1) (by positivity)
        have h3 : 700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 * (ε / (2 * (700000 * M ^ 3 * (B_v + 1) ^ 2 + 1))) < ε / 2 := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_div_iff₀ h_den two_pos]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (B_v + 1)]
        linarith
      linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_nonneg : 0 ≤ κ := le_of_lt hκ_pos
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have hδ'_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ' := le_of_lt hδ'_pos
  have hδ'_ne : δ' ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ'_pos
  have hδ'_ode : 2 * δ' ≤ δ_ode := by
    have h1 : δ' ≤ δ_ode / 2 := le_trans hδ'_le (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have hδ'_52 : 2 * δ' ≤ 1 / 52 := by
    have h1 : δ' ≤ 1 / 104 := le_trans hδ'_le (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨h_iota_sub, h_iota_smul, h_diff_hm1, h_hm1_lip, h_deriv_hm1⟩ :=
    cinfT_iotaT_deriv_and_hm1KappaSqT_lipschitz
  have hχ_range : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ regCutoff δ' r ∧ regCutoff δ' r ≤ 1 := by
    intro r
    unfold regCutoff
    exact ⟨le_max_left 0 _, max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 _)⟩
  have hχ_one : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ δ' → regCutoff δ' r = 1 := by
    intro r hr
    unfold regCutoff
    have h_div : r / δ' ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hδ'_pos).mpr hr
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right zero_le_one]
  have hχ_vanish : ∀ r : ℝ, 2 * δ' ≤ r → regCutoff δ' r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    unfold regCutoff
    have h_div : 2 ≤ r / δ' := (le_div_iff₀ hδ'_pos).mpr hr
    rw [min_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
  have hχ_lip : ∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, |regCutoff δ' r₁ - regCutoff δ' r₂| ≤ (1 / δ') * |r₁ - r₂| := by
    intro r₁ r₂
    unfold regCutoff
    have h_max : ∀ u v : ℝ, |max 0 u - max 0 v| ≤ |u - v| := by
      intro u v
      rcases max_cases 0 u with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;>
        rcases max_cases 0 v with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩ <;>
        { rw [h1, h3, abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self (u - v), neg_le_abs (u - v)] }
    have h_min : ∀ a b : ℝ, |min 1 a - min 1 b| ≤ |a - b| := by
      intro a b
      rcases min_cases 1 a with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;>
        rcases min_cases 1 b with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩ <;>
        { rw [h1, h3, abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self (a - b), neg_le_abs (a - b)] }
    calc |max 0 (min 1 (2 - r₁ / δ')) - max 0 (min 1 (2 - r₂ / δ'))|
      _ ≤ |min 1 (2 - r₁ / δ') - min 1 (2 - r₂ / δ')| := h_max _ _
      _ ≤ |(2 - r₁ / δ') - (2 - r₂ / δ')| := h_min _ _
      _ = |(r₂ - r₁) / δ'| := by congr 1; ring
      _ = (1 / δ') * |r₁ - r₂| := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hδ'_pos, abs_sub_comm, div_eq_inv_mul, one_div]
  let rFn : CinfT → ℝ := fun q => Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q))
  have hrFn_nonneg : ∀ q : CinfT, 0 ≤ rFn q := fun q => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have h_hm1_nonneg : ∀ q : CinfT, 0 ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) :=
    fun q => (h_hm1_lip κ hκ1 (ιT q) (ιT q)).1
  have hrFn_sq : ∀ q : CinfT, rFn q ^ 2 = (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) := by
    intro q
    dsimp [rFn]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (h_hm1_nonneg q))
  have h_hm1_eq_rFn : ∀ q : CinfT, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) = rFn q ^ 2 * κ := by
    intro q
    rw [hrFn_sq q]
    field_simp [hκ_ne]
  have hrFn_le_of_hm1 : ∀ (q : CinfT) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ c ^ 2 * κ → rFn q ≤ c := by
    intro q c hc hq
    have h1 : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ c ^ 2 := by
      calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) * (c ^ 2 * κ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by positivity)
        _ = c ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
    calc rFn q = Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)) := rfl
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (c ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      _ = c := Real.sqrt_sq hc
  have h_hm1_le_of_rFn : ∀ (q : CinfT) (c : ℝ), rFn q ≤ c → hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ c ^ 2 * κ := by
    intro q c hq
    rw [h_hm1_eq_rFn q]
    have h_sq : rFn q ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hrFn_nonneg q) hq 2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq hκ_nonneg
  have hrFn_ge_of_hm1 : ∀ (q : CinfT) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ^ 2 * κ ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) → c ≤ rFn q := by
    intro q c hc hq
    have h1 : c ^ 2 ≤ (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) := by
      calc c ^ 2 = (1 / κ) * (c ^ 2 * κ) := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by positivity)
    calc c = Real.sqrt (c ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq hc).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      _ = rFn q := rfl
  have hrFn_lip : ∀ q₁ q₂ : CinfT, |rFn q₁ - rFn q₂| ≤ ‖ιT q₁ - ιT q₂‖ :=
    fun q₁ q₂ => (h_hm1_lip κ hκ1 (ιT q₁) (ιT q₂)).2.2
  have h_deriv_cinfT : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, f ∈ CinfT → deriv f ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f hf
    refine ⟨by simpa using hf.1.iterate_deriv 1, fun x => ?_⟩
    have h_shift : (fun y : ℝ => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hf.2
    have h_comp := deriv_comp_add_const f 1 x
    rw [h_shift] at h_comp
    exact h_comp.symm
  have h_smul_cinfT : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => c * f x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro c f hf
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hf.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x]
  have h_sub_const_cinfT : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => f x - c) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro c f hf
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub contDiff_const, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x]
  have h_sub_cinfT : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → g ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => f x - g x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x, hg.2 x]
  have h_zero_cinfT : (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) ∈ CinfT := ⟨contDiff_const, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have h_iota_congr : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f ∈ CinfT) (hg : g ∈ CinfT),
      (∀ x : ℝ, f x = g x) → ιT ⟨f, hf⟩ = ιT ⟨g, hg⟩ := by
    intro f g hf hg hfg
    have h_eq : f = g := funext hfg
    subst h_eq
    rfl
  have h_iota_zero : ιT ⟨fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ), h_zero_cinfT⟩ = 0 := by
    have h_smul0 := h_iota_smul 0 ⟨fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ), h_zero_cinfT⟩
      (h_smul_cinfT 0 _ h_zero_cinfT)
    have h_eq0 : ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => 0 * (0 : ℝ), h_smul_cinfT 0 _ h_zero_cinfT⟩ =
        ιT ⟨fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ), h_zero_cinfT⟩ :=
      h_iota_congr _ _ _ _ (fun _ => zero_mul 0)
    rw [h_eq0, zero_smul] at h_smul0
    exact h_smul0
  have hV_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, regTruncatedVecFnT δ' κ q ∈ CinfT := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq : rFn q ≤ 2 * δ'
    · have hq_ode : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * κ :=
        h_hm1_le_of_rFn q δ_ode (le_trans hq hδ'_ode)
      have h_dg : diagGreen κ (q : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT := h_reg κ hκ1 q hq_ode
      have h_ddg : deriv (diagGreen κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) ∈ CinfT := h_deriv_cinfT _ h_dg
      have h_F : (fun x : ℝ => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (diagGreen κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x) ∈ CinfT :=
        h_smul_cinfT (16 * κ ^ 5) _ h_ddg
      exact h_smul_cinfT (regCutoff δ' (rFn q)) _ h_F
    · have hq_ge : 2 * δ' ≤ rFn q := le_of_not_ge hq
      have h_eq_zero : regTruncatedVecFnT δ' κ q = fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        ext x
        unfold regTruncatedVecFnT
        change regCutoff δ' (rFn q) * (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (diagGreen κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x) = 0
        rw [hχ_vanish (rFn q) hq_ge, zero_mul]
      rw [h_eq_zero]
      exact h_zero_cinfT
  have hV_small : ∀ q : CinfT, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * κ →
      ∀ x : ℝ, regTruncatedVecFnT δ' κ q x = 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (diagGreen κ (q : ℝ → ℝ)) x := by
    intro q hq x
    have hr : rFn q ≤ δ' := hrFn_le_of_hm1 q δ' hδ'_nonneg hq
    unfold regTruncatedVecFnT

  · let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    let W : ℕ → CinfT := fun k => ⟨iteratedDeriv k w₀, hW_smooth q k, hW_per q k⟩
    have hW0 : W 0 = q := Subtype.ext iteratedDeriv_zero
    let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (W k)))
    let T : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => cinfSeminormT m w₀
    have hr_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ r k := fun _ => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hT_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ T m := fun m => h_semi_nn m w₀
    have hr0 : r 0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [r]

      have h2δ'_le : 2 * δ' ≤ 1 / 26 := by linarith
      have h_sq_le : (2 * δ') ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h2δ'_le 2
      have h_mul : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 := by
        calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)
          _ ≤ (1 / κ) * ((2 * δ') ^ 2 * κ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h_lt) (by positivity)
          _ = (2 * δ') ^ 2 := by field_simp
          _ ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 := h_sq_le
      have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)) ≤ 1 / 26 := by
        calc Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q))
          _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 26) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_mul
          _ = 1 / 26 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hr_T : ∀ m : ℕ, r (m + 1) ≤ 13 * T m := fun m => h_deriv_hm1 q m
    have h_sum_r : ∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ j) :=
      fun j => (h_sum_bound r hr_nn hr0 j).1
    have hr_le_n : ∀ i ≤ n, r i ≤ r_max i := by
      intro i hi

      · have hm_lt : m < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi
        have hTm : T m ≤ M' m := le_trans (hq_low m hm_lt) (le_max_left (M m) 0)
        exact le_trans (hr_T m) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTm (by norm_num))
    have h_tsum_le_n : ∀ j ≤ n, (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ j) ≤ S_max j := by
      intro j hj
      exact (h_sum_r j).tsum_le_tsum (fun ℓ => h_mono r r_max n hr_nn hr_le_n ℓ j hj)

    have h_top_tsum : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ (n + 1)) ≤ A₀ * T n + B₀ := by
      have h_sb := (h_sum_bound r hr_nn hr0 (n + 1)).2
      have h_b0 : shiftedGreenBoundSeq r 0 (n + 1) = 0 := rfl
      rw [h_b0, mul_zero, zero_add] at h_sb
      have h_split : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),

          (Nat.choose (n + 1) 0 : ℝ) * (r (n + 1 - 0) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ 0) :=
        Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n
      rw [h_split, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero] at h_sb
      have h_mid_sum_le : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Nat.choose (n + 1) (k + 1) : ℝ) * (r (n + 1 - (k + 1)) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ (k + 1))) ≤ B_rem := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_)
        have hk_lt : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        have hk1_le : k + 1 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk_lt
        have h_sub_eq : n + 1 - (k + 1) = n - k := Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub n k
        rw [h_sub_eq]
        have h1 : r (n - k) ≤ r_max (n - k) := hr_le_n (n - k) (Nat.sub_le n k)
        have h2 : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ (k + 1)) ≤ S_max (k + 1) := h_tsum_le_n (k + 1) hk1_le
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (tsum_nonneg (fun ℓ => h_nn r hr_nn ℓ (k + 1))) (hr_max_nn (n - k))
      have h_i0_le : r (n + 1) * (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ 0) ≤
          (13 * T n) * S_max 0 :=
        mul_le_mul (hr_T n) (h_tsum_le_n 0 (Nat.zero_le n))
          (tsum_nonneg (fun ℓ => h_nn r hr_nn ℓ 0))
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hT_nn n))
      dsimp [A₀, B₀]
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨h_contDiff, h_base0, h_base_succ, h_rec⟩ :=
      shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrenceT κ hκ1 q
    obtain ⟨h_good0, h_step, h_comb⟩ :=
      freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_periodic_stepT κ hκ1
    obtain ⟨_, h_good_zero, h_sob, _, _⟩ :=
      KdV.freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds κ hκ1
    have h_freq_zero : ∃ M_f : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_f ∧
        ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun _ : ℝ => 0) η‖ ≤ M_f := by
      refine ⟨0, le_rfl, fun η => ?_⟩

    have h_prof : ∀ m j : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x) ∧

          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x) η‖ ≤ M_f) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x)) ≤
          shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro j x
        rcases j with _ | j
        · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 0 x = freeGreenKernel κ 0 :=
            funext (h_base0 x)
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_good0
        · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 (j + 1) x = fun _ : ℝ => 0 :=
            funext (h_base_succ j x)
          rw [h_eq]
          exact ⟨h_good_zero.1, h_freq_zero, le_of_eq h_good_zero.2⟩
      | succ m ih =>
        intro j x
        let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (Nat.choose j i : ℝ)
        let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i u =>
          -∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m i x v *
            (W (j - i) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u
        have hF : ∀ i : ℕ,
            IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F i) ∧
            (∃ M_f : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_f ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F i) η‖ ≤ M_f) ∧
            Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F i)) ≤ r (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m i := by
          intro i
          have h_st := h_step (W (j - i)) x
            (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m i x) (ih i x).1 (ih i x).2.1
          refine ⟨h_st.1, h_st.2.1, le_trans h_st.2.2 ?_⟩
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih i x).2.2 (hr_nn (j - i))
        have h_cb := h_comb j c F (fun i _ => ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg _, (hF i).1, (hF i).2.1⟩)
        have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ (m + 1) j x =
            fun u => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), c i * F i u :=
          funext (h_rec m j x)
        rw [h_eq]
        refine ⟨h_cb.1, h_cb.2.1, le_trans h_cb.2.2 ?_⟩
        change ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), c i * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F i)) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), c i * (r (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m i)
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF i).2.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    have h_sup : ∀ m j : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x u| ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j := by
      intro m j x u
      exact le_trans (h_sob (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x) (h_prof m j x).1 u)
        (h_prof m j x).2.2
    
    let h : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y y
    let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) y y
    have hf_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, f m = fun y => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ (m + 1) y 0 := by
      intro m
      ext y

      intro m

    let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r (m + 1) p
    have hv_sum : ∀ p : ℕ, (p : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) → Summable (v p) := by
      intro p _
      exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (h_sum_r p)
    have hv_bound : ∀ (p m : ℕ) (y : ℝ), (p : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ p (f m) y‖ ≤ v p m := by
      intro p m y _
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, hf_eq m]
      exact h_sup (m + 1) p y 0
    let g_tilde_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∑' m : ℕ, f m y
    have h_smooth_tilde : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) g_tilde_fun :=
      contDiff_tsum hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound
    have hh0_eq : h 0 = fun _ => 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      ext y
      simp [h, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    have h_sum_shift : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => f m y) := by
      intro y
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum 0 le_top) ?_
      intro m
      have h0 := hv_bound 0 m y le_top
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h0
      exact h0
    have h_sum_all : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => h ℓ y) :=
      fun y => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (h_sum_shift y)
    have h_diag_eq : diagGreen κ w₀ = fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_fun y := by
      ext y
      have h_split : diagGreen κ w₀ y = h 0 y + g_tilde_fun y :=
        (h_sum_all y).tsum_eq_zero_add
      have h0_y : h 0 y = 1 / (2 * κ) := congr_fun hh0_eq y
      linarith
    have h_deriv_diag_eq : deriv (diagGreen κ w₀) = deriv g_tilde_fun := by
      ext y
      rw [h_diag_eq]
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_fun z)
          (0 + deriv g_tilde_fun y) y :=
        (hasDerivAt_const y (1 / (2 * κ))).add
          ((h_smooth_tilde.differentiable (by decide) y).hasDerivAt)
      rw [hd.deriv, zero_add]
    have h_fderiv_sum : ∀ (p : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ p (f m) x) :=
      fun p x => Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum p le_top) (fun m => hv_bound p m x le_top)
    have h_iterDeriv_tsum : ∀ (p : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv p g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv p (f m) x := by
      intro p x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
      have h_fd := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (p : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
      change iteratedFDeriv ℝ p g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ p (f m) x at h_fd
      rw [h_fd, ContinuousMultilinearMap.tsum_eval (h_fderiv_sum p x) (fun _ => 1)]
      simp_rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have h_deriv_bound : ∀ x : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (deriv (diagGreen κ w₀)) x| ≤ A₀ * T n + B₀ := by
      intro x
      rw [h_deriv_diag_eq, ← iteratedDeriv_succ', h_iterDeriv_tsum (n + 1) x]
      have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f m) x‖) := by
        refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_) (hv_sum (n + 1) le_top)
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
        exact hv_bound (n + 1) m x le_top
      have h_abs_le : |∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f m) x| ≤
          ∑' m : ℕ, ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f m) x‖ := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_norm_sum
      have h_tsum_v : (∑' m : ℕ, ‖iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f m) x‖) ≤
          ∑' m : ℕ, v (n + 1) m := by
        refine h_norm_sum.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) (hv_sum (n + 1) le_top)
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
        exact hv_bound (n + 1) m x le_top
      have h_v_eq_all : (∑' m : ℕ, v (n + 1) m) = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ (n + 1) := by
        have h_split := (h_sum_r (n + 1)).tsum_eq_zero_add
        have h_z : shiftedGreenBoundSeq r 0 (n + 1) = 0 := rfl
        dsimp [v]
        linarith
      linarith
    let c_cut : ℝ := regCutoff δ' (Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)))
    have hc_cut_nn : 0 ≤ c_cut := by
      dsimp [c_cut]
      unfold regCutoff
      exact le_max_left 0 _
    have hc_cut_le1 : c_cut ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [c_cut]
      unfold regCutoff
      exact max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 _)
    have hV_eq_mul : regTruncatedVecFnT δ' κ q =
        fun y : ℝ => (c_cut * (16 * κ ^ 5)) * deriv (diagGreen κ w₀) y := by
      ext y
      dsimp [regTruncatedVecFnT, c_cut, w₀]
      ring
    refine h_semi_le n (regTruncatedVecFnT δ' κ q) (A * T n + B)
      (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA_nn (hT_nn n)) hB_nn) (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [hV_eq_mul, h_iter_const_mul n (c_cut * (16 * κ ^ 5)) (deriv (diagGreen κ w₀)) x,
        abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc_cut_nn (by positivity))]
    have hc_le : c_cut * (16 * κ ^ 5) ≤ 16 * κ ^ 5 := by
      calc c_cut * (16 * κ ^ 5)
        _ ≤ 1 * (16 * κ ^ 5) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_cut_le1 (by positivity)
        _ = 16 * κ ^ 5 := one_mul _
    calc (c_cut * (16 * κ ^ 5)) * |iteratedDeriv n (deriv (diagGreen κ w₀)) x|
      _ ≤ (16 * κ ^ 5) * (A₀ * T n + B₀) :=
        mul_le_mul hc_le (h_deriv_bound x) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = A * T n + B := by
        dsimp [A, B]
        ring

subgoal_signatures.name: hm1KappaSqT_and_autocorrelation_fourierCircle
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) :
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
    hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) =
      ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ,
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + s) * (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) =
        ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 * Real.cos (2 * π * n * s))

subgoal_signatures.name: shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrenceT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x u)) ∧
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u))

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_periodic_stepT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (freeGreenKernel κ 0) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (W : CinfT) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f η‖ ≤ M) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
        (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        (13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT W))) * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
        ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
        (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

(h_dom1 : ∀ (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → ∀ (g : CinfT) (x : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel Λ (g : ℝ → ℝ) 1 x x| ≤ (13 / (2 * Λ)) * ‖ιT g‖)

  let f' : CinfT := ⟨fun x => deriv (w₁ s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w₂ s : ℝ → ℝ) x, hf'_mem⟩
  have hf'_eq_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, (f' : ℝ → ℝ) x = deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro x
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (w₁ s : ℝ → ℝ) x := (w₁ s).2.1.differentiable (by decide) x
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (w₂ s : ℝ → ℝ) x := (w₂ s).2.1.differentiable (by decide) x
    exact (deriv_sub hd1 hd2).symm
  have h_w_sub : ιT (w₁ s) - ιT (w₂ s) = ιT f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (((toHm1T (w₁ s) - toHm1T (w₂ s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n) = (toHm1T f : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, h_toHm1T_apply (w₁ s) n, h_toHm1T_apply (w₂ s) n, h_toHm1T_apply f n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, f]
    rw [← mul_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier (w₁ s) n) (h_int_fourier (w₂ s) n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_v_decomp : ιT v₁ - ιT v₂ = (16 * κ ^ 5) • ιT r + (4 * κ ^ 2) • ιT f' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (((toHm1T v₁ - toHm1T v₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n) =
      ((((16 * κ ^ 5) • toHm1T r + (4 * κ ^ 2) • toHm1T f' : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n)
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, lp.coeFn_add, lp.coeFn_smul, lp.coeFn_smul,
      Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul,
      h_toHm1T_apply v₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply v₂ n, h_toHm1T_apply r n, h_toHm1T_apply f' n]
    have h_fc : fourierCircle (v₁ : ℝ → ℝ) n - fourierCircle (v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) n =
        ((16 * κ ^ 5 : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourierCircle (r : ℝ → ℝ) n +
        ((4 * κ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourierCircle (f' : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
      dsimp [fourierCircle]
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier v₁ n) (h_int_fourier v₂ n),
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
          ((h_int_fourier r n).const_mul ((16 * κ ^ 5 : ℝ) : ℂ))
          ((h_int_fourier f' n).const_mul ((4 * κ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      have hv1x := hv₁_eq x
      have hv2x := hv₂_eq x
      dsimp [regFlowRHS] at hv1x hv2x
      dsimp [r, f']
      rw [hv1x, hv2x]
      push_cast
      ring
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
    linear_combination ((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ) * h_fc
  have h_prof_deriv : ∀ n : ℤ,
      hm1ProfileT (f' : ℝ → ℝ) n = (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) * hm1ProfileT (f : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro n
    let c : ℂ := ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * I
    let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)
    let F' : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f' : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ) - c * F x
    have hF_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (F' x) x := by
      intro x
      have hd_x : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)) 1 x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).ofReal_comp
      have hd_arg : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I)
          (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * 1) * I) x :=
        ((hd_x.const_mul ((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ)).neg).mul_const I
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I))
          (Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * 1) * I)) x :=
        hd_arg.cexp

        rw [hf'_eq_deriv x]
        exact (f.2.1.differentiable (by decide) x).hasDerivAt

        hd_f_real.ofReal_comp

      dsimp [F', F, c]
      ring

      (h_int_fourier f' n).sub ((h_int_fourier f n).const_mul c)
    have h_ftc : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' x) = F 1 - F 0 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun x _ => hF_deriv x) hF'_int
    have h_bdry : F 1 - F 0 = 0 := by
      have h_exp1 : Complex.exp (-(2 * (π : ℂ) * (n : ℂ) * I)) = 1 := by
        have h_arg : -(2 * (π : ℂ) * (n : ℂ) * I) = ((-n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (π : ℂ) * I) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg]
        exact Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I (-n)
      have hf_per : (f : ℝ → ℝ) 1 = (f : ℝ → ℝ) 0 := by
        simpa using f.2.2 0
      simp [F, h_exp1, hf_per]
    have h_split : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' x) =
        fourierCircle (f' : ℝ → ℝ) n - c * fourierCircle (f : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
      dsimp [F', F, fourierCircle]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier f' n) ((h_int_fourier f n).const_mul c),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have h_fc_eq : fourierCircle (f' : ℝ → ℝ) n = c * fourierCircle (f : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
      rw [h_ftc, h_bdry] at h_split
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_split.symm
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
    rw [h_fc_eq]
    dsimp [c]
    ring
  have h_ortho : inner ℝ (ιT f) (ιT f') = 0 := by
    rw [Submodule.coe_inner]
    change inner ℝ (toHm1T f) (toHm1T f') = 0
    rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum]
    have h_term : ∀ n : ℤ, inner ℝ ((toHm1T f : ℤ → ℂ) n) ((toHm1T f' : ℤ → ℂ) n) = 0 := by
      intro n
      rw [h_toHm1T_apply f n, h_toHm1T_apply f' n, h_prof_deriv n]
      set z : ℂ := hm1ProfileT (f : ℝ → ℝ) n
      set a : ℝ := 2 * π * (n : ℝ)
      change inner ℝ z (((a : ℂ) * I) * z) = 0
      rw [Complex.inner]
      simp [mul_re, mul_im]
      ring
    simp only [h_term, tsum_zero]
  refine ⟨r, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  have h_rhs_eq : 2 * inner ℝ (ιT (w₁ s) - ιT (w₂ s)) (ιT v₁ - ιT v₂) =
      32 * κ ^ 5 * inner ℝ (ιT (w₁ s) - ιT (w₂ s)) (ιT r) := by
    rw [h_w_sub, h_v_decomp, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, h_ortho]
    ring
  rwa [← h_rhs_eq]
