      have h_cast : (2 : ℂ) * (π : ℂ) * I * (n : ℂ) = (((2 * π * (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_cast, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π)]
    have h_mul : ‖fourierCircle (r : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ = (2 * π * |(n : ℝ)|) * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ := by
      rw [h_norm, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt h_pos)]
    rw [h_mul, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, ← mul_pow]
  have h_mode_le : ∀ n : ℤ,
      ‖fourierCircle (r : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ≤
        (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      rw [h_fc_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_div]
      positivity
    · rw [h_ibp_norm_sq n hn]
      have h_den_pos : 0 < 4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_frac_le_one : (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
        (div_le_one h_den_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      have h_one_le_w : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))]
      calc ((2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ ^ 2) / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)
        _ = ((2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)) * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_frac_le_one (sq_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle Δg n‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_one_le_w (sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨hr_sum1, hr_hm1_eq⟩ := (cinfT_fourierCircle_summable_and_hasSum r).2.2 1 le_rfl
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_norm_sq_r : ‖ιT r‖ ^ 2 = hm1KappaSqT 1 (ιT r) := by
    change ‖((ιT r : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 = hm1KappaSqT 1 (ιT r)
    have hu := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos ((ιT r : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hu
    rw [hu]
    unfold hm1KappaSqT
    congr 1 with n
    have h_den_ne : 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h_w1 : (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [one_pow, mul_one, div_self h_den_ne]
    rw [h_w1, one_mul]
  have h_norm_sq_le : ‖ιT r‖ ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖ιT f₁ - ιT f₂‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc ‖ιT r‖ ^ 2
      _ = hm1KappaSqT 1 (ιT r) := h_norm_sq_r
      _ = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (r : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := hr_hm1_eq
      _ ≤ h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ Δg := hr_sum1.tsum_le_tsum h_mode_le h_Δg_sum
      _ ≤ 9 * ‖ιT f₁ - ιT f₂‖ ^ 2 := h_Δg_norm_le
      _ = (3 * ‖ιT f₁ - ιT f₂‖) ^ 2 := by ring
  exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_norm_sq_le (by positivity)).2

by
  let κ : ℝ := κ₀

      have h_int_K : (∫ _ : ℝ, K ∂μ_I) = K := by

  have h_goal2 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
      fourierCircle (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ₀ w0 (m + 2) x x) n =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ,

    have hG_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry G)

          show -(((2 * π * n - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I =
            (((-((2 * π * n - p.2) * p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,

        Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
          (greenIterKernel κ₀ w0 (m + 2) x x : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, G x ξ) := by
      ext x
      rw [h_iter_eq (m + 2) x x, ← mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ),
          mul_assoc, ← integral_const_mul]

  have h_int_step : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ),
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
          iterWavePacket κ₀ w0 (ℓ + 1) x ξ) =
        -∑' j : ℤ,
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * ((n - j : ℤ) : ℝ) - (ξ - 2 * π * j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
              iterWavePacket κ₀ w0 ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * j)) *
            fourierCircle w0 j / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * j) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by

    obtain ⟨h_wp_cont, K_ℓ, _hK_ℓ_nn, hK_ℓ_bd⟩ := h_wp ℓ
    let F : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ := fun j x =>
      Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
        (-iterWavePacket κ₀ w0 ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * j) *
          fourierCircle w0 j / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * j) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let bound : ℤ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j _ => K_ℓ * ‖fourierCircle w0 j‖
    let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
        iterWavePacket κ₀ w0 (ℓ + 1) x ξ
    have hF_meas : ∀ j : ℤ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F j) μ_I := by

      have hc : Continuous (F j) := by

        have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by
          fun_prop
        have hc2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => iterWavePacket κ₀ w0 ℓ x (ξ - 2 * π * j)) :=
          h_wp_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact hc1.mul ((hc2.neg.mul continuous_const).div_const _)
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable

      intro j
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_

      rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_neg,
          show -(((2 * π * n - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = (((-((2 * π * n - ξ) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,

        push_cast; ring
      have h_fn : F j = fun x : ℝ =>
          (Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * ((n - j : ℤ) : ℝ) - (ξ - 2 * π * j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *

        ext x
        dsimp [F]
        rw [h_phase]
        ring

      ring

  have h_goal3 : ∀ (n : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ),
      iterFreqPacketT κ₀ w0 0 n ξ =
        -fourierCircle w0 n / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n - ξ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro n ξ
    dsimp [iterFreqPacketT]
    rw [h_int_step 0 n ξ]
    have h_orth : ∀ j : ℤ,

          Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * ((n - j : ℤ) : ℝ) - (ξ - 2 * π * j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *

        congr 1; push_cast; ring

          show (ξ - 2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (2 * π * (n : ℝ) - ξ) ^ 2 by ring,

        -∑' j : ℤ,

    exact h_int_step (k + 1) n ξ
  exact ⟨h_goal1, h_goal2, h_goal3, h_goal4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(κ₀ : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀)
    (h_fc : (∀ w : CinfT,
        Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖) ∧
        Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) ∧
        hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w) =
          ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ u₁ u₂ : CinfT,
        Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
          ‖fourierCircle (u₁ : ℝ → ℝ) n - fourierCircle (u₂ : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 /
            (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) ∧
        hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT u₁ - ιT u₂) =
          ∑' n : ℤ,
            ‖fourierCircle (u₁ : ℝ → ℝ) n - fourierCircle (u₂ : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 /
              (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)))
    (h_freq : ∀ w : CinfT,
      (∀ k : ℕ,
        (∀ n : ℤ, Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) k n ξ)) ∧
        ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ), ‖iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) k n ξ‖ ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
        fourierCircle (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n =
          (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ),
        iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 n ξ =
          -fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n - ξ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ),
        iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (k + 1) n ξ =
          -∑' j : ℤ,
            iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) k (n - j) (ξ - 2 * π * j) *
              fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) j / ((κ₀ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * j) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (h_bf : (∀ ξ : ℝ,
        Summable (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ∧
        (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (ξ - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ≤ 41 / κ₀) ∧
      (∀ (η : ℝ) (c : ℤ → ℝ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ c n) → Summable c →
        Summable (fun m : ℤ =>
          (1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
            (∑' n : ℤ, c n / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) ∧
        (∑' m : ℤ,
          (1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) *
            (∑' n : ℤ, c n / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (η + 2 * π * (m - n)) ^ 2))) ≤
          (169 / κ₀) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)))
    (w₁ w₂ : CinfT)
    (hw₁ : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁) ≤ (1 / (256 * 13)) ^ 2 * κ₀)
    (hw₂ : hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₂) ≤ (1 / (256 * 13)) ^ 2 * κ₀)
    (m : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x => κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) ≤
      4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁) ∧
    Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x =>
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x -
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x =>
      κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x -
      κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) ≤
      4 * (4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂)

      refine ⟨hDk1_sum, ?_⟩
      have h_I1_bound : (∑' n : ℤ, I₁ n) ≤ ρ * ((4 * ρ) ^ k * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ)) := by
        have h_Kd1 : (169 / κ₀) * (∑' i : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) i‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * i) ^ 2)) =
            (169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁) := by
          rw [(h_fc.1 w₁).2.2]
        calc (∑' n : ℤ, I₁ n)
          _ ≤ ((169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁)) * ∑' m : ℤ, D k m := by
            rw [← h_Kd1]; exact hS1_tsum_le
          _ ≤ ρ * ((4 * ρ) ^ k * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ)) :=
            mul_le_mul hRw1_le_ρ hDk_le (tsum_nonneg (hD_nn k)) hρ_nn
      have h_I2_bound : (∑' n : ℤ, I₂ n) ≤ ρ ^ (k + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ) := by
        have h_Kd2 : (169 / κ₀) * (∑' i : ℤ, d_Δ i ^ 2 / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * i) ^ 2)) =
            (169 / κ₀) * H_Δ := by
          dsimp [H_Δ, d_Δ]; rw [(h_fc.2 w₁ w₂).2]
        set R_w2 : ℝ := (169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₂)
        have hRw2_nn : 0 ≤ R_w2 := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (h_hm1_nn w₂)
        have h_pow_le : R_w2 ^ (k + 1) ≤ ρ ^ (k + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hRw2_nn hRw2_le_ρ (k + 1)
        calc (∑' n : ℤ, I₂ n)
          _ ≤ ((169 / κ₀) * H_Δ) * ∑' m : ℤ, E_w w₂ k m := by
            rw [← h_Kd2]; exact hS2_tsum_le
          _ ≤ ((169 / κ₀) * H_Δ) * (R_w2 ^ k * ((2 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₂))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEw2_le (mul_nonneg (by positivity) h_hm1_diff_nn)
          _ = R_w2 ^ (k + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ) := by
            dsimp [R_w2]; rw [pow_succ']; ring
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (k + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pow_le (mul_nonneg (by positivity) h_hm1_diff_nn)
      have h_4k_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h_comb_pow : 2 * (ρ * (4 * ρ) ^ k) + 2 * ρ ^ (k + 1) ≤ (4 * ρ) ^ (k + 1) := by
        calc 2 * (ρ * (4 * ρ) ^ k) + 2 * ρ ^ (k + 1)
          _ = (2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k + 2) * ρ ^ (k + 1) := by rw [mul_pow, pow_succ']; ring
          _ ≤ (4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k) * ρ ^ (k + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [h_4k_ge1]) (by positivity)
          _ = (4 * ρ) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [mul_pow, pow_succ']; ring
      have h_tsum_split : (∑' n : ℤ, (2 * I₁ n + 2 * I₂ n)) =
          2 * (∑' n : ℤ, I₁ n) + 2 * (∑' n : ℤ, I₂ n) := by
        rw [(hI1_sum.mul_left 2).tsum_add (hI2_sum.mul_left 2),
            tsum_mul_left (f := I₁), tsum_mul_left (f := I₂)]
      calc (∑' n : ℤ, D (k + 1) n)
        _ ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, (2 * I₁ n + 2 * I₂ n) := hDk1_sum.tsum_le_tsum h_pw_D h_dom_D
        _ = 2 * (∑' n : ℤ, I₁ n) + 2 * (∑' n : ℤ, I₂ n) := h_tsum_split
        _ ≤ 2 * (ρ * ((4 * ρ) ^ k * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ))) + 2 * (ρ ^ (k + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ)) := by
          linarith [h_I1_bound, h_I2_bound]
        _ = (2 * (ρ * (4 * ρ) ^ k) + 2 * ρ ^ (k + 1)) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ) := by ring
        _ ≤ (4 * ρ) ^ (k + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_comb_pow (mul_nonneg (by positivity) h_hm1_diff_nn)
  
  obtain ⟨hE_m1_sum, hE_m1_le⟩ := hE_ind w₁ (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨hD_m1_sum, hD_m1_le⟩ := hD_ind (m + 1)
  have h_pw_single : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x => κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * κ₀) * E_w w₁ (m + 1) n := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨B, hB, hB_le⟩, _⟩ := h_pkt_single w₁ (m + 1)
    rw [h_fc_smul (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n]
    have h_cs_n := h_mode_cs n
      (fourierCircle (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n)
      (iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n) B
      (((h_freq w₁).1 (m + 1)).1 n) hB (hB_le n) ((h_freq w₁).2.1 m n)
    have h_Ew_eq : E_w w₁ (m + 1) n =
        (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ,
          (κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n - ξ) ^ 2) *
            ‖iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [E_w, A_w]
      congr 2; ext ξ; rw [h_sq_sqrt_mul]
    rw [h_Ew_eq]
    exact h_cs_n
  have h_pw_diff : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x =>
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x -
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * κ₀) * D (m + 1) n := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨B, hB, hB_le⟩, _⟩ := h_pkt_diff (m + 1)
    rw [h_fc_sub_smul (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x)
        (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x)
        (h_G_diag_cont w₁ (m + 2)) (h_G_diag_cont w₂ (m + 2)) n]
    have h_cs_n := h_mode_cs n
      (fourierCircle (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n -
        fourierCircle (fun x => greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n)
      (fun ξ => iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ -
        iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ) B
      ((((h_freq w₁).1 (m + 1)).1 n).sub (((h_freq w₂).1 (m + 1)).1 n)) hB (hB_le n)
      (h_fc_diff_eq m n)
    have h_D_eq : D (m + 1) n =
        (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ,
          (κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n - ξ) ^ 2) *
            ‖iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ -
              iterFreqPacketT κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [D, A_Δ]
      congr 2; ext ξ; rw [h_sq_sqrt_mul]
    rw [h_D_eq]
    exact h_cs_n
  have h_sum_single : Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x => κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity) h_pw_single (hE_m1_sum.mul_left (2 * κ₀))
  have h_sum_diff : Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) *
        ‖fourierCircle (fun x =>
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x -
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x) n‖ ^ 2) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity) h_pw_diff (hD_m1_sum.mul_left (2 * κ₀))
  refine ⟨h_sum_single, ?_, h_sum_diff, ?_⟩
  · have h_Rw1_pow : ((169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁)) ^ (m + 1) ≤
        (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) := by
      have h1 : ((169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁)) ^ (m + 1) ≤ ρ ^ (m + 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (h_hm1_nn w₁)) hRw1_le_ρ (m + 1)
      have h2 : ρ ^ (m + 1) = (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) := by
        dsimp [ρ]; rw [← pow_mul]
      linarith
    calc h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x)
      _ ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, (2 * κ₀) * E_w w₁ (m + 1) n :=
        h_sum_single.tsum_le_tsum h_pw_single (hE_m1_sum.mul_left (2 * κ₀))
      _ = (2 * κ₀) * ∑' n : ℤ, E_w w₁ (m + 1) n := tsum_mul_left (f := E_w w₁ (m + 1))
      _ ≤ (2 * κ₀) * (((169 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁)) ^ (m + 1) *
            ((2 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE_m1_le (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (2 * κ₀) * ((1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) * ((2 / κ₀) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_Rw1_pow (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (h_hm1_nn w₁)))
          (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁) := by
        have : κ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ₀_pos; field_simp; ring
  · calc h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x =>
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x -
          κ₀ * greenIterKernel κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x)
      _ ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, (2 * κ₀) * D (m + 1) n :=
        h_sum_diff.tsum_le_tsum h_pw_diff (hD_m1_sum.mul_left (2 * κ₀))
      _ = (2 * κ₀) * ∑' n : ℤ, D (m + 1) n := tsum_mul_left (f := D (m + 1))
      _ ≤ (2 * κ₀) * ((4 * ρ) ^ (m + 1) * ((2 / κ₀) * H_Δ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_m1_le (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * (4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁ - ιT w₂) := by
        dsimp [ρ, H_Δ]
        have : κ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ₀_pos; field_simp; ring

informal_problem.statement:
(κ₀ : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 1 ≤ κ₀)
    (h_bf0 : Summable (fun m : ℤ => 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (0 - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ∧
      (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (0 - 2 * π * m) ^ 2)) ≤ 41 / κ₀) :
    (∀ u v : ℝ → ℝ,
      Continuous u → Function.Periodic u 1 →
      Continuous v → Function.Periodic v 1 →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle u n‖ ^ 2) →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle v n‖ ^ 2) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) 1 ∧
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (fun x => u x * v x) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x => u x * v x) ≤
        (169 / κ₀) * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ u * h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ v) ∧
    (∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (A B ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ ρ₁ → ρ₁ ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 ≤ ρ₂ → 4 * ρ₂ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (F m) ∧ Function.Periodic (F m) 1 ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, |F m x| ≤ A * ρ₁ ^ m) ∧
        Summable (fun n : ℤ => (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (F m) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
        h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (F m) ≤ B * ρ₂ ^ m) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) ∧
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) 1 ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |∑' m : ℕ, F m x| ≤ 2 * A) ∧
      Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
        (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1KappaNormSqT κ₀ (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, F m x) ≤ 4 * B)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ₀_pos : 0 < κ₀ := by linarith
  have hκ₀_ne : κ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ₀_pos
  let W : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => 4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2
  have hW_pos : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < W n := fun n => by dsimp [W]; positivity
  have hW_nn : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ W n := fun n => le_of_lt (hW_pos n)
  have hW_inv_le : ∀ m : ℤ, 1 / W m ≤ 1 / (κ₀ ^ 2 + (0 - 2 * π * (m : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by
    intro m
    refine one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) ?_
    dsimp [W]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg κ₀, sq_nonneg (2 * π * (m : ℝ))]
  have hW_inv_sum : Summable (fun m : ℤ => 1 / W m) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => by positivity) hW_inv_le h_bf0.1
  have hW_inv_tsum : (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / W m) ≤ 41 / κ₀ :=
    le_trans (hW_inv_sum.tsum_le_tsum hW_inv_le h_bf0.1) h_bf0.2
  have hK_sum_le : ∀ n : ℤ,
      Summable (fun k : ℤ => 2 / W (n - k) + 2 / W k) ∧
      (∑' k : ℤ, (2 / W (n - k) + 2 / W k)) ≤ 169 / κ₀ := by
    intro n
    have h_shift_eq : (fun k : ℤ => 1 / W (n - k)) = (fun m : ℤ => 1 / W m) ∘ (Equiv.subLeft n) := rfl
    have h_shift_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 1 / W (n - k)) := by
      rw [h_shift_eq]
      exact (Equiv.summable_iff (Equiv.subLeft n)).mpr hW_inv_sum
    have h_shift_tsum : (∑' k : ℤ, 1 / W (n - k)) = ∑' m : ℤ, 1 / W m :=
      Equiv.tsum_eq (Equiv.subLeft n) (fun m : ℤ => 1 / W m)
    have h_fn1 : (fun k : ℤ => 2 / W (n - k)) = (fun k : ℤ => 2 * (1 / W (n - k))) := by
      ext k; ring
    have h_fn2 : (fun k : ℤ => 2 / W k) = (fun k : ℤ => 2 * (1 / W k)) := by
      ext k; ring
    have hs1 : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 2 / W (n - k)) := by
      rw [h_fn1]; exact h_shift_sum.mul_left 2
    have hs2 : Summable (fun k : ℤ => 2 / W k) := by
      rw [h_fn2]; exact hW_inv_sum.mul_left 2
    refine ⟨hs1.add hs2, ?_⟩
    calc (∑' k : ℤ, (2 / W (n - k) + 2 / W k))
      _ = (∑' k : ℤ, 2 / W (n - k)) + (∑' k : ℤ, 2 / W k) := hs1.tsum_add hs2
      _ = 2 * (∑' k : ℤ, 1 / W (n - k)) + 2 * (∑' k : ℤ, 1 / W k) := by
          rw [h_fn1, h_fn2, tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]
      _ = 4 * (∑' m : ℤ, 1 / W m) := by rw [h_shift_tsum]; ring
      _ ≤ 4 * (41 / κ₀) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW_inv_tsum (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 169 / κ₀ := by
          have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 / κ₀ := by positivity
          have h_eq : 169 / κ₀ - 4 * (41 / κ₀) = 5 / κ₀ := by ring
          linarith
  let μ_I : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 1)
  have h_Ioc_lt_top : volume (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) < ⊤ := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have h_const_int : ∀ c : ℝ, Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => c) μ_I :=
    fun c => integrableOn_const h_Ioc_lt_top.ne
  have h_fourier_inv : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => W n * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2) →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle f n‖) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasSum (fun n : ℤ =>
        fourierCircle f n * Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * I)) (f x : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |f x| ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle f n‖) := by
    intro f hf_cont hf_per hf_h1
    have hf_l1 : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle f n‖) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
        ((hW_inv_sum.add hf_h1).mul_left (1 / 2))
      have h_pos : 0 < 2 * W n := by have := hW_pos n; positivity
      have h_rhs : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / W n + W n * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2) =
          (1 + (W n) ^ 2 * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2) / (2 * W n) := by
        have : W n ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hW_pos n)
        field_simp
      rw [h_rhs, le_div_iff₀ h_pos]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - W n * ‖fourierCircle f n‖)]
    have h_hasSum : ∀ z : ℝ,
        HasSum (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCircle f n * Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) * I))
          (f z : ℂ) := by

    (h_cont₂ : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ p.1 p.2))

      |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / κ) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|))
    (h_bd₂ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / κ) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|)) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 p.2) ∧
    Continuous (diagGreen κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ x y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| ≤ (4 / (3 * κ)) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (6 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ) (B_v B_Δ B_lin h : ℝ),
      Continuous v → 0 ≤ B_v → 0 ≤ B_Δ → 0 ≤ B_lin →
      (∀ y : ℝ, |v y| ≤ B_v) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ B_Δ) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y| ≤ B_lin) →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        |diagGreen κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - diagGreen κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x -
          h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * v y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x)| ≤
          16 * B_lin + 64 * B_Δ ^ 2)

          (fun m : ℕ => -∫ z : ℝ, F m z) := by
        funext m
        exact h_tele m a b
      rw [h_congr, tsum_neg]
    have hS_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), |S m z| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
      intro m z
      dsimp [S]
      have h_term : ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b| ≤
            (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [abs_mul]
        have hb1 : |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 := by
          calc |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z|
            _ ≤ (1 / κ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - z|) := h_bd₁ p.1 a z
            _ ≤ (1 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_κ_le (by positivity))
                (h_exp_le_one a z) (Real.exp_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 := by ring
        have hb2 : |greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b| ≤
            (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
          calc |greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b|
            _ ≤ (1 / κ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := h_bd₂ p.2 z b
            _ ≤ (1 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_κ_le (by positivity)) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
            _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by ring
        calc |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z| * |greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b|
          _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) :=
            mul_le_mul hb1 hb2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by ring
          _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (p.1 + p.2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by rw [← pow_add]
          _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by rw [hp_eq]
      calc |∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
              greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b|
        _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
              |greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ (Finset.antidiagonal m).card • ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ h_term
        _ = (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
          rw [Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          ring
        _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hm_le_pow m) (by positivity)) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = (2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by rw [← mul_pow]
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by norm_num
    have hF_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (F m) := by
      intro m
      dsimp [F, S]
      refine (continuous_finset_sum _ fun p _ => ?_).mul (hw₁_cont.sub hw₂_cont)
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 a z) :=
        (h_cont₁ p.1).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 z b) :=
        (h_cont₂ p.2).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact hc1.mul hc2
    have hF_dom : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ),
        ‖F m z‖ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
      intro m z
      dsimp [F]
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |S m z| * |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) z - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z|
        _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) * B_Δ :=
          mul_le_mul (hS_bound m z) (hΔ_bd z) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by ring
    have hF_int : ∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (F m) volume := by
      intro m
      refine ((h_exp_shift_int b).const_mul ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_Δ)).mono'
        (hF_cont m).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_dom m)
    have h_sum_int : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F m z‖) := by
      have h_half_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_Δ) * ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) :=
        ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_right B_Δ).mul_right _
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _)) (fun m => ?_) h_half_sum
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_mono (hF_int m).norm ((h_exp_shift_int b).const_mul _) (hF_dom m)
    rw [h_peel_sub, MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hF_int h_sum_int]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    dsimp [F, S, greenKernel]
    rw [tsum_mul_right, ← tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm (hG₁_sum_norm a z) (hG₂_sum_norm z b)]
  have hG_lip : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a b - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) a b| ≤ 8 * B_Δ := by
    intro a b
    let K : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
      greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a z * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z b *
        ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) z - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z)
    have hK_cont : Continuous K := by
      dsimp [K]
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a z) :=
        hG₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z b) :=
        hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul (hw₁_cont.sub hw₂_cont)
    have hK_dom : ∀ z : ℝ, ‖K z‖ ≤ (2 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
      intro z
      dsimp [K]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h1 := hG₁_bd_43 a z
      have h2 := hG₂_bd_43_exp z b
      have h12 : |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a z| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z b| ≤
          2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by
        calc |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a z| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z b|
          _ ≤ (4 / 3) * ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by ring
          _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) a z| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z b| *
            |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) z - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z|
        _ ≤ (2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|)) * B_Δ :=
          mul_le_mul h12 (hΔ_bd z) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := by ring
    have hK_int : Integrable K volume :=
      ((h_exp_shift_int b).const_mul (2 * B_Δ)).mono' hK_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hK_dom)
    rw [h_res a b, abs_neg]
    calc |∫ z : ℝ, K z|
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K z‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm K
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, (2 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) :=
        integral_mono hK_int.norm ((h_exp_shift_int b).const_mul (2 * B_Δ)) hK_dom
      _ = (2 * B_Δ) * ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - b|) := integral_const_mul (2 * B_Δ) _
      _ ≤ (2 * B_Δ) * 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_shift_le b) (by positivity)
      _ = 8 * B_Δ := by ring
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
    greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x *
      ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
    greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * v y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x
  have hA_cont : Continuous A := by
    dsimp [A]
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) :=
      hG₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul (hw₁_cont.sub hw₂_cont)
  have hA_int : Integrable A volume := by
    refine ((h_exp_shift_int x).const_mul (2 * B_Δ)).mono' hA_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    dsimp [A]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
        _ ≤ (4 / 3) * ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) :=
          mul_le_mul (hG₁_bd_43 x y) (hG₂_bd_43_exp y x) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    calc |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| *
          |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y|
      _ ≤ (2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) * B_Δ :=
        mul_le_mul h12 (hΔ_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (2 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
  have hB_cont : Continuous B := by
    dsimp [B]
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact (hc1.mul hv_cont).mul hc2
  have hB_int : Integrable B volume := by
    refine ((h_exp_shift_int x).const_mul (2 * B_v)).mono' hB_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    dsimp [B]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
        _ ≤ (4 / 3) * ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) :=
          mul_le_mul (hG₂_bd_43 x y) (hG₂_bd_43_exp y x) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    calc |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |v y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
      _ = (|greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|) * |v y| := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) * B_v :=
        mul_le_mul h12 (hv_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (2 * B_v) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
  have h_comb_eq : diagGreen κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - diagGreen κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * (-∫ y : ℝ, B y) =
      -∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y) := by
    dsimp [diagGreen]
    rw [h_res x x]
    change -(∫ y : ℝ, A y) - h * (-∫ y : ℝ, B y) = -∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y)
    have h_sub_int : ∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y) = (∫ y : ℝ, A y) - h * (∫ y : ℝ, B y) := by
      rw [integral_sub hA_int (hB_int.const_mul h), integral_const_mul]
    linarith
  have h_pt_bound : ∀ y : ℝ,
      ‖A y - h * B y‖ ≤ (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
    intro y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_alg : A y - h * B y =
        (greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) *
          ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y) +
        ((greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
          greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) * ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) := by
      dsimp [A, B]
      ring
    rw [h_alg]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| ≤
        4 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| * |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
        _ ≤ (4 / 3) * ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) :=
          mul_le_mul (hG₂_bd_43 x y) (hG₂_bd_43_exp y x) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    have ht1 : |(greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) *
        ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y)| ≤
        (4 * B_lin) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| *
            |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y|
        _ ≤ (4 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) * B_lin :=
          mul_le_mul h12 (hlin_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (4 * B_lin) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
    have hG2_le2 : |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
        _ ≤ (4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := hG₂_bd_43_exp y x
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    have h_diff : |(greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
        greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| ≤
        (16 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y| *
            |greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x|
        _ ≤ (8 * B_Δ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) :=
          mul_le_mul (hG_lip x y) hG2_le2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (16 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
    have ht2 : |((greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
        greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) * ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y)| ≤
        (16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |(greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
            greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x| * |(w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y|
        _ ≤ ((16 * B_Δ) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|)) * B_Δ :=
          mul_le_mul h_diff (hΔ_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
    calc |(greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) *
            ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y) +
          ((greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
            greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) * ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y)|
      _ ≤ |(greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y * greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) *
            ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y - h * v y)| +
          |((greenKernel κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x y - greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x y) *
            greenKernel κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y x) * ((w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y)| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (4 * B_lin) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) +
          (16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := add_le_add ht1 ht2
      _ = (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) := by ring
  change |diagGreen κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - diagGreen κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x - h * (-∫ y : ℝ, B y)| ≤
      16 * B_lin + 64 * B_Δ ^ 2
  rw [h_comb_eq, abs_neg]
  calc |∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y)|
    _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, ‖A y - h * B y‖ := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun y => A y - h * B y)
    _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
      integral_mono (hA_int.sub (hB_int.const_mul h)).norm
        ((h_exp_shift_int x).const_mul (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2)) h_pt_bound
    _ = (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |y - x|) :=
      integral_const_mul (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) _
    _ ≤ (4 * B_lin + 16 * B_Δ ^ 2) * 4 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_shift_le x) (by positivity)
    _ = 16 * B_lin + 64 * B_Δ ^ 2 := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(u : ℝ → CinfT) (hu : IsSmoothSolutionT u) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    Function.Periodic (kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
    (∃ (M_kdv M₁ M₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_kdv ∧ 0 ≤ M₁ ∧ 0 ≤ M₂ ∧
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
        |kdvRHS (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M_kdv) ∧
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
        |(u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M₁ * |τ - t₀|) ∧
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
        |(u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - t₀) * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤
          M₂ * |τ - t₀| ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
        ((1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) t₀)

(u : ℝ → CinfT) (hu : IsSmoothSolutionT u) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (t₀ : ℝ) :

proof.tactics:
by
  let U : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => (u p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2
  have hU_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) U := hu.1
  have hU_per : ∀ t : ℝ, Function.Periodic (fun y : ℝ => U (t, y)) 1 :=
    fun t => (u t).2.2
  have h_dt_prop : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G →
      (∀ t : ℝ, Function.Periodic (fun y : ℝ => G (t, y)) 1) →
      let G_t : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ G p (1, 0)
      ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G_t ∧
      (∀ t y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y)) (G_t (t, y)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, Function.Periodic (fun y : ℝ => G_t (t, y)) 1) := by
    intro G hG hG_per
    let G_t : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ G p (1, 0)
    have hGt_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) G_t :=
      (hG.fderiv_right (m := ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hGt_deriv : ∀ t y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y)) (G_t (t, y)) t := by
      intro t y
      have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (t, y) :=
        hG.differentiable (by decide) (t, y)
      have h_curve : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ, y)) (1, 0) t :=
        (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t y)
      exact h_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h_curve
    have hGt_per : ∀ t : ℝ, Function.Periodic (fun y : ℝ => G_t (t, y)) 1 := by
      intro t y
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y + 1)) (G_t (t, y + 1)) t :=
        hGt_deriv t (y + 1)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y)) (G_t (t, y)) t :=
        hGt_deriv t y
      have h_eq : (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y + 1)) = (fun τ : ℝ => G (τ, y)) :=
        funext (fun τ => hG_per τ y)
      rw [h_eq] at h1
      exact h1.unique h2
    exact ⟨hGt_smooth, hGt_deriv, hGt_per⟩
  let V_t : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ U p (1, 0)
  obtain ⟨hVt_smooth, hU_deriv, hVt_per⟩ := h_dt_prop U hU_smooth hU_per
  let A_t : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fderiv ℝ V_t p (1, 0)
  obtain ⟨hAt_smooth, hVt_deriv, hAt_per⟩ := h_dt_prop V_t hVt_smooth hVt_per
  have h_kdv_eq : ∀ t y : ℝ, kdvRHS (u t : ℝ → ℝ) y = V_t (t, y) := by
    intro t y
    exact (hu.2 t y).unique (hU_deriv t y)
  have h_kdv_fn_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, kdvRHS (u t : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y : ℝ => V_t (t, y) :=
    fun t => funext (h_kdv_eq t)
  have hkdv_cont_t0 : Continuous (kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    rw [h_kdv_fn_eq t₀]
    exact hVt_smooth.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hkdv_per_t0 : Function.Periodic (kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 := by
    rw [h_kdv_fn_eq t₀]
    exact hVt_per t₀
  have h_strip_bound : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous F →
      (∀ t : ℝ, Function.Periodic (fun y : ℝ => F (t, y)) 1) →
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ, |F (τ, y)| ≤ M := by
    intro F hF_cont hF_per
    let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF_cont.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0, fun τ hτ y => ?_⟩
    let y₀ : ℝ := Int.fract y
    have hy₀_mem : y₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨Int.fract_nonneg y, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one y)⟩
    have hp_mem : (τ, y₀) ∈ K := ⟨hτ, hy₀_mem⟩
    have h_eq : F (τ, y) = F (τ, y₀) := by
      have h_p : F (τ, y - (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1) = F (τ, y) :=
        (hF_per τ).sub_int_mul_eq (⌊y⌋)
      rw [mul_one] at h_p
      exact h_p.symm
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_le_C : |F (τ, y₀)| ≤ C := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC (τ, y₀) hp_mem
    exact le_trans h_le_C (le_max_left C 0)
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀_nn, hU_bd⟩ := h_strip_bound U hU_smooth.continuous hU_per
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁_nn, hVt_bd⟩ := h_strip_bound V_t hVt_smooth.continuous hVt_per
  obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂_nn, hAt_bd⟩ := h_strip_bound A_t hAt_smooth.continuous hAt_per
  have ht₀_mem : t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_mvt_1d : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b B : ℝ),
      (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, |f' t| ≤ B) →
      |f b - f a| ≤ B * |b - a| := by
    intro f f' a b B h_deriv h_bd
    have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (f := f) (f' := f') (s := Set.uIcc a b) (x := a) (y := b)
      (fun t _ => (h_deriv t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_bd t ht)
      (convex_uIcc a b) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_mvt
  have h_uIcc_abs : ∀ {a b t : ℝ}, t ∈ Set.uIcc a b → |t - a| ≤ |b - a| := by
    intro a b t ht
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at ht
    rcases ht with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      linarith
  have h_kdv_bd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
      |kdvRHS (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M₁ := by
    intro τ hτ y
    rw [h_kdv_eq τ y]
    exact hVt_bd τ hτ y
  have h_taylor1 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
      |(u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M₁ * |τ - t₀| := by
    intro τ hτ y
    have h_sub : Set.uIcc t₀ τ ⊆ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) :=
      Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ht₀_mem hτ
    exact h_mvt_1d (fun t => U (t, y)) (fun t => V_t (t, y)) t₀ τ M₁
      (fun t => hU_deriv t y)
      (fun t ht => hVt_bd t (h_sub ht) y)
  have h_taylor2 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ∀ y : ℝ,
      |(u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - t₀) * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤
        M₂ * |τ - t₀| ^ 2 := by
    intro τ hτ y
    have h_sub : Set.uIcc t₀ τ ⊆ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) :=
      Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ht₀_mem hτ
    have hVt_inc : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc t₀ τ, |V_t (t, y) - V_t (t₀, y)| ≤ M₂ * |τ - t₀| := by
      intro t ht
      have h_sub_t : Set.uIcc t₀ t ⊆ Set.uIcc t₀ τ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left ht
      have h_mvt_v := h_mvt_1d (fun s => V_t (s, y)) (fun s => A_t (s, y)) t₀ t M₂
        (fun s => hVt_deriv s y)
        (fun s hs => hAt_bd s (h_sub (h_sub_t hs)) y)
      exact le_trans h_mvt_v (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_uIcc_abs ht) hM₂_nn)
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => U (t, y) - (t - t₀) * V_t (t₀, y)
    let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => V_t (t, y) - V_t (t₀, y)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t := by
      intro t
      dsimp [g, g']
      have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t - t₀) * V_t (t₀, y)) (V_t (t₀, y)) t := by
        simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const t₀).mul_const (V_t (t₀, y)))
      exact (hU_deriv t y).sub h_lin
    have h_mvt_g := h_mvt_1d g g' t₀ τ (M₂ * |τ - t₀|) hg_deriv hVt_inc
    have hg_diff : g τ - g t₀ =
        (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (τ - t₀) * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y := by
      dsimp [g, U]
      rw [h_kdv_eq t₀ y]
      ring
    rw [← hg_diff]
    calc |g τ - g t₀|
      _ ≤ (M₂ * |τ - t₀|) * |τ - t₀| := h_mvt_g
      _ = M₂ * |τ - t₀| ^ 2 := by ring
  have h2κ_pos : 0 < 2 * κ := by linarith
  have h_int_Ici : IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |z|)) (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
    have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) h2κ_pos).mono_set
      (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
    refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
    intro z hz
    dsimp
    have hz_nn : 0 ≤ z := hz
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hz_nn]
    ring_nf
  have h_int_Iic : IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |z|)) (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
    have h_neg := h_int_Ici.comp_neg
    rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
    refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
    intro z _
    dsimp
    rw [abs_neg]
  have h_int_Ioi : IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |z|)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume :=
    h_int_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self
  have h_exp_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |z|)) volume := by
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact h_int_Iic.union h_int_Ioi
  have h_conv_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
        ((1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * kdvRHS (u t₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) t₀ := by
    intro x
    have h_exp_x_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|)) volume :=
      h_exp_int.comp_sub_left x
    let S : Set ℝ := Set.Ioo (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1)
    have hS_nhds : S ∈ nhds t₀ := Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun τ y => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y
    let F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun τ y => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * kdvRHS (u τ : ℝ → ℝ) y
    let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * M₁
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ τ in nhds t₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (F τ) volume := by
      filter_upwards with τ
      have hc : Continuous (F τ) := by
        dsimp [F]
        exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|))).mul
          (u τ).2.1.continuous
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hFt0_int : Integrable (F t₀) volume := by
      have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * B₀) volume :=
        h_exp_x_int.mul_const B₀
      have hFt0_cont : Continuous (F t₀) := by
        dsimp [F]
        exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|))).mul
          (u t₀).2.1.continuous
      refine h_dom_int.mono' hFt0_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with y
      dsimp [F]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hU_bd t₀ ht₀_mem y) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    have hF't0_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (F' t₀) volume := by
      have hc : Continuous (F' t₀) := by
        dsimp [F']
        exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|))).mul
          hkdv_cont_t0
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_bound_le : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ τ ∈ S, ‖F' τ y‖ ≤ bound y := by
      filter_upwards with y τ hτ
      dsimp [F', bound]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (h_kdv_bd τ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ) y) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
      h_exp_x_int.mul_const M₁
    have h_diff : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ τ ∈ S, HasDerivAt (fun τ' => F τ' y) (F' τ y) τ := by
      filter_upwards with y τ _
      dsimp [F, F']
      exact (hu.2 τ y).const_mul (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|))
    have h_int_deriv := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      hS_nhds hF_meas hFt0_int hF't0_meas h_bound_le h_bound_int h_diff).2
    exact h_int_deriv.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  exact ⟨hkdv_cont_t0, hkdv_per_t0,
    ⟨M₁, M₁, M₂, hM₁_nn, hM₁_nn, hM₂_nn, h_kdv_bd, h_taylor1, h_taylor2⟩,
    h_conv_deriv⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h_iter : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y| ≤
        ((4 / 3) * r) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|))) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y x) ∧
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) x x) x) ∧
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x')
        (greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x) x) ∧
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x')
        (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x +
          (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m a x) x) ∧
    (∃ B_d : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_d ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterDerivY κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) a x| ≤
        B_d * ((4 / 3) * r) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|))

          _ = (M * (1 / 2) * Real.exp (κ / 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - x₀|)) * |y₁ - y₂| := by ring
      have h_sum_t : |(G y₁ z - G y₂ z) * freeGreenKernel κ z y₁ +
          G y₂ z * (freeGreenKernel κ z y₁ - freeGreenKernel κ z y₂)| ≤
          ((L * (1 / (2 * κ)) + M * (1 / 2)) * Real.exp (κ / 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - x₀|)) * |y₁ - y₂| := by
        linarith
      calc |(G y₁ z - G y₂ z) * freeGreenKernel κ z y₁ +
            G y₂ z * (freeGreenKernel κ z y₁ - freeGreenKernel κ z y₂)| * |w₀ z|
        _ ≤ (((L * (1 / (2 * κ)) + M * (1 / 2)) * Real.exp (κ / 2) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |z - x₀|)) *
              |y₁ - y₂|) * B_w :=
          mul_le_mul h_sum_t (hw_bd z) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = bound z * |y₁ - y₂| := by
          dsimp [bound]
          ring
    have h_ae_ne : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, z ≠ x₀ := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
      have h_set : {z : ℝ | ¬z ≠ x₀} = {x₀} := by ext z; simp
      rw [h_set]
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_singleton x₀
    have h_F_deriv : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, HasDerivAt (fun y => F y z) (F' z) x₀ := by
      filter_upwards [h_ae_ne] with z hzx
      exact ((hG_deriv z hzx).mul_const (w₀ z)).mul (h_fg_deriv z x₀ hzx)
    have h_main := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_lip hs_nhds
      h_F_meas h_Fx₀_int h_F'_meas h_F_lip h_bound_int h_F_deriv).2.neg
    exact ⟨h_int1, h_int2, h_main⟩
  have h_diag_d : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x x) x := by
    intro ℓ x
    have h_s3 :
        Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z x) volume ∧
        Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x) volume ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun y => -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z y * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y)
          (-(∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterDerivY κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z x +
            greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x))) x := by
      cases ℓ with
      | zero =>
        refine h_bilin x (fun y z => freeGreenKernel κ z y) (fun z => freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
          1 (1 / 2) zero_le_one (by norm_num) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro y
          exact (h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact (h_fgd_meas_z x).aestronglyMeasurable
        · intro y z
          simpa only [pow_zero] using (h_iter 0).2 z y
        · intro z
          exact h_fgd_bd z x
        · intro y₁ y₂ z
          exact h_fg_lip z y₁ y₂
        · intro z hzx
          exact h_fg_deriv z x hzx
      | succ m =>
        refine h_bilin x (fun y z => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) z y)
          (fun z => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) z x)
          (((4 / 3) * r) ^ (m + 1)) (B_d * ((4 / 3) * r) ^ m)
          (pow_nonneg h43r_nn (m + 1)) (mul_nonneg hBd_nn (pow_nonneg h43r_nn m))
          ?_ (h_off_cont_z m x).aestronglyMeasurable ?_ ?_ (h_off_lip m) ?_
        · intro y
          exact ((h_iter (m + 1)).1.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · intro y z
          exact (h_iter (m + 1)).2 z y
        · intro z
          exact h_dG_const m z x
        · intro z _
          exact h_off_d1 m z x
    obtain ⟨h_int1, h_int2, h_deriv⟩ := h_s3
    have h_fun_eq : (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) y y) =
        fun y => -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z y * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y := by
      ext y
      change -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y = _
      congr 1
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
      dsimp only
      rw [h_symm ℓ y z]
    have h_val_eq : -(∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterDerivY κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z x +
        greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x)) =
        2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x x := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add h_int1 h_int2, neg_add]
      have h_term2 : -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z x * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x =
          greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x x := by
        change _ = -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x
        congr 1
        refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
        dsimp only
        rw [h_symm ℓ z x]
      rw [h_fub ℓ x, h_term2]
      ring
    rw [h_fun_eq, ← h_val_eq]
    exact h_deriv
  exact ⟨h_symm, h_diag_d, h_off_d1, h_off_d2, B_d, hBd_nn, h_dG_exp⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have hκ_half_pos : 0 < κ / 2 := by positivity
  set w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_geom_tsum : (∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) = 4 / 3 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have h_exp_le_one : ∀ a x : ℝ, Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) ≤ 1 :=
    fun a x => Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - x)])
  have h_G_bd : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a x : ℝ), |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a x| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
    intro ℓ a x
    calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a x|
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) := (h_off_bd ℓ).2.2 a x
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_le_one a x) (by positivity)
      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := mul_one _
  have h_G1_bd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m a x
    calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x|
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := h_G_bd (m + 1) a x
      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
  have h_G1_le_G0 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m a x
    have h1 := h_G1_bd m a x
    have h_diff : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m =
        (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
    have : 0 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_dG_unif : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x| ≤ B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m a x
    calc |greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x|
      _ ≤ B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) := h_dG_bd m a x
      _ ≤ B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_le_one a x) (by positivity)
      _ = B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_one _
  have h_sum_G_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a x‖) := by
    intro a x
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun ℓ => ?_) h_geom_sum
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_G_bd ℓ a x
  have h_sum_G : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G_norm a x).of_norm
  have h_sum_G1_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x‖) :=
    fun a x => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (h_sum_G_norm a x)
  have h_sum_G1 : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G1_norm a x).of_norm
  have h_sum_dG1_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x‖) := by
    intro a x
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_)
      (h_geom_sum.mul_left B_d)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_dG_unif m a x
  have h_sum_dG1 : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_dG1_norm a x).of_norm
  have hG_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w₀ p.1 p.2) :=
    continuous_tsum (fun ℓ => (h_off_bd ℓ).1) h_geom_sum
      (fun ℓ p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_G_bd ℓ p.1 p.2)
  have hg_cont : Continuous (diagGreen κ w₀) :=
    hG_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hG_per : ∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₀ (x + 1) (y + 1) = greenKernel κ w₀ x y := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [greenKernel]
    exact tsum_congr (fun ℓ => (h_off_bd ℓ).2.1 x y)
  have h_G_symm : ∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₀ x y = greenKernel κ w₀ y x := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [greenKernel]
    exact tsum_congr (fun ℓ => h_symm ℓ x y)
  have h_peel_G : ∀ a x : ℝ,
      greenKernel κ w₀ a x = freeGreenKernel κ a x + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G a x).tsum_eq_zero_add
  have h_fg_diag : ∀ x : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have h_peel_diag : ∀ x : ℝ,
      diagGreen κ w₀ x = 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x := by
    intro x
    change greenKernel κ w₀ x x = 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x
    rw [h_peel_G x x, h_fg_diag x]
  have h_diag : ∀ x : ℝ,
      1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w₀ x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w₀) (diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x) x := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_tail_abs : |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x| ≤ 1 / (6 * κ) := by
        calc |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x|
          _ = ‖∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x‖ :=
            norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_sum_G1_norm x x)
          _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
            refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) (h_sum_G1_norm x x)
              (h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (8 * κ)))
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
            calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x x|
              _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := h_diag_bd (m + 1) x
              _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
          _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
          _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * (4 / 3) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]
          _ = 1 / (6 * κ) := by ring
      have h_low := (abs_le.mp h_tail_abs).1
      have h_diff : 1 / (2 * κ) - 1 / (6 * κ) - 1 / (4 * κ) = 1 / (12 * κ) := by
        field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
      have : 0 ≤ 1 / (12 * κ) := by positivity
      linarith [h_peel_diag x]
    · have h_tsum_d : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) y y)
          (diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x) x := by
        refine hasDerivAt_tsum (u := fun m : ℕ => (2 * B_d) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m)
          (g := fun m y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) y y)
          (g' := fun m y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) y y)
          (y₀ := x)
          (h_geom_sum.mul_left (2 * B_d))
          (fun m y => h_diag_d m y)
          (fun m y => ?_)
          (h_sum_G1 x x)
          x
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos two_pos]
        calc 2 * |greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) y y|
          _ ≤ 2 * (B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_dG_unif m y y) zero_le_two
          _ = (2 * B_d) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
      have h_add_d := h_tsum_d.const_add (1 / (2 * κ))
      have h_fn_eq : (fun y : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) y y) =
          diagGreen κ w₀ := by
        ext y
        exact (h_peel_diag y).symm
      rwa [h_fn_eq] at h_add_d
  have hG_exp : ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w₀ x y| ≤ (4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := by
    intro x y
    calc |greenKernel κ w₀ x y|
      _ = ‖∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
      _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_sum_G_norm x y)

    · refine squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => 2 * κ * (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2) (fun x => ?_) ?_
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
          abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (hg_pos x)), div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x)⁻¹
          _ ≤ (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 * (2 * κ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_inv_2g x) (sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 2 * κ * (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 := by ring
      · simpa using ((h_tend_R y).1.pow 2).const_mul (2 * κ)
  have h2gsq_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun x => ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))
  have h_exp_abs_int : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * |u|)) volume := by
    let g0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (-κ * |u|)
    have h_int_Ioi_κ : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * u)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume :=
      exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hκ_pos
    have hg0_eq_Ioi : Set.EqOn g0 (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * u)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro u hu
      dsimp [g0]
      rw [abs_of_pos hu]
    have hg0_int_Ioi : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Ioi 0) volume :=
      h_int_Ioi_κ.congr_fun hg0_eq_Ioi.symm measurableSet_Ioi
    have hg0_int_Ici : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      rwa [integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi]
    have hg0_even : ∀ u : ℝ, g0 (-u) = g0 u := by
      intro u; dsimp [g0]; rw [abs_neg]
    have hg0_int_Iic : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_comp := hg0_int_Ici.comp_neg
      simpa [hg0_even] using h_comp
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact hg0_int_Iic.union hg0_int_Ioi
  have h_int : ∀ y : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (greenKernel κ w₀ x y * greenKernel κ w₀ y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2))
        volume := by
    intro y
    let f_y : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      (greenKernel κ w₀ x y * greenKernel κ w₀ y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2)
    have hf_cont : Continuous f_y := by
      dsimp [f_y]
      have hG1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₀ x y) :=
        hG_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      have hG2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₀ y x) :=
        hG_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hg2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2) :=
        continuous_const.mul (hg_cont.pow 2)
      exact (hG1.mul hG2).div hg2 h2gsq_ne
    have h_exp_y_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|)) volume :=
      h_exp_abs_int.comp_sub_right y
    refine (h_exp_y_int.const_mul ((128 / 9) * κ ^ 2)).mono' hf_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    dsimp [f_y]
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))]
    have h_denom : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2) ≤ 8 * κ ^ 2 := by
      have h_sq : (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2 ≤ (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (h_diag x).1 2
      have h1 : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq zero_le_two)
      have h2 : 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) = 8 * κ ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
      linarith
    have h_num : |greenKernel κ w₀ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₀ y x| ≤
        (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|) := by
      have h1 := hG_exp x y
      have h2 := hG_exp y x
      rw [abs_sub_comm y x] at h2
      calc |greenKernel κ w₀ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₀ y x|
        _ ≤ ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|)) *
            ((4 / 3) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|)) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (16 / 9) * (Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|)) := by ring
        _ = (16 / 9) * Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 2
          ring
    calc (|greenKernel κ w₀ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₀ y x|) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2)
      _ = (|greenKernel κ w₀ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₀ y x|) *
          (1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((16 / 9) * Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|)) * (8 * κ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul h_num h_denom (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = ((128 / 9) * κ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|) := by ring
  refine ⟨hG_cont, hG_per, h_G_symm, fun x => (h_diag x).1, hG_exp, ?_⟩
  intro y
  have h_wronsk_L : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ y →
      2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y x -
        diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x =
        greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x := by
    intro x hx
    let W_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      greenKernelLeft κ w₀ x ξ * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y ξ -
        greenDerivLeft κ w₀ x ξ * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y ξ
    have hW_L_deriv : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Iic x, HasDerivAt W_L 0 ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ_x : ξ ≤ x := hξ
      have hξ_y : ξ ≤ y := le_trans hξ_x hx
      have hd1_x := (h_d1_LR x ξ).1
      have hd2_x := (h_d2_LR x ξ).1 hξ_x
      have hd1_y := (h_d1_LR y ξ).1
      have hd2_y := (h_d2_LR y ξ).1 hξ_y
      refine ((hd1_x.mul hd2_y).sub (hd2_x.mul hd1_y)).congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hW_L_cont : ContinuousWithinAt W_L (Set.Iic x) x :=
      (hW_L_deriv x Set.right_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hW_L_io : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Iio x, HasDerivAt W_L 0 ξ :=
      fun ξ hξ => hW_L_deriv ξ (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hξ)
    have hW_L_tend : Filter.Tendsto W_L Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
      have ht := ((h_tend_L x).1.mul (h_tend_L y).2).sub ((h_tend_L x).2.mul (h_tend_L y).1)
      simpa using ht
    have h_int_W_L := MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      hW_L_cont hW_L_io MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero hW_L_tend
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero, sub_zero] at h_int_W_L
    have hW_L_zero : W_L x = 0 := h_int_W_L.symm
    dsimp [W_L] at hW_L_zero
    have h_gx : greenKernelLeft κ w₀ x x = diagGreen κ w₀ x :=
      (h_eq_LR x x).1 le_rfl
    have h_dgx : greenDerivLeft κ w₀ x x = (diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x + 1) / 2 :=
      (h_jump_LR x).1
    rw [h_gx, h_dgx] at hW_L_zero
    linarith
  have h_wronsk_R : ∀ x : ℝ, y ≤ x →
      2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x -
        diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x =
        -greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x := by
    intro x hx
    let W_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      greenKernelRight κ w₀ x ξ * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y ξ -
        greenDerivRight κ w₀ x ξ * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y ξ
    have hW_R_deriv : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Ici x, HasDerivAt W_R 0 ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ_x : x ≤ ξ := hξ
      have hξ_y : y ≤ ξ := le_trans hx hξ_x
      have hd1_x := (h_d1_LR x ξ).2
      have hd2_x := (h_d2_LR x ξ).2 hξ_x
      have hd1_y := (h_d1_LR y ξ).2
      have hd2_y := (h_d2_LR y ξ).2 hξ_y
      refine ((hd1_x.mul hd2_y).sub (hd2_x.mul hd1_y)).congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hW_R_cont : ContinuousWithinAt W_R (Set.Ici x) x :=
      (hW_R_deriv x Set.left_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hW_R_oi : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Ioi x, HasDerivAt W_R 0 ξ :=
      fun ξ hξ => hW_R_deriv ξ (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hξ)
    have hW_R_tend : Filter.Tendsto W_R Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have ht := ((h_tend_R x).1.mul (h_tend_R y).2).sub ((h_tend_R x).2.mul (h_tend_R y).1)
      simpa using ht
    have h_int_W_R := MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      hW_R_cont hW_R_oi MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero hW_R_tend
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero, zero_sub] at h_int_W_R
    have hW_R_zero : W_R x = 0 := by linarith
    dsimp [W_R] at hW_R_zero
    have h_gx : greenKernelRight κ w₀ x x = diagGreen κ w₀ x :=
      (h_eq_LR x x).2 le_rfl
    have h_dgx : greenDerivRight κ w₀ x x = (diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x - 1) / 2 :=
      (h_jump_LR x).2
    rw [h_gx, h_dgx] at hW_R_zero
    linarith
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
    (greenKernel κ w₀ x y * greenKernel κ w₀ y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2)
  let F_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x)
  let F_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -((greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x))
  have hF_L_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Iic y, HasDerivAt F_L (f x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2g_ne : 2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [hg_pos x])
    have hd_num : HasDerivAt (fun x' => (greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x') ^ 2)
        (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y x) x :=
      ((h_d1_LR y x).1).pow 2
    have hd_den : HasDerivAt (fun x' => 2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x')
        (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x) x :=
      ((h_diag x).2).const_mul 2
    refine (hd_num.div hd_den h2g_ne).congr_deriv ?_
    have hw_L := h_wronsk_L x hx
    have h_eq_y : greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x = greenKernel κ w₀ y x := (h_eq_LR y x).1 hx
    have h_sym_xy : greenKernel κ w₀ x y = greenKernel κ w₀ y x := h_G_symm x y
    have h_num_eq :
        (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) -
          greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x)) =
        2 * (greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 := by
      calc (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) -
            greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x))
        _ = 2 * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x *
              (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x * greenDerivLeft κ w₀ y x -
                diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x) := by ring
        _ = 2 * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x * greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x := by rw [hw_L]
        _ = 2 * (greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 := by ring
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_num_eq, h_eq_y, h_sym_xy]
    ring
  have hF_R_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ici y, HasDerivAt F_R (f x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2g_ne : 2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [hg_pos x])
    have hd_num : HasDerivAt (fun x' => (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x') ^ 2)
        (2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x) x :=
      ((h_d1_LR y x).2).pow 2
    have hd_den : HasDerivAt (fun x' => 2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x')
        (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x) x :=
      ((h_diag x).2).const_mul 2
    refine ((hd_num.div hd_den h2g_ne).neg).congr_deriv ?_
    have hw_R := h_wronsk_R x hx
    have h_eq_y : greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x = greenKernel κ w₀ y x := (h_eq_LR y x).2 hx
    have h_sym_xy : greenKernel κ w₀ x y = greenKernel κ w₀ y x := h_G_symm x y
    have h_num_eq :
        -((2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) -
          greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x)) / (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2) =
        2 * (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) ^ 2 := by
      have h_top :
          (2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) -
            greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x)) =
          -2 * (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 := by
        calc (2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x) -
              greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x))
          _ = 2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x *
                (2 * diagGreen κ w₀ x * greenDerivRight κ w₀ y x -
                  diagGreenDeriv κ w₀ x * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) := by ring
          _ = 2 * greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x * (-greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) := by rw [hw_R]
          _ = -2 * (greenKernelRight κ w₀ y x) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h_top]
      ring
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_num_eq, h_eq_y, h_sym_xy]
    ring
  have h_int_L : ∫ x in Set.Iic y, f x = F_L y - 0 := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_L_deriv y Set.right_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun x hx => hF_L_deriv x (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hx)
    · exact (h_int y).integrableOn
    · exact (h_tend_F y).1
  have h_int_R : ∫ x in Set.Ioi y, f x = 0 - F_R y := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_R_deriv y Set.left_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun x hx => hF_R_deriv x (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hx)
    · exact (h_int y).integrableOn
    · exact (h_tend_F y).2
  have h_split : (∫ x : ℝ, f x) = (∫ x in Set.Iic y, f x) + (∫ x in Set.Ioi y, f x) := by
    rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
    exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic (h_int y)).symm
  change (∫ x : ℝ, f x) = diagGreen κ w₀ y
  rw [h_split, h_int_L, h_int_R]
  dsimp [F_L, F_R]
  have h_gy_L : greenKernelLeft κ w₀ y y = diagGreen κ w₀ y := (h_eq_LR y y).1 le_rfl
  have h_gy_R : greenKernelRight κ w₀ y y = diagGreen κ w₀ y := (h_eq_LR y y).2 le_rfl
  have h_gy_ne : diagGreen κ w₀ y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hg_pos y)
  rw [h_gy_L, h_gy_R]
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x u)) ∧
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u))
