proof.tactics:
by
  let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w₀ := w.2.1
  have hw_per : Function.Periodic w₀ 1 := w.2.2
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_fg_nonneg : ∀ v u : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel κ v u := by
    intro v u
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    positivity
  have h_fg_cont : ∀ u : ℝ, Continuous (fun v : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ v u) := by
    intro u
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    fun_prop
  let f0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * |v|)
  have hf0_Ici : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v)) (Set.Ioi (-1 : ℝ)) volume :=
      exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v)) (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) volume :=
      h1.mono_set (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num))
    refine h2.congr_fun (fun v hv => ?_) measurableSet_Ici
    dsimp [f0]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hv]
  have hf0_Iic : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => f0 (-v)) (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have := hf0_Ici.comp_neg
      rwa [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at this
    refine h1.congr_fun (fun v _ => ?_) measurableSet_Iic
    dsimp [f0]
    rw [abs_neg]
  have hf0_int : Integrable f0 volume := by
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact hf0_Iic.union (hf0_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  have h_fg_int : ∀ u : ℝ, Integrable (fun v : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ v u) volume := by
    intro u
    have h_eq : (fun v : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ v u) = (fun v : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * f0 (v - u)) := by
      ext v; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (hf0_int.comp_sub_right u).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_shift0 : ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u := by
    intro x u
    simp only [shiftedGreenIter, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    have h_sub : x - (x + u) = 0 - u := by ring
    rw [h_sub]
  have h_base0 : ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u := by
    intro x u
    unfold shiftedGreenIterDeriv
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    exact h_shift0 x u
  have h_base_succ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 (n + 1) x u = 0 := by
    intro n x u
    unfold shiftedGreenIterDeriv
    have h_fn : (fun x' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ 0 x' (x' + u)) = (fun _ : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) :=
      funext fun x' => h_shift0 x' u
    rw [h_fn, iteratedDeriv_const, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
  have h_shift_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ (m + 1) x u =
      -∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x v * w₀ (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u := by
    intro m x u
    simp only [shiftedGreenIter, greenIterKernel]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self
      (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m x z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z (x + u)) x]
    congr 1
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
    dsimp
    congr 1
    simp only [freeGreenKernel]
    have h_sub : x + v - (x + u) = v - u := by ring
    rw [h_sub]
  have s2_step : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => F x v)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => -∫ v : ℝ, F x v * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x =
          -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
        Continuous (fun u => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x u : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x| ≤ B) := by
    intro F hF_smooth hF_cont hF_bound
    let I : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n x u =>
      -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u
    have h_hasDerivAt : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x₀ u : ℝ),

      intro n x₀ u
      obtain ⟨M_n, hMn_nn, hMn⟩ := hF_bound n
      obtain ⟨M_succ, hMsucc_nn, hMsucc⟩ := hF_bound (n + 1)
      let Φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u

      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => M_succ * freeGreenKernel κ v u
      have h_meas : ∀ᶠ x in nhds x₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (Φ x) volume :=
        Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ((hF_cont n x).mul (h_fg_cont u)).aestronglyMeasurable
      have h_int_x0 : Integrable (Φ x₀) volume := by
        refine ((h_fg_int u).const_mul M_n).mono'
          (((hF_cont n x₀).mul (h_fg_cont u)).aestronglyMeasurable)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        dsimp [Φ]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg v u)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x₀ v) (h_fg_nonneg v u)
      have h_meas' : AEStronglyMeasurable (Φ' x₀) volume :=

      have h_bound_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), ‖Φ' x v‖ ≤ bound v := by

        dsimp [Φ', bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg v u)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMsucc x v) (h_fg_nonneg v u)
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume := (h_fg_int u).const_mul M_succ
      have h_diff : ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun x' => Φ x' v) (Φ' x v) x := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v x _ => ?_
        have hd_diff : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v)) :=
          (hF_smooth v).differentiable_iteratedDeriv n (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top n))
        have hd : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v))
            (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun x' => F x' v) x) x := by
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
          exact (hd_diff x).hasDerivAt
        exact hd.mul_const (freeGreenKernel κ v u)

        (s := Set.univ) Filter.univ_mem h_meas h_int_x0 h_meas' h_bound_ae h_bound_int h_diff
      exact h_main.2.neg
    have hI0 : ∀ x u : ℝ, I 0 x u = -∫ v : ℝ, F x v * freeGreenKernel κ v u := by
      intro x u
      dsimp [I]
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have h_iter_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) = fun x => I n x u := by
      intro n u
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        ext x
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, hI0 x u]
      | succ n ih =>
        ext x
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
        exact (h_hasDerivAt n x u).deriv
    have h_smooth_G : ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => -∫ v : ℝ, F x v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) := by
      intro u
      refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv fun n _ => ?_
      rw [h_iter_eq n u]
      intro x
      exact (h_hasDerivAt n x u).differentiableAt
    have h_deriv_G : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x u : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x = I n x u := by
      intro n x u
      exact congrFun (h_iter_eq n u) x
    have hI_shift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x u : ℝ),
        I n x u = -∫ y : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' (u + y)) x * freeGreenKernel κ y 0 := by
      intro n x u
      dsimp [I]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self
        (fun v : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' v) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u) u]
      congr 1
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      dsimp
      congr 1
      simp only [freeGreenKernel]
      have h_sub : u + y - u = y - 0 := by ring
      rw [h_sub]

      intro n x
      obtain ⟨M_n, hMn_nn, hMn⟩ := hF_bound n
      have h_eq : (fun u => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x) =
          (fun u => -∫ y : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' (u + y)) x * freeGreenKernel κ y 0) := by
        ext u
        rw [h_deriv_G n x u, hI_shift n x u]
      rw [h_eq]
      refine Continuous.neg ?_
      refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated
        (bound := fun y => M_n * freeGreenKernel κ y 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro u
        exact (((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).mul (h_fg_cont 0)).aestronglyMeasurable
      · intro u
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        dsimp
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      · exact (h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        exact ((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
    have h_bound_G : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x u : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x| ≤ B := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨M_n, hMn_nn, hMn⟩ := hF_bound n
      let B : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, M_n * freeGreenKernel κ y 0
      have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := by
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg fun y => ?_
        exact mul_nonneg hMn_nn (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      refine ⟨B, hB_nn, fun x u => ?_⟩
      rw [h_deriv_G n x u, hI_shift n x u, abs_neg, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine le_trans (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) ?_
      have h_int_lhs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' (u + y)) x * freeGreenKernel κ y 0‖) volume := by
        refine ((h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n).mono'
          ((((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).mul (h_fg_cont 0)).norm.aestronglyMeasurable)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
        dsimp
        rw [abs_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_int_lhs ((h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      dsimp
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
    exact ⟨h_smooth_G, h_deriv_G, h_cont_G, h_bound_G⟩
  have h_w_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x v : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv k (fun x' : ℝ => w₀ (x' + v)) x = iteratedDeriv k w₀ (x + v) := by
    intro k x v
    exact congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const k w₀ v) x
  have hW_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, Continuous (iteratedDeriv k w₀) := by
    intro k
    exact hw_smooth.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hW_per : ∀ k : ℕ, Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv k w₀) 1 := by
    intro k y
    have h_shift : (fun x' : ℝ => w₀ (x' + 1)) = w₀ := funext hw_per
    calc iteratedDeriv k w₀ (y + 1)
      _ = iteratedDeriv k (fun x' : ℝ => w₀ (x' + 1)) y := (h_w_iter k y 1).symm
      _ = iteratedDeriv k w₀ y := by rw [h_shift]
  have hW_bound : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w₀ y| ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hW_cont k).continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0, fun y => ?_⟩
    let y₀ : ℝ := Int.fract y
    have hy₀_mem : y₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨Int.fract_nonneg y, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one y)⟩
    have hy_eq : y₀ + (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1 = y := by
      dsimp [y₀]
      linarith [Int.self_sub_floor y]
    have h_per_y : iteratedDeriv k w₀ y = iteratedDeriv k w₀ y₀ := by
      calc iteratedDeriv k w₀ y
        _ = iteratedDeriv k w₀ (y₀ + (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1) := by rw [hy_eq]
        _ = iteratedDeriv k w₀ y₀ := (hW_per k).int_mul ⌊y⌋ y₀
    rw [h_per_y, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_trans (hC y₀ hy₀_mem) (le_max_left C 0)
  let C_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (hW_bound k)
  have hC_seq_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_seq k := fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hW_bound k)).1
  have hC_seq : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv k w₀ y| ≤ C_seq k :=
    fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hW_bound k)).2
  have s3_step : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v) x)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v * w₀ (x + v))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M' ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x| ≤ M') ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) := by
    intro g hg_smooth hg_cont hg_bound
    have h_smooth_prod : ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v * w₀ (x + v)) := by
      intro v
      have hw_sm : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : ℝ => w₀ (x + v)) :=
        hw_smooth.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      exact (hg_smooth v).mul hw_sm
    have h_leibniz : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x v : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v) := by
      intro n x v
      have hg_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (n : ℕ∞) (fun x' : ℝ => g x' v) x :=
        (hg_smooth v).contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have hw_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (n : ℕ∞) (fun x' : ℝ => w₀ (x' + v)) x :=
        (hw_smooth.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have h_mul := iteratedDeriv_mul hg_cd hw_cd
      change iteratedDeriv n ((fun x' => g x' v) * (fun x' => w₀ (x' + v))) x = _
      rw [h_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [h_w_iter (n - j) x v]
    have h_cont_prod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x) := by
      intro n x
      have h_eq : (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x) =
          fun v => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v) :=
        funext fun v => h_leibniz n x v
      rw [h_eq]
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
      have hw_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v)) :=
        (hW_cont (n - j)).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      exact (continuous_const.mul (hg_cont j x)).mul hw_cont
    let M_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (hg_bound j)
    have hM_seq_nn : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_seq j := fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hg_bound j)).1
    have hM_seq : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x v : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤ M_seq j :=
      fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hg_bound j)).2
    have h_bound_prod : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M' ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x| ≤ M' := by
      intro n
      let M' : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * M_seq j * C_seq (n - j)
      have hM'_nn : 0 ≤ M' := by
        refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 (hM_seq_nn j)) (hC_seq_nn (n - j))
      refine ⟨M', hM'_nn, fun x v => ?_⟩
      rw [h_leibniz n x v]
      refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
      have h1 : (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * M_seq j :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM_seq j x v) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      exact mul_le_mul h1 (hC_seq (n - j) (x + v)) (abs_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hM_seq_nn j))
    have h_int_sum : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x u : ℝ),
        -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) := by
      intro n x u
      let h_term : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j v =>
        iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u
      have h_term_int : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          Integrable (fun v : ℝ => (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * h_term j v) volume := by
        intro j _
        refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
        have hw_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v)) :=
          (hW_cont (n - j)).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
        refine ((h_fg_int u).const_mul (M_seq j * C_seq (n - j))).mono'
          (((hg_cont j x).mul hw_cont).mul (h_fg_cont u)).aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        dsimp [h_term]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg v u)]
        have h_prod : |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| * |iteratedDeriv (n - j) w₀ (x + v)| ≤
            M_seq j * C_seq (n - j) :=
          mul_le_mul (hM_seq j x v) (hC_seq (n - j) (x + v)) (abs_nonneg _) (hM_seq_nn j)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod (h_fg_nonneg v u)
      have h_eq : (fun v : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u) =
          fun v : ℝ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * h_term j v := by
        ext v
        rw [h_leibniz n x v, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        dsimp [h_term]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ h_term_int, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, mul_neg]
    exact ⟨h_smooth_prod, h_cont_prod, h_bound_prod, h_int_sum⟩
  have h_inv : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x u)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun u => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x' u) x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x' u) x| ≤ M) := by
    intro m
    induction m with

      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ 0 x u) = fun _ : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ 0 u :=

        rw [h_fn]
        exact contDiff_const

        rcases n with _ | n
        · have h_fn : (fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv 0 (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ 0 x' u) x) =

          unfold freeGreenKernel

          exact continuous_const

          rw [h_base0 x u]
          unfold freeGreenKernel
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * |0 - u|) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
            exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)

            _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp (by positivity)

      have h_eq_fn : ∀ u : ℝ, (fun x : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ (m + 1) x u) =
          fun x : ℝ => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x v * w₀ (x + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u :=
        fun u => funext fun x => h_shift_succ m x u
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        rw [h_eq_fn u]
        exact hG_sm u
      · intro n x
        have h_eq_u : (fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ (m + 1) x' u) x) =
            fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x := by
          ext u
          rw [h_eq_fn u]
        rw [h_eq_u]
        exact hG_cont n x
      · intro n
        obtain ⟨B, hB_nn, hB⟩ := hG_bd n
        refine ⟨B, hB_nn, fun x u => ?_⟩
        rw [h_eq_fn u]
        exact hB x u
  refine ⟨fun m u => (h_inv m).1 u, h_base0, h_base_succ, ?_⟩
  intro m n x u
  obtain ⟨h_sm_m, h_cont_m, h_bd_m⟩ := h_inv m
  obtain ⟨hF_sm, hF_cont, hF_bd, h_int_sum⟩ :=
    s3_step (shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m) h_sm_m h_cont_m h_bd_m
  obtain ⟨_, hG_deriv, _, _⟩ :=
    s2_step (fun x v => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x v * w₀ (x + v)) hF_sm hF_cont hF_bd
  have h_eq_fn : (fun x' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x' (x' + u)) =
      fun x' : ℝ => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ m x' v * w₀ (x' + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u :=
    funext fun x' => h_shift_succ m x' u
  change iteratedDeriv n (fun x' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) x' (x' + u)) x = _
  rw [h_eq_fn, hG_deriv n x u, h_int_sum n x u]
  rfl

      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧

      IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f η‖ ≤ M) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧

        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_κ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  have h_denom_ge1 : ∀ η : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 := fun η => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η, sq_nonneg (κ - 1)]
  obtain ⟨⟨h_inv_int, h_inv_eq⟩, _⟩ := freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq κ hκ
  have h_line := freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds κ hκ
  
  have h_fl_cont_bound : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Integrable f volume →
      Continuous (fourierLine f) ∧ ∃ C_f : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine f ζ‖ ≤ C_f := by
    intro f hf_cont hf_int
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ζ z => Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (f z : ℂ)
    let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ‖f z‖
    have hw_int : Integrable bound volume := hf_int.norm
    have hK_meas : ∀ ζ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K ζ) volume := by
      intro ζ
      have hc : Continuous (K ζ) := by
        dsimp [K]
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hf_cont)
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hK_dom : ∀ ζ : ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K ζ z‖ ≤ bound z := by
      intro ζ
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K, bound]
      rw [norm_mul, show -((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ζ * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => K ζ z) := by
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K]
      exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
        continuous_const
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z) :=
      continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hw_int hK_cont
    refine ⟨continuous_const.mul h_int_cont,
      ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ z : ℝ, bound z,
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _)), ?_⟩
    intro ζ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    rw [norm_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z‖
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K ζ z‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (K ζ)
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z :=
        integral_mono_ae ((hw_int.mono' (hK_meas ζ) (hK_dom ζ)).norm) hw_int (hK_dom ζ)
  
  have laplace_cos_integral_Ioi : ∀ c : ℝ,
      ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v) =
        κ / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    intro c
    have h_den : 0 < κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by positivity
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
      Real.exp (-κ * v) * (-κ * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)) / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
      dsimp [F]
      fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * x)) (Real.exp (-κ * v) * (-κ)) v := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) (-κ) v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-κ)
        exact h1.exp
      have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => c * x) c v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul c
      have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (c * x)) (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.cos
      have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (c * x)) (Real.cos (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.sin
      have hd_trig : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -κ * Real.cos (c * x) + c * Real.sin (c * x))
          (-κ * (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) + c * (Real.cos (c * v) * c)) v :=
        (hd_cos.const_mul (-κ)).add (hd_sin.const_mul c)
      have hd_prod := (hd_exp.mul hd_trig).div_const (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
      convert hd_prod using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have hf_int : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) := by fun_prop
      refine (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hκ_pos).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v _
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc Real.exp (-κ * v) * |Real.cos (c * v)|
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-κ * v) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-κ * v) := mul_one _
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      let C : ℝ := (κ + |c|) / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
      apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * v) * C)
      · intro v
        dsimp [F, C]
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
            abs_of_pos h_den, mul_div_assoc]
        gcongr
        calc |-κ * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)|
          _ ≤ |-κ * Real.cos (c * v)| + |c * Real.sin (c * v)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = κ * |Real.cos (c * v)| + |c| * |Real.sin (c * v)| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hκ_pos]
          _ ≤ κ * 1 + |c| * 1 := by
              gcongr
              · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
              · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
          _ = κ + |c| := by ring
      · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = 0 * C by ring]
        apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const
        apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
        have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hκ_pos Filter.tendsto_id
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(κ * x)) := by ext x; ring
        change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv hf_int hF_lim
    rw [h_res]
    dsimp [F]
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
    ring
  let f_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * |v|)
  have hf_R_Ici : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
    have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos).mono_set
      (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
    refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
    intro v hv
    dsimp [f_R]
    have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]
  have hf_R_Iic : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
    have h_neg := hf_R_Ici.comp_neg
    rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
    refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
    intro v _
    dsimp [f_R]
    rw [abs_neg]
  have hf_R_int : Integrable f_R volume := by
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact hf_R_Iic.union (hf_R_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  have h_fg0_eq : freeGreenKernel κ 0 = fun u => (1 / (2 * κ)) * f_R u := by
    ext u
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel, f_R]
    rw [zero_sub, abs_neg]
  have h_cos_full : ∀ c : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun v : ℝ => f_R v * Real.cos (c * v)) volume ∧
      (∫ v : ℝ, f_R v * Real.cos (c * v)) = 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    intro c
    let g_cos : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.cos (c * v)
    have hg_cos_int : Integrable g_cos volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous g_cos := by dsimp [g_cos, f_R]; fun_prop
      refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      dsimp [g_cos]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
      calc f_R v * |Real.cos (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
      _ = f_R v := mul_one _
    refine ⟨hg_cos_int, ?_⟩
    have h_even : ∀ v : ℝ, g_cos (-v) = g_cos v := by
      intro v
      dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
      rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
    have h_split0 : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg_cos_int.integrableOn hg_cos_int.integrableOn).symm
    have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v := by
      have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g_cos
      rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
      rw [← h_neg]
      congr 1 with v
      exact (h_even v).symm
    have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) =
        ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro v hv
      dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
      have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv
      rw [abs_of_pos hv_pos]
    rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_ioi_eq, laplace_cos_integral_Ioi c]
    ring
  have h_sin_full : ∀ c : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun v : ℝ => f_R v * Real.sin (c * v)) volume ∧
      (∫ v : ℝ, f_R v * Real.sin (c * v)) = 0 := by
    intro c
    let g_sin : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.sin (c * v)
    have hg_sin_int : Integrable g_sin volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous g_sin := by dsimp [g_sin, f_R]; fun_prop
      refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      dsimp [g_sin]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
      calc f_R v * |Real.sin (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
      _ = f_R v := mul_one _
    refine ⟨hg_sin_int, ?_⟩
    have h_odd : ∀ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v) = -g_sin v := by
      intro v
      dsimp [g_sin, f_R]
      rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      ring
    have h1 := integral_neg_eq_self g_sin volume
    have h2 : (∫ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v)) = -(∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v) := by
      rw [← integral_neg]
      congr 1 with v
      exact h_odd v
    linarith
  have h_fg0_int : Integrable (freeGreenKernel κ 0) volume := by
    rw [h_fg0_eq]
    exact hf_R_int.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_fg0_val : (∫ u : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) = 1 / κ ^ 2 := by
    have h0 := (h_cos_full 0).2
    have h_eq_fR : (fun v : ℝ => f_R v * Real.cos (0 * v)) = f_R := by
      ext v; rw [zero_mul, Real.cos_zero, mul_one]
    rw [h_eq_fR] at h0
    rw [h_fg0_eq, integral_const_mul, h0]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_fourier_0 : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (freeGreenKernel κ 0 u : ℂ)) volume ∧
      (∫ u : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (freeGreenKernel κ 0 u : ℂ)) =
        1 / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro ξ
    obtain ⟨hc_int, hc_val⟩ := h_cos_full ξ
    obtain ⟨hs_int, hs_val⟩ := h_sin_full ξ
    let g_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / (2 * κ)) * (f_R u * Real.cos (ξ * u))
    let g_s : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / (2 * κ)) * (f_R u * Real.sin (ξ * u))
    have hgc_int : Integrable g_c volume := hc_int.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
    have hgs_int : Integrable g_s volume := hs_int.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
    have h_fn : (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (freeGreenKernel κ 0 u : ℂ)) =
        (fun u : ℝ => (g_c u : ℂ) - I * (g_s u : ℂ)) := by
      ext u
      dsimp [g_c, g_s, freeGreenKernel, f_R]
      rw [zero_sub, abs_neg]
      have h_arg : -((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I = (↑(-(ξ * u)) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
          Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h1 : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => (g_c u : ℂ)) volume := hgc_int.ofReal
    have h2 : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => I * (g_s u : ℂ)) volume := hgs_int.ofReal.const_mul I
    have hc1 : (∫ u : ℝ, (g_c u : ℂ)) = ((∫ u : ℝ, g_c u : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hgc_int
    have hc2 : (∫ u : ℝ, (g_s u : ℂ)) = ((∫ u : ℝ, g_s u : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hgs_int
    refine ⟨by rw [h_fn]; exact h1.sub h2, ?_⟩
    rw [h_fn, integral_sub h1 h2, integral_const_mul, hc1, hc2]
    dsimp [g_c, g_s]
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hc_val, hs_val]
    have h_κ_c : (κ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_κ_ne
    have h_den_c : ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ))
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_fourier_v : ∀ (v ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (freeGreenKernel κ v u : ℂ)) volume ∧

          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
          (13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT W))) * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
          ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) →
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    Function.Periodic (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x) ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x ∧
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x

(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : CinfT)
    (hw : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 * κ)
    (h_leibniz :
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x u)) ∧
      (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
      (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) n x u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)))
    (h_h1_step :
      (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧

        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * (W : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
          (13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT W))) * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),

          0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
          ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) →
        IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
        (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
          (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
        Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))) :
    ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
    Function.Periodic (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x) ∧
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x) ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ y y) x ∧
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x ∧
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ + 1) y y) x

proof.tactics:
by
  let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw₀_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w₀ := w.2.1
  have hw₀_per : Function.Periodic w₀ 1 := w.2.2
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  obtain ⟨h_contDiff, h_base0, h_base_succ, h_rec⟩ := h_leibniz
  obtain ⟨h_good0, h_step, h_comb⟩ := h_h1_step
  obtain ⟨_, h_good_zero, h_sob, _, _⟩ := KdV.freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds κ hκ
  have h_freq_zero : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun _ : ℝ => 0) η‖ ≤ M := by
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, fun η => ?_⟩
    have h_fl0 : fourierLine (fun _ : ℝ => 0) η = 0 := by
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      simp
    rw [h_fl0, norm_zero, mul_zero]
  have h_iter_add : ∀ m k : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv m (iteratedDeriv k w₀) = iteratedDeriv (m + k) w₀ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih k, ← iteratedDeriv_succ, Nat.add_right_comm m 1 k]
  have hW_smooth : ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv k w₀) := by
    intro k
    refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [h_iter_add m k]
    exact hw₀_smooth.differentiable_iteratedDeriv (m + k)
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top (m + k)))
  have hW_per : ∀ k : ℕ, Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv k w₀) 1 := by
    intro k x
    have h_shift : (fun z : ℝ => w₀ (z + 1)) = w₀ := funext hw₀_per
    calc iteratedDeriv k w₀ (x + 1)
      _ = iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℝ => w₀ (z + 1)) x :=
        (congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const k w₀ 1) x).symm
      _ = iteratedDeriv k w₀ x := by rw [h_shift]
  let W : ℕ → CinfT := fun k => ⟨iteratedDeriv k w₀, hW_smooth k, hW_per k⟩
  have hW0 : W 0 = w := Subtype.ext iteratedDeriv_zero
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (W k)))
  have hr_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ r k := fun k => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hr0 : r 0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [hW0]
    have h_mul : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / 26) ^ 2 := by
      calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) * ((1 / 26) ^ 2 * κ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 26) ^ 2 := by field_simp
    have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ≤ 1 / 26 := by
      calc Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 26) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_mul
        _ = 1 / 26 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have h_step_sum : ∀ (a R : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ R m) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a m + R m) →
      Summable R →
      Summable a := by
    intro a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
    refine summable_of_sum_range_le ha_nn (c := 2 * a 0 + 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, R m) ?_
    intro N
    have h_shift : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m + a N = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) + a 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_succ, ← Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have haN : 0 ≤ a N := ha_nn N
    have h_sum_step : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) ≤
        (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
      calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1)
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((1 / 2) * a m + R m) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => h_le m)
        _ = (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hR_bound : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, R m :=
      hR_sum.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range N) (fun m _ => hR_nn m)
    linarith
  have h_nn : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro n
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact zero_le_one
      · exact le_rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro n
      change 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ =>
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hr_nn _) (ih j)))
  have h_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n
      let R : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      have ha_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m := fun m => h_nn m n
      have hR_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ R m := fun m =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ =>
          mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hr_nn _) (h_nn m j)))
      have h_le : ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a m + R m := by
        intro m
        have h_eq : a (m + 1) = R m + (Nat.choose n n : ℝ) * (r (n - n) * a m) := by
          change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j) =
            R m + (Nat.choose n n : ℝ) * (r (n - n) * a m)
          exact Finset.sum_range_succ _ n
        rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_self] at h_eq
        have hr0_mul : r 0 * a m ≤ (1 / 2) * a m :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr0 (ha_nn m)
        linarith
      have hR_sum : Summable R := by
        refine summable_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
        exact ((ih j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).mul_left (r (n - j))).mul_left (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
      exact h_step_sum a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
  have h_prof : ∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m n x) ∧
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ,
        (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m n x) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m n x)) ≤
        shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro n x
      rcases n with _ | n
      · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 0 x = freeGreenKernel κ 0 :=
          funext (h_base0 x)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_good0
      · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ 0 (n + 1) x = fun _ : ℝ => 0 :=
          funext (h_base_succ n x)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact ⟨h_good_zero.1, h_freq_zero, le_of_eq h_good_zero.2⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      intro n x
      let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
      let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j u =>
        -∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x v *
          (W (n - j) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u
      have hF : ∀ j : ℕ,
          IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
          (∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F j) η‖ ≤ M) ∧
          Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)) ≤ r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j := by
        intro j
        have h_st := h_step (W (n - j)) x
          (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m j x) (ih j x).1 (ih j x).2.1
        refine ⟨h_st.1, h_st.2.1, le_trans h_st.2.2 ?_⟩
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih j x).2.2 (hr_nn (n - j))
      have h_cb := h_comb n c F (fun j _ => ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg _, (hF j).1, (hF j).2.1⟩)
      have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ (m + 1) n x =
          fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u :=
        funext (h_rec m n x)
      rw [h_eq]
      refine ⟨h_cb.1, h_cb.2.1, le_trans h_cb.2.2 ?_⟩
      change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF j).2.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have h_sup : ∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m n x u| ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n := by
    intro m n x u
    exact le_trans (h_sob (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w₀ m n x) (h_prof m n x).1 u)
      (h_prof m n x).2.2
  let h : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y y
  let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) y y
  have hf_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, f m = fun y => shiftedGreenIter κ w₀ (m + 1) y 0 := by
    intro m
    ext y
    simp [f, shiftedGreenIter]
  have hf_smooth : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (f m) := by
    intro m
    rw [hf_eq m]
    exact h_contDiff (m + 1) 0
  let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun n m => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r (m + 1) n
  have hv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) → Summable (v n) := by
    intro n _
    exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (h_sum n)
  have hv_bound : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (y : ℝ), (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) y‖ ≤ v n m := by
    intro n m y _
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, hf_eq m]
    exact h_sup (m + 1) n y 0
  let g_tilde_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∑' m : ℕ, f m y
  have h_smooth_tilde : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) g_tilde_fun :=
    contDiff_tsum hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound
  have hh0_eq : h 0 = fun _ => 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    ext y
    simp [h, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
  have h_sum_shift : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => f m y) := by
    intro y
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum 0 le_top) ?_
    intro m
    have h0 := hv_bound 0 m y le_top
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h0
    exact h0
  have h_sum_all : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => h ℓ y) :=
    fun y => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (h_sum_shift y)
  have h_diag_eq : diagGreen κ w₀ = fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_fun y := by
    ext y
    have h_split : diagGreen κ w₀ y = h 0 y + g_tilde_fun y :=
      (h_sum_all y).tsum_eq_zero_add
    have h0_y : h 0 y = 1 / (2 * κ) := congr_fun hh0_eq y
    linarith
  have h_smooth_diag : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen κ w₀) := by
    rw [h_diag_eq]
    exact contDiff_const.add h_smooth_tilde
  have h_fg_shift : ∀ x y : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ (x + 1) (y + 1) = freeGreenKernel κ x y := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  have h_per_iter : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ (x + 1) (y + 1) = greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      exact h_fg_shift x y
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
        (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ (x + 1) z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z (y + 1)) 1]
      congr 1
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_))
      dsimp
      rw [ih x z, hw₀_per z, h_fg_shift z y]
  have h_per_diag : Function.Periodic (diagGreen κ w₀) 1 := by
    intro x
    change (∑' ℓ : ℕ, h ℓ (x + 1)) = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, h ℓ x
    have h_eq_term : (fun ℓ : ℕ => h ℓ (x + 1)) = (fun ℓ : ℕ => h ℓ x) := by
      ext ℓ
      exact h_per_iter ℓ x x
    rw [h_eq_term]
  have h_sub_eq : (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) = g_tilde_fun := by
    ext y
    have h_d : diagGreen κ w₀ y = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_fun y := congr_fun h_diag_eq y
    linarith
  refine ⟨h_smooth_diag, h_per_diag, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hh0_deriv : deriv (h 0) x = 0 := by
    rw [hh0_eq]
    exact deriv_const x (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_fderiv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x) := by
    intro n
    exact Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) (fun m => hv_bound n m x le_top)
  have h_iterDeriv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (f m) x) := by
    intro n
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) ?_
    intro m
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
    exact hv_bound n m x le_top
  have h_iterDeriv_tsum : ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (f m) x := by
    intro n
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have h_fd := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x at h_fd
    rw [h_fd, ContinuousMultilinearMap.tsum_eval (h_fderiv_sum n) (fun _ => 1)]
    simp_rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
  have h_sum_d1_shift : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (f ℓ) x) := by
    have hs := h_iterDeriv_sum 1
    simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hs
  have h_sum_d1_all : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (h ℓ) x) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp h_sum_d1_shift
  have h_d1_shift_eq :
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (f ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_sub_eq, ← iteratedDeriv_one, h_iterDeriv_tsum 1]
    simp_rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
  have h_d1_all_eq :
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (h ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_d1_shift_eq, h_sum_d1_all.tsum_eq_zero_add, hh0_deriv, zero_add]
  have h_d3_shift_eq :
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w₀ y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (f ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_sub_eq, h_iterDeriv_tsum 3]
  exact ⟨h_sum_all x, h_sum_d1_all, h_sum_d1_shift, h_d1_all_eq, h_d1_shift_eq, h_d3_shift_eq⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w₀ := w.2.1
  have hw_per : Function.Periodic w₀ 1 := w.2.2
  have hw_cont : Continuous w₀ := hw_smooth.continuous
  obtain ⟨C_w, hC_w⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) hw_cont.continuousOn
  let B_w : ℝ := max C_w 0
  have hB_w_nn : 0 ≤ B_w := le_max_right C_w 0
  have hw_bd : ∀ z : ℝ, |w₀ z| ≤ B_w := by
    intro z
    let z₀ : ℝ := Int.fract z
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨Int.fract_nonneg z, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one z)⟩
    have h_eq : w₀ z = w₀ z₀ := by
      have h_decomp : z₀ + (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) * 1 = z := by
        dsimp [z₀]
        linarith [Int.self_sub_floor z]
      rw [← h_decomp]
      exact hw_per.int_mul ⌊z⌋ z₀
    rw [h_eq]
    have h1 : |w₀ z₀| ≤ C_w := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC_w z₀ hz₀_mem
    exact le_trans h1 (le_max_left C_w 0)
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_fg_nonneg : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel κ x y := by
    intro x y
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    positivity
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_symm : ∀ x y : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x y = freeGreenKernel κ y x := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro a b
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * |a - b|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - b)])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h_exp_le
  let f0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * |v|)
  have hf0_Ici : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v)) (Set.Ioi (-1 : ℝ)) volume :=
      exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v)) (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) volume :=
      h1.mono_set (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num))
    refine h2.congr_fun (fun v hv => ?_) measurableSet_Ici
    dsimp [f0]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hv]
  have hf0_Iic : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => f0 (-v)) (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have := hf0_Ici.comp_neg
      rwa [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at this
    refine h1.congr_fun (fun v _ => ?_) measurableSet_Iic
    dsimp [f0]
    rw [abs_neg]
  have hf0_int : Integrable f0 volume := by
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact hf0_Iic.union (hf0_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  have h_fg_int : ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z y) volume := by
    intro y
    have h_eq : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z y) = (fun z : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * f0 (z - y)) := by
      ext z; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (hf0_int.comp_sub_right y).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_fg_int_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, (∫ z : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ z y) = ∫ z : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ z 0 := by
    intro y
    have h_eq : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z y) = (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ (z - y) 0) := by
      ext z
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      rw [sub_zero]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_sub_right_eq_self (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z 0) y
  have h_fgd_meas : ∀ y : ℝ, Measurable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) := by
    intro y
    unfold freeGreenDerivY
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const) (by fun_prop) ?_
    exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_id) (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have h_fgd_le_fg : ∀ z y : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY κ z y| ≤ κ * freeGreenKernel κ z y := by
    intro z y
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, freeGreenKernel]
    have h_rhs : κ * (1 / (2 * κ) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - y|)) = (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - y|) := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_rhs]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr h1), neg_sub]
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr h2)]
    · rw [abs_zero]
      positivity
  have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a b| ≤ B := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / (2 * κ), by positivity, h_fg_bound⟩
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, B, hB_nn, hB_bound⟩ := ih
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p u =>
        greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 (p.2 + u) * w₀ (p.2 + u) * freeGreenKernel κ u 0
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (B * B_w) * freeGreenKernel κ u 0
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        (h_fg_int 0).const_mul (B * B_w)
      have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
        intro p
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 (p.2 + u)) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => w₀ (p.2 + u)) :=
          hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
        have h_c3 : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ u 0) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul h_c2).mul h_c3).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p u‖ ≤ bound u := by
        intro p
        filter_upwards with u
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg u 0)]
        have h1 := hB_bound p.1 (p.2 + u)
        have h2 := hw_bd (p.2 + u)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB_nn) (h_fg_nonneg u 0)
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p u) := by
        filter_upwards with u
        dsimp [F]
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 (p.2 + u)) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.add continuous_const))
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w₀ (p.2 + u)) :=
          hw_cont.comp (continuous_snd.add continuous_const)
        exact (h_c1.mul h_c2).mul continuous_const
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, F p u) :=
        MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
      have h_shift_eq : ∀ a b : ℝ,
          greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) a b = -∫ u : ℝ, F (a, b) u := by
        intro a b
        dsimp [greenIterKernel, F]
        congr 1
        have h_sh := MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self (μ := volume)
          (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z b) b
        rw [← h_sh]
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => ?_)
        dsimp only
        have h_fg_sh : freeGreenKernel κ (b + u) b = freeGreenKernel κ u 0 := by
          dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
          have : b + u - b = u - 0 := by ring
          rw [this]
        rw [h_fg_sh]
      have h_fun_eq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) p.1 p.2) =
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => -∫ u : ℝ, F p u) := by
        ext ⟨a, b⟩
        exact h_shift_eq a b
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ u : ℝ, bound u,
        MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hB_nn hB_w_nn) (h_fg_nonneg u 0)), ?_⟩
      intro a b
      rw [h_shift_eq a b, abs_neg]
      have hF_int : Integrable (F (a, b)) volume :=
        h_bound_int.mono' (hF_meas (a, b)) (hF_dom (a, b))
      calc |∫ u : ℝ, F (a, b) u|
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, ‖F (a, b) u‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (a, b))
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, bound u := MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (a, b))
  have h_left_peel : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z * greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z y := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      rfl
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      obtain ⟨h_cℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bd⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound ℓ
      let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u z =>
        freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z * greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z u * w₀ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y
      let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => B_w * freeGreenKernel κ u y
      let g₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => (M * B_w) * freeGreenKernel κ z x
      have hg₁_int : Integrable g₁ volume := (h_fg_int y).const_mul B_w
      have hg₂_int : Integrable g₂ volume := (h_fg_int x).const_mul (M * B_w)
      have hg_prod : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2) (volume.prod volume) :=
        hg₁_int.mul_prod hg₂_int
      have hK_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) := by
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        have hcwz : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w₀ p.2) :=
          hw_cont.comp continuous_snd
        have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.2 p.1) :=
          h_cℓ.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)
        have hcwu : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w₀ p.1) :=
          hw_cont.comp continuous_fst
        have hc3 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((((hc1.mul hcwz).mul hc2).mul hcwu).mul hc3).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hK_dom : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂(volume.prod volume), ‖Function.uncurry K p‖ ≤ g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2 := by
        filter_upwards with p
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, K, g₁, g₂]
        repeat rw [abs_mul]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg x p.2), abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg p.1 y), h_fg_symm x p.2]
        have h1 := hw_bd p.2
        have h2 := hM_bd p.2 p.1
        have h3 := hw_bd p.1
        have h12 : |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.2 p.1| * |w₀ p.2| ≤ M * B_w :=
          mul_le_mul h2 h1 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn
        have h_prod_le : (|w₀ p.1| * (|greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.2 p.1| * |w₀ p.2|)) ≤
            B_w * (M * B_w) :=
          mul_le_mul h3 h12 (by positivity) hB_w_nn
        have h_fg_nn : 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x :=
          mul_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg p.1 y) (h_fg_nonneg p.2 x)
        calc freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x * |w₀ p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.2 p.1| *
              |w₀ p.1| * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y
          _ = (|w₀ p.1| * (|greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.2 p.1| * |w₀ p.2|)) *
                (freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x) := by ring
          _ ≤ (B_w * (M * B_w)) * (freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_le h_fg_nn
          _ = B_w * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y * (M * B_w * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x) := by ring
      have hK_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) :=
        hg_prod.mono' hK_meas hK_dom
      change -∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x u * w₀ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y = _
      have h_lhs : (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x u * w₀ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
          (fun u : ℝ => -∫ z : ℝ, K u z) := by
        ext u
        rw [ih x u]
        dsimp [K]
        rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const, ← MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const]
      rw [h_lhs, MeasureTheory.integral_neg, neg_neg, MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hK_int]
      have h_rhs : (fun z : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, K u z) =
          (fun z : ℝ => -(freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z * greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) z y)) := by
        ext z
        dsimp [K, greenIterKernel]
        have h_rearr : (fun u : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z * greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z u *
            w₀ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
          (fun u : ℝ => (freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z) *
            (greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ z u * w₀ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y)) := by
          ext u; ring
        rw [h_rearr, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs, MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
  have h_symm : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y x := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      exact h_fg_symm x y
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      rw [h_left_peel ℓ y x]
      change -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y = _
      congr 1
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
      dsimp only
      rw [ih x z, h_fg_symm z y]
      ring
  have h_ftc_Iic : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      (∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Iic x') volume) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Iic x', g z) (g x) x := by
    intro g hg x hg_Iic
    have h_eq : (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Iic x', g z) =
        (fun x' => (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z) + ∫ z in x..x', g z) := by
      ext x'
      exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hg_Iic x) (hg_Iic x'))
    rw [h_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in x..x', g z) (g x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hg.intervalIntegrable x x)
        (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x)) hg.continuousAt
    exact hd.const_add (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z)
  have h_ftc_Ioi : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      (∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi x') volume) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Ioi x', g z) (-g x) x := by

      rcases le_total x x' with hx | hx'
      · have h_un : Set.Ioc x x' ∪ Set.Ioi x' = Set.Ioi x := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx

        have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc x x') volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable x x').1
        have h_sum := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi x')
        rw [h_un, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx] at h_sum
        linarith
      · have h_un : Set.Ioc x' x ∪ Set.Ioi x = Set.Ioi x' := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx'
        have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Ioc x' x) (Set.Ioi x) := Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
        have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc x' x) volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable x' x).1
        have h_sum := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi x)
        rw [h_un, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx', intervalIntegral.integral_symm x x'] at h_sum
        linarith
    rw [h_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in x..x', g z) (g x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hg.intervalIntegrable x x)
        (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x)) hg.continuousAt
    exact hd.const_sub (∫ z in Set.Ioi x, g z)
  have h_conv_deriv : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (M_F : ℝ),

    have hg_R_cont : Continuous g_R := hF_cont.mul (by fun_prop)

          (Set.Iic x') volume :=
        ((h_fg_int x').const_mul (2 * κ * M_F * Real.exp (κ * x'))).integrableOn
      refine h_dom.mono' hg_L_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Iic] with z hz
      change z ≤ x' at hz
      dsimp [g_L, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hz)]

            rw [h1]; field_simp
          _ = (2 * κ * Real.exp (κ * x')) * (1 / (2 * κ) * Real.exp (-κ * -(z - x'))) := by ring

          (Set.Ioi x') volume :=

      refine h_dom.mono' hg_R_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with z hz
      change x' < z at hz
      dsimp [g_R, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * z) =
          (2 * κ * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * (1 / (2 * κ) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - x'))) := by
        have h1 : Real.exp (-κ * x') * Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) = Real.exp (-κ * z) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        calc Real.exp (-κ * z)

          _ = (2 * κ * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * (1 / (2 * κ) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - x'))) := by ring

        _ = 2 * κ * M_F * Real.exp (-κ * x') * (1 / (2 * κ) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - x'))) := by

      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg z x')]

      have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (M_F * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ z x') volume :=

      have h_m : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') volume :=

      refine h_dom.mono' h_m ?_
      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]

        _ = (M_F * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ z x' := by ring
    have h_conv_fg : ∀ x' : ℝ,

          rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hz)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(z - x')) = Real.exp (-κ * x') * Real.exp (κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      have h_R : (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') =
          ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * I_R x' := by
        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioi x',
            F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x' = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * g_R z := by

          change x' < z at hz
          dsimp [freeGreenKernel, g_R]
          rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) = Real.exp (κ * x') * Real.exp (-κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_split, h_L, h_R]
      ring
    have h_conv_fgd : ∀ x' : ℝ,
        -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x' =
          (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x') -
          (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x') := by
      intro x'
      have h_split : (∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =

          (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') := by
        rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic (h_int_fgd x')).symm
      have h_L : (∫ z in Set.Iic x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =

        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio]

          rw [if_pos hz]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (x' - z)) = Real.exp (-κ * x') * Real.exp (κ * z) := by

        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioi x',
            F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x' = ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * g_R z := by
          intro z hz

          have h_not_lt : ¬ (z < x') := not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hz)

          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) = Real.exp (κ * x') * Real.exp (-κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h_congr,

    have hd_IR : HasDerivAt I_R (-(F x * Real.exp (-κ * x))) x :=

    have hd_exp_pos : HasDerivAt (fun x' => Real.exp (κ * x')) (κ * Real.exp (κ * x)) x := by

        _ = F x * Real.exp (-κ * x + κ * x) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]

        _ = -F x * Real.exp (κ * x + -κ * x) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ = -F x := by ring_nf; rw [Real.exp_zero, mul_one]

      rw [h_fun_eq]

        (hd_prod_R.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ)))).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [h_exp_cancel1, h_exp_cancel2, h_conv_fgd x]
      field_simp
      ring
    · have h_fun_eq : (fun x' => -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =
