            (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x')) := funext h_conv_fgd
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      refine ((hd_prod_L.const_mul (1 / 2)).sub
        (hd_prod_R.const_mul (1 / 2))).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [h_exp_cancel1, h_exp_cancel2, h_conv_fg x]
      field_simp
      ring
  have h_diag_mvt : ∀ (H D D₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (M_D : ℝ), 0 ≤ M_D →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, H x y = H y x) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun z : ℝ => D z y)) →
      (∀ a x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => H a y) (D a x) x) →
      (∀ a x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => D a y) (D₂ a x) x) →
      (∀ a x : ℝ, |D₂ a x| ≤ M_D) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => H y y) (2 * D x x) x := by
    intro H D D₂ M_D hM_D h_symm_H h_cont_D h_deriv_H h_deriv_D h_bd_D₂ x
    have hD_lip : ∀ a t₁ t₂ : ℝ, |D a t₁ - D a t₂| ≤ M_D * |t₁ - t₂| := by
      intro a t₁ t₂
      have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        (f := fun t => D a t) (f' := fun t => D₂ a t) (s := Set.univ) (C := M_D)
        (fun t _ => (h_deriv_D a t).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun t _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_bd_D₂ a t)
        convex_univ (Set.mem_univ t₂) (Set.mem_univ t₁)
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_mvt
    let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => M_D * |y - x| + |D y x - D x x|
    have hE_nonneg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ E y := fun y => by dsimp [E]; positivity
    have hE_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto E (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => M_D * |y - x|) (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
        have hc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => M_D * |y - x|) := by fun_prop
        simpa using hc.tendsto x
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => |D y x - D x x|) (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
        have hc : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => |D y x - D x x|) :=
          ((h_cont_D x).sub continuous_const).abs
        simpa using hc.tendsto x
      simpa using h1.add h2
    have h_diff_le : ∀ y : ℝ,
        |(H y y - H y x) - (y - x) * D x x| ≤ E y * |y - x| := by
      intro y
      let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => H y t - t * D x x
      let φ' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => D y t - D x x
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc x y, HasDerivWithinAt φ (φ' t) (Set.uIcc x y) t := by
        intro t _
        have hd : HasDerivAt φ (φ' t) t := by
          dsimp [φ, φ']
          have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * D x x) (D x x) t := by
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (D x x)
          exact (h_deriv_H y t).sub hd_lin
        exact hd.hasDerivWithinAt
      have hφ'_bd : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc x y, ‖φ' t‖ ≤ E y := by
        intro t ht
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        dsimp [φ', E]
        have ht_le : |t - x| ≤ |y - x| := by
          rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at ht
          rcases ht with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_trans h1 h2))]
            linarith
          · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h2), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_trans h1 h2))]
            linarith
        have h_tri : |D y t - D x x| ≤ |D y t - D y x| + |D y x - D x x| :=
          abs_sub_le (D y t) (D y x) (D x x)
        have h_lip := hD_lip y t x
        have h_mul : M_D * |t - x| ≤ M_D * |y - x| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_le hM_D
        linarith
      have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        hφ_deriv hφ'_bd (convex_uIcc x y) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_mvt
      have h_alg : φ y - φ x = (H y y - H y x) - (y - x) * D x x := by
        dsimp [φ]; ring
      rw [h_alg] at h_mvt
      exact h_mvt
    have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun y => H y y - H y x) (D x x) x := by
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
        tendsto_const_nhds hE_tendsto (fun y => by positivity) (fun y => ?_)
      rcases eq_or_ne x y with rfl | hxy
      · simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, inv_zero, zero_mul]
        exact hE_nonneg x
      · have hyx_pos : 0 < |y - x| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hxy))
        have h_step : ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖(H y y - H y x) - (H x x - H x x) - (y - x) • D x x‖ ≤
            |y - x|⁻¹ * (E y * |y - x|) := by
          simp only [sub_self, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_diff_le y) (by positivity)
        have h_cancel : |y - x|⁻¹ * (E y * |y - x|) = E y := by
          have : |y - x| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyx_pos
          field_simp
        linarith
    have hd_second : HasDerivAt (fun y => H y x) (D x x) x := by
      have h_eq : (fun y => H y x) = (fun y => H x y) := by
        ext y
        exact h_symm_H y x
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_deriv_H x x
    have hd_sum := hd_sub.add hd_second
    have h_fun_eq : ((fun y => H y y - H y x) + (fun y => H y x)) = (fun y => H y y) := by
      ext y; dsimp; ring
    have h_val_eq : D x x + D x x = 2 * D x x := by ring
    rw [h_fun_eq, h_val_eq] at hd_sum
    exact hd_sum
  have h_part1 : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y x) ∧
      (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y| ≤ B) := by
    intro ℓ
    obtain ⟨h_cℓ, B, hB_nn, hB_bd⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound ℓ
    exact ⟨h_cℓ, h_symm ℓ, B, hB_nn, hB_bd⟩
  have h_part2 : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) z y)) ∧
      (∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ z y : ℝ, |greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) z y| ≤ L) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a y)
          (greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a y)
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x +
            w₀ x * greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a x) x) := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨h_cm, _, B_m, hB_m_nn, hB_m⟩ := h_part1 m
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y
      let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z u =>
        greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u * w₀ u * freeGreenDerivY κ u y
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (B_m * B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ u y
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        (h_fg_int y).const_mul (B_m * B_w * κ)
      have hF_meas : ∀ z : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F z) volume := by
        intro z
        have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u * w₀ u) :=
          (h_cm.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul hw_cont
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (h_fgd_meas y).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ z : ℝ, ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F z u‖ ≤ bound u := by
        intro z
        filter_upwards with u
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h12 : |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u| * |w₀ u| ≤ B_m * B_w :=
          mul_le_mul (hB_m z u) (hw_bd u) (abs_nonneg _) hB_m_nn
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u| * |w₀ u| * |freeGreenDerivY κ u y|
          _ ≤ (B_m * B_w) * (κ * freeGreenKernel κ u y) :=
            mul_le_mul h12 (h_fgd_le_fg u y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = B_m * B_w * κ * freeGreenKernel κ u y := by ring
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun z : ℝ => F z u) := by
        filter_upwards with u
        dsimp [F]
        exact ((h_cm.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mul continuous_const).mul
          continuous_const
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, F z u) :=
        MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
      exact h_int_cont.neg
    · refine ⟨(B_m * B_w * κ) * ∫ u : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ u 0,
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => h_fg_nonneg u 0)), ?_⟩
      intro z y
      dsimp [greenIterDerivY]
      rw [abs_neg]
      let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u * w₀ u * freeGreenDerivY κ u y
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (B_m * B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ u y
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        (h_fg_int y).const_mul (B_m * B_w * κ)
      have hg_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable g volume := by
        have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u * w₀ u) :=
          (h_cm.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul hw_cont
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (h_fgd_meas y).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hg_dom : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, ‖g u‖ ≤ bound u := by
        filter_upwards with u
        dsimp [g, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h12 : |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u| * |w₀ u| ≤ B_m * B_w :=
          mul_le_mul (hB_m z u) (hw_bd u) (abs_nonneg _) hB_m_nn
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m z u| * |w₀ u| * |freeGreenDerivY κ u y|
          _ ≤ (B_m * B_w) * (κ * freeGreenKernel κ u y) :=
            mul_le_mul h12 (h_fgd_le_fg u y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = B_m * B_w * κ * freeGreenKernel κ u y := by ring
      have hg_int : Integrable g volume := h_bound_int.mono' hg_meas hg_dom
      calc |∫ u : ℝ, g u|
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, ‖g u‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm g
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, bound u := MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae hg_int.norm h_bound_int hg_dom
        _ = (B_m * B_w * κ) * ∫ u : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ u y :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = (B_m * B_w * κ) * ∫ u : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ u 0 := by
          rw [h_fg_int_eq y]
    · intro a x
      have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z) :=
        (h_cm.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul hw_cont
      have h_bd : ∀ z : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z| ≤ B_m * B_w := by
        intro z
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hB_m a z) (hw_bd z) (abs_nonneg _) hB_m_nn
      exact (h_conv_deriv (fun z => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z) (B_m * B_w)
        hc (by positivity) h_bd x).1
    · intro a x
      have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z) :=
        (h_cm.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul hw_cont
      have h_bd : ∀ z : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z| ≤ B_m * B_w := by
        intro z
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hB_m a z) (hw_bd z) (abs_nonneg _) hB_m_nn
      have hd := (h_conv_deriv (fun z => greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a z * w₀ z) (B_m * B_w)
        hc (by positivity) h_bd x).2
      refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      ring
  refine ⟨h_part1, h_part2, ?_⟩
  intro ℓ x
  obtain ⟨_, h_symm_succ, B_succ, hB_succ_nn, hB_succ⟩ := h_part1 (ℓ + 1)
  obtain ⟨_, _, B_ℓ, hB_ℓ_nn, hB_ℓ⟩ := h_part1 ℓ
  obtain ⟨h_cont_D, _, h_d1, h_d2⟩ := h_part2 ℓ
  let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1)
  let D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1)
  let D₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun a y =>
    κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) a y + w₀ y * greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a y
  let M_D : ℝ := κ ^ 2 * B_succ + B_w * B_ℓ
  have hM_D : 0 ≤ M_D := by positivity
  have h_bd_D₂ : ∀ a y : ℝ, |D₂ a y| ≤ M_D := by
    intro a y
    dsimp [D₂, M_D]
    have h_tri := abs_add_le (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) a y)
      (w₀ y * greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a y)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < κ ^ 2), abs_mul] at h_tri
    have h1 : κ ^ 2 * |greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) a y| ≤ κ ^ 2 * B_succ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB_succ a y) (by positivity)
    have h2 : |w₀ y| * |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ a y| ≤ B_w * B_ℓ :=
      mul_le_mul (hw_bd y) (hB_ℓ a y) (abs_nonneg _) hB_w_nn
    linarith
  exact h_diag_mvt H D D₂ M_D hM_D h_symm_succ h_cont_D h_d1 h_d2 h_bd_D₂ x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h2κ_pos : 0 < 2 * κ := by linarith
  let w₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hw₀_cont : Continuous w₀ := w.2.1.continuous
  have hw₀_per : Function.Periodic w₀ 1 := w.2.2
  obtain ⟨C_w, hC_w⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hw₀_cont.continuousOn
  let B_w : ℝ := max C_w 0
  have hBw_nn : 0 ≤ B_w := le_max_right C_w 0
  have hBw_bd : ∀ z : ℝ, |w₀ z| ≤ B_w := by
    intro z
    have hz_mem : z - (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr (Int.floor_le z), by linarith [Int.lt_floor_add_one z]⟩
    have hz_eq : w₀ (z - (⌊z⌋ : ℝ)) = w₀ z := by
      have h_per := hw₀_per.int_mul (-⌊z⌋) z
      have h_arg : z - (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) = z + ((-⌊z⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) * 1 := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_arg, h_per]
    have h1 : ‖w₀ (z - (⌊z⌋ : ℝ))‖ ≤ C_w := hC_w (z - (⌊z⌋ : ℝ)) hz_mem
    rw [hz_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (le_max_left C_w 0)
  have h_fg_nonneg : ∀ (α : ℝ), 0 < α → ∀ z y : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel α z y := by
    intro α hα z y
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    positivity
  have h_fg_cont : ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ), Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel α z y) := by
    intro α y
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_int : ∀ (α : ℝ), 0 < α → ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel α z y) volume := by
    intro α hα y
    let f0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-α * |v|)
    have hf0_Ici : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-α * v)) (Set.Ioi (-1 : ℝ)) volume :=
        exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hα
      have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-α * v)) (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) volume :=
        h1.mono_set (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num))
      refine h2.congr_fun (fun v hv => ?_) measurableSet_Ici
      dsimp [f0]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hv]
    have hf0_Iic : IntegrableOn f0 (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => f0 (-v)) (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
        have := hf0_Ici.comp_neg
        rwa [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at this
      refine h1.congr_fun (fun v _ => ?_) measurableSet_Iic
      dsimp [f0]
      rw [abs_neg]
    have hf0_int : Integrable f0 volume := by
      rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
      exact hf0_Iic.union (hf0_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
    have h_eq : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel α z y) = (fun z : ℝ => (1 / (2 * α)) * f0 (z - y)) := by
      ext z; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (hf0_int.comp_sub_right y).const_mul (1 / (2 * α))
  have h_fgd_meas : ∀ (α : ℝ) (y : ℝ), Measurable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY α z y) := by
    intro α y
    unfold freeGreenDerivY
    exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iio (by fun_prop)
      (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Ioi (by fun_prop) measurable_const)
  have h_fgd_le : ∀ (α : ℝ), 0 < α → ∀ z y : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY α z y| ≤ α * freeGreenKernel α z y := by
    intro α hα z y
    have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, freeGreenKernel]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2),
          abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr h1)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-α * -(z - y)) = Real.exp (-α * (y - z)) := by
        congr 1; ring
      rw [h_exp]
      exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2),
          abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr h2)]
      exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
    · rw [abs_zero]
      positivity
  have h_G_cont : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ p.1 p.2) :=
    fun ℓ => (h_off_diag.1 ℓ).1
  have h_G_symm : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x y : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ y x :=
    fun ℓ => (h_off_diag.1 ℓ).2.1
  have h_G_bd : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w₀ ℓ x y| ≤ B :=
    fun ℓ => (h_off_diag.1 ℓ).2.2
  have h_D_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) z y) :=
    fun m => (h_off_diag.2.1 m).1
  have h_D_bd : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ z y : ℝ, |greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) z y| ≤ L :=
    fun m => (h_off_diag.2.1 m).2.1
  have h_D1 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ a x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a y)
        (greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a x) x :=
    fun m => (h_off_diag.2.1 m).2.2.1
  have h_D2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ a x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) a y)
        (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ (m + 1) a x + w₀ x * greenIterKernel κ w₀ m a x) x :=
    fun m => (h_off_diag.2.1 m).2.2.2
  have h_diag : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (ℓ + 1) x x) x :=
    h_off_diag.2.2
  have hG0 : ∀ y : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ 0 y y = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro y
    dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hM0 : ∀ y : ℝ, greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ 0 y = κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ 1 y y := by
    intro y
    dsimp [greenIterMixedDiag, greenIterDerivY, greenIterKernel]
    rw [mul_neg, neg_inj, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    have h_ae : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, z ≠ y :=
      MeasureTheory.compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr (MeasureTheory.measure_singleton y)
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [h_ae] with z hz
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, freeGreenKernel]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hzy | hyz
    · rw [if_pos hzy, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hzy), abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hzy)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(z - y)) = Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)) := by
        congr 1; ring
      rw [h_exp]
      field_simp
    · have h1 : ¬ z < y := not_lt_of_gt hyz
      rw [if_neg h1, if_pos hyz, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hyz), abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hyz)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(y - z)) = Real.exp (-κ * (z - y)) := by
        congr 1; ring
      rw [h_exp]
      field_simp
  have h_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ 1 y y)
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w₀ 1 x x +
          2 * w₀ x * greenIterKernel κ w₀ 0 x x +
          2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ 0 x) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ 0 y)
        (κ ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ 1 y y) x +
          w₀ x * deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w₀ 0 y y) x) x := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hG1 : greenIterKernel κ w₀ 1 x x =
          (1 / κ) * (-∫ z : ℝ, w₀ z * freeGreenKernel (2 * κ) z x) := by
        dsimp [greenIterKernel]
        have h_pt : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenKernel κ z x) =
            fun z : ℝ => (1 / κ) * (w₀ z * freeGreenKernel (2 * κ) z x) := by
          ext z
          dsimp [freeGreenKernel]

          have h_le1 : |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m p.1 p.2| * |w₀ p.1| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.1 y| ≤
              (B_m * B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y := by
            have h_p1 : |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m p.1 p.2| * |w₀ p.1| ≤ B_m * B_w :=
              mul_le_mul hb1 (hBw_bd p.1) (abs_nonneg _) hBm_nn
            calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m p.1 p.2| * |w₀ p.1| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.1 y|
              _ ≤ (B_m * B_w) * (κ * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y) :=
                mul_le_mul h_p1 hb3 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hBm_nn hBw_nn)
              _ = (B_m * B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y := by ring
          have h_le2 : |w₀ p.2| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.2 x| ≤ (B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x := by
            calc |w₀ p.2| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.2 x|
              _ ≤ B_w * (κ * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x) :=
                mul_le_mul (hBw_bd p.2) hb2 (abs_nonneg _) hBw_nn
              _ = (B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x := by ring
          calc |greenIterKernel κ w₀ m p.1 p.2| * |w₀ p.2| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.2 x| * |w₀ p.1| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.1 y|
            _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w₀ m p.1 p.2| * |w₀ p.1| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.1 y|) *
                (|w₀ p.2| * |freeGreenDerivY κ p.2 x|) := by ring
            _ ≤ ((B_m * B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y) * ((B_w * κ) * freeGreenKernel κ p.2 x) :=
              mul_le_mul h_le1 h_le2 (by positivity) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (h_fg_nonneg κ hκ_pos p.1 y))
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hK2_int]
        have h_step2 : (fun u : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, K2 z u) =
            fun u : ℝ => -((-∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₀ m u z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) *
              w₀ u * freeGreenDerivY κ u x) := by
          ext u
          have h_factor : (fun z : ℝ => K2 z u) =
              fun z : ℝ => (greenIterKernel κ w₀ m u z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) *
                (w₀ u * freeGreenDerivY κ u x) := by
            ext z
            dsimp [K2]
            rw [h_G_symm m z u]
            ring
          rw [h_factor, integral_mul_const]
          ring
        rw [h_step2, integral_neg]
      rw [h_eval_first] at hd_first
      have hd_second : HasDerivAt (fun y => -∫ z : ℝ, Φ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y)
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 2) x x + w₀ x * greenIterDerivY κ w₀ (m + 1) x x) x := by
        rw [funext h_fub_mixed]
        exact hd_first
      have hd_comb := (hd_first.add hd_second).add hd_cross
      have h_fun_eq : (fun y =>
          (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x) +
          (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) +
          ((-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) -
           (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) -
           (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x))) =
          fun y => greenIterMixedDiag κ w₀ (m + 1) y := by
        ext y
        dsimp [greenIterMixedDiag, Φ]
        ring
      change HasDerivAt (fun y =>
          (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x) +
          (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) +
          ((-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) -
           (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ x z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) -
           (-∫ z : ℝ, Φ y z * w₀ z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x))) _ x at hd_comb
      rw [h_fun_eq] at hd_comb
      refine hd_comb.congr_deriv ?_
      rw [(h_diag (m + 1) x).deriv, (h_diag m x).deriv]
      ring

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT)
       (h_sub : (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩ = ιT q₁ - ιT q₂) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT)
       (h_smul : (fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul⟩ = c • ιT q) ∧
    (∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT),
      Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
        ‖fourierCircle (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) n - fourierCircle (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 /
          (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) ∧
      hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁ - ιT q₂) =
        ∑' n : ℤ,
          ‖fourierCircle (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) n - fourierCircle (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) n‖ ^ 2 /
            (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ∧
      hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁ - ιT q₂) ≤ ‖ιT q₁ - ιT q₂‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f g : Hm1T),
      0 ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ f ∧
      hm1KappaSqT κ f ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2 ∧
      |Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ f) - Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ g)| ≤ ‖f - g‖) ∧
    (∀ (g : CinfT) (h_deriv : deriv (g : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT) (B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |(g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B) →
      ‖ιT ⟨deriv (g : ℝ → ℝ), h_deriv⟩‖ ≤ B)

by
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_summable_lp : ∀ u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖u n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro u
    have hu := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp u.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hu
    exact hu
  have h_norm_sq_lp : ∀ u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n : ℤ, ‖u n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    have hu := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum hp_pos u
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hu
    exact hu
  have h_fc_eq : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one (fun x : ℝ => (g x : ℂ)) n = fourierCircle g n := by
    intro g n
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral (fun x : ℝ => (g x : ℂ)) n zero_lt_one]
    have h_sub : (1 : ℝ) / (1 - 0) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_sub, one_smul, fourierCircle]
    congr 1 with x
    rw [fourier_coe_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_parseval : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle g n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle g n‖ ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g x) ^ 2 := by
    intro g hg
    let g_C : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (g x : ℂ)
    have hg_C : Continuous g_C := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hg
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable g_C (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      hg_C.aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_int_sq : Integrable (fun x => ‖g_C x‖ ^ 2) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le zero_le_one).mp
        ((hg_C.norm.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    have h_memLp : MemLp g_C 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas).mpr h_int_sq
    have hs := (hasSum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp).summable
    have h_tsum := tsum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp
    simp only [g_C, h_fc_eq g] at hs h_tsum
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    rw [h_tsum]
    have h_inv : ((1 : ℝ) - 0)⁻¹ = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_inv, one_smul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_prof_sq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 =
        (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f n
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ =
        (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
    rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
    simp_rw [h_rpow]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
      (h_parseval (q : ℝ → ℝ) q.2.1.continuous).1
    rw [h_prof_sq (q : ℝ → ℝ) n]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) h_inv_le
  have h_toHm1T_apply : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      (toHm1T q : ℤ → ℂ) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro q n
    dsimp [toHm1T]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_int_fourier : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ))
        volume 0 1 := by
    intro q n
    have hq_cont : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have h_cont : Continuous
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h_conj1 : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT)
      (h_sub : (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩ = ιT q₁ - ιT q₂ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ h_sub
    let q_sub : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (toHm1T q_sub : ℤ → ℂ) n = ((toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, h_toHm1T_apply q_sub n, h_toHm1T_apply q₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply q₂ n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, q_sub]
    rw [← mul_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier q₁ n) (h_int_fourier q₂ n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_conj2 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT)
      (h_smul : (fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul⟩ = c • ιT q := by
    intro c q h_smul
    let q_smul : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (toHm1T q_smul : ℤ → ℂ) n = ((c • toHm1T q : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, h_toHm1T_apply q_smul n, h_toHm1T_apply q n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, q_smul]
    have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => (c : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ))) := by
      ext x
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_fn, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have h_conj4 : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (f g : Hm1T),
      0 ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ f ∧
      hm1KappaSqT κ f ≤ ‖f‖ ^ 2 ∧
      |Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ f) - Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ g)| ≤ ‖f - g‖ := by
    intro κ hκ f g
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    let w : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)
    let m : ℤ → ℂ := fun n => ((Real.sqrt (w n) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hw_nonneg : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ w n := fun n => by
      dsimp [w]
      positivity
    have hw_le_one : ∀ n : ℤ, w n ≤ 1 := by
      intro n
      dsimp [w]
      have h_den : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2 := by positivity
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt h_den)
    have hm_sq_eq : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 = w n * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      dsimp [m]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (w n)),
        mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hw_nonneg n)]
    have hm_sq_le : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), ‖m n * z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n z
      rw [hm_sq_eq n z]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (hw_le_one n)
    have h_mem_T : ∀ u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Memℓp (fun n : ℤ => m n * u n) 2 := by
      intro u
      rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => hm_sq_le n (u n))
        (h_summable_lp u)
    let T_κ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
      fun u => ⟨fun n => m n * u n, h_mem_T u⟩
    have h_eq : ∀ h : Hm1T, hm1KappaSqT κ h = ‖T_κ (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro h
      rw [h_norm_sq_lp (T_κ (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2))]
      unfold hm1KappaSqT
      congr 1 with n
      exact (hm_sq_eq n ((h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n)).symm
    have h_le_norm : ∀ h : Hm1T, hm1KappaSqT κ h ≤ ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro h
      rw [h_eq h]
      change ‖T_κ (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ^ 2
      rw [h_norm_sq_lp (T_κ (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)), h_norm_sq_lp (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)]
      exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => hm_sq_le n ((h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n))
        (h_summable_lp (T_κ (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)))
        (h_summable_lp (h : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2))
    have h_T_sub_le : ‖T_κ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) - T_κ (g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ ≤ ‖f - g‖ := by
      let u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)
      let v : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := (g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)
      have h_sub_pt : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖(T_κ u - T_κ v) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(u - v) n‖ ^ 2 := by
        intro n
        have h1 : (T_κ u - T_κ v) n = m n * (u - v) n := by
          change (T_κ u) n - (T_κ v) n = m n * (u n - v n)
          dsimp [T_κ]
          ring
        rw [h1]
        exact hm_sq_le n ((u - v) n)
      have h_tsum_le : (∑' n : ℤ, ‖(T_κ u - T_κ v) n‖ ^ 2) ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖(u - v) n‖ ^ 2 :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_sub_pt (h_summable_lp (T_κ u - T_κ v)) (h_summable_lp (u - v))
      rw [← h_norm_sq_lp (u - v)] at h_tsum_le
      apply lp.norm_le_of_tsum_le hp_pos (norm_nonneg (f - g))
      simp_rw [h_rpow]
      exact h_tsum_le
    refine ⟨by rw [h_eq f]; exact sq_nonneg _, h_le_norm f, ?_⟩
    have h_sqrt_f : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ f) =
        Real.sqrt (1 / κ) * ‖T_κ (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ := by
      rw [h_eq f, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
    have h_sqrt_g : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ g) =
        Real.sqrt (1 / κ) * ‖T_κ (g : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ := by
      rw [h_eq g, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
    rw [h_sqrt_f, h_sqrt_g, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sqrt_le_one : Real.sqrt (1 / κ) ≤ 1 := by
      have h_inv_le : 1 / κ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hκ_pos).mpr hκ
      calc Real.sqrt (1 / κ)

          ∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * F₁ ξ + 2 * F₂ ξ) :=
      integral_mono hA_succ_int ((h_int_UV1.const_mul 2).add (h_int_UV2.const_mul 2)) h_pw_le
    have h_add :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * F₁ ξ + 2 * F₂ ξ)) =
          2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, F₁ ξ) + 2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, F₂ ξ) := by
      rw [integral_add (h_int_UV1.const_mul 2) (h_int_UV2.const_mul 2),
          integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    change (∫ ξ : ℝ, F₁ ξ) ≤ K₁ * (∫ η : ℝ, A₁ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) at h_bound_UV1
    change (∫ ξ : ℝ, F₂ ξ) ≤ K₂ * (∫ η : ℝ, A₂ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) at h_bound_UV2
    linarith [h_mono, h_add, h_bound_UV1, h_bound_UV2]
  intro r₁ r_diff
  have h_hm1_1_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁) := by
    rw [h_fc1.2.2.2]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (tsum_nonneg (fun n => div_nonneg (hc₁_nn n) (by positivity)))
  have h_hm1_diff_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁ - ιT q₂) := by
    rw [h_fc_diff.2]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (tsum_nonneg (fun n => div_nonneg (hc₂_nn n) (by positivity)))
  have hr₁_sq : r₁ ^ 2 = K₁ := by
    dsimp [r₁, K₁, c₁, b₁]
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h_hm1_1_nn, h_fc1.2.2.2]
    ring
  have hr_diff_sq : r_diff ^ 2 = K₂ := by
    dsimp [r_diff, K₂, c₂, b₂]
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h_hm1_diff_nn, h_fc_diff.2]
    ring
  rw [hr₁_sq, hr_diff_sq]
  calc (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A_succ ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
    _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) *
          (2 * (K₁ * (∫ η : ℝ, A₁ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) +
           2 * (K₂ * (∫ η : ℝ, A₂ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * K₁ * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A₁ ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) +
        2 * K₂ * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A₂ ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  obtain ⟨⟨h_inv_int, h_inv_eq⟩, h_fg_eq⟩ := freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq κ hκ
  have h0_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) volume := by
    simpa [one_div] using h_inv_int
  set r₁ := 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁))
  set r₂ := 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₂))
  set r_diff := 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁ - ιT q₂))
  have hr₁_nn : 0 ≤ r₁ := by positivity
  have hr₂_nn : 0 ≤ r₂ := by positivity
  have hr_diff_nn : 0 ≤ r_diff := by positivity
  have hr_le_quarter : ∀ w : CinfT, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / 52) ^ 2 * κ →
      13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    intro w hw
    have h_prod : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / 52) ^ 2 := by
      calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)
        _ ≤ (1 / κ) * ((1 / 52) ^ 2 * κ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 52) ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
    have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ≤ 1 / 52 := by
      calc Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / 52 : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_prod
        _ = 1 / 52 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ 1 / 4 := hr_le_quarter q₁ hq₁
  have hr₂_le : r₂ ≤ 1 / 4 := hr_le_quarter q₂ hq₂
  have hr₁_half : r₁ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hr₁_sq : 2 * r₁ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    have h_sq : r₁ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr₁_nn hr₁_le 2
    linarith
  have hr₂_sq : r₂ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    have h_sq : r₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr₂_nn hr₂_le 2
    linarith
  have h_geom_half : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_tsum_half : (∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) = 2 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have h_inv_2κ_le : 1 / (2 * κ) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have h_bd1_succ : ∀ (x : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
      |greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x| ≤ r₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro x m
    have h_pow : r₁ ^ m ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr₁_nn hr₁_half m
    have h_coeff : (1 / (2 * κ)) * r₁ ≤ r₁ := by
      calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * r₁
        _ ≤ 1 * r₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_2κ_le hr₁_nn
        _ = r₁ := one_mul r₁
    calc |greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x|
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * r₁ ^ (m + 1) := h_dom1 (m + 1) x
      _ = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * r₁) * r₁ ^ m := by rw [pow_succ']; ring
      _ ≤ r₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_le_mul h_coeff h_pow (pow_nonneg hr₁_nn m) hr₁_nn
  have h_sum1_succ : ∀ x : ℝ,
      Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x) := by
    intro x
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom_half.mul_left r₁) (fun m => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_bd1_succ x m
  have h_sum1 : ∀ x : ℝ,
      Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) :=
    fun x => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (h_sum1_succ x)
  have h_G0 : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w 0 x x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro w x
    dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have h_conj1 : ∀ x : ℝ,
      |diagGreen κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ)| ≤
        26 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁)) := by
    intro x
    have h_peel : diagGreen κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ) =
        ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x := by
      have h_s0 := (h_sum1 x).tsum_eq_zero_add
      have h0 := h_G0 (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x
      change (∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) - 1 / (2 * κ) =
        ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x
      linarith [h_s0, h0]
    rw [h_peel, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x‖) :=
      (h_sum1_succ x).norm
    have h_dom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => r₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
      h_geom_half.mul_left r₁
    calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x‖
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_norm_sum
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, r₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        refine h_norm_sum.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) h_dom_sum
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact h_bd1_succ x m
      _ = r₁ * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
      _ = r₁ * 2 := by rw [h_tsum_half]
      _ = 26 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁)) := by dsimp [r₁]; ring
  have h_fm : ∀ (w : CinfT) (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x z * (w : ℝ → ℝ) z) ∧
      Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) m x z * (w : ℝ → ℝ) z) volume := by
    intro w m x
    let w0 : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hw_cont : Continuous w0 := w.2.1.continuous
    have hw_per : Function.Periodic w0 1 := w.2.2
    obtain ⟨Cw, hCw⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (f := w0) (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) hw_cont.continuousOn
    let Bw : ℝ := max Cw 0
    have hw_bound : ∀ z : ℝ, |w0 z| ≤ Bw := by
      intro z
      have h_fract_mem : Int.fract z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨Int.fract_nonneg z, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one z)⟩
      have h_eq : w0 z = w0 (Int.fract z) := by
        have h_z : z = Int.fract z + (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) * 1 := by
          rw [← Int.self_sub_floor z]
          ring
        calc w0 z = w0 (Int.fract z + (⌊z⌋ : ℝ) * 1) := congrArg w0 h_z
          _ = w0 (Int.fract z) := hw_per.int_mul ⌊z⌋ (Int.fract z)
      rw [h_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact le_trans (hCw (Int.fract z) h_fract_mem) (le_max_left Cw 0)
    obtain ⟨h_cont_m, h_int_m⟩ := (h_G_pkt w m x).1
    have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w0 m x z * w0 z) :=
      h_cont_m.mul hw_cont
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    refine (h_int_m.norm.const_mul Bw).mono' hc.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm Bw]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw_bound z) (abs_nonneg _)
  have h_iter_eq : ∀ (w : CinfT) (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      (greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x : ℂ) =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterWavePacket κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro w ℓ x
    let w0 : ℝ → ℝ := (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    rcases ℓ with _ | m
    · dsimp [greenIterKernel, iterWavePacket]
      exact (h_fg_eq x x).2.symm
    · obtain ⟨h_fm_cont, h_fm_int⟩ := h_fm w m x
      let f_m : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w0 m x z * w0 z
      let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z ξ =>
        (f_m z : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hH_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry H) := by
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, H, f_m]
        refine (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (h_fm_cont.comp continuous_fst)).mul ?_
        refine Continuous.div ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
            ((((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst)).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
            (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
              (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const).mul continuous_const))
        · exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.add ((continuous_pow 2).comp continuous_snd))
        · intro p
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos p.2))
      have hH_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry H) (volume.prod volume) := by
        refine (h_fm_int.norm.mul_prod h0_int).mono' hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with p
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, H]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_mul,
            show -((p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I = (((-(p.2 * p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I,
            show ((p.2 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = (((p.2 * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I,
            one_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos p.2)),
            Complex.norm_real, one_div]
        exact le_rfl
      have h_step1 : (greenIterKernel κ w0 (m + 1) x x : ℂ) =
          -∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z x : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [greenIterKernel, f_m]
        rw [Complex.ofReal_neg]
        congr 1
        refine integral_ofReal.symm.trans ?_
        congr 1; ext z
        push_cast; rfl
      have h_step2_eq : (∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z x : ℂ)) =
          (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ := by
        calc (∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z x : ℂ))
          _ = ∫ z : ℝ, (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ) := by
            congr 1; ext z
            rw [← (h_fg_eq z x).2, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (f_m z : ℂ) (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ), mul_assoc,
                ← integral_const_mul]
          _ = (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ := integral_const_mul _ _
      have h_inner : ∀ ξ : ℝ, -∫ z : ℝ, H z ξ =
          iterWavePacket κ w0 (m + 1) x ξ *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        intro ξ
        have h_rew : (fun z : ℝ => H z ξ) =
            fun z : ℝ => (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (f_m z : ℂ)) *
              (Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          ext z
          dsimp [H]
          ring

  have h_bd_d_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, |d (m + 1)| ≤ r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m
    have h_pow_4 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_right_comm]
      norm_num
    have h_sq : d (m + 1) ^ 2 ≤ (r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 := by
      calc d (m + 1) ^ 2
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ΔE (m + 1) := h_diff_diag_sq x (m + 1)
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ((1 / κ) * r_diff ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΔE_bound m) (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ ^ 2)) * (r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_pow_4]; ring
        _ ≤ 1 * (r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_2κ2_le (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 2 := one_mul _
    exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq (by positivity))
  have h_sum_d_succ : Summable (fun m : ℕ => d (m + 1)) := by
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom_half.mul_left r_diff) (fun m => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_bd_d_succ m
  have h_sum_d : Summable d := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp h_sum_d_succ
  have h_sum2 : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) := by
    have h_eq_q2 : (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) =
        (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x - d ℓ) := by
      ext ℓ; dsimp [d]; ring
    rw [h_eq_q2]
    exact (h_sum1 x).sub h_sum_d
  have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [h_G0 (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_G0 (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, sub_self]
  have h_peel_d : diagGreen κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - diagGreen κ (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x =
      ∑' m : ℕ, d (m + 1) := by
    have h_sub_tsum : diagGreen κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - diagGreen κ (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, d ℓ := by
      change (∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) -
        (∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x) = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, d ℓ
      exact ((h_sum1 x).tsum_sub h_sum2).symm
    have h_s0 := h_sum_d.tsum_eq_zero_add
    linarith [h_sub_tsum, h_s0, hd0]
  rw [h_peel_d, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have h_norm_sum_d : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖d (m + 1)‖) := h_sum_d_succ.norm
  have h_dom_sum_d : Summable (fun m : ℕ => r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
    h_geom_half.mul_left r_diff
  calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, d (m + 1)‖
    _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖d (m + 1)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_norm_sum_d
    _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, r_diff * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      refine h_norm_sum_d.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) h_dom_sum_d
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h_bd_d_succ m
    _ = r_diff * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
    _ = r_diff * 2 := by rw [h_tsum_half]
    _ = 26 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q₁ - ιT q₂)) := by dsimp [r_diff]; ring

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, _K_alpha, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, _hK_alpha, h_quad, _h_ratio, _h_interp⟩ :=
    diagGreen_alpha_and_interpolationT
  obtain ⟨δ_ode, hδ_ode, h_ode_full⟩ := diagGreen_third_order_odeT
  obtain ⟨δ_weyl, hδ_weyl, h_weyl⟩ := integral_rhoDerivDensity_eq_diagGreenT
  obtain ⟨h_mono, h_cont_hm1, ⟨δ_pt, hδ_pt, h_deriv_pt⟩⟩ :=
    alphaFunctionalT_hasDerivAt_and_hm1_contT
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  set δ' : ℝ := min δ (min δ₁ (min δ_ode (min δ_weyl δ_pt)))
  have hδ' : 0 < δ' := by positivity
  have hδ'_le_δ : δ' ≤ δ := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ'_le_δ₁ : δ' ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ'_le_ode : δ' ≤ δ_ode :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hδ'_le_weyl : δ' ≤ δ_weyl :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hδ'_le_pt : δ' ≤ δ_pt :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
  set δ₀ : ℝ := (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ'
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := by positivity
  have hδ₀_le_half : δ₀ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    have h_div_le : c₁ / (2 * c₂) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      linarith
    calc δ₀ = (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ' := rfl
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * δ' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (le_of_lt hδ')
      _ = δ' / 2 := by ring
  have hδ₀_le_δ : δ₀ ≤ δ := by linarith
  have h_alg : c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h_diff : c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 - c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 =
        c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ' ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
      dsimp [δ₀]
      have : c₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₂
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ' ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
      have : 0 ≤ c₂ - c₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hc₁₂
      positivity
    linarith
  have h_abs_uIcc : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ∈ Set.uIcc 0 b → |a| ≤ |b| ∧ (|a| = |b| → a = b) := by
    intro a b h
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at h
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · have hb : 0 ≤ b := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      exact ⟨h2, id⟩
    · have hb : b ≤ 0 := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos hb]
      exact ⟨by linarith, fun h_eq => by linarith⟩
  have h_bootstrap : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (E : ℝ), 0 < E → Continuous f →
      f 0 ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * E →
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, f s ≤ δ' ^ 2 * E) → f t ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * E) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, f t ≤ δ' ^ 2 * E := by
    intro f E hE_pos hf_cont hf0 hf_step τ
    by_contra! h_gt
    let S : Set ℝ := Set.uIcc 0 τ ∩ {s : ℝ | δ' ^ 2 * E ≤ f s}
    have hS_compact : IsCompact S :=
      isCompact_uIcc.inter_right (isClosed_Ici.preimage hf_cont)
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := ⟨τ, Set.right_mem_uIcc, le_of_lt h_gt⟩
    obtain ⟨s₀, ⟨hs₀_uIcc, hs₀_ge⟩, hs₀_min⟩ :=
      hS_compact.exists_isMinOn hS_nonempty continuous_abs.continuousOn
    change δ' ^ 2 * E ≤ f s₀ at hs₀_ge
    have h_half_lt_full : (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * E < δ' ^ 2 * E := by
      have h_sq_lt : (δ' / 2) ^ 2 < δ' ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_sq_lt hE_pos
    have h_le_s₀ : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 s₀, f s ≤ δ' ^ 2 * E := by
      intro s hs
      by_contra! hs_gt
      have h_mem : δ' ^ 2 * E ∈ Set.uIcc (f 0) (f s) :=
        Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt hs_gt⟩)
      obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁_mem, hs₁_eq⟩ :=
        intermediate_value_uIcc hf_cont.continuousOn h_mem
      have hs_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 s₀ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs
      have hs₀_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s₀ ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 τ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs₀_uIcc
      have hs₁_in_S : s₁ ∈ S := ⟨hs₀_sub (hs_sub hs₁_mem), le_of_eq hs₁_eq.symm⟩
      have h_min_s₁ : |s₀| ≤ |s₁| := hs₀_min hs₁_in_S
      have h_abs1 := h_abs_uIcc hs₁_mem
      have h_abs2 := h_abs_uIcc hs
      have h_eq1 : s₁ = s := h_abs1.2 (by linarith [h_abs1.1, h_abs2.1])
      subst h_eq1
      linarith
    have hs₀_half : f s₀ ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * E := hf_step s₀ h_le_s₀
    linarith
  refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le_δ, ?_⟩
  intro κ₀ hκ₀ κ hκ_2κ₀ w hw hw₀
  have hκ : 2 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_nonneg : 0 ≤ κ := le_of_lt hκ_pos
  have hκ_ge_κ₀ : κ₀ ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hw_hasDeriv : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : CinfT, HasCinfDerivAtT w v t := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, _⟩ := hw t
    exact ⟨v, hv_deriv⟩
  have h_local_cons : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → ∀ (t : ℝ),
      (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * M) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * κ) →
      alphaFunctionalT M (w t : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro M hM t h_ball_M h_ball_κ
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
    let g_α : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => alphaFunctionalT M (w τ : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, HasDerivAt g_α 0 s := by
      intro s hs
      have hs_M : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * M := h_ball_M s hs
      have hs_κ : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * κ := h_ball_κ s hs
      obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ := hw s
      have hs_M_pt : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ_pt ^ 2 * M :=
        le_trans hs_M (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_pt 2) hM_nonneg)
      have hs_M_weyl : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ_weyl ^ 2 * M :=
        le_trans hs_M (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_weyl 2) hM_nonneg)
      have hs_M_ode : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * M :=
        le_trans hs_M (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_ode 2) hM_nonneg)
      have hs_κ_ode : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w s)) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * κ :=
        le_trans hs_κ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_ode 2) hκ_nonneg)
      obtain ⟨h_rhs_cont, h_rhs_per, h_rhs_ortho⟩ :=
        regFlowRHS_orthogonality_diagGreenT δ_ode
          (fun E hE q hq => ⟨(h_ode_full E hE q hq).1, (h_ode_full E hE q hq).2.1, (h_ode_full E hE q hq).2.2.1⟩)
          κ M hκ hM (w s) hs_M_ode hs_κ_ode
      have hd := h_deriv_pt M hM w v s hv_deriv hs_M_pt
      have hv_fun : (v : ℝ → ℝ) = regFlowRHS κ (w s : ℝ → ℝ) := funext hv_eq
      rw [hv_fun] at hd
      have h_w := h_weyl M hM (w s) (regFlowRHS κ (w s : ℝ → ℝ)) h_rhs_cont h_rhs_per hs_M_weyl
      rw [h_w, h_rhs_ortho] at hd
      exact hd
    have h_mvt : ∀ (a b : ℝ), a < b → Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 t → g_α b = g_α a := by
      intro a b hab h_sub
      have h_cont_ab : ContinuousOn g_α (Set.Icc a b) :=
        fun x hx => (hg_deriv x (h_sub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have h_deriv_ab : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt g_α 0 x :=
        fun x hx => hg_deriv x (h_sub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx))
      obtain ⟨c, _, hc_slope⟩ :=
        exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope g_α (fun _ => 0) hab h_cont_ab h_deriv_ab
      have h_ne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab)
      have h_sub_zero : g_α b - g_α a = 0 := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc_slope.symm).resolve_right h_ne
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_zero
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 t with ht_pos | rfl | ht_neg
    · exact h_mvt 0 t ht_pos Set.Icc_subset_uIcc
    · rfl
    · exact (h_mvt t 0 ht_neg Set.Icc_subset_uIcc').symm
  have h_halve_from_cons : ∀ (M : ℝ), κ₀ ≤ M → ∀ (t : ℝ),
      hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * M →
      alphaFunctionalT M (w t : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) →
      hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * M := by
    intro M hM t hwt_ball h_cons_M
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans hκ₀ hM
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
    have hw0_M_δ₀ : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * M := by
      calc hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0))
        _ ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w 0)) := (h_mono κ₀ M hκ₀ hM (ιT (w 0))).2
        _ ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * κ₀ := hw₀
        _ ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM (sq_nonneg δ₀)
    have h_δ₁_sq : δ' ^ 2 * M ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_δ₁ 2) hM_nonneg
    have h_δ₀_δ₁ : δ₀ ^ 2 * M ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M := by
      have h_δ₀_le_δ₁ : δ₀ ≤ δ₁ := by linarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ₀_pos) h_δ₀_le_δ₁ 2) hM_nonneg
    have hw0_δ₁ : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M := le_trans hw0_M_δ₀ h_δ₀_δ₁
    have hwt_δ₁ : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * M := le_trans hwt_ball h_δ₁_sq
    have h_wt_lower : c₁ * hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ M * alphaFunctionalT M (w t : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      (h_quad M hM1 (w t) hwt_δ₁).1
    have h_w0_upper : M * alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) :=
      (h_quad M hM1 (w 0) hw0_δ₁).2
    have h_eq : M * alphaFunctionalT M (w t : ℝ → ℝ) = M * alphaFunctionalT M (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
      rw [h_cons_M]
    have h_c2_le : c₂ * hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ c₂ * (δ₀ ^ 2 * M) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0_M_δ₀ (le_of_lt hc₂)
    have h_alg_M : c₂ * (δ₀ ^ 2 * M) ≤ c₁ * ((δ' / 2) ^ 2 * M) := by
      calc c₂ * (δ₀ ^ 2 * M) = (c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2) * M := by ring
        _ ≤ (c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2) * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_alg hM_nonneg
        _ = c₁ * ((δ' / 2) ^ 2 * M) := by ring
    have h_c1_le : c₁ * hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ c₁ * ((δ' / 2) ^ 2 * M) := by linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_c1_le hc₁
  have h_init_half : ∀ (M : ℝ), κ₀ ≤ M → hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 * M := by
    intro M hM
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
    have hw0_M_δ₀ : hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0)) ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * M := by
      calc hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w 0))
        _ ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT (w 0)) := (h_mono κ₀ M hκ₀ hM (ιT (w 0))).2
        _ ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * κ₀ := hw₀
        _ ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM (sq_nonneg δ₀)
    have h_sq : δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ₀_pos) hδ₀_le_half 2
    exact le_trans hw0_M_δ₀ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq hM_nonneg)
  have h_ball_κ : ∀ t : ℝ, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * κ := by
    apply h_bootstrap (fun τ => hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w τ))) κ hκ_pos
      (h_cont_hm1 κ hκ1 w hw_hasDeriv) (h_init_half κ hκ_ge_κ₀)
    intro t h_ivl
    exact h_halve_from_cons κ hκ_ge_κ₀ t (h_ivl t Set.right_mem_uIcc)
      (h_local_cons κ hκ1 t h_ivl h_ivl)
  have h_trapped_M : ∀ (M : ℝ), κ₀ ≤ M → ∀ (t : ℝ), hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w t)) ≤ δ' ^ 2 * M := by
    intro M hM
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans hκ₀ hM
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
    apply h_bootstrap (fun τ => hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w τ))) M hM_pos
      (h_cont_hm1 M hM1 w hw_hasDeriv) (h_init_half M hM)
    intro t h_ivl
    exact h_halve_from_cons M hM t (h_ivl t Set.right_mem_uIcc)
      (h_local_cons M hM1 t h_ivl (fun s _ => h_ball_κ s))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t M hM
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
    have h_sq : δ' ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ') hδ'_le_δ 2
    exact le_trans (h_trapped_M M hM t) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq hM_nonneg)
  · intro M hM t
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans hκ₀ hM
    exact h_local_cons M hM1 t (fun s _ => h_trapped_M M hM s) (fun s _ => h_ball_κ s)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ (δ₁ c₁ c₂ K_alpha : ℝ),
      0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ ≤ c₂ ∧ 0 < K_alpha ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w : CinfT, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ →
        c₁ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ κ * alphaFunctionalT κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ∧
        κ * alphaFunctionalT κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : CinfT,
        hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w₁) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ → hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w₂) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ →
        alphaFunctionalT κ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) = alphaFunctionalT κ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) →
        Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w₁)) ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w₂))) ∧
      (∀ κ₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ₀ → ∃ C_int : ℝ, 0 < C_int ∧
        ∀ M : ℝ, κ₀ ≤ M → ∀ w₁ w₂ : CinfT,
          hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₁) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ₀ → hm1KappaSqT κ₀ (ιT w₂) ≤ δ₁ ^ 2 * κ₀ →
          ‖ιT w₁ - ιT w₂‖ ≤
            C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 *
              Real.sqrt (hm2NormSqT (fun x => recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - recipGreenDiffT κ₀ (w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x)) +
            C_int * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT w₁)) + Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSqT M (ιT w₂))))

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_third_order_odeT
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_ode : ℝ, 0 < δ_ode ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : CinfT),
        hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * κ →
        ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
        Function.Periodic (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
            2 * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x +
            4 * (w : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x +
            4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x) ∧
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (1 / (2 * κ) - diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) * kdvRHS (w : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: regFlowRHS_orthogonality_diagGreenT

(δ_ode : ℝ)
    (h_ode : ∀ (E : ℝ), 1 ≤ E → ∀ (w : CinfT),

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_jump_ode_ring : ∀ (κ q0z q1z q2z gz k1z : ℝ),
      -((((-q2z + 2 * q0z ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0z - 4 * κ ^ 4) * gz ^ 2 +
            2 * q1z * gz * ((k1z + 1) / 2) -
            2 * (q0z - 2 * κ ^ 2) * ((k1z + 1) / 2) ^ 2) - 0) +
        (0 - ((-q2z + 2 * q0z ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0z - 4 * κ ^ 4) * gz ^ 2 +
            2 * q1z * gz * ((k1z - 1) / 2) -
            2 * (q0z - 2 * κ ^ 2) * ((k1z - 1) / 2) ^ 2))) =
      -(2 * q1z * gz + 4 * q0z * k1z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * k1z) + 6 * q0z * k1z := by
    intros
    ring
  have h_comm_ring : ∀ (κ q0x q1x q2x q4x k1x k2x k4x : ℝ),
      16 * κ ^ 5 * (-k4x + 6 * (q1x * k1x + q0x * k2x)) +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * (-q4x + 6 * (q1x * q1x + q0x * q2x)) =
      -(16 * κ ^ 5 * k4x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q4x) +
        6 * (q1x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k1x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q1x) +
          q0x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k2x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q2x)) := by
    intros
    ring
  have h_cont_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (j : ℕ),
      Continuous (iteratedDeriv j f) := by
    intro f hf j
    exact hf.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (le_of_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top j)))
  have h_hasDerivAt_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (j : ℕ) (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv j f) (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) f y) y := by
    intro f hf j y
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact (hf.differentiable_iteratedDeriv j (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top j)) y).hasDerivAt
  have h_hasDerivAt_zero : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ∀ (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt f (iteratedDeriv 1 f y) y := by
    intro f hf y
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_hasDerivAt_iter f hf 0 y
  have h_per_deriv : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → Function.Periodic (deriv f) 1 := by
    intro f hf y
    have h_shift : (fun z : ℝ => f (z + 1)) = f := funext hf
    have h_comp := deriv_comp_add_const f 1 y
    rw [h_shift] at h_comp
    exact h_comp.symm
  have h_per_iter : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic f 1 → ∀ (j : ℕ),
      Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv j f) 1 := by
    intro f hf j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact hf
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact h_per_deriv (iteratedDeriv j f) ih
  have h_per_bdd : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 →
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |f y| ≤ B := by
    intro f hf_cont hf_per
    obtain ⟨x₀, _, hx₀_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) hf_cont.abs.continuousOn
    refine ⟨|f x₀|, abs_nonneg _, fun y => ?_⟩
    have h_eq : f y = f (Int.fract y) := by
      have h1 := hf_per.int_mul ⌊y⌋ (Int.fract y)
      have h2 : Int.fract y + (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1 = y := by
        linarith [Int.self_sub_floor y]
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hx₀_max ⟨Int.fract_nonneg y, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one y)⟩
  obtain ⟨δ_ode, hδ_ode, h_ode⟩ := diagGreen_third_order_odeT
  set δ_brack : ℝ := min δ_ode (3 / 208)
  have hδ_brack : 0 < δ_brack := by positivity
  refine ⟨δ_brack, hδ_brack, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ q hq
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have hκ_nn : 0 ≤ κ := le_of_lt hκ_pos
  have hκ_half_pos : 0 < κ / 2 := by positivity
  have h_inv_κ_le_one : 1 / κ ≤ 1 := div_le_self zero_le_one hκ1
  have hδ_le_ode : δ_brack ≤ δ_ode := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_le_ct : δ_brack ≤ 3 / 208 := min_le_right _ _
  have hq_ode : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ δ_ode ^ 2 * κ :=
    le_trans hq (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ_brack) hδ_le_ode 2) hκ_nn)
  have hq_ct : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ (3 / 208 : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ :=
    le_trans hq (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ_brack) hδ_le_ct 2) hκ_nn)
  set q0 : ℝ → ℝ := (q : ℝ → ℝ)
  have hq0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q0 := q.2.1
  have hq0_per : Function.Periodic q0 1 := q.2.2
  obtain ⟨hg_smooth, hg_per, hg_ode_raw, _⟩ := h_ode κ hκ1 q hq_ode
  let k0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => diagGreen κ q0 y - 1 / (2 * κ)
  have hk0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) k0 := hg_smooth.sub contDiff_const
  let q1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 q0
  let q2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 q0
  let q3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 q0
  let q4 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 4 q0
  let k1 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 k0
  let k2 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 2 k0
  let k3 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 k0
  let k4 : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv 4 k0
  have hq0_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt q0 (q1 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_zero q0 hq0_smooth
  have hq1_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt q1 (q2 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter q0 hq0_smooth 1
  have hq2_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt q2 (q3 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter q0 hq0_smooth 2
  have hq3_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt q3 (q4 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter q0 hq0_smooth 3
  have hk0_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt k0 (k1 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_zero k0 hk0_smooth
  have hk1_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt k1 (k2 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter k0 hk0_smooth 1
  have hk2_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt k2 (k3 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter k0 hk0_smooth 2
  have hk3_d : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt k3 (k4 y) y := h_hasDerivAt_iter k0 hk0_smooth 3
  have h_hasDerivAt_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ q0) (k1 y) y := by
    intro y
    have h_eq : diagGreen κ q0 = fun z => k0 z + 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      ext z; dsimp [k0]; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (hk0_d y).add_const (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_deriv_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, deriv (diagGreen κ q0) y = k1 y :=
    fun y => (h_hasDerivAt_diag y).deriv
  have h_iter1_diag : iteratedDeriv 1 (diagGreen κ q0) = k1 := by
    ext y
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one, h_deriv_diag y]
  have h_iter2_diag : iteratedDeriv 2 (diagGreen κ q0) = k2 := by
    ext y
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, h_iter1_diag, (hk1_d y).deriv]
  have h_iter3_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (diagGreen κ q0) y = k3 y := by
    intro y
    rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 by rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, h_iter2_diag, (hk2_d y).deriv]
  have hg_ode : ∀ y : ℝ,
      k3 y = 2 * q1 y * diagGreen κ q0 y + 4 * q0 y * k1 y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * k1 y := by
    intro y
    have hy := hg_ode_raw y
    change k3 y = 2 * deriv q0 y * diagGreen κ q0 y + 4 * q0 y * deriv k0 y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv k0 y at hy
    rwa [(hq0_d y).deriv, (hk0_d y).deriv] at hy
  have h_kdv_eq : kdvRHS q0 = fun y => -q3 y + 6 * (q0 y * q1 y) := by
    ext y
    dsimp [kdvRHS, q1, q3]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
    ring
  obtain ⟨B0, hB0_nn, hB0⟩ := h_per_bdd q0 hq0_smooth.continuous hq0_per
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1_nn, hB1⟩ := h_per_bdd q1 (h_cont_iter q0 hq0_smooth 1) (h_per_iter q0 hq0_per 1)
  obtain ⟨B2, hB2_nn, hB2⟩ := h_per_bdd q2 (h_cont_iter q0 hq0_smooth 2) (h_per_iter q0 hq0_per 2)
  obtain ⟨B3, hB3_nn, hB3⟩ := h_per_bdd q3 (h_cont_iter q0 hq0_smooth 3) (h_per_iter q0 hq0_per 3)
  set B_kdv : ℝ := B3 + 6 * B0 * B1
  have hBkdv_nn : 0 ≤ B_kdv := by positivity
  have hkdv_bd : ∀ y : ℝ, |kdvRHS q0 y| ≤ B_kdv := by
    intro y
    rw [h_kdv_eq]
    have h_tri := abs_add_le (-q3 y) (6 * (q0 y * q1 y))
    rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6), abs_mul] at h_tri
    have h_mul : |q0 y| * |q1 y| ≤ B0 * B1 :=
      mul_le_mul (hB0 y) (hB1 y) (abs_nonneg _) hB0_nn
    linarith [hB3 y]
  set r : ℝ := 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q))
  have hr_nn : 0 ≤ r := by positivity
  have h_hm1_div : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ (3 / 208 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)
      _ ≤ (1 / κ) * ((3 / 208 : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_ct (by positivity)
      _ = (3 / 208 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
  have h_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q)) ≤ 3 / 208 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
    exact ⟨by norm_num, h_hm1_div⟩
  have hr_le : r ≤ 3 / 16 := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have h43r_nn : 0 ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * r := by positivity
  have h43r_quarter : (4 / 3 : ℝ) * r ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨h_fc_sum, h_fc_hasSum, h_fc_hm1⟩ := cinfT_fourierCircle_summable_and_hasSum q
  have h_bf := blochFloquet_kernel_tsum_boundT κ hκ1
  obtain ⟨h_off_cont, h_off_raw⟩ := greenIterKernel_damped_offDiag_boundT κ hκ1 q
    ⟨h_fc_sum, h_fc_hasSum, (h_fc_hm1 κ hκ1).1, (h_fc_hm1 κ hκ1).2⟩ h_bf
  have h_off_r : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ q0 ℓ x y| ≤ ((4 / 3) * r) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := by
    intro ℓ x y

      _ ≤ 1 * ((4 / 3) * r) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_κ_le_one (pow_nonneg h43r_nn ℓ)
      _ = ((4 / 3) * r) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := by ring
  obtain ⟨h_symm, h_diag_d, h_off_d1, h_off_d2, B_d, hBd, h_dG_r⟩ :=
    greenIterKernel_deriv_and_symmT κ hκ1 q r hr_nn
      (fun ℓ => ⟨h_off_cont ℓ, h_off_r ℓ⟩)
  have h_off_bd : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ q0 ℓ x y| ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := by
    intro ℓ x y
    calc |greenIterKernel κ q0 ℓ x y|
      _ ≤ ((4 / 3) * r) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) := h_off_r ℓ x y
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |x - y|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ h43r_nn h43r_quarter ℓ) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  have h_dG_bd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterDerivY κ q0 (m + 1) a x| ≤
        B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) := by
    intro m a x
    calc |greenIterDerivY κ q0 (m + 1) a x|
      _ ≤ B_d * ((4 / 3) * r) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) := h_dG_r m a x
      _ ≤ B_d * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-(κ / 2) * |a - x|) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ h43r_nn h43r_quarter m) hBd

by
  obtain ⟨h_iota_sub, h_iota_smul, _h_hm1_diff, h_hm1_lip, _h_deriv_linf⟩ :=
    cinfT_iotaT_deriv_and_hm1KappaSqT_lipschitz
  obtain ⟨h_iota_add, h_iota_linf, h_iota_deriv, h_ortho⟩ :=
    cinfT_iotaT_hasDerivAt_and_deriv_orthogonalityT
  obtain ⟨δ_hm1, hδ_hm1_pos, hδ_hm1_le_brack, h_pred⟩ :=
    diagGreen_linear_predictor_hm1_boundsT δ_brack hδ_brack
  have h_deriv_cinfT : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, f ∈ CinfT → deriv f ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f hf
    refine ⟨by simpa using hf.1.iterate_deriv 1, fun x => ?_⟩
    have h_shift : (fun y : ℝ => f (y + 1)) = f := funext hf.2

    exact h_comp.symm
  have h_smul_cinfT : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => c * f x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro c f hf
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hf.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x]
  have h_add_cinfT : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → g ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => f x + g x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x, hg.2 x]
  have h_sub_cinfT : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → g ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => f x - g x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x, hg.2 x]
  have h_mul_cinfT : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → g ∈ CinfT → (fun x : ℝ => f x * g x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [hf.2 x, hg.2 x]
  have h_iter_cinfT : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), f ∈ CinfT → iteratedDeriv n f ∈ CinfT := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f hf
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hf
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f hf
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact h_deriv_cinfT _ (ih f hf)
  have h_iota_congr : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : f ∈ CinfT) (hg : g ∈ CinfT),
      (∀ x : ℝ, f x = g x) → ιT ⟨f, hf⟩ = ιT ⟨g, hg⟩ := by
    intro f g hf hg hfg
    have h_eq : f = g := funext hfg
    subst h_eq
    rfl
  have h_kdvRHS_cinfT : ∀ q : CinfT, kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro q
    have h1 : iteratedDeriv 3 (q : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT := h_iter_cinfT 3 _ q.2
    have h2 : (fun x : ℝ => (-1 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 3 (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=
      h_smul_cinfT (-1) _ h1
    have h3 : deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT := h_deriv_cinfT _ q.2
    have h4 : (fun x : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=
      h_mul_cinfT _ _ q.2 h3
    have h5 : (fun x : ℝ => 6 * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x)) ∈ CinfT :=
      h_smul_cinfT 6 _ h4
    have h6 := h_add_cinfT _ _ h2 h5
    have h_eq : kdvRHS (q : ℝ → ℝ) =
        fun x : ℝ => (-1 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 3 (q : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          6 * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by
      ext x
      dsimp [kdvRHS]
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h6
  have h_K'_cinfT : ∀ (q v : CinfT),
      (fun x : ℝ => -iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x +
        6 * deriv (fun z => (q : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) x) ∈ CinfT := by

      h_smul_cinfT (-1) _ h1
    have h3 : (fun z : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) ∈ CinfT :=
      h_mul_cinfT _ _ q.2 v.2
    have h4 : deriv (fun z : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) ∈ CinfT :=

    have h5 : (fun x : ℝ => 6 * deriv (fun z : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) x) ∈ CinfT :=

    have h6 := h_add_cinfT _ _ h2 h5
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x +

        6 * deriv (fun z => (q : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) x) := by

    rw [h_eq]

  have h_lincomb_cinfT : ∀ (q₁ q₂ q₃ : CinfT) (c : ℝ),

    intro q₁ q₂ q₃ c

      h_sub_cinfT _ _ q₁.2 q₂.2
    let q₁₂ : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h12⟩
    have hc3 : (fun x : ℝ => c * (q₃ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=
      h_smul_cinfT c _ q₃.2
    let cq₃ : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q₃ : ℝ → ℝ) x, hc3⟩

      h_sub_cinfT _ _ q₁₂.2 cq₃.2
    refine ⟨⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (cq₃ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_all⟩, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [h_iota_sub q₁₂ cq₃ h_all, h_iota_sub q₁ q₂ h12, h_iota_smul c q₃ hc3]
  refine ⟨δ_hm1, hδ_hm1_pos, hδ_hm1_le_brack, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ h_brack V hV_reg hV_kdv0 hV_ball s₀ τ v₀ hv₀
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_nn : 0 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have hδ_hm1_sq_le_brack : δ_hm1 ^ 2 ≤ δ_brack ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ_hm1_pos) hδ_hm1_le_brack 2
  let K : ℝ → CinfT := fun τ' => ⟨kdvRHS (V s₀ τ' : ℝ → ℝ), h_kdvRHS_cinfT (V s₀ τ')⟩
  have hK_eq : ∀ (τ' : ℝ) (x : ℝ), (K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x = kdvRHS (V s₀ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have hK_τ : K τ = v₀ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    exact (hv₀ x).symm
  have hV_s₀_diff : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : CinfT, HasCinfDerivAtT (fun τ' => V s₀ τ') v t :=
    fun t => ⟨(hV_reg s₀ t).choose, (hV_reg s₀ t).choose_spec.1⟩
  obtain ⟨h_K_bounds_all, h_K_deriv⟩ :=
    kdvRHS_cinfT_hm1_hasDerivAt_and_uniform_boundT
      h_iota_sub h_iota_smul h_iota_linf (fun τ' => V s₀ τ') K hV_s₀_diff hK_eq
  obtain ⟨M_K, hM_K_nn, hM_K_bound⟩ := h_K_bounds_all τ
  obtain ⟨_, _, ⟨M_kdv, M₁, M₂, _, _, hM₂_nn, _, _, h_taylor0⟩, _⟩ :=
    smooth_solution_uniform_taylor_and_exp_conv_hasDerivAtT (fun s => V s 0) hV_kdv0 1 le_rfl s₀
  set C_init : ℝ := M₂ ^ 2
  have hC_init_nn : 0 ≤ C_init := sq_nonneg M₂
  have h_init_bound : ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ 1 →
      ‖ιT (V s 0) - ιT (V s₀ 0) - (s - s₀) • ιT (K 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_init * |s - s₀| ^ 3 := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_mem : s ∈ Set.Icc (s₀ - 1) (s₀ + 1) := by
      rw [abs_sub_le_iff] at hs
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.2], by linarith [hs.1]⟩
    obtain ⟨δ₀_s, hδ₀_s_fn, hδ₀_s_iota⟩ := h_lincomb_cinfT (V s 0) (V s₀ 0) (K 0) (s - s₀)
    have h_pt : ∀ y : ℝ, |(δ₀_s : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M₂ * |s - s₀| ^ 2 := by
      intro y
      rw [hδ₀_s_fn y, hK_eq 0 y]
      exact h_taylor0 s hs_mem y
    have h_norm : ‖ιT (V s 0) - ιT (V s₀ 0) - (s - s₀) • ιT (K 0)‖ ≤ M₂ * |s - s₀| ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hδ₀_s_iota]
      exact h_iota_linf δ₀_s (M₂ * |s - s₀| ^ 2) (by positivity) h_pt
    have h_sq : ‖ιT (V s 0) - ιT (V s₀ 0) - (s - s₀) • ιT (K 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (M₂ * |s - s₀| ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_norm 2
    have h_pow4_le_pow3 : |s - s₀| ^ 4 ≤ |s - s₀| ^ 3 := by
      calc |s - s₀| ^ 4 = |s - s₀| * |s - s₀| ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * |s - s₀| ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (by positivity)
        _ = |s - s₀| ^ 3 := one_mul _
    calc ‖ιT (V s 0) - ιT (V s₀ 0) - (s - s₀) • ιT (K 0)‖ ^ 2

      _ ≤ C_init * |s - s₀| ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow4_le_pow3 hC_init_nn
  set η : ℝ := min 1 (δ_hm1 / (M_K + 1))
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min one_pos (div_pos hδ_hm1_pos (by linarith))
  set C : ℝ := Real.exp (112 * κ ^ 5 * |τ|) * (C_init + 2048 * M_K ^ 4)
  have hC_nn : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  refine ⟨C, η, hC_nn, hη_pos, ?_⟩
  intro s hs

  have hh_le_1 : |h| ≤ 1 := le_trans hs (min_le_left _ _)
  have hh_le_δ : |h| ≤ δ_hm1 / (M_K + 1) := le_trans hs (min_le_right _ _)
  let Δ : ℝ → Hm1T := fun τ' => ιT (V s τ') - ιT (V s₀ τ') - h • ιT (K τ')
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ' => ‖Δ τ'‖ ^ 2
  have hE_nn : ∀ τ' : ℝ, 0 ≤ E τ' := fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hE0_le : E 0 ≤ C_init * |h| ^ 3 := h_init_bound s hh_le_1
  let v₁ : ℝ → CinfT := fun τ' => (hV_reg s τ').choose
  let v₂ : ℝ → CinfT := fun τ' => (hV_reg s₀ τ').choose
  let K' : ℝ → CinfT := fun τ' =>
    ⟨fun x : ℝ => -iteratedDeriv 3 (v₂ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x +
      6 * deriv (fun z => (V s₀ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v₂ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) z) x,
     h_K'_cinfT (V s₀ τ') (v₂ τ')⟩
  have hK'_eq : ∀ (τ' : ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      (K' τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        -iteratedDeriv 3 (v₂ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          6 * deriv (fun z => (V s₀ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v₂ τ' : ℝ → ℝ) z) x :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  let Δ' : ℝ → Hm1T := fun τ' => ιT (v₁ τ') - ιT (v₂ τ') - h • ιT (K' τ')
  let E' : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ' => 2 * inner ℝ (Δ τ') (Δ' τ')
  have hE_deriv : ∀ τ' : ℝ, HasDerivAt E (E' τ') τ' := by
    intro τ'
    have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun t => ιT (V s t)) (ιT (v₁ τ')) τ' :=
      h_iota_deriv (fun t => V s t) (v₁ τ') τ' (hV_reg s τ').choose_spec.1
    have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun t => ιT (V s₀ t)) (ιT (v₂ τ')) τ' :=
      h_iota_deriv (fun t => V s₀ t) (v₂ τ') τ' (hV_reg s₀ τ').choose_spec.1
    have hdK : HasDerivAt (fun t => ιT (K t)) (ιT (K' τ')) τ' :=
      h_K_deriv τ' (v₂ τ') (K' τ') (hV_reg s₀ τ').choose_spec.1 (hK'_eq τ')
    have hdΔ : HasDerivAt Δ (Δ' τ') τ' := (hd₁.sub hd₂).sub (hdK.const_smul h)
    exact hdΔ.norm_sq
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ' => E τ' + 2048 * M_K ^ 4 * |h| ^ 3
  have hG_nn : ∀ τ' : ℝ, 0 ≤ G τ' := fun τ' => add_nonneg (hE_nn τ') (by positivity)
  have hG_deriv : ∀ τ' : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (E' τ') τ' :=
    fun τ' => (hE_deriv τ').add_const (2048 * M_K ^ 4 * |h| ^ 3)
  let R : ℝ := 112 * κ ^ 5
  have hR_nn : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hE'_bound : ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 τ, |E' τ'| ≤ R * G τ' := by
    intro τ' hτ'

    have h_w₁_ball : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s τ')) ≤ δ_hm1 ^ 2 * κ := hV_ball s τ'
    have h_q_ball : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ')) ≤ δ_hm1 ^ 2 * κ := hV_ball s₀ τ'
    have h_q_brack : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ')) ≤ δ_brack ^ 2 * κ :=
      le_trans h_q_ball (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ_hm1_sq_le_brack hκ_nn)
    have h_pred_ball : hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ') + h • ιT (K τ')) ≤ (2 * δ_hm1) ^ 2 * κ := by
      have h_lip_pair := h_hm1_lip κ hκ1 (ιT (V s₀ τ') + h • ιT (K τ')) (ιT (V s₀ τ'))
      have h_nn_pred : 0 ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ') + h • ιT (K τ')) := h_lip_pair.1
      have h_diff_norm : ‖(ιT (V s₀ τ') + h • ιT (K τ')) - ιT (V s₀ τ')‖ = |h| * ‖ιT (K τ')‖ := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_lip_ineq :
          Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ') + h • ιT (K τ'))) -
            Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ'))) ≤ |h| * ‖ιT (K τ')‖ := by
        have h_abs := h_lip_pair.2.2
        rw [h_diff_norm] at h_abs
        exact (abs_le.mp h_abs).2
      have h_q_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ'))) ≤ δ_hm1 := by
        have h1 : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ')) ≤ δ_hm1 ^ 2 := by
          calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ'))
            _ ≤ (1 / κ) * (δ_hm1 ^ 2 * κ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_q_ball (by positivity)
            _ = δ_hm1 ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
        calc Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (V s₀ τ')))
          _ ≤ Real.sqrt (δ_hm1 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
          _ = δ_hm1 := Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hδ_hm1_pos)
      have h_hK : |h| * ‖ιT (K τ')‖ ≤ δ_hm1 := by
        calc |h| * ‖ιT (K τ')‖
          _ ≤ |h| * M_K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK_hm1 (abs_nonneg h)
          _ ≤ |h| * (M_K + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (abs_nonneg h)
