        iteratedDeriv n (v₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      h_iter_sub v₁ v₂ n x
    have h_diag_sub :
        iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
          iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y) x +
            iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x := by
      rw [h_iter_sub (V s (t - s)) (V s₀ τ₀) n x,
          h_iter_sub (V s (t - s)) (V s₀ (t - s)) n x,
          h_iter_sub (V s₀ (t - s)) (V s₀ τ₀) n x]
      ring
    change |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ ε * |s - s₀|
    rw [h_diag_sub, h_v_iter]
    let E₁ := iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x
    let E₂ := iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      -(s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x
    have h_split :
        iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y) x +
          iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (V s₀ (t - s) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
          (s - s₀) * (iteratedDeriv n (v₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) =
        E₁ + E₂ := by
      dsimp [E₁, E₂]
      ring
    rw [h_split]
    have h_tri := abs_add_le E₁ E₂
    linarith
  · intro x
    change (v₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (v₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x = diffFlowRHS κ (V s₀ τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x
    rw [hv₁_eq x, hv₂_eq x]
    rfl

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_semi_nn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT n f := by
    intro n f
    unfold cinfSeminormT
    refine Real.sSup_nonneg ?_
    rintro y ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    exact abs_nonneg _
  have h_semi_le : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n f x| ≤ B) → cinfSeminormT n f ≤ B := by
    intro n f B _ hB
    unfold cinfSeminormT
    refine csSup_le ⟨|iteratedDeriv n f 0|, ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, rfl⟩⟩ ?_
    rintro y ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    exact hB x
  have h_iter_add : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m k : ℕ),
      iteratedDeriv m (iteratedDeriv k f) = iteratedDeriv (m + k) f := by
    intro f m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih k, ← iteratedDeriv_succ, Nat.add_right_comm m 1 k]
  have hW_smooth : ∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    intro g n
    refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [h_iter_add (g : ℝ → ℝ) m n]
    exact g.2.1.differentiable_iteratedDeriv (m + n)
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top (m + n)))
  have hW_per : ∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ), Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ)) 1 := by
    intro g n x
    have h_shift : (fun z : ℝ => (g : ℝ → ℝ) (z + 1)) = (g : ℝ → ℝ) := funext g.2.2
    calc iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + 1)
      _ = iteratedDeriv n (fun z : ℝ => (g : ℝ → ℝ) (z + 1)) x :=
        (congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const n (g : ℝ → ℝ) 1) x).symm
      _ = iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x := by rw [h_shift]
  have h_iter_le : ∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro g n x
    let y : ℝ := Int.fract x
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨Int.fract_nonneg x, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one x)⟩
    have hx_eq : y + (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) * 1 = x := by
      dsimp [y]
      linarith [Int.self_sub_floor x]
    have h_per_x : iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x = iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) y := by
      calc iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x
        _ = iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) (y + (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) * 1) := by rw [hx_eq]
        _ = iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) y := (hW_per g n).int_mul ⌊x⌋ y
    rw [h_per_x]
    unfold cinfSeminormT
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) z|) :=
      continuous_abs.comp ((hW_smooth g n).continuous)
    have h_bdd : BddAbove (Set.image (fun z : ℝ => |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) z|) (Set.Icc 0 1)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.bddAbove_image h_cont.continuousOn
    exact le_csSup h_bdd ⟨y, hy_mem, rfl⟩
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_summable_lp : ∀ u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖u n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro u
    have hu := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp u.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hu
    exact hu
  have h_fc_eq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) n = fourierCircle f n := by
    intro f n
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) n zero_lt_one]
    have h_sub : (1 : ℝ) / (1 - 0) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_sub, one_smul, fourierCircle]
    congr 1 with x
    rw [fourier_coe_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_parseval : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f hf
    let f_C : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (f x : ℂ)
    have hf_C : Continuous f_C := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hf
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable f_C (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      hf_C.aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_int_sq : Integrable (fun x => ‖f_C x‖ ^ 2) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le zero_le_one).mp
        ((hf_C.norm.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    have h_memLp : MemLp f_C 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas).mpr h_int_sq
    have hs := (hasSum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp).summable
    have h_tsum := tsum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp
    simp only [f_C, h_fc_eq f] at hs h_tsum
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    rw [h_tsum]
    have h_inv : ((1 : ℝ) - 0)⁻¹ = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_inv, one_smul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_prof_sq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 =
        (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f n
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ =
        (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
    rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
    simp_rw [h_rpow]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
      (h_parseval (q : ℝ → ℝ) q.2.1.continuous).1
    rw [h_prof_sq (q : ℝ → ℝ) n]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) h_inv_le
  have h_toHm1T_apply : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      (toHm1T q : ℤ → ℂ) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro q n
    dsimp [toHm1T]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_iota_le : ∀ (g : CinfT), ‖ιT g‖ ≤ cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro g
    let g₀ : ℝ → ℝ := (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    let M₀ : ℝ := cinfSeminormT 0 g₀
    have hM₀_nn : 0 ≤ M₀ := h_semi_nn 0 g₀
    have hg₀_cont : Continuous g₀ := g.2.1.continuous
    have hg₀_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |g₀ x| ≤ M₀ := by
      intro x
      simpa [g₀, M₀, iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_iter_le g 0 x
    have h_prof_le : ∀ n : ℤ,
        ‖((ιT g : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖fourierCircle g₀ n‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      change ‖(toHm1T g : ℤ → ℂ) n‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖fourierCircle g₀ n‖ ^ 2
      rw [h_toHm1T_apply g n, h_prof_sq g₀ n]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
        inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))])
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) h_inv_le
    obtain ⟨h_sum_g0, h_tsum_g0⟩ := h_parseval g₀ hg₀_cont
    have h_tsum_le :
        (∑' n : ℤ, ‖((ιT g : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2) ≤ M₀ ^ 2 := by
      calc (∑' n : ℤ, ‖((ιT g : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle g₀ n‖ ^ 2 :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_prof_le
            (h_summable_lp ((ιT g : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)) h_sum_g0
        _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g₀ x) ^ 2 := h_tsum_g0
        _ ≤ ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..1, M₀ ^ 2 := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
            ((hg₀_cont.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
            (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (fun x _ => ?_)
          rw [← sq_abs (g₀ x)]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hg₀_bd x) 2
        _ = M₀ ^ 2 := by simp
    apply lp.norm_le_of_tsum_le hp_pos hM₀_nn
    simp_rw [h_rpow]
    exact h_tsum_le
  have h_laplace : ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * |v|)) volume ∧
      (∫ v : ℝ, Real.exp (-c * |v|)) = 2 / c := by
    intro c hc
    let f_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-c * |v|)
    have hf_Ici : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hc).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
      refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
      intro v hv
      dsimp [f_c]
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]
    have hf_Iic : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_neg := hf_Ici.comp_neg
      rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
      refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
      intro v _
      dsimp [f_c]
      rw [abs_neg]
    have hf_int : Integrable f_c volume := by
      rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
      exact hf_Iic.union (hf_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
    refine ⟨hf_int, ?_⟩
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => -(1 / c) * Real.exp (-c * v)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by dsimp [F]; fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-c * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) (-c) v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-c)
      have hd2 := hd1.exp.const_mul (-(1 / c))
      convert hd2 using 1
      have : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
      field_simp
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [show (0 : ℝ) = -(1 / c) * 0 by ring]
      apply Filter.Tendsto.const_mul
      apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
      have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => c * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc Filter.tendsto_id
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(c * x)) := by ext x; ring
      change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_ioi_val : (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-c * v)) = 1 / c := by
      have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv
        (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hc) hF_lim
      rw [h_res]
      dsimp [F]
      rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
      ring
    have h_split : ∫ v : ℝ, f_c v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hf_int.integrableOn hf_int.integrableOn).symm
    have h_iic_eq : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v := by
      have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) f_c
      rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
      rw [← h_neg]
      congr 1 with v
      dsimp [f_c]
      rw [abs_neg]
    have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-c * v) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro v hv
      dsimp [f_c]
      have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv
      rw [abs_of_pos hv_pos]
    rw [h_split, h_iic_eq, h_ioi_eq, h_ioi_val]
    ring
  have h_hm1_c0 : ∀ (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → ∀ (g : CinfT),
      cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
        26 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ιT g‖ + (2 / Λ) * cinfSeminormT 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro Λ hΛ g
    have hΛ_pos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨h_int_2Λ, h_val_2Λ⟩ := h_laplace (2 * Λ) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨h_int_Λ, h_val_Λ⟩ := h_laplace Λ hΛ_pos
    let K : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Λ * Real.exp (-(2 * Λ) * |v|)
    have hK_int : Integrable K volume := h_int_2Λ.const_mul Λ
    have hK_val : (∫ v : ℝ, K v) = 1 := by
      dsimp [K]
      rw [integral_const_mul, h_val_2Λ]
      have : Λ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hΛ_pos
      field_simp
    let M₁ : ℝ := cinfSeminormT 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hM₁_nn : 0 ≤ M₁ := h_semi_nn 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ (g : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      (hW_smooth g 0).differentiable (by decide)
    have h_deriv_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖deriv (g : ℝ → ℝ) y‖ ≤ M₁ := by
      intro y

              rw [h_pow_id]
              ring
            _ ≤ 26 * C₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_bound (by positivity)
            _ = 26 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by ring
        have h_term2 : (2 / Λ) * cinfSeminormT 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ 2 * B' 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          have h_2Λ : 2 / Λ = 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
            dsimp [Λ]
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
          rw [h_2Λ]
          calc 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m * cinfSeminormT 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m * B' 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_01 (by positivity)
            _ = 2 * B' 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by ring
        calc cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ)
          _ ≤ 26 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ιT g‖ + (2 / Λ) * cinfSeminormT 1 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := h_step0
          _ ≤ 26 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) * (A⁻¹) ^ m + 2 * B' 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m :=
            add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ = D₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by dsimp [D₀]; ring
      | succ n' ih =>
        intro A hA
        have hA_pos : 0 < A := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hA
        have hA_ne : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA_pos
        have hA2 : 1 ≤ A ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hA
        obtain ⟨D_n, hD_n_nn, hD_n_ih⟩ := ih (A ^ 2) hA2
        let D_succ : ℝ := 2 * D_n + B' (n' + 2)
        have hD_succ_nn : 0 ≤ D_succ := add_nonneg (by positivity) (hB'_nn (n' + 2))
        refine ⟨D_succ, hD_succ_nn, ?_⟩
        intro m g hg_B hg_hm1
        let δ : ℝ := (A⁻¹) ^ m
        have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by positivity
        have h_step_d := h_deriv n' δ hδ_pos g
        have hg_0n' : cinfSeminormT n' (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m :=
          hD_n_ih m g hg_B hg_hm1
        have hg_0n2 : cinfSeminormT (n' + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B' (n' + 2) :=
          le_trans (hg_B (n' + 2)) (hB_le_B' (n' + 2))
        have h_alg : (2 / δ) * (D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m) = 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          dsimp [δ]
          rw [inv_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
          have h_2m : A ^ (2 * m) = A ^ m * A ^ m := by
            rw [← pow_add]
            congr 1
            omega
          rw [h_2m, mul_inv]
          have hAm_ne : (A ^ m)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m hA_ne)
          field_simp
        have h_term1 : (2 / δ) * cinfSeminormT n' (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          calc (2 / δ) * cinfSeminormT n' (g : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ (2 / δ) * (D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_0n' (by positivity)
            _ = 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := h_alg
        have h_term2 : δ * cinfSeminormT (n' + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B' (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          calc δ * cinfSeminormT (n' + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ δ * B' (n' + 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_0n2 (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
            _ = B' (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := mul_comm _ _
        calc cinfSeminormT (n' + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
          _ ≤ (2 / δ) * cinfSeminormT n' (g : ℝ → ℝ) + δ * cinfSeminormT (n' + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :=
            h_step_d
          _ ≤ 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m + B' (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m :=
            add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ = D_succ * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by dsimp [D_succ]; ring
    obtain ⟨C, hC_nn, hC_bound⟩ := h_zero_n n 2 (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨C, hC_nn, fun m g hg_B hg_hm1 => ?_⟩
    simpa [one_div] using hC_bound m g hg_B hg_hm1

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_iota_sub, h_iota_smul⟩ := h_iota_lin
  obtain ⟨h_sem_nn, h_sem_le, h_le_sem, h_iota_le_sem0⟩ := h_sem_basic
  have h_cdAt : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun q n x => (q.2.1.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
  have h_sub_mem : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT),
      (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=
    fun q₁ q₂ => ⟨q₁.2.1.sub q₂.2.1, q₁.2.2.sub q₂.2.2⟩
  have h_smul_mem : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT),
      (fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=
    fun c q => ⟨contDiff_const.mul q.2.1, fun x => by dsimp; rw [q.2.2 x]⟩
  let z₀ : CinfT := ⟨fun _ => 0, contDiff_const, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun q₁ q₂ n x => iteratedDeriv_sub (h_cdAt q₁ n x) (h_cdAt q₂ n x)
  have h_iter_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        c * iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro c q n x
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using iteratedDeriv_const_smul (h_cdAt q n x) c
  have h_iter_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (z₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0 := by
    intro n x
    have h_eq : (z₀ : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => (0 : ℝ) * (z₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y := by
      funext y; simp [z₀]
    have h0 := h_iter_smul 0 z₀ n x
    rw [← h_eq, zero_mul] at h0
    exact h0
  have h_diff_pt : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤
        cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n x
    have h1 := h_le_sem ⟨fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y, h_sub_mem q₁ q₂⟩ n x
    rwa [← h_iter_sub q₁ q₂ n x]
  have h_sem_rev_tri : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ),
      |cinfSeminormT n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) - cinfSeminormT n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ)| ≤
        cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_le : cinfSeminormT n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) +
            cinfSeminormT n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        refine h_sem_le n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) _ (add_nonneg (h_sem_nn _ _) (h_sem_nn _ _)) (fun x => ?_)
        have h_id : iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x =
            (iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) +
              iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by ring
        calc |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x|
          _ = |(iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) +
                iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := by rw [← h_id]
          _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x| +
                |iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) +
                cinfSeminormT n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) :=
            add_le_add (h_diff_pt q₁ q₂ n x) (h_le_sem q₂ n x)
      linarith
    · have h_le : cinfSeminormT n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) +
            cinfSeminormT n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        refine h_sem_le n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) _ (add_nonneg (h_sem_nn _ _) (h_sem_nn _ _)) (fun x => ?_)
        have h_id : iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x =
            -(iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) +
              iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by ring
        calc |iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x|
          _ = |-(iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) +
                iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := by rw [← h_id]
          _ ≤ |-(iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x)| +
                |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x| +
                |iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := by rw [abs_neg]
          _ ≤ cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) +
                cinfSeminormT n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) :=
            add_le_add (h_diff_pt q₁ q₂ n x) (h_le_sem q₁ n x)
      linarith
  have h_eval_cont : ∀ (G : ℝ → CinfT),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (G s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (G t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (G τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by
    intro G hG n x
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro t ε hε
    obtain ⟨η, hη, h_close⟩ := hG n t ε hε
    refine ⟨η, hη, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs ⊢
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_diff_pt (G s) (G t) n x) (h_close s hs)
  have h_semi_cont : ∀ (G : ℝ → CinfT),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧

      have h_sub_eq : (iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) -
          (iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) =
          (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) -
            (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) := by ring
      rw [h_sub_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int2]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun τ _ => ?_)
      exact (h_iter_sub (G₁ τ) (G₂ τ) n x).symm
    obtain ⟨hU0, hU_deriv, hU_cont⟩ := h_s2 z₀ U D hD_cont hU_int
    let γ : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun s => (ιT (U s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)
    let γ' : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := fun s => (ιT (D s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)
    have h_iota_zero : ιT z₀ = 0 := by
      have h_z_eq : z₀ = ⟨fun x : ℝ => (0 : ℝ) * (z₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul_mem 0 z₀⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext; funext x; simp [z₀]
      have h_sm := h_iota_smul 0 z₀ (h_smul_mem 0 z₀)
      rw [← h_z_eq, zero_smul] at h_sm
      exact h_sm
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [γ]
      rw [hU0, h_iota_zero, Submodule.coe_zero]
    have h_curve_lp_cont : ∀ (F : ℝ → CinfT),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (s₀ ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| < η →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (F s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (F s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
        Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (ιT (F s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)) := by
      intro F hF
      rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      intro s₀ ε hε
      obtain ⟨η, hη, h_close⟩ := hF 0 s₀ ε hε
      refine ⟨η, hη, fun s hs => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have h_norm_eq : ‖(ιT (F s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) - (ιT (F s₀) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ =
          ‖ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (F s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (F s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_mem (F s) (F s₀)⟩‖ := by
        rw [← Submodule.coe_sub, Submodule.norm_coe, h_iota_sub (F s) (F s₀) (h_sub_mem (F s) (F s₀))]
      rw [h_norm_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt
        (h_iota_le_sem0 ⟨fun x : ℝ => (F s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (F s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_mem (F s) (F s₀)⟩)
        (h_close s hs)
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := h_curve_lp_cont U hU_cont
    have hγ'_cont : Continuous γ' := h_curve_lp_cont D hD_cont
    have hγ_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt γ (γ' s) s := by
      intro s
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨η, hη, h_d⟩ := hU_deriv s 0 (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
      refine ⟨η, hη, fun s' hs' => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs'
      rw [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_norm, abs_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      let diff_U : CinfT :=
        ⟨fun x : ℝ => (U s' : ℝ → ℝ) x - (U s : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_mem (U s') (U s)⟩
      let smul_D : CinfT :=
        ⟨fun x : ℝ => (s' - s) * (D s : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul_mem (s' - s) (D s)⟩
      let rem_U : CinfT :=
        ⟨fun x : ℝ => (diff_U : ℝ → ℝ) x - (smul_D : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_mem diff_U smul_D⟩
      have h_rem_iota : ιT rem_U = ιT (U s') - ιT (U s) - (s' - s) • ιT (D s) := by
        dsimp [rem_U]
        rw [h_iota_sub diff_U smul_D (h_sub_mem diff_U smul_D)]
        dsimp [diff_U, smul_D]
        rw [h_iota_sub (U s') (U s) (h_sub_mem (U s') (U s)),
            h_iota_smul (s' - s) (D s) (h_smul_mem (s' - s) (D s))]
      have h_rem_norm : ‖γ s' - γ s - (s' - s) • γ' s‖ = ‖ιT rem_U‖ := by
        change ‖(ιT (U s') : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) - (ιT (U s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) -
            (s' - s) • (ιT (D s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ = ‖ιT rem_U‖
        rw [← Submodule.coe_sub, ← Submodule.coe_smul, ← Submodule.coe_sub,
            Submodule.norm_coe, h_rem_iota]
      have h_rem_le : ‖ιT rem_U‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * |s' - s| := by
        refine le_trans (h_iota_le_sem0 rem_U) ?_
        refine h_sem_le 0 (rem_U : ℝ → ℝ) ((ε / 2) * |s' - s|) (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
        have hd_x := h_d s' hs' x
        simpa [rem_U, diff_U, smul_D, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hd_x
      rw [h_rem_norm]
      by_cases h_eq : s' = s
      · subst h_eq
        simp [hε]
      · have h_pos : 0 < |s' - s| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq)
        calc |s' - s|⁻¹ * ‖ιT rem_U‖
          _ ≤ |s' - s|⁻¹ * ((ε / 2) * |s' - s|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rem_le (by positivity)
          _ = ε / 2 := by
            have : |s' - s| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pos
            field_simp
          _ < ε := half_lt_self hε
    have h_ftc : ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, γ' τ = γ t - γ 0 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right
        hγ_cont.continuousOn
        (fun x _ => (hγ_deriv x).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (hγ'_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    rw [hγ0, sub_zero] at h_ftc
    have h_norm_γ : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖γ s‖ = ‖ιT (W₁ s) - ιT (W₂ s)‖ := by
      intro s
      change ‖(ιT (U s) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ = ‖ιT (W₁ s) - ιT (W₂ s)‖
      rw [Submodule.norm_coe, h_iota_sub (W₁ s) (W₂ s) (h_sub_mem (W₁ s) (W₂ s))]
    have h_norm_γ' : ∀ τ : ℝ, ‖γ' τ‖ = ‖ιT (G₁ τ) - ιT (G₂ τ)‖ := by
      intro τ
      change ‖(ιT (D τ) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ = ‖ιT (G₁ τ) - ιT (G₂ τ)‖
      rw [Submodule.norm_coe, h_iota_sub (G₁ τ) (G₂ τ) (h_sub_mem (G₁ τ) (G₂ τ))]
    rw [← h_norm_γ t, ← h_ftc]
    have h_int_eq : (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ιT (G₁ τ) - ιT (G₂ τ)‖) =
        ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖γ' τ‖ := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun τ _ => ?_)
      exact (h_norm_γ' τ).symm
    rw [h_int_eq]
    exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_abs_integral_norm

informal_problem.statement:
(h_iota_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT)
       (h_sub : (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩ = ιT q₁ - ιT q₂)
    (h_interp : (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT n f) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n f x| ≤ B) → cinfSeminormT n f ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ (g : CinfT), ‖ιT g‖ ≤ cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ (B : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ (g : CinfT),
            (∀ m : ℕ, cinfSeminormT m (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B m) →
            ‖ιT g‖ < η →
            cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) < ε) ∧
      (∀ (B : ℕ → ℝ) (C₀ L : ℝ), 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ L →
        ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : CinfT),
            (∀ j : ℕ, cinfSeminormT j (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B j) →
            ‖ιT g‖ ≤ C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) →
            cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m))
    (h_int_op : (∀ (w₀ : CinfT) (G : ℝ → CinfT),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (G s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (G t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
        ∃ W : ℝ → CinfT,
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
            ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
              cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (W s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (W t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (W t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
              iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
            cinfSeminormT n (W t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
              cinfSeminormT n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) +
                |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, cinfSeminormT n (G τ : ℝ → ℝ)|)) ∧
      (∀ (w₀ : CinfT) (G₁ G₂ W₁ W₂ : ℝ → CinfT),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (G₁ s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (G₁ t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (G₂ s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (G₂ t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₁ t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
            iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₂ t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
            iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          ‖ιT (W₁ t) - ιT (W₂ t)‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ιT (G₁ τ) - ιT (G₂ τ)‖|))
    (V : CinfT → CinfT) (M₀ L_lip : ℝ) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hL_lip : 0 ≤ L_lip)
    (hV_bdd : ∀ q : CinfT, ‖ιT (V q)‖ ≤ M₀)
    (hV_lip : ∀ q₁ q₂ : CinfT, ‖ιT (V q₁) - ιT (V q₂)‖ ≤ L_lip * ‖ιT q₁ - ιT q₂‖)
    (hV_tier : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℝ),
      ∃ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∀ q : CinfT,
          (∀ m < n, cinfSeminormT m (q : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M m) →
          cinfSeminormT n (V q : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ A * cinfSeminormT n (q : ℝ → ℝ) + B)

    (∀ (u : ℝ → CinfT),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (V (u s) : ℝ → ℝ) x - (V (u t) : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε)) ∧
    (∀ (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → CinfT) (w_tilde : ℝ → CinfT),
      (∀ N : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) →
      (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) →
      ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x)
          Filter.atTop
          (nhds (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x))) ∧
    (∃ w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → CinfT,
      (∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq m s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
          iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq m τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∧
      (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m))

      dsimp [q_sub] at h_add
      rw [← h_eq] at h_add
      have h_diff_le := (hC_spec m).2 N τ hτ
      have h_w_le := hB_w_spec m τ hτ
      dsimp [B_all]
      linarith
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    let ε' : ℝ := ε / (|t| + 1)
    have hε'_pos : 0 < ε' := by positivity
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, h_mod⟩ := hV_mod B_all n ε' hε'_pos
    have h_pow_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h_ev0 : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, C_fn 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < δ := by
      have h_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C_fn 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul h_pow_zero
      exact h_t.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ_pos)
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp h_ev0
    refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN => ?_⟩
    have hN_0 : C_fn 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < δ := hN₀ N hN
    have h_int_seq :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x) volume 0 t :=
      (h_cont_eval (fun τ => V (w_seq N τ)) (hV_cont_curve (w_seq N) (hw_seq_cont N)) n x).intervalIntegrable 0 t
    have h_int_tilde :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x) volume 0 t :=
      (h_cont_eval (fun τ => V (w_tilde τ)) (hV_cont_curve w_tilde hw_tilde_cont) n x).intervalIntegrable 0 t
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int_seq h_int_tilde]
    have h_int_bound : ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t,
        (iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x)‖ ≤
          ε' * |t - 0| := by
      refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun τ hτ => ?_)
      have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ
      have hτ_T : |τ| ≤ T := h_uIcc_abs t τ hτ_uIcc
      have hs0 : cinfSeminormT 0 (fun y => (w_seq N τ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde τ : ℝ → ℝ) y) < δ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt ((hC_spec 0).2 N τ hτ_T) hN_0
      have hV_lt :
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (V (w_seq N τ) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V (w_tilde τ) : ℝ → ℝ) y) < ε' :=
        h_mod (w_seq N τ) (w_tilde τ) (hB_seq N τ hτ_T) (hB_tilde τ hτ_T) hs0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← h_iter_sub (V (w_seq N τ)) (V (w_tilde τ)) n x]
      exact le_trans (h_pt_le (q_sub (V (w_seq N τ)) (V (w_tilde τ))) n x) (le_of_lt hV_lt)
    have h_strict : ε' * |t - 0| < ε := by
      rw [sub_zero]
      have h_alg : ε' * (|t| + 1) = ε := by
        dsimp [ε']
        have : |t| + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
      calc ε' * |t|
        _ < ε' * (|t| + 1) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hε'_pos
        _ = ε := h_alg
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_int_bound h_strict
  · have h_const_cont : ∀ q : CinfT, IsCinfCont (fun _ : ℝ => q) := by
      intro q n t ε hε
      refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, fun s _ => ?_⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_sem_self_sub q n) hε
    let step : { u : ℝ → CinfT // IsCinfCont u } → { u : ℝ → CinfT // IsCinfCont u } :=
      fun p =>
        let hG : IsCinfCont (fun t : ℝ => V (p.1 t)) := hV_cont_curve p.1 p.2
        ⟨(h_int_ex w₀ (fun t => V (p.1 t)) hG).choose,
          (h_int_ex w₀ (fun t => V (p.1 t)) hG).choose_spec.1⟩
    let P : ℕ → { u : ℝ → CinfT // IsCinfCont u } :=
      fun m => Nat.rec ⟨fun _ => w₀, h_const_cont w₀⟩ (fun _ p => step p) m
    let w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → CinfT := fun m => (P m).1
    have hw_seq0 : ∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀ := fun _ => rfl
    have hw_seq_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, IsCinfCont (w_seq m) := fun m => (P m).2
    have hw_seq_int : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
          iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x +
            ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq m τ) : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      fun m => (h_int_ex w₀ (fun t => V (w_seq m t)) (hV_cont_curve (w_seq m) (P m).2)).choose_spec.2.1
    have hw_seq_tier : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
        cinfSeminormT n (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) +
            |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, cinfSeminormT n (V (w_seq m τ) : ℝ → ℝ)| :=
      fun m => (h_int_ex w₀ (fun t => V (w_seq m t)) (hV_cont_curve (w_seq m) (P m).2)).choose_spec.2.2
    have h_iota_zero : ιT q_zero = 0 := by
      rw [← norm_eq_zero]
      exact le_antisymm (le_trans (h_hm1_le q_zero) (h_sem_zero_le 0)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_hm1_exact : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
        ‖ιT (w_seq (m + 1) t) - ιT (w_seq m t)‖ ≤
          M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro t
        have h_w0_int : ∀ (t' : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (w_seq 0 t' : ℝ → ℝ) x =
              iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x +
                ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t', iteratedDeriv n (q_zero : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
          intro t' n x
          rw [hw_seq0 t']
          dsimp [q_zero]
          rw [h_iter_zero n x, intervalIntegral.integral_zero, add_zero]
        have h_diff0 := h_int_diff w₀ (fun τ => V (w_seq 0 τ)) (fun _ => q_zero)
          (w_seq 1) (w_seq 0)
          (hV_cont_curve (w_seq 0) (hw_seq_cont 0)) (h_const_cont q_zero)
          (hw_seq_int 0) h_w0_int t
        have h_mono0 := h_int_mono (fun τ => ‖ιT (V (w_seq 0 τ)) - ιT q_zero‖) M₀ 0 t hM₀ (fun τ _ => by
          refine ⟨norm_nonneg _, ?_⟩
          dsimp only []
          rw [h_iota_zero, sub_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one]
          exact hV_bdd (w_seq 0 τ))
        calc ‖ιT (w_seq (0 + 1) t) - ιT (w_seq 0 t)‖
          _ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ιT (V (w_seq 0 τ)) - ιT q_zero‖| := h_diff0
          _ ≤ M₀ * |t| ^ (0 + 1) / (Nat.factorial (0 + 1) : ℝ) := h_mono0
          _ = M₀ * L_lip ^ 0 * |t| ^ (0 + 1) / (Nat.factorial (0 + 1) : ℝ) := by ring
      | succ m ih =>
        intro t
        have h_diff_succ := h_int_diff w₀ (fun τ => V (w_seq (m + 1) τ)) (fun τ => V (w_seq m τ))
          (w_seq (m + 2)) (w_seq (m + 1))
          (hV_cont_curve (w_seq (m + 1)) (hw_seq_cont (m + 1)))
          (hV_cont_curve (w_seq m) (hw_seq_cont m))
          (hw_seq_int (m + 1)) (hw_seq_int m) t
        have h_mono_succ := h_int_mono
          (fun τ => ‖ιT (V (w_seq (m + 1) τ)) - ιT (V (w_seq m τ))‖)
          (M₀ * L_lip ^ (m + 1)) (m + 1) t (by positivity) (fun τ _ => by
          refine ⟨norm_nonneg _, ?_⟩
          calc ‖ιT (V (w_seq (m + 1) τ)) - ιT (V (w_seq m τ))‖
            _ ≤ L_lip * ‖ιT (w_seq (m + 1) τ) - ιT (w_seq m τ)‖ := hV_lip _ _
            _ ≤ L_lip * (M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |τ| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih τ) hL_lip
            _ = M₀ * L_lip ^ (m + 1) * |τ| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := by ring)
        exact le_trans h_diff_succ h_mono_succ
    refine ⟨w_seq, hw_seq0, hw_seq_cont, hw_seq_int, ?_⟩
    intro T hT n
    have h_hm1_shift : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
        ‖ιT (q_sub (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t))‖ ≤
          (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := by
      intro m t ht
      have h_pow : |t| ^ (m + 1) ≤ T ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg t) ht (m + 1)
      have h_num : M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1) ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m := by
        calc M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1)
          _ ≤ M₀ * L_lip ^ m * T ^ (m + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow (by positivity)
          _ = (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m := by ring
      have h_fact_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
      have h_fact_le : (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.factorial_le (Nat.le_succ m))
      calc ‖ιT (q_sub (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t))‖
        _ = ‖ιT (w_seq (m + 1) t) - ιT (w_seq m t)‖ := by
          rw [h_iota_sub (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t) (h_sub_mem (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t))]
        _ ≤ M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := h_hm1_exact m t
        _ ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h_fact_pos h_fact_le
    have h_tier_bdd : ∀ j : ℕ,
        ∃ M_j : ℝ, ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T → cinfSeminormT j (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M_j := by
      intro j
      induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h j ih =>
        let M_prev : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if h : i < j then (ih i h).choose else 0
        have hM_prev : ∀ i < j, ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT i (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M_prev i := by
          intro i hi m t ht
          dsimp [M_prev]
          rw [dif_pos hi]
          exact (ih i hi).choose_spec m t ht
        obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hAB⟩ := hV_tier j M_prev
        let C₀ : ℝ := cinfSeminormT j (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + B * T
        have hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀ := add_nonneg (h_sem_nonneg j _) (mul_nonneg hB hT)
        have h_gron_m : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT j (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := by
          intro m
          induction m with
          | zero =>
            intro t _
            rw [hw_seq0 t]
            have h1 : cinfSeminormT j (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ C₀ := by
              dsimp [C₀]
              linarith [mul_nonneg hB hT]
            have h2 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (A * |t|) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
            calc cinfSeminormT j (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ)
              _ ≤ C₀ * 1 := by linarith
              _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀
          | succ m ih_m =>
            intro t ht
            have h_gron_step := h_int_gron (fun τ => cinfSeminormT j (V (w_seq m τ) : ℝ → ℝ))
              A B C₀ t hA hB hC₀ (fun τ hτ => by
                have hτ_le_t : |τ| ≤ |t| := h_uIcc_abs t τ hτ
                have hτ_le_T : |τ| ≤ T := le_trans hτ_le_t ht
                refine ⟨h_sem_nonneg j _, ?_⟩
                calc cinfSeminormT j (V (w_seq m τ) : ℝ → ℝ)
                  _ ≤ A * cinfSeminormT j (w_seq m τ : ℝ → ℝ) + B :=
                    hAB (w_seq m τ) (fun i hi => hM_prev i hi m τ hτ_le_T)
                  _ ≤ A * (C₀ * Real.exp (A * |τ|)) + B := by
                    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih_m τ hτ_le_T) hA])
            have h_step := hw_seq_tier m j t
            have h_Bt : B * |t| ≤ B * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hB
            have h_alg : cinfSeminormT j (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + (C₀ * (Real.exp (A * |t|) - 1) + B * |t|) ≤
                C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := by
              dsimp [C₀]
              linarith
            linarith
        refine ⟨C₀ * Real.exp (A * T), fun m t ht => ?_⟩
        calc cinfSeminormT j (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ)
          _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := h_gron_m m t ht
          _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * T) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hA)) hC₀
    let B_T : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => 2 * (h_tier_bdd j).choose
    have hB_T : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T → ∀ (j : ℕ),
        cinfSeminormT j (q_sub (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t) : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B_T j := by
      intro m t ht j
      have h_m1 : cinfSeminormT j (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ (h_tier_bdd j).choose :=
        (h_tier_bdd j).choose_spec (m + 1) t ht
      have h_m0 : cinfSeminormT j (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ (h_tier_bdd j).choose :=
        (h_tier_bdd j).choose_spec m t ht
      have h_tri := h_sem_sub j (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t)
      dsimp [B_T, q_sub]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨C, hC_nonneg, hC_geom⟩ :=
      h_fact_geom B_T (M₀ * T) (L_lip * T) (by positivity) (by positivity) n
    exact ⟨C, hC_nonneg, fun m t ht =>
      hC_geom m (q_sub (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t)) (hB_T m t ht) (h_hm1_shift m t ht)⟩

(h_sem_basic : (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT n f) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n f x| ≤ B) → cinfSeminormT n f ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ)))
    (w₀ : CinfT) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → CinfT)
    (hw_seq0 : ∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀)
    (hw_seq_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
        cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq m s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε)
    (hw_geom : ∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (n : ℕ),
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :
    ∃ w_tilde : ℝ → CinfT,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε) ∧
      (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x)))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_sem_nonneg, h_sem_le, h_pt_le⟩ := h_sem_basic
  let subCinfT : CinfT → CinfT → CinfT := fun q₁ q₂ =>
    ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x,
      ⟨q₁.2.1.sub q₂.2.1, fun x => by dsimp; rw [q₁.2.2 x, q₂.2.2 x]⟩⟩
  let addCinfT : CinfT → CinfT → CinfT := fun q₁ q₂ =>
    ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x,
      ⟨q₁.2.1.add q₂.2.1, fun x => by dsimp; rw [q₁.2.2 x, q₂.2.2 x]⟩⟩
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun q₁ q₂ n x => iteratedDeriv_sub (q₁.2.1.contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top))
      (q₂.2.1.contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top))
  have h_iter_add : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    fun q₁ q₂ n x => iteratedDeriv_add (q₁.2.1.contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top))
      (q₂.2.1.contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top))
  have h_s1 : ∀ (d : ℕ → CinfT),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), Summable (fun m : ℕ => cinfSeminormT n (d m : ℝ → ℝ))) →
      ∃ D : CinfT,
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (d m : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) ∧
          iteratedDeriv n (D : ℝ → ℝ) x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (d m : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro d h_sum
    let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m x => (d m : ℝ → ℝ) x
    have hf_smooth : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (f m) :=
      fun m => (d m).2.1
    let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun n m => cinfSeminormT n (d m : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) → Summable (v n) :=
      fun n _ => h_sum n
    have hv_bound : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ ≤ v n m := by
      intro n m x _
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h_pt_le (d m) n x
    let D_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑' m : ℕ, f m x
    have h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) D_fun :=
      contDiff_tsum hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound
    have h_per : Function.Periodic D_fun 1 :=
      fun x => tsum_congr (fun m => (d m).2.2 x)
    let D : CinfT := ⟨D_fun, ⟨h_smooth, h_per⟩⟩
    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
    intro n x
    have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (d m : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_) (hv_sum n le_top)
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      exact hv_bound n m x le_top
    have h_fderiv_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) (fun m => hv_bound n m x le_top)
    refine ⟨h_norm_sum, ?_⟩
    change iteratedDeriv n D_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (f m) x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have h_fd := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n D_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x at h_fd
    rw [h_fd, ContinuousMultilinearMap.tsum_eval h_fderiv_sum (fun _ => 1)]
    simp_rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
  have h_s2 : ∀ (w_infty : CinfT) (u : ℕ → CinfT),
      u 0 = w₀ →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x‖) ∧
        iteratedDeriv n (w_infty : ℝ → ℝ) x =
          iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x +
            ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (u N : ℝ → ℝ) x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n (w_infty : ℝ → ℝ) x))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C →
        (∀ m : ℕ, cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) →
        ∀ N : ℕ, cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (u N : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_infty : ℝ → ℝ) y) ≤ (2 * C) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) := by
    intro w_infty u hu0 h_tsum
    have h_tele : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x) =
          iteratedDeriv n (u N : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
      intro n x N
      have h_congr :
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x) =
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (u m : ℝ → ℝ) x)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => h_iter_sub (u (m + 1)) (u m) n x)
      rw [h_congr, Finset.sum_range_sub (fun m => iteratedDeriv n (u m : ℝ → ℝ) x) N, hu0]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n x
      let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x
      have hδ_sum : Summable δ := (h_tsum n x).1.of_norm
      have h_tendsto_sum :
          Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' m : ℕ, δ m)) :=
        hδ_sum.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
      have h_add : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∑' m : ℕ, δ m)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.add h_tendsto_sum
      rw [← (h_tsum n x).2] at h_add
      refine h_add.congr (fun N => ?_)
      have ht := h_tele n x N
      dsimp [δ]
      linarith
    · intro n C hC h_step N
      refine h_sem_le n (fun y => (u N : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_infty : ℝ → ℝ) y) ((2 * C) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N)
        (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
      let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x
      have hδ_sum : Summable δ := (h_tsum n x).1.of_norm
      have h_split : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) + (∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) = ∑' m : ℕ, δ m :=
        Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add N hδ_sum
      have h_diff_eq : iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u N : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_infty : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
          -(∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) := by
        rw [h_iter_sub (u N) w_infty n x, (h_tsum n x).2]
        have ht := h_tele n x N
        change (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) = iteratedDeriv n (u N : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x at ht
        change (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) + (∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) =
          ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u (m + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u m : ℝ → ℝ) y) x at h_split
        linarith
      rw [h_diff_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_neg]
      have h_tail_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖δ (m + N)‖) :=
        (summable_nat_add_iff N).mpr (h_tsum n x).1
      have h_tsum_norm : ‖∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)‖ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖δ (m + N)‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_tail_norm
      have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
        summable_geometric_two.mul_left (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N)
      have h_term_le : ∀ m : ℕ,
          ‖δ (m + N)‖ ≤ (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        intro m
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |δ (m + N)|
          _ ≤ cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (u (m + N + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u (m + N) : ℝ → ℝ) y) :=
            h_pt_le (subCinfT (u (m + N + 1)) (u (m + N))) n x
          _ ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m + N) := h_step (m + N)
          _ = (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
            rw [pow_add]
            ring
      calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)‖
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖δ (m + N)‖ := h_tsum_norm
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_term_le h_tail_norm h_geom_sum
        _ = (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
        _ = (2 * C) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N := by
          rw [tsum_geometric_two]
          ring
  let d : ℝ → ℕ → CinfT := fun t m => subCinfT (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t)
  have h_d_sum : ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      Summable (fun m : ℕ => cinfSeminormT n (d t m : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    intro t n
    obtain ⟨C, _hC, h_step⟩ := hw_geom |t| (abs_nonneg t) n
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => h_sem_nonneg n _)
      (fun m => h_step m t le_rfl)
      (summable_geometric_two.mul_left C)
  let D : ℝ → CinfT := fun t => Classical.choose (h_s1 (d t) (h_d_sum t))
  let w_tilde : ℝ → CinfT := fun t => addCinfT w₀ (D t)
  have hw_tilde_tsum : ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x‖) ∧
      iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq (m + 1) t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq m t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x := by
    intro t n x
    have hD_spec := Classical.choose_spec (h_s1 (d t) (h_d_sum t)) n x
    refine ⟨hD_spec.1, ?_⟩
    have h_add : iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (w₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x + iteratedDeriv n (D t : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      h_iter_add w₀ (D t) n x
    rw [h_add, hD_spec.2]
  have hw_unif : ∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (n : ℕ),
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
          cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N := by
    intro T hT n
    obtain ⟨C, hC, h_step⟩ := hw_geom T hT n
    refine ⟨2 * C, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro N t ht
    exact (h_s2 (w_tilde t) (fun m => w_seq m t) (hw_seq0 t) (hw_tilde_tsum t)).2
      n C hC (fun m => h_step m t ht) N
  have hw_pt : ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x)) :=
    fun t n x => (h_s2 (w_tilde t) (fun m => w_seq m t) (hw_seq0 t) (hw_tilde_tsum t)).1 n x
  have hw_cont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η →
        cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε := by
    intro n t ε hε
    set T : ℝ := |t| + 1
    have hT : 0 ≤ T := by positivity
    obtain ⟨C, _hC_nonneg, hC_bound⟩ := hw_unif T hT n
    have h_pow_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [mul_zero] using
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul C
          (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1))
    have h_ev_lt : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < ε / 4 :=
      h_pow_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨N, hN_lt⟩ := h_ev_lt.exists
    obtain ⟨η_N, hη_N, h_cont_N⟩ := hw_seq_cont N n t (ε / 4) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨min η_N 1, lt_min hη_N one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    have hs_η : |s - t| < η_N := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_left _ _)
    have hs_1 : |s - t| < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_right _ _)
    have hs_T : |s| ≤ T := by
      have h_tri : |s| ≤ |s - t| + |t| := by
        simpa using abs_add_le (s - t) t
      dsimp [T]
      linarith
    have ht_T : |t| ≤ T := by
      dsimp [T]
      linarith
    have h1 : cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε / 4 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (hC_bound N s hs_T) hN_lt
    have h2 : cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε / 4 :=
      h_cont_N s hs_η
    have h3 : cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) < ε / 4 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (hC_bound N t ht_T) hN_lt
    have h_le : cinfSeminormT n (fun x => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ≤ 3 * ε / 4 := by
      refine h_sem_le n (fun x => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) x) (3 * ε / 4) (by linarith) (fun x => ?_)
      have h_id_eq : iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
          -iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y) x +
          iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x +
          iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x := by
        rw [h_iter_sub (w_tilde s) (w_tilde t) n x,
          h_iter_sub (w_seq N s) (w_tilde s) n x,
          h_iter_sub (w_seq N s) (w_seq N t) n x,
          h_iter_sub (w_seq N t) (w_tilde t) n x]
        ring
      have h_pt1 : |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y) x| ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y) :=
        h_pt_le (subCinfT (w_seq N s) (w_tilde s)) n x
      have h_pt2 : |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x| ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y) :=
        h_pt_le (subCinfT (w_seq N s) (w_seq N t)) n x
      have h_pt3 : |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x| ≤
          cinfSeminormT n (fun y => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) y) :=
        h_pt_le (subCinfT (w_seq N t) (w_tilde t)) n x
      have h_tri1 := abs_add_le
        (-iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y) x +
          iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x)
        (iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x)
      have h_tri2 := abs_add_le
        (-iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_tilde s : ℝ → ℝ) y) x)
        (iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (w_seq N s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w_seq N t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x)
      rw [abs_neg] at h_tri2
      rw [h_id_eq]
      linarith
    linarith
  exact ⟨w_tilde, hw_cont, hw_unif, hw_pt⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(h_sem_bound : ∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ))
    (w_tilde : ℝ → CinfT) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ w : ℝ → CinfT,
      (∀ (t x : ℝ), (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x = (w_tilde t : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * t)) ∧
      (∀ (s M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w s)) = hm1KappaSqT M (ιT (w_tilde s))) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℝ) (v_tilde : CinfT),
        HasCinfDerivAtT w_tilde v_tilde s →
        ∃ v : CinfT,
          HasCinfDerivAtT w v s ∧
          ∀ x : ℝ, (v : ℝ → ℝ) x = (v_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * s) + c * deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_trans_mem : ∀ (q : CinfT) (a : ℝ), (fun x : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) (x + a)) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro q a
    refine ⟨q.2.1.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const), fun x => ?_⟩
    change (q : ℝ → ℝ) (x + 1 + a) = (q : ℝ → ℝ) (x + a)
    rw [add_right_comm x 1 a]
    exact q.2.2 (x + a)
  have h_deriv_mem : ∀ (q : CinfT), deriv (q : ℝ → ℝ) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro q
    refine ⟨q.2.1.deriv', fun x => ?_⟩
    have h_per : (fun y : ℝ => (q : ℝ → ℝ) (y + 1)) = (q : ℝ → ℝ) := funext q.2.2
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const (q : ℝ → ℝ) 1 x, h_per]
  have h_add_mem : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT), (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT :=

          _ ≤ (M₂ * c ^ 2 + 1) * |t - s| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (abs_nonneg (t - s))
          _ ≤ (M₂ * c ^ 2 + 1) * η₃ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt ht₃) (le_of_lt h_den₂_pos)
          _ = ε / 3 := by
            dsimp [η₃]
            have : M₂ * c ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_den₂_pos
            field_simp
      exact le_trans h_step1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_step2 (abs_nonneg (t - s)))
    rw [h_3term_id]
    have h_tri1 := abs_add_le (R₁ + R₂) R₃
    have h_tri2 := abs_add_le R₁ R₂
    linarith

by
  have hJ_cont : Continuous J := hJ_smooth.continuous
  have hJ_diff : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ_smooth.differentiable (by decide)
  have hdJ_cont : Continuous (deriv J) := hJ_smooth.continuous_deriv (by decide)
  have hJ_per01 : J 1 = J 0 := by simpa using hJ_per 0
  have h_alg0 : ∀ (a b : ℂ), b * a = a * b := fun a b => mul_comm b a
  have h_alg1 : ∀ (a b c d : ℂ), (a * b) * c + b * d = a * (b * c) + b * d :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => by ring
  have h_alg2 : ∀ (z I1 I2 : ℂ), -z * I1 + I2 = 0 → I2 = z * I1 :=
    fun _ _ _ h => by linear_combination h
  have h_fc_deriv : ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCircle (deriv J) n = (((2 * π * (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) * fourierCircle J n := by
    intro n
    set ξ : ℝ := 2 * π * (n : ℝ)
    let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (J x : ℂ)
    let f1 : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      -((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (J x : ℂ))
    let f2 : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((deriv J x : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hΦ_d : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt Φ (f1 x + f2 x) x := by
      intro x _
      dsimp [Φ, f1, f2]
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)) 1 x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).ofReal_comp
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) (-((ξ : ℂ) * I)) x := by
        have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => -((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) = (fun y : ℝ => -((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (y : ℂ)) := by
          ext y; ring
        rw [h_eq]
        simpa using h1.const_mul (-((ξ : ℂ) * I))
      have h_exp_d : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I))
          (-((ξ : ℂ) * I) * Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) x :=
        h2.cexp.congr_deriv (h_alg0 _ _)

        (hJ_diff.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).ofReal_comp
      exact (h_exp_d.mul hJ_d).congr_deriv (h_alg1 _ _ _ _)
    have hf1_int : IntervalIntegrable f1 volume 0 1 := by
      have h_cont : Continuous f1 := by dsimp [f1]; fun_prop
      exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hf2_int : IntervalIntegrable f2 volume 0 1 := by
      have h_cont : Continuous f2 := by dsimp [f2]; fun_prop
      exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hΦ_d (hf1_int.add hf2_int)
    have hΦ_bdry : Φ 1 - Φ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [Φ, ξ]
      have h_exp1 : -(((2 * π * (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 : ℂ)) * I =
          ((-n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (π : ℂ) * I) := by
        push_cast; ring

      dsimp [f1, fourierCircle, ξ]

    rw [hf1_eq, hf2_eq] at h_ftc
    exact h_alg2 (((ξ : ℂ) * I)) (fourierCircle J n) (fourierCircle (deriv J) n) h_ftc
  have h_pw : ∀ n : ℤ,
      ‖fourierCircle (deriv J) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
        ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    set ξ : ℝ := 2 * π * (n : ℝ)
    have h_norm_sq : ‖fourierCircle (deriv J) n‖ ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 * ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_fc_deriv n, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    change ‖fourierCircle (deriv J) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
      ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
    rw [h_norm_sq]
    have h_num : ξ ^ 2 * ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sq_nonneg _)
      linarith
    calc (ξ ^ 2 * ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2
      _ ≤ ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
      _ = ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
        have h_ne : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
  have h_sum_weight : Summable (fun n : ℤ => 1 / (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)) := by
    let g : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + if n = 0 then (1 / 4 : ℝ) else 0
    have hg_sum : Summable g :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).add
        (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℤ) (1 / 4 : ℝ)).summable
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hg_sum
    dsimp [g]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn; norm_num
    · rw [if_neg hn, add_zero]
      have hn_abs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(n : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hn
      have hn_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hn_abs, sq_abs (n : ℝ)]
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hpi : (2 : ℝ) ≤ π := Real.two_le_pi
      have h_pi_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_denom : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := (one_mul _).symm
          _ ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ ≤ 4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            linarith [show (2 * π) ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 by ring]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hn_pos h_denom
  have h_hm1_sum : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by
    let C : ℝ := ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖J x‖
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_)
      (h_sum_weight.mul_left (C ^ 2))
    have h_fc_bound : ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ≤ C := by
      dsimp [fourierCircle, C]
      refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        ?h_bound (hJ_cont.norm.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      filter_upwards with x _
      have h_exp : -(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(2 * π * n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
      exact le_rfl
    have h_sq : ‖fourierCircle J n‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fc_bound 2
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)
    have h_ring : C ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) = C ^ 2 * (1 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2)) := by ring
    linarith only [h_div, h_ring]
  have h_hm2_sum :
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle (deriv J) n‖ ^ 2 / (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) h_pw h_hm1_sum
  exact h_hm2_sum.tsum_le_tsum h_pw h_hm1_sum

  let F : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => W k * ‖fourierCircle u k‖ ^ 2
  let G : ℤ → ℝ := fun m => ‖fourierCircle v m‖ ^ 2 / W m

  have hG_nn : ∀ m : ℤ, 0 ≤ G m := fun m => by dsimp [G]; have := hW_nn m; positivity
  set U : ℝ := h1NormSqT u
  set V : ℝ := hm1NormSqT v
  have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := tsum_nonneg hF_nn
  have hV_nn : 0 ≤ V := tsum_nonneg hG_nn
  let Φ : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ := fun n k => h0 k * G (n - k)
  have hΦ_nn : ∀ n k : ℤ, 0 ≤ Φ n k := fun n k => mul_nonneg (hh0_nn k) (hG_nn (n - k))
  have hΦ_sum_k : ∀ n : ℤ, Summable (fun k : ℤ => Φ n k) := by
    intro n
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => hΦ_nn n k) (fun k => ?_) (hh0_sum.mul_right V)
    have h_le : G (n - k) ≤ V := hv_hm1.le_tsum (n - k) (fun m _ => hG_nn m)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le (hh0_nn k)
  have hG_shift_sum : ∀ n : ℤ, Summable (fun k : ℤ => G (n - k)) := by
    intro n
    exact (Equiv.summable_iff (Equiv.subLeft n)).mpr hv_hm1
  have hG_shift_tsum : ∀ n : ℤ, (∑' k : ℤ, G (n - k)) = V := by

  let M_seq : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => U * (2 * (∑' k : ℤ, Φ n k) + 2 * h0 n * V)
  have h_mode_le : ∀ n : ℤ,
      ‖fourierCircle (fun x => u x * v x) n‖ ^ 2 / W n ≤ M_seq n := by
    intro n
    let X : ℤ → ℝ := fun k => ‖fourierCircle u k‖ * ‖fourierCircle v (n - k)‖

      set W₂ : ℝ := W (n - k)

      _ = ((1 - cκ / (κ * (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * fourierCircle (w : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
          rw [Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_div cκ (κ * (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))]

    have h_dk : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity

      linarith only [h_diff, h_nn]
    have hb_nn : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
    have hb_le : b ≤ 2 * κ₀ ^ 2 / κ := by
      dsimp [b]

    have h_wt_k0 : 1 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ κ₀ ^ 2 / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by

        ring

      linarith only [h_diff, h_nn]
    have h_b_bound : 2 * b ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ (8 * κ₀ ^ 6 / κ ^ 2) / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by

      _ ≤ (2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) + (8 * κ₀ ^ 6 / κ ^ 2) / (4 * κ₀ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) *

    congr 1 with x

    congr 1

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) h_sum_w0

    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hT₃_l1_le : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₃ x|) ≤ 3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ := by
    calc ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₃ x|
      _ ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
          (hT₃_cont.abs.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 1) hT₃_pt
      _ = 3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ := by simp
  have h_conj4 : hm1NormSqT T₃ ≤ 9 * κ₀ ^ 8 / κ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := h_l1_to_hm1 T₃ hT₃_cont
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₃ x|) ^ 2 ≤ (3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hT₃_l1_nn hT₃_l1_le 2
    have h3 : (1 / 2) * (3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * κ₀ ^ 8 / κ ^ 2 := by
      have h_diff : 9 * κ₀ ^ 8 / κ ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * (3 * κ₀ ^ 4 / κ) ^ 2 =
          (9 / 2) * κ₀ ^ 8 / κ ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ (9 / 2) * κ₀ ^ 8 / κ ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨h_cont_per, h_pt, _, h_dom_m⟩ := h_dom κ hκ_ge1 w
  have h_h2_int := h_two κ hκ_ge1 w
  set r := 13 * Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))
  have hr_nn : 0 ≤ r := by positivity
  have hr_le : r ≤ 1 / 256 := by
    have h_ratio : (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ (1 / (256 * 13) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_k (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / κ)
      have h2 : (1 / κ) * ((1 / (256 * 13) : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ) = (1 / (256 * 13) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
      linarith
    have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ≤ 1 / (256 * 13) := by
      calc Real.sqrt ((1 / κ) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 / (256 * 13) : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_ratio
        _ = 1 / (256 * 13) := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have h_geom : Summable (fun m : ℕ => r ^ m) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nn (by linarith)
  have h_geom_le : (∑' m : ℕ, r ^ m) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nn (by linarith)]
    rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have h_h2_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x := by
    intro x
    have h0 := h_dom_m 0 x
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at h0
    exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h0
  have hg_cont : Continuous (diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [diagGreen, greenKernel]
    refine continuous_tsum (fun ℓ => (h_cont_per ℓ).1) (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))) ?_
    intro ℓ x
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt ℓ x
  have h_peel1 : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ) =
      ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 1) x x := by
    intro x
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x
    have hf0 : f 0 = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      dsimp [f, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have h_sum0 : Summable f :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ)))
        (fun ℓ => by simpa [f, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt ℓ x)
    have h_eq0 : diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x = f 0 + ∑' m, f (m + 1) := h_sum0.tsum_eq_zero_add
    linarith
  have h_peel2 : ∀ x : ℝ,
      diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 1 x x =
        ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x := by
    intro x
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) ℓ x x
    have h_sum0 : Summable f :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ)))
        (fun ℓ => by simpa [f, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt ℓ x)
    have h_sum1 : Summable (fun m => f (m + 1)) := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h_sum0
    have h_eq1 : (∑' m, f (m + 1)) = f 1 + ∑' m, f (m + 2) := h_sum1.tsum_eq_zero_add
    linarith [h_peel1 x]
  have h_r2_h2 : ∀ x : ℝ,
      |diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 1 x x| ≤
        2 * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x := by
    intro x
    rw [h_peel2 x]
    have h2_x := h_h2_nn x
    have h_dom_s : Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x * r ^ m) :=
      h_geom.mul_left (greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x)
    have h_le : ∀ m : ℕ,
        ‖greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x‖ ≤
          greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x * r ^ m := by
      intro m
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm (greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x) (r ^ m)]
      exact h_dom_m m x
    have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_le h_dom_s
    calc |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x|
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (m + 2) x x‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x * r ^ m) :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_le h_sum_norm h_dom_s
      _ = greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x * ∑' m : ℕ, r ^ m := tsum_mul_left
      _ ≤ greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_geom_le h2_x
      _ = 2 * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x := by ring
  set R₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
    diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 1 x x
  have hR₂_cont : Continuous R₂ := (hg_cont.sub continuous_const).sub (h_cont_per 1).1
  have hR₂_l1_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |R₂ x| :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hR₂_l1 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |R₂ x|) ≤ (2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
    calc ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |R₂ x|
      _ ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
          (hR₂_cont.abs.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
          ((continuous_const.mul (h_cont_per 2).1).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
          h_r2_h2
      _ = 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, greenIterKernel κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) 2 x x :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul 2 _
      _ ≤ 2 * ((1 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_h2_int (by positivity)
      _ = (2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by ring
  set c_κ : ℝ := 4 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - κ₀ ^ 2)
  set T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_κ * R₂ x
  have hc_κ_nn : 0 ≤ c_κ := by dsimp [c_κ]; positivity
  have hc_κ_le : c_κ ≤ (16 / 3) * κ ^ 3 := by
    dsimp [c_κ]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hκ_sq_sub_pos]
    have h_alg : (16 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * (κ ^ 2 - κ₀ ^ 2) - 4 * κ ^ 5 =
        (4 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * ((κ - 2 * κ₀) * (κ + 2 * κ₀)) := by ring
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ (4 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * ((κ - 2 * κ₀) * (κ + 2 * κ₀)) := by
      have : 0 ≤ κ - 2 * κ₀ := by linarith
      positivity
    linarith
  have hT₂_cont : Continuous T₂ := continuous_const.mul hR₂_cont
  have hT₂_abs_eq : (fun x : ℝ => |T₂ x|) = (fun x : ℝ => c_κ * |R₂ x|) := by
    ext x
    dsimp [T₂]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc_κ_nn]
  have hT₂_l1_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₂ x| :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (fun x _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hT₂_l1_le : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₂ x|) ≤ (32 / 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
    rw [hT₂_abs_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    calc c_κ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |R₂ x|)
      _ ≤ ((16 / 3) * κ ^ 3) * ((2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) :=
        mul_le_mul hc_κ_le hR₂_l1 hR₂_l1_nn (by positivity)
      _ = (32 / 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
        field_simp
        ring
  have h_conj3 : hm1NormSqT T₂ ≤ 64 * κ₀ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
    have h1 := h_l1_to_hm1 T₂ hT₂_cont
    have h2 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, |T₂ x|) ^ 2 ≤ ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hT₂_l1_nn hT₂_l1_le 2
    have h_quad : (1 / 2) * ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ^ 2 ≤
        64 * κ₀ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by
      have h_diff : 64 * κ₀ * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) - (1 / 2) * ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w)) ^ 2 =
          hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) * ((64 / 9) * κ₀ + (512 / 9) * (κ₀ - hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))) := by ring
      have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ κ₀ - hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) := by linarith [h_hm1_k_le_k0]
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) *
          ((64 / 9) * κ₀ + (512 / 9) * (κ₀ - hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w))) := by positivity
      linarith
    linarith
  exact ⟨h_conj1, h_conj2, h_conj3, h_conj4⟩
