proof.tactics:
by
  haveI : Fact (1 ≤ (2 : ENNReal)) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ENNReal).toReal := by norm_num
  have h_rpow : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ (2 : ENNReal).toReal = x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
  have h_summable_lp : ∀ u : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2, Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖u n‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro u
    have hu := (memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos).mp u.2
    simp_rw [h_rpow] at hu
    exact hu
  have h_fc_eq : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one (fun x : ℝ => (g x : ℂ)) n = fourierCircle g n := by
    intro g n
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral (fun x : ℝ => (g x : ℂ)) n zero_lt_one]
    have h_sub : (1 : ℝ) / (1 - 0) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_sub, one_smul, fourierCircle]
    congr 1 with x
    rw [fourier_coe_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_parseval : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖fourierCircle g n‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (∑' n : ℤ, ‖fourierCircle g n‖ ^ 2) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g x) ^ 2 := by
    intro g hg
    let g_C : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (g x : ℂ)
    have hg_C : Continuous g_C := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hg
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable g_C (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      hg_C.aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_int_sq : Integrable (fun x => ‖g_C x‖ ^ 2) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le zero_le_one).mp
        ((hg_C.norm.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    have h_memLp : MemLp g_C 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas).mpr h_int_sq
    have hs := (hasSum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp).summable
    have h_tsum := tsum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one h_memLp
    simp only [g_C, h_fc_eq g] at hs h_tsum
    refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
    rw [h_tsum]
    have h_inv : ((1 : ℝ) - 0)⁻¹ = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_inv, one_smul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h_prof_sq : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      ‖hm1ProfileT f n‖ ^ 2 =
        (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierCircle f n‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f n
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ =
        (Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT]
    rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have h_mem : ∀ q : CinfT, Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [memℓp_gen_iff hp_pos]
    simp_rw [h_rpow]
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
      (h_parseval (q : ℝ → ℝ) q.2.1.continuous).1
    rw [h_prof_sq (q : ℝ → ℝ) n]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + (2 * π * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * π * (n : ℝ))])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) h_inv_le
  have h_toHm1T_apply : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      (toHm1T q : ℤ → ℂ) n = hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) n := by
    intro q n
    dsimp [toHm1T]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_int_fourier : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℤ),
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ))
        volume 0 1 := by
    intro q n
    have hq_cont : Continuous (q : ℝ → ℝ) := q.2.1.continuous
    have h_cont : Continuous
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q : ℝ → ℝ) x : ℂ)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have h_iota_add : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT)
      (h_add : (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_add⟩ = ιT q₁ + ιT q₂ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ h_add
    let q_add : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x + (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_add⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (toHm1T q_add : ℤ → ℂ) n = ((toHm1T q₁ + toHm1T q₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_add, Pi.add_apply, h_toHm1T_apply q_add n, h_toHm1T_apply q₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply q₂ n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, q_add]
    rw [← mul_add, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (h_int_fourier q₁ n) (h_int_fourier q₂ n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_iota_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT)
      (h_sub : (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩ = ιT q₁ - ιT q₂ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ h_sub
    let q_sub : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (toHm1T q_sub : ℤ → ℂ) n = ((toHm1T q₁ - toHm1T q₂ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_sub, Pi.sub_apply, h_toHm1T_apply q_sub n, h_toHm1T_apply q₁ n, h_toHm1T_apply q₂ n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, q_sub]
    rw [← mul_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_int_fourier q₁ n) (h_int_fourier q₂ n)]
    congr 1
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_iota_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT)
      (h_smul : (fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT),
      ιT ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul⟩ = c • ιT q := by
    intro c q h_smul
    let q_smul : CinfT := ⟨fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply lp.ext
    ext n
    change (toHm1T q_smul : ℤ → ℂ) n = ((c • toHm1T q : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) : ℤ → ℂ) n
    rw [lp.coeFn_smul, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, h_toHm1T_apply q_smul n, h_toHm1T_apply q n]
    dsimp [hm1ProfileT, fourierCircle, q_smul]
    have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ =>

    have h_tsum_le :
        (∑' n : ℤ, ‖((ιT g : Hm1T) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) n‖ ^ 2) ≤ B ^ 2 := by

  have h_iota_deriv : ∀ (w : ℝ → CinfT) (v : CinfT) (t : ℝ),

        -iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          6 * deriv (fun z => (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) x) →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < η → ∀ x : ℝ,
          |(K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K' : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ ε * |s - t| := by
    intro t v K' hw hK' ε hε
    let d_wt : CinfT := ⟨deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ), h_deriv_cinfT _ (w t).2⟩
    let d_v : CinfT := ⟨deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ), h_deriv_cinfT _ v.2⟩
    obtain ⟨B₁, _, hB₁⟩ := h_cinfT_bound (w t)
    obtain ⟨B₂, _, hB₂⟩ := h_cinfT_bound d_wt
    obtain ⟨B₃, _, hB₃⟩ := h_cinfT_bound v
    obtain ⟨B₄, _, hB₄⟩ := h_cinfT_bound d_v
    let B₀ : ℝ := max 1 (max B₁ (max B₂ (max B₃ B₄)))
    have hB₀_ge_1 : 1 ≤ B₀ := le_max_left _ _
    have hB₀_nn : 0 ≤ B₀ := by linarith
    have hB₀_ge_B₁ : B₁ ≤ B₀ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hB₀_ge_B₂ : B₂ ≤ B₀ :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    have hB₀_ge_B₃ : B₃ ≤ B₀ :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
    have hB₀_ge_B₄ : B₄ ≤ B₀ :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
    have h_wt_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |(w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ :=
      fun x => le_trans (hB₁ x) hB₀_ge_B₁
    have h_dwt_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ :=
      fun x => le_trans (hB₂ x) hB₀_ge_B₂
    have h_v_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |(v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ :=
      fun x => le_trans (hB₃ x) hB₀_ge_B₃
    have h_dv_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ :=
      fun x => le_trans (hB₄ x) hB₀_ge_B₄
    have hB₀_le_sq : B₀ ≤ B₀ ^ 2 := by
      calc B₀ = B₀ * 1 := (mul_one B₀).symm
        _ ≤ B₀ * B₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB₀_ge_1 hB₀_nn
        _ = B₀ ^ 2 := (sq B₀).symm
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
    let ε₁ : ℝ := min 1 (ε / (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2))
    have hε₁_pos : 0 < ε₁ := lt_min one_pos (div_pos hε h_den_pos)
    have hε₁_le_1 : ε₁ ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hε₁_le_div : ε₁ ≤ ε / (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2) := min_le_right _ _
    have hε₁_le_B₀ : ε₁ ≤ B₀ := le_trans hε₁_le_1 hB₀_ge_1
    obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀_pos, hη₀⟩ := hw 0 ε₁ hε₁_pos
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ := hw 1 ε₁ hε₁_pos
    obtain ⟨η₃, hη₃_pos, hη₃⟩ := hw 3 ε₁ hε₁_pos
    let η : ℝ := min η₀ (min η₁ (min η₃ ε₁))
    have hη_pos : 0 < η :=
      lt_min hη₀_pos (lt_min hη₁_pos (lt_min hη₃_pos hε₁_pos))
    refine ⟨η, hη_pos, ?_⟩
    intro s hs x
    have hs₀ : |s - t| < η₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_left _ _)
    have hs₁ : |s - t| < η₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hs (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hs₃ : |s - t| < η₃ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hs (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hs_ε₁ : |s - t| ≤ ε₁ :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
    let δ₀ : ℝ := iteratedDeriv 0 (fun y => (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - t) * iteratedDeriv 0 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x
    let δ₁ : ℝ := iteratedDeriv 1 (fun y => (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - t) * iteratedDeriv 1 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x
    let δ₃ : ℝ := iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - t) * iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x
    have hδ₀_bd : |δ₀| ≤ ε₁ * |s - t| := hη₀ s hs₀ x
    have hδ₁_bd : |δ₁| ≤ ε₁ * |s - t| := hη₁ s hs₁ x
    have hδ₃_bd : |δ₃| ≤ ε₁ * |s - t| := hη₃ s hs₃ x
    have hδ₀_eq : δ₀ = (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
      dsimp [δ₀]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have hδ₁_eq : δ₁ = deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
      dsimp [δ₁]
      rw [h_iter_sub (w s) (w t) 1 x, iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one]
    have hδ₃_eq : δ₃ = iteratedDeriv 3 (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv 3 (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x -
        (s - t) * iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
      dsimp [δ₃]
      rw [h_iter_sub (w s) (w t) 3 x]
    have h_pt_id :
        (K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K' : ℝ → ℝ) x =
          -δ₃ + 6 * (δ₀ * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x +
            (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x * δ₁ +
            ((w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x) *
              (deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x)) := by
      rw [hK s x, hK t x, hK' x, h_prod_deriv (w t) v x, hδ₀_eq, hδ₁_eq, hδ₃_eq]
      dsimp [kdvRHS]
      ring
    have h_diff0_bd : |(w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ 2 * B₀ * |s - t| := by
      have h_id : (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x = δ₀ + (s - t) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
        rw [hδ₀_eq]; ring
      rw [h_id]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le δ₀ ((s - t) * (v : ℝ → ℝ) x)
      rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
      have h_v_st : |s - t| * |(v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ * |s - t| := by
        calc |s - t| * |(v : ℝ → ℝ) x|
          _ ≤ |s - t| * B₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_v_bd x) (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = B₀ * |s - t| := mul_comm _ _
      have h_δ₀_st : |δ₀| ≤ B₀ * |s - t| :=
        le_trans hδ₀_bd (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε₁_le_B₀ (abs_nonneg _))
      linarith
    have h_diff1_bd : |deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ 2 * B₀ * ε₁ := by
      have h_id : deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x = δ₁ + (s - t) * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
        rw [hδ₁_eq]; ring
      rw [h_id]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le δ₁ ((s - t) * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x)
      rw [abs_mul] at h_tri
      have h_dv_st : |s - t| * |deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ * |s - t| := by
        calc |s - t| * |deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x|
          _ ≤ |s - t| * B₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_dv_bd x) (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = B₀ * |s - t| := mul_comm _ _
      have h_δ₁_st : |δ₁| ≤ B₀ * |s - t| :=
        le_trans hδ₁_bd (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε₁_le_B₀ (abs_nonneg _))
      have h_step : |δ₁ + (s - t) * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ 2 * B₀ * |s - t| := by linarith
      exact le_trans h_step (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_ε₁ (by positivity))
    have h_term1 : |δ₀ * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |δ₀| * |deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x|
        _ ≤ (ε₁ * |s - t|) * B₀ :=
          mul_le_mul hδ₀_bd (h_dwt_bd x) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = B₀ * (ε₁ * |s - t|) := by ring
        _ ≤ B₀ ^ 2 * (ε₁ * |s - t|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB₀_le_sq (by positivity)
        _ = B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by ring
    have h_term2 : |(w t : ℝ → ℝ) x * δ₁| ≤ B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |(w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| * |δ₁|
        _ ≤ B₀ * (ε₁ * |s - t|) :=
          mul_le_mul (h_wt_bd x) hδ₁_bd (abs_nonneg _) hB₀_nn
        _ ≤ B₀ ^ 2 * (ε₁ * |s - t|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB₀_le_sq (by positivity)
        _ = B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by ring
    have h_term3 :
        |((w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x) *
          (deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x)| ≤
          4 * B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |(w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x| *
            |deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x|
        _ ≤ (2 * B₀ * |s - t|) * (2 * B₀ * ε₁) :=
          mul_le_mul h_diff0_bd h_diff1_bd (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = 4 * B₀ ^ 2 * ε₁ * |s - t| := by ring
    have h_sum_bd :
        |(K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K' : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤
          ((1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2) * ε₁) * |s - t| := by
      rw [h_pt_id]
      have ht1 := abs_add_le (-δ₃)
        (6 * (δ₀ * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x + (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x * δ₁ +
          ((w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x) *
            (deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x)))
      rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)] at ht1
      have ht2 := abs_add_le
        (δ₀ * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x + (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x * δ₁)
        (((w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x) *
          (deriv (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x))
      have ht3 := abs_add_le (δ₀ * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ((w t : ℝ → ℝ) x * δ₁)
      linarith
    have h_coeff_le : (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2) * ε₁ ≤ ε := by
      calc (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2) * ε₁
        _ ≤ (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2) * (ε / (1 + 36 * B₀ ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε₁_le_div (le_of_lt h_den_pos)
        _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt h_den_pos)
    exact le_trans h_sum_bd (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff_le (abs_nonneg _))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro τ
    let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => (K p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2
    have hF_cont : Continuous F := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      rintro ⟨t, x₀⟩
      rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hw_diff t
      let K'_t : CinfT :=
        ⟨fun x => -iteratedDeriv 3 (v : ℝ → ℝ) x +
          6 * deriv (fun z => (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z * (v : ℝ → ℝ) z) x,
         h_K'_cinfT (w t) v⟩
      obtain ⟨B_K', hB_K'_nn, hB_K'⟩ := h_cinfT_bound K'_t
      obtain ⟨η_t, hη_t_pos, h_tay_t⟩ :=
        h_K_taylor t v K'_t hv (fun _ => rfl) 1 one_pos
      have hKt_contAt : ContinuousAt (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀ :=
        (K t).2.1.continuous.continuousAt
      obtain ⟨δ_x, hδ_x_pos, hδ_x⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hKt_contAt (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      have h_den_pos : 0 < 2 * (1 + B_K') := by positivity
      let δ : ℝ := min δ_x (min η_t (ε / (2 * (1 + B_K'))))
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ :=
        lt_min hδ_x_pos (lt_min hη_t_pos (div_pos hε h_den_pos))
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨s, x⟩ hp
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp
      have hs_δ : |s - t| < δ := by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hp.1
      have hx_δ : dist x x₀ < δ := hp.2
      have hs_η : |s - t| < η_t :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hs_δ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hs_div : |s - t| < ε / (2 * (1 + B_K')) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hs_δ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have hx_δx : dist x x₀ < δ_x :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hx_δ (min_le_left _ _)
      have h_time_diff : |(K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x| < ε / 2 := by
        have h_id : (K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x =
            ((K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x) +
              (s - t) * (K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x := by ring
        have h_tri := abs_add_le
          ((K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x)
          ((s - t) * (K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x)
        rw [ ← h_id, abs_mul] at h_tri
        have h1 : |(K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (s - t) * (K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤
            1 * |s - t| := h_tay_t s hs_η x
        have h2 : |s - t| * |(K'_t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ |s - t| * B_K' :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB_K' x) (abs_nonneg _)
        have h3 : |(K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ (1 + B_K') * |s - t| := by linarith
        have h4 : (1 + B_K') * |s - t| < (1 + B_K') * (ε / (2 * (1 + B_K'))) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs_div (by positivity)
        have h5 : (1 + B_K') * (ε / (2 * (1 + B_K'))) = ε / 2 := by
          have : 1 + B_K' ≠ 0 := by positivity
          field_simp
        linarith
      have h_space_diff : |(K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀| < ε / 2 := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hδ_x hx_δx
      change dist ((K s : ℝ → ℝ) x) ((K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀) < ε
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h_split : (K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀ =
          ((K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x) + ((K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀) := by ring
      rw [h_split]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le ((K s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x) ((K t : ℝ → ℝ) x - (K t : ℝ → ℝ) x₀)
      linarith
    let S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.uIcc 0 τ ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    have hS_compact : IsCompact S := isCompact_uIcc.prod isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF_cont.continuousOn
    let M_K : ℝ := max C 0
    have hM_K_nn : 0 ≤ M_K := le_max_right C 0
    refine ⟨M_K, hM_K_nn, ?_⟩
    intro τ' hτ'
    have h_pt : ∀ y : ℝ, |(K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M_K := by
      intro y
      let y₀ : ℝ := Int.fract y
      have hy₀_mem : y₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨Int.fract_nonneg y, le_of_lt (Int.fract_lt_one y)⟩
      have hp_mem : (τ', y₀) ∈ S := ⟨hτ', hy₀_mem⟩
      have h_per : (K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) y = (K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) y₀ := by
        have hp : (K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) (y - (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * 1) = (K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) y :=
          (K τ').2.2.sub_int_mul_eq (⌊y⌋)
        rw [mul_one] at hp
        exact hp.symm
      rw [h_per]
      have h_le_C : |(K τ' : ℝ → ℝ) y₀| ≤ C := by
        simpa [F, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC (τ', y₀) hp_mem
      exact le_trans h_le_C (le_max_left C 0)
    exact ⟨h_pt, h_iota_linf (K τ') M_K hM_K_nn h_pt⟩
  · intro t v K' hw hK'
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto, Metric.tendsto_nhds_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, h_tay⟩ := h_K_taylor t v K' hw hK' (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨η, hη_pos, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs
    obtain ⟨δ_s, hδ_s_fn, hδ_s_iota⟩ := h_lincomb_cinfT (K s) (K t) K' (s - t)
    have h_pt : ∀ x : ℝ, |(δ_s : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ (ε / 2) * |s - t| := by
      intro x
      rw [hδ_s_fn x]
      exact h_tay s hs x
    have h_norm : ‖ιT (K s) - ιT (K t) - (s - t) • ιT K'‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * |s - t| := by
      rw [← hδ_s_iota]
      exact h_iota_linf δ_s ((ε / 2) * |s - t|) (by positivity) h_pt
    have h_quot_nn : 0 ≤ ‖s - t‖⁻¹ * ‖ιT (K s) - ιT (K t) - (s - t) • ιT K'‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h_quot_nn]
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · subst hst
      rw [sub_self, norm_zero, inv_zero, zero_mul]
      exact hε
    · have h_abs_pos : 0 < |s - t| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hst)
      have h_abs_ne : |s - t| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_abs_pos
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |s - t|⁻¹ * ‖ιT (K s) - ιT (K t) - (s - t) • ιT K'‖
        _ ≤ |s - t|⁻¹ * ((ε / 2) * |s - t|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = ε / 2 := by
          field_simp [h_abs_ne]
        _ < ε := half_lt_self hε

informal_problem.statement:
(δ_brack : ℝ) (hδ_brack : 0 < δ_brack) :
    ∃ δ_hm1 : ℝ, 0 < δ_hm1 ∧ δ_hm1 ≤ δ_brack ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
        ∀ (w₁ q v : CinfT) (B_v h : ℝ),
          0 ≤ B_v →
          hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w₁) ≤ δ_hm1 ^ 2 * κ →
          hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q) ≤ δ_hm1 ^ 2 * κ →
          hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT q + h • ιT v) ≤ (2 * δ_hm1) ^ 2 * κ →

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases h_sem_basic with ⟨h_semi_nn, h_semi_le, h_iter_le⟩
  have h_iter_add_nat : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m k : ℕ),
      iteratedDeriv m (iteratedDeriv k f) = iteratedDeriv (m + k) f := by
    intro f m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih k, ← iteratedDeriv_succ, Nat.add_right_comm m 1 k]
  have hW_smooth : ∀ (q : CinfT) (k : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv k (q : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    intro q k
    refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [h_iter_add_nat (q : ℝ → ℝ) m k]
    exact q.2.1.differentiable_iteratedDeriv (m + k) (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top (m + k)))
  have h_cdAt : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro q n x
    exact (q.2.1.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun z : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) z - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) z) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n x
    exact iteratedDeriv_sub (h_cdAt q₁ n x) (h_cdAt q₂ n x)
  have h_cont : ∀ d : ℕ, Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    intro d
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    intro τ ε hε
    obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, _⟩ := hw_reg τ
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ := hv_deriv d 1 zero_lt_one
    let M_v : ℝ := cinfSeminormT d (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hMv_nn : 0 ≤ M_v := h_semi_nn d (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 1 + M_v := by linarith
    refine ⟨min η₁ (ε / (1 + M_v)), lt_min hη₁_pos (div_pos hε h_den_pos), ?_⟩
    intro τ' hτ'
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hτ' ⊢
    have hτ'₁ : |τ' - τ| < η₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hτ' (min_le_left _ _)
    have hτ'₂ : |τ' - τ| < ε / (1 + M_v) := lt_of_lt_of_le hτ' (min_le_right _ _)
    let B : ℝ := (1 + M_v) * |τ' - τ|
    have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h_den_pos) (abs_nonneg _)
    have h_pt_diff : ∀ x : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hη₁ τ' hτ'₁ x
      rw [h_iter_sub (w τ') (w τ) d x, one_mul] at h1
      have h2 : |iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M_v := h_iter_le v d x
      have h3 : |(τ' - τ) * iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ M_v * |τ' - τ| := by
        rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg _)
      have h_tri := abs_sub_le
        (iteratedDeriv d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x)
        ((τ' - τ) * iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) x) 0
      rw [sub_zero, sub_zero] at h_tri
      dsimp [B]
      linarith
    have h_le1 : cinfSeminormT d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) + B := by
      apply h_semi_le d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) (cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) + B)
        (add_nonneg (h_semi_nn d _) hB_nn)
      intro x
      have h1 := h_pt_diff x
      have h2 := h_iter_le (w τ) d x
      have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (iteratedDeriv d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x)
        (iteratedDeriv d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_le2 : cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ cinfSeminormT d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) + B := by
      apply h_semi_le d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) (cinfSeminormT d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) + B)
        (add_nonneg (h_semi_nn d _) hB_nn)
      intro x
      have h1 := h_pt_diff x
      rw [abs_sub_comm] at h1
      have h2 := h_iter_le (w τ') d x
      have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (iteratedDeriv d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x)
        (iteratedDeriv d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) x)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_abs_le : |cinfSeminormT d (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) - cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ)| ≤ B := by
      rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hB_lt : B < ε := by
      calc B = (1 + M_v) * |τ' - τ| := rfl
        _ < (1 + M_v) * (ε / (1 + M_v)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hτ'₂ h_den_pos
        _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt h_den_pos)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_abs_le hB_lt
  have h_scalar_chain : ∀ (d : ℕ) (t₀ σ x c : ℝ) (v : CinfT),
      HasCinfDerivAtT w v (t₀ + σ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ'))
        (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ) +
          c * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)) σ := by
    intro d t₀ σ x c v hv_deriv
    let δ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' =>
      iteratedDeriv d (fun z : ℝ => (w (t₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) z - (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) z) (x + c * σ')
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' =>
      iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ')
    have hψ : HasDerivAt ψ (c * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)) σ := by
      have hd_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ)) (x + c * σ) :=
        (hW_smooth (w (t₀ + σ)) d).differentiable (by decide) (x + c * σ)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ))
          (iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (t₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)) (x + c * σ) := by
        have h1 := hd_diff.hasDerivAt
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h1
        exact h1
      have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => x + c * σ') c σ := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id σ).const_mul c).const_add x
      have h_comp := hd.comp σ h_lin
      rw [mul_comm] at h_comp
      exact h_comp
    have hδ : HasDerivAt δ (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)) σ := by
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro ε hε
      rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
      obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ := hv_deriv d (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      have h_v_cont : ContinuousAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ')) σ := by
        have hc1 : Continuous (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ)) := (hW_smooth v d).continuous
        have hc2 : Continuous (fun σ' : ℝ => x + c * σ') :=
          continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
        exact (hc1.comp hc2).continuousAt
      obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂_pos, hη₂⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp h_v_cont (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      refine ⟨min η₁ η₂, lt_min hη₁_pos hη₂_pos, ?_⟩
      intro σ' hσ'
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hσ'
      have hσ'₁ : |(t₀ + σ') - (t₀ + σ)| < η₁ := by
        have : (t₀ + σ') - (t₀ + σ) = σ' - σ := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hσ' (min_le_left _ _)
      have hσ'₂ : dist σ' σ < η₂ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hσ' (min_le_right _ _)
      have hδ_zero : δ σ = 0 := by
        dsimp [δ]
        rw [h_iter_sub (w (t₀ + σ)) (w (t₀ + σ)) d (x + c * σ), sub_self]
      have h_step1 := hη₁ (t₀ + σ') hσ'₁ (x + c * σ')
      have h_diff_t : (t₀ + σ') - (t₀ + σ) = σ' - σ := by ring
      rw [h_diff_t] at h_step1
      have h_step2 := le_of_lt (hη₂ hσ'₂)
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_step2
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul, hδ_zero, sub_zero]
      have h_split :
          δ σ' - (σ' - σ) * iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ) =
            (δ σ' - (σ' - σ) * iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ')) +
            (σ' - σ) * (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ') -
              iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)) := by ring
      rw [h_split]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le
        (δ σ' - (σ' - σ) * iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ'))
        ((σ' - σ) * (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ') -
          iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ)))
      have h_mul :
          |(σ' - σ) * (iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ') -
            iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ))| ≤ (ε / 2) * |σ' - σ| := by
        rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_step2 (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have h_sum := hδ.add hψ
    have h_fn_eq : (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x + c * σ')) =
        fun σ' : ℝ => δ σ' + ψ σ' := by
      ext σ'
      dsimp [δ, ψ]
      rw [h_iter_sub (w (t₀ + σ')) (w (t₀ + σ)) d (x + c * σ'), sub_add_cancel]
    rw [h_fn_eq]
    exact h_sum
  have h_v_iter : ∀ (d : ℕ) (t y : ℝ) (v g_tilde : CinfT),
      (∀ z : ℝ, (v : ℝ → ℝ) z = regFlowRHS κ (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z) →
      (∀ z : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) z) →
      iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) y =
        16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) y +
          4 * κ ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w t : ℝ → ℝ) y := by
    intro d t y v g_tilde hv_eq hg
    have hg_fn : diagGreen κ (w t : ℝ → ℝ) = fun z : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) z :=
      funext hg
    have hv_fn : (v : ℝ → ℝ) = fun z : ℝ =>
        16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z := by
      ext z
      rw [hv_eq z]
      dsimp [regFlowRHS]
      rw [hg_fn, deriv_const_add (1 / (2 * κ))]
    have h_cd_g : ContDiffAt ℝ d (deriv (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ)) y := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact ((hW_smooth g_tilde 1).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
    have h_cd_w : ContDiffAt ℝ d (deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ)) y := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact ((hW_smooth (w t) 1).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
    have h_cd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ d (fun z : ℝ => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) z) y :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul h_cd_g
    have h_cd2 : ContDiffAt ℝ d (fun z : ℝ => 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z) y :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul h_cd_w
    rw [hv_fn]
    have h_add := iteratedDeriv_add h_cd1 h_cd2
    have h_mul1 := iteratedDeriv_const_mul h_cd_g (16 * κ ^ 5)
    have h_mul2 := iteratedDeriv_const_mul h_cd_w (4 * κ ^ 2)
    change iteratedDeriv d
        ((fun z : ℝ => 16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) z) +
         (fun z : ℝ => 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) z)) y = _
    rw [h_add, h_mul1, h_mul2, ← iteratedDeriv_succ', ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
  refine ⟨h_cont, ?_⟩
  intro d τ₀ σ x g_tilde hg
  obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ := hw_reg (τ₀ + σ)
  have h_chain := h_scalar_chain d τ₀ σ x (-4 * κ ^ 2) v hv_deriv
  have h_v := h_v_iter d (τ₀ + σ) (x + -4 * κ ^ 2 * σ) v g_tilde hv_eq hg
  have h_fn : (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x + -4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')) =
      (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')) := by
    ext σ'
    congr 1
    ring
  have h_pt : x + -4 * κ ^ 2 * σ = x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ := by ring
  have h_val :
      iteratedDeriv d (v : ℝ → ℝ) (x + -4 * κ ^ 2 * σ) +
        (-4 * κ ^ 2) * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (τ₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) (x + -4 * κ ^ 2 * σ) =
        16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ) := by
    rw [h_v, h_pt]
    ring
  rw [h_fn, h_val] at h_chain
  exact h_chain

informal_problem.statement:
(h_sem_basic : (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT n f) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n f x| ≤ B) → cinfSeminormT n f ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        |iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ)))
    (δ_diag : ℝ) (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (h_static : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
      ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
        ∀ w : CinfT, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT w) ≤ δ_diag ^ 2 * κ →
          (∀ d < n, ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv d (w : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ R) →
          ∃ g_tilde : CinfT,
            (∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w : ℝ → ℝ) x = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∧
            (∀ M_n : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_n →
              (∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (w : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M_n) →
              ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ C₁ * M_n + C₂))
    (n : ℕ) (T R₀ : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hR₀ : 0 ≤ R₀) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ w : ℝ → CinfT,
        (∀ d : ℕ, Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ))) →
        (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : CinfT),
          (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) y) →
          HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
            (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
        (∀ τ : ℝ, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w τ)) ≤ δ_diag ^ 2 * κ) →
        (∀ d ≤ n, cinfSeminormT d (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₀) →
        ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T → ∀ d ≤ n, cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_sem_nn, h_sem_le, h_iter_le⟩ := h_sem_basic
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_uIcc_abs : ∀ (a τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 a → |τ| ≤ |a| := by
    intro a τ hτ
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans h1 h2)]
      exact h2
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos (le_trans h1 h2)]
      exact neg_le_neg h1
  have h_uIcc_trans : ∀ (σ σ₁ σ' : ℝ),
      σ₁ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ → σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ₁ → σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ := by
    intro σ σ₁ σ' hσ₁ hσ'
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at hσ₁ hσ' ⊢
    rcases hσ₁ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> rcases hσ' with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩
    · left; exact ⟨h3, le_trans h4 h2⟩
    · left; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · right; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · right; exact ⟨le_trans h1 h3, h4⟩
  have h_uIcc_add_bound : ∀ (τ₀ σ s T : ℝ),
      |τ₀| ≤ T → |τ₀ + σ| ≤ T → s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ → |τ₀ + s| ≤ T := by
    intro τ₀ σ s T hτ₀ hτ hs
    rw [abs_le] at hτ₀ hτ ⊢
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hs with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_single_tier_step : ∀ (D : ℕ) (T R₁ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ R₁ →
      ∃ σ₂ A : ℝ, 0 < σ₂ ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧
        ∀ w : ℝ → CinfT,
          (∀ d : ℕ, Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ))) →
          (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : CinfT),
            (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) y) →
            HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w τ)) ≤ δ_diag ^ 2 * κ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T → ∀ d < D, cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₁) →
          ∀ τ₀ τ : ℝ, |τ₀| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ T → |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ →
            cinfSeminormT D (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ 2 * cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A := by
    intro D T R₁ _hT hR₁
    obtain ⟨C₁, C₂, hC₁_nn, hC₂_nn, hC_spec⟩ := h_static D R₁ hR₁
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 32 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ + 1) := by positivity
    let σ₂ : ℝ := min 1 (1 / (32 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ + 1)))
    have hσ₂_pos : 0 < σ₂ := lt_min one_pos (div_pos one_pos h_denom_pos)
    have hσ₂_le_inv : σ₂ ≤ 1 / (32 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
    have h_half : σ₂ * (16 * κ ^ 5) * C₁ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h1 : σ₂ * (32 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ + 1)) ≤ 1 :=
        (le_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos).mp hσ₂_le_inv
      have h2 : 0 ≤ σ₂ * κ ^ 5 := by positivity
      linarith
    let A₀ : ℝ := σ₂ * (16 * κ ^ 5) * C₂
    let A : ℝ := 2 * A₀
    have hA₀_nn : 0 ≤ A₀ := by positivity
    have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A := by positivity
    refine ⟨σ₂, A, hσ₂_pos, hA_nn, ?_⟩
    intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_low τ₀ τ hτ₀ hτ h_diff
    let σ : ℝ := τ - τ₀
    have hσ_abs : |σ| ≤ σ₂ := h_diff
    have hτ₀_σ : τ₀ + σ = τ := add_sub_cancel τ₀ τ
    let f_max : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => cinfSeminormT D (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hf_cont : Continuous f_max := (hw_cont D).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
    have hI_nonempty : (Set.uIcc 0 σ).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_uIcc
    obtain ⟨σ_star, hσ_star_mem, hσ_star_max⟩ :=
      isCompact_uIcc.exists_isMaxOn hI_nonempty hf_cont.continuousOn
    let M_star : ℝ := f_max σ_star
    have hM_star_nn : 0 ≤ M_star := h_sem_nn D (w (τ₀ + σ_star) : ℝ → ℝ)
    have h_le_M_star : ∀ σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ, f_max σ' ≤ M_star :=
      fun σ' hσ' => isMaxOn_iff.mp hσ_star_max σ' hσ'
    have h_bound_uIcc : ∀ σ₁ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ,
        f_max σ₁ ≤ cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A₀ + (1 / 2) * M_star := by
      intro σ₁ hσ₁
      have hσ₁_le_σ : |σ₁| ≤ |σ| := h_uIcc_abs σ σ₁ hσ₁
      have hσ₁_le_σ₂ : |σ₁| ≤ σ₂ := le_trans hσ₁_le_σ hσ_abs
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A₀ + (1 / 2) * M_star := by
        have : 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) := h_sem_nn D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ)
        positivity
      refine h_sem_le D (w (τ₀ + σ₁) : ℝ → ℝ)
        (cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A₀ + (1 / 2) * M_star) h_rhs_nn (fun z => ?_)
      let x : ℝ := z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ₁
      let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => iteratedDeriv D (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')
      let L_bound : ℝ := 16 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ * M_star + C₂)
      have hL_nn : 0 ≤ L_bound := by positivity
      have h_step_σ' : ∀ σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ₁,
          ∃ d_val : ℝ, HasDerivAt Φ d_val σ' ∧ ‖d_val‖ ≤ L_bound := by
        intro σ' hσ'
        have hσ'_in_σ : σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ := h_uIcc_trans σ σ₁ σ' hσ₁ hσ'
        have h_w_M_star : cinfSeminormT D (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M_star :=
          h_le_M_star σ' hσ'_in_σ
        have h_τ_σ'_T : |τ₀ + σ'| ≤ T :=
          h_uIcc_add_bound τ₀ σ σ' T hτ₀ (by rwa [hτ₀_σ]) hσ'_in_σ
        have h_low_pt : ∀ d < D, ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ R₁ := by
          intro d hd y
          exact le_trans (h_iter_le (w (τ₀ + σ')) d y) (hw_low (τ₀ + σ') h_τ_σ'_T d hd)
        have h_D_pt : ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv D (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) y| ≤ M_star := by
          intro y
          exact le_trans (h_iter_le (w (τ₀ + σ')) D y) h_w_M_star
        obtain ⟨g_tilde, hg_eq, hg_bound⟩ :=
          hC_spec (w (τ₀ + σ')) (hw_ball (τ₀ + σ')) h_low_pt
        have hg_pt := hg_bound M_star hM_star_nn h_D_pt (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')
        let d_val : ℝ := 16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (D + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')
        refine ⟨d_val, hw_mov D τ₀ σ' x g_tilde hg_eq, ?_⟩
        change ‖16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (D + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ')‖ ≤ L_bound
        rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_pt (by positivity)
      have h_hasDeriv : ∀ σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ₁, HasDerivWithinAt Φ (deriv Φ σ') (Set.uIcc 0 σ₁) σ' := by
        intro σ' hσ'
        obtain ⟨d_val, hd, _⟩ := h_step_σ' σ' hσ'
        rw [hd.deriv]
        exact hd.hasDerivWithinAt
      have h_deriv_le : ∀ σ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 σ₁, ‖deriv Φ σ'‖ ≤ L_bound := by
        intro σ' hσ'
        obtain ⟨d_val, hd, hb⟩ := h_step_σ' σ' hσ'
        rw [hd.deriv]
        exact hb
      have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        h_hasDeriv h_deriv_le (convex_uIcc 0 σ₁) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
      have h_Φ0 : ‖Φ 0‖ ≤ cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        change ‖iteratedDeriv D (w (τ₀ + 0) : ℝ → ℝ) ((z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ₁) - 4 * κ ^ 2 * 0)‖ ≤ _
        rw [add_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact h_iter_le (w τ₀) D (z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ₁)
      have h_Φσ₁_eq : ‖Φ σ₁‖ = |iteratedDeriv D (w (τ₀ + σ₁) : ℝ → ℝ) z| := by
        change ‖iteratedDeriv D (w (τ₀ + σ₁) : ℝ → ℝ) ((z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ₁) - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ₁)‖ = _
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_tri : ‖Φ σ₁‖ ≤ ‖Φ 0‖ + ‖Φ σ₁ - Φ 0‖ := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (Φ σ₁) (Φ 0)
      have h_mvt_σ₂ : L_bound * ‖σ₁ - 0‖ ≤ σ₂ * L_bound := by
        rw [sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ₁_le_σ₂ hL_nn
      have h_alg : cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + σ₂ * L_bound =
          cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A₀ + (σ₂ * (16 * κ ^ 5) * C₁) * M_star := by
        dsimp [A₀, L_bound]
        ring
      have h_half_M : (σ₂ * (16 * κ ^ 5) * C₁) * M_star ≤ (1 / 2) * M_star :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_half hM_star_nn
      linarith
    have hM_star_bound : M_star ≤ 2 * cinfSeminormT D (w τ₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + A := by
      have := h_bound_uIcc σ_star hσ_star_mem
      dsimp [A]
      linarith
    have h_f_σ : f_max σ ≤ M_star := h_le_M_star σ Set.right_mem_uIcc
    dsimp [f_max] at h_f_σ
    rw [hτ₀_σ] at h_f_σ
    exact le_trans h_f_σ hM_star_bound
  have h_recurrence : ∀ (T σ₂ R₁ A : ℝ),
      0 ≤ T → 0 < σ₂ → 0 ≤ R₁ → 0 ≤ A →
      ∃ B : ℝ, R₁ ≤ B ∧
        ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ),
          F 0 ≤ R₁ →
          (∀ τ₀ τ : ℝ, |τ₀| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ T → |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ → F τ ≤ 2 * F τ₀ + A) →
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T → F τ ≤ B := by
    intro T σ₂ R₁ A _hT hσ₂ hR₁ hA
    let M : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => Nat.rec R₁ (fun _ prev => 2 * prev + A) m
    have hM_zero : M 0 = R₁ := rfl
    have hM_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, M (m + 1) = 2 * M m + A := fun _ => rfl
    have hM_ge : ∀ m : ℕ, R₁ ≤ M m := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => exact le_rfl
      | succ m ihm =>
        rw [hM_succ]
        linarith
    have hM_mono : ∀ m : ℕ, M m ≤ M (m + 1) := by
      intro m
      have h_ge := hM_ge m
      rw [hM_succ]
      linarith
    have h_step_m : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ),
        F 0 ≤ R₁ →
        (∀ τ₀ τ : ℝ, |τ₀| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ T → |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ → F τ ≤ 2 * F τ₀ + A) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ → F τ ≤ M m := by
      intro F hF0 hF_step m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro τ _ hτ_le
        rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hτ_le
        have hτ0 : τ = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp hτ_le
        subst hτ0
        exact hF0
      | succ m ihm =>
        intro τ hτ_T hτ_le
        have h_cast : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * σ₂ = (m : ℝ) * σ₂ + σ₂ := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_cast] at hτ_le
        rcases le_or_gt |τ| ((m : ℝ) * σ₂) with h_le | h_gt
        · exact le_trans (ihm τ hτ_T h_le) (hM_mono m)
        · have hm_nn : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (le_of_lt hσ₂)
          let τ₀ : ℝ := if 0 ≤ τ then (m : ℝ) * σ₂ else -((m : ℝ) * σ₂)
          have hτ₀_abs : |τ₀| = (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := by
            dsimp [τ₀]
            split_ifs with h_sign
            · exact abs_of_nonneg hm_nn
            · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hm_nn]
          have hτ₀_le_m : |τ₀| ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := le_of_eq hτ₀_abs
          have hτ₀_T : |τ₀| ≤ T := by linarith
          have h_diff : |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ := by
            dsimp [τ₀]
            split_ifs with h_sign
            · have h_abs_τ : |τ| = τ := abs_of_nonneg h_sign
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
              linarith
            · push_neg at h_sign
              have h_abs_τ : |τ| = -τ := abs_of_neg h_sign
              rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
              linarith
          have hF_τ₀ : F τ₀ ≤ M m := ihm τ₀ hτ₀_T hτ₀_le_m
          have hF_τ : F τ ≤ 2 * F τ₀ + A := hF_step τ₀ τ hτ₀_T hτ_T h_diff
          rw [hM_succ]
          linarith
    let m_star : ℕ := Nat.ceil (T / σ₂)
    refine ⟨M m_star, hM_ge m_star, ?_⟩
    intro F hF0 hF_step τ hτ_T
    have h_ceil : T / σ₂ ≤ (m_star : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (T / σ₂)
    have hT_le : T ≤ (m_star : ℝ) * σ₂ := (div_le_iff₀ hσ₂).mp h_ceil
    exact h_step_m F hF0 hF_step m_star τ hτ_T (le_trans hτ_T hT_le)
  have h_tier : ∀ (D : ℕ) (T R₁ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ R₁ →
      ∃ B₂ : ℝ, R₁ ≤ B₂ ∧
        ∀ w : ℝ → CinfT,
          (∀ d : ℕ, Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ))) →
          (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : CinfT),
            (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) y) →
            HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w τ)) ≤ δ_diag ^ 2 * κ) →
          cinfSeminormT D (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₁ →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T → ∀ d < D, cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₁) →
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
            cinfSeminormT D (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B₂ := by
    intro D T R₁ hT hR₁
    obtain ⟨σ₂, A, hσ₂_pos, hA_nn, h_double⟩ := h_single_tier_step D T R₁ hT hR₁
    obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_rec⟩ := h_recurrence T σ₂ R₁ A hT hσ₂_pos hR₁ hA_nn
    refine ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
    intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init hw_low τ hτ
    exact h_rec (fun s => cinfSeminormT D (w s : ℝ → ℝ)) hw_init
      (h_double w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_low) τ hτ
  have h_ind : ∀ (D : ℕ) (T R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ R₀ →
      ∃ B : ℝ, R₀ ≤ B ∧
        ∀ w : ℝ → CinfT,
          (∀ d : ℕ, Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ))) →
          (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : CinfT),
            (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ) : ℝ → ℝ) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) y) →
            HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ') : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (g_tilde : ℝ → ℝ) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, hm1KappaSqT κ (ιT (w τ)) ≤ δ_diag ^ 2 * κ) →
          (∀ d ≤ D, cinfSeminormT d (w 0 : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₀) →
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
            ∀ d ≤ D, cinfSeminormT d (w τ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ B := by
    intro D
    induction D with
    | zero =>
      intro T R₀ hT hR₀
      obtain ⟨B₂, hR₀_le, h_step⟩ := h_tier 0 T R₀ hT hR₀
      refine ⟨B₂, hR₀_le, ?_⟩
      intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ d hd
      have hd0 : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
      subst hd0
      refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball (hw_init 0 le_rfl) ?_ τ hτ
      intro τ' _ d' hd'
      exact (Nat.not_lt_zero d' hd').elim
    | succ D ihD =>
      intro T R₀ hT hR₀
      obtain ⟨R₁, hR₀_le_R₁, h_ihD⟩ := ihD T R₀ hT hR₀
      have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
      obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ := h_tier (D + 1) T R₁ hT hR₁_nn
      refine ⟨B₂, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
      intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ d hd
      have h_low : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ'| ≤ T → ∀ d' ≤ D, cinfSeminormT d' (w τ' : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ R₁ := by
        intro τ' hτ' d' hd'
        exact h_ihD w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
          (fun d'' hd'' => hw_init d'' (le_trans hd'' (Nat.le_succ D)))
          τ' hτ' d' hd'
      rcases Nat.of_le_succ hd with hd_le_D | rfl
      · exact le_trans (h_low τ hτ d hd_le_D) hR₁_le_B₂
      · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
          (le_trans (hw_init (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
        intro τ' hτ' d' hd'
        exact h_low τ' hτ' d' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hd')
  obtain ⟨B, hR₀_le_B, h_bound⟩ := h_ind n T R₀ hT hR₀
  exact ⟨B, le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_B, h_bound⟩

by
  obtain ⟨h_semi_nn, h_semi_le, h_iter_le⟩ := h_sem_basic
  have h_iter_add : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (m k : ℕ),
      iteratedDeriv m (iteratedDeriv k f) = iteratedDeriv (m + k) f := by
    intro f m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih k, ← iteratedDeriv_succ, Nat.add_right_comm m 1 k]
  have hW_smooth : ∀ (g : CinfT) (n : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
    intro g n
    refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [h_iter_add (g : ℝ → ℝ) m n]
    exact g.2.1.differentiable_iteratedDeriv (m + n)
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top (m + n)))
  have h_laplace : ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * |v|)) volume ∧
      (∫ v : ℝ, Real.exp (-c * |v|)) = 2 / c := by
    intro c hc
    let f_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-c * |v|)
    have hf_Ici : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hc).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
      refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
      intro v hv
      dsimp [f_c]
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]
    have hf_Iic : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_neg := hf_Ici.comp_neg
      rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
      refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
      intro v _
      dsimp [f_c]
      rw [abs_neg]
    have hf_int : Integrable f_c volume := by
      rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
      exact hf_Iic.union (hf_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
    refine ⟨hf_int, ?_⟩
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => -(1 / c) * Real.exp (-c * v)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by dsimp [F]; fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-c * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) (-c) v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-c)
      have hd2 := hd1.exp.const_mul (-(1 / c))
      convert hd2 using 1
      have : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
      field_simp
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [show (0 : ℝ) = -(1 / c) * 0 by ring]
      apply Filter.Tendsto.const_mul
      apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
      have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => c * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc Filter.tendsto_id
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(c * x)) := by ext x; ring

      rw [h_eq]
      exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_ioi_val : (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-c * v)) = 1 / c := by
      have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv
        (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hc) hF_lim
      rw [h_res]
      dsimp [F]
      rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
      ring
    have h_split : ∫ v : ℝ, f_c v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hf_int.integrableOn hf_int.integrableOn).symm
    have h_iic_eq : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v := by
      have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) f_c

  have h_hm1_c0 : ∀ (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → ∀ (g : CinfT),

    intro Λ hΛ g

    obtain ⟨h_int_2Λ, h_val_2Λ⟩ := h_laplace (2 * Λ) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨h_int_Λ, h_val_Λ⟩ := h_laplace Λ hΛ_pos

    have hK_val : (∫ v : ℝ, K v) = 1 := by

      (hW_smooth g 0).differentiable (by decide)
    have h_deriv_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖deriv (g : ℝ → ℝ) y‖ ≤ M₁ := by
      intro y
      have h := h_iter_le g 1 y
      simpa [M₁, Real.norm_eq_abs, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] using h
    have h_mvt : ∀ (x v : ℝ), |(g : ℝ → ℝ) x - (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v)| ≤ M₁ * |v| := by
      intro x v
      have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun y _ => hg_diff.differentiableAt)
        (fun y _ => h_deriv_bound y)
        convex_univ (Set.mem_univ (x + v)) (Set.mem_univ x)
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg] using h
    refine h_semi_le 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) (26 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ιT g‖ + (2 / Λ) * M₁) (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have h_ker_id : ∀ v : ℝ,
        (4 * Λ ^ 3) * (freeGreenKernel Λ x (x + v) * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel Λ (x + v) x) =
          K v * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) := by
      intro v
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel, K]
      have h_sub1 : x - (x + v) = -v := by ring
      have h_sub2 : x + v - x = v := by ring
      rw [h_sub1, h_sub2, abs_neg]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-Λ * |v|) * Real.exp (-Λ * |v|) = Real.exp (-(2 * Λ) * |v|) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have : Λ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hΛ_pos
      calc (4 * Λ ^ 3) * (1 / (2 * Λ) * Real.exp (-Λ * |v|) * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) * (1 / (2 * Λ) * Real.exp (-Λ * |v|)))
        _ = ((4 * Λ ^ 3) * (1 / (2 * Λ)) * (1 / (2 * Λ))) * (Real.exp (-Λ * |v|) * Real.exp (-Λ * |v|)) * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) := by ring
        _ = Λ * Real.exp (-(2 * Λ) * |v|) * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v) := by
          rw [h_exp]
          congr 2
          field_simp
          ring
    have h_avg_bound : |∫ v : ℝ, K v * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v)| ≤ 26 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ιT g‖ := by

    have hKg_int : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => K v * (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v)) volume := by

      have hg_bd : |(g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v)| ≤ cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by

      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_bd (by dsimp [K]; positivity)
    have hK_const_int : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => K v * (g : ℝ → ℝ) x) volume :=

    have hK_diff_int : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => K v * ((g : ℝ → ℝ) x - (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v))) volume := by
      have h_eq : (fun v : ℝ => K v * ((g : ℝ → ℝ) x - (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v))) =

    have h_rem_pw : ∀ v : ℝ, |K v * ((g : ℝ → ℝ) x - (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x + v))| ≤ M₁ * Real.exp (-Λ * |v|) := by

        rw [← h_gx_eq]

  have h_deriv : ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → ∀ (g : CinfT),
      cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
        (2 / δ) * cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) + δ * cinfSeminormT (n + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro n δ hδ g
    let M₀ : ℝ := cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    let M₂ : ℝ := cinfSeminormT (n + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hM₀_nn : 0 ≤ M₀ := h_semi_nn n (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hM₂_nn : 0 ≤ M₂ := h_semi_nn (n + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    refine h_semi_le (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ((2 / δ) * M₀ + δ * M₂) (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
    let f : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    let f' : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    let f'' : ℝ → ℝ := iteratedDeriv (n + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f :=
      (hW_smooth g n).differentiable (by decide)
    have hf'_diff : Differentiable ℝ f' :=
      (hW_smooth g (n + 1)).differentiable (by decide)
    have hf_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt f (f' y) y := by
      intro y
      have hd := (hf_diff.differentiableAt (x := y)).hasDerivAt
      have h_eq : deriv f y = f' y := (congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_succ (n := n) (f := (g : ℝ → ℝ))) y).symm
      rwa [h_eq] at hd
    have hf'_deriv_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, deriv f' y = f'' y :=
      fun y => (congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_succ (n := n + 1) (f := (g : ℝ → ℝ))) y).symm
    have hf_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, |f y| ≤ M₀ :=
      fun y => h_iter_le g n y
    have hf''_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖deriv f' y‖ ≤ M₂ := by
      intro y
      rw [hf'_deriv_eq y, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h_iter_le g (n + 2) y
    have hf'_lip : ∀ τ : ℝ, ‖f' (x + τ) - f' x‖ ≤ M₂ * ‖τ‖ := by
      intro τ
      have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun y _ => hf'_diff.differentiableAt)
        (fun y _ => hf''_bound y)
        convex_univ (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ (x + τ))
      simpa using h
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => f (x + τ) - f x - τ * f' x
    have hΦ_deriv : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt Φ (f' (x + τ) - f' x) τ := by
      intro τ
      dsimp [Φ]
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t)) (f' (x + τ)) τ := by
        simpa using (hf_deriv (x + τ)).comp τ ((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_add x)

        hd1.sub_const (f x)

        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id τ).mul_const (f' x)

      (fun τ _ => (hΦ_deriv τ).differentiableAt)
      hΦ_bound
      (convex_Icc 0 δ)
      (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hδ))
      (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hδ))
    have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = 0 := by dsimp [Φ]; ring
    rw [hΦ0, sub_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hδ), Real.norm_eq_abs] at hΦ_mvt
    have h_id : δ * f' x = (f (x + δ) - f x) - Φ δ := by dsimp [Φ]; ring

      have h1 : |δ * f' x| = |(f (x + δ) - f x) - Φ δ| := by rw [h_id]

      have h2 := abs_sub (f (x + δ) - f x) (Φ δ)
      have h3 := abs_sub (f (x + δ)) (f x)
      have h4 := hf_bound (x + δ)
      have h5 := hf_bound x
      linarith
    have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_δ_f' (le_of_lt hδ)
    have h_lhs : δ * |f' x| / δ = |f' x| := mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hδ)
    have h_rhs : (2 * M₀ + δ ^ 2 * M₂) / δ = (2 / δ) * M₀ + δ * M₂ := by
      have : δ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ
      field_simp
    rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_div
    exact h_div
  have h_s2_1 : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (g : CinfT) (σ : ℝ), 0 < σ →
      cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
        (2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + m + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro n g σ hσ
      simpa using h_deriv n σ hσ g
    | succ m ih =>
      intro n g σ hσ
      let σ₀ : ℝ := σ / (4 * 8 ^ m)
      have hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀ := by dsimp [σ₀]; positivity
      have h1 := h_deriv n σ₀ hσ₀ g
      have h2 := ih (n + 1) g σ hσ
      have h_idx : n + 1 + m + 2 = n + (m + 1) + 2 := by omega
      rw [h_idx] at h2
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_of_lt hσ₀)

        dsimp [σ₀]
        have : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_coeff2 : 2 / σ₀ = 8 ^ (m + 1) / σ := by
        dsimp [σ₀]
        have : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ
        rw [pow_succ]
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_pow8 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 8 ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 8)
      have h_σ₀_le : σ₀ * σ ^ (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * σ ^ (m + 2) := by
        dsimp [σ₀]
        rw [pow_succ' σ (m + 1)]
        have h_pos : 0 ≤ σ ^ (m + 1) := by positivity
        have h_frac : σ / (4 * 8 ^ m) ≤ (1 / 2) * σ := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          nlinarith
        nlinarith
      have h_sem_nn : 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :=
        h_semi_nn (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
      have h_term2 : σ₀ * (σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)) ≤
          (1 / 2) * σ ^ (m + 2) * cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_σ₀_le h_sem_nn
      have h_expand : σ₀ * ((2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)) =
          (1 / 2) * cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          σ₀ * (σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
        rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, h_coeff1]
      rw [h_expand] at h_mul
      rw [h_coeff2] at h1
      have h_comb : cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
          2 * (8 ^ (m + 1) / σ) * cinfSeminormT n (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          σ ^ (m + 2) * cinfSeminormT (n + (m + 1) + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        linarith
      have h_rw : 2 * (8 ^ (m + 1) / σ) = 2 * 8 ^ (m + 1) / σ := by ring
      rwa [h_rw] at h_comb
  exact ⟨h_hm1_c0, h_s2_1⟩

      rw [pow_succ', pow_mul, h_sqrt_sq j x hx, ih x hx]
  have h_sqrt_le_one : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → (Real.sqrt^[j] x) ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro x _ hx1
      simpa using hx1
    | succ j ih =>
      intro x hx0 hx1
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (ih x hx0 hx1)
  have h_sqrt_zero : ∀ (j : ℕ), (Real.sqrt^[j] (0 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, Real.sqrt_zero]
  have h_sqrt_cont : ∀ (j : ℕ), Continuous (Real.sqrt^[j]) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => exact continuous_id
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ']
      exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp ih
  have h_sub_cinfT : ∀ q₁ q₂ : CinfT,
      (fun x : ℝ => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    refine ⟨q₁.2.1.sub q₂.2.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [q₁.2.2 x, q₂.2.2 x]
  have h_smul_cinfT : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT),
      (fun x : ℝ => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∈ CinfT := by
    intro c q
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul q.2.1, fun x => ?_⟩
    dsimp
    rw [q.2.2 x]
  let d : ℝ → CinfT := fun s =>
    ⟨fun x => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_cinfT (u s) (u s₀)⟩
  let w : ℝ → CinfT := fun s =>
    ⟨fun x => (s - s₀) * (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul_cinfT (s - s₀) v₀⟩
  let r : ℝ → CinfT := fun s =>
    ⟨fun x => (d s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_cinfT (d s) (w s)⟩
  have h_iota_r : ∀ s : ℝ, ιT (r s) = ιT (u s) - ιT (u s₀) - (s - s₀) • ιT v₀ := by
    intro s
    have h1 := h_iota_lin.1 (d s) (w s) (h_sub_cinfT (d s) (w s))
    have h2 := h_iota_lin.1 (u s) (u s₀) (h_sub_cinfT (u s) (u s₀))
    have h3 := h_iota_lin.2 (s - s₀) v₀ (h_smul_cinfT (s - s₀) v₀)
    change ιT ⟨fun x => (d s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_cinfT (d s) (w s)⟩ = _
    rw [h1]
    change ιT ⟨fun x => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_sub_cinfT (u s) (u s₀)⟩ -
      ιT ⟨fun x => (s - s₀) * (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x, h_smul_cinfT (s - s₀) v₀⟩ = _
    rw [h2, h3]
  let A : ℝ := Real.sqrt C
  have hA_nn : 0 ≤ A := Real.sqrt_nonneg C
  have h_hm1 : ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ η → ‖ιT (r s)‖ ≤ A * |s - s₀| * Real.sqrt |s - s₀| := by
    intro s hs
    have h_sq := h_cube s hs
    rw [← h_iota_r s] at h_sq
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq
    have h_lhs : Real.sqrt (‖ιT (r s)‖ ^ 2) = ‖ιT (r s)‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_cube_eq : C * |s - s₀| ^ 3 = C * (|s - s₀| ^ 2 * |s - s₀|) := by ring
    have h_rhs : Real.sqrt (C * |s - s₀| ^ 3) = A * |s - s₀| * Real.sqrt |s - s₀| := by
      rw [h_cube_eq, Real.sqrt_mul hC, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg _)]
      dsimp [A]
      ring
    rwa [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_sqrt
  have h_contDiffAt_cinfT : ∀ (q : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      ContDiffAt ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro q n x
    exact (q.2.1.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) y - (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (q₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (q₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro q₁ q₂ n x
    exact iteratedDeriv_sub (h_contDiffAt_cinfT q₁ n x) (h_contDiffAt_cinfT q₂ n x)
  have h_iter_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : CinfT) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => c * (q : ℝ → ℝ) y) x =
        c * iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro c q n x
    exact iteratedDeriv_const_mul (h_contDiffAt_cinfT q n x) c
  have h_iter_r : ∀ (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
          (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro s n x
    change iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (d s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (w s : ℝ → ℝ) y) x = _
    rw [h_iter_sub (d s) (w s) n x]
    change iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (s - s₀) * (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x = _
    rw [h_iter_smul (s - s₀) v₀ n x]
  have h_iter_r_expand : ∀ (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv n (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x -
          (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro s n x
    rw [h_iter_r s n x, h_iter_sub (u s) (u s₀) n x]
  have hr₀_sem : ∀ n : ℕ, cinfSeminormT n (r s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
    intro n
    apply h_sem_basic.2.1 n (r s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) 0 le_rfl
    intro x
    have h0 : iteratedDeriv n (r s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x = 0 := by
      rw [h_iter_r_expand s₀ n x]
      ring
    rw [h0, abs_zero]
  have h_r_sem : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ η → cinfSeminormT m (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨B, hB_nn, hB⟩ := h_sem m
    have hu0_nn : 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) := h_sem_basic.1 m _
    have hv0_nn : 0 ≤ cinfSeminormT m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) := h_sem_basic.1 m _
    let M : ℝ := B + cinfSeminormT m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) + η * cinfSeminormT m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ)
    have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := by positivity
    refine ⟨M, hM_nn, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    apply h_sem_basic.2.1 m (r s : ℝ → ℝ) M hM_nn
    intro x
    rw [h_iter_r_expand s m x]
    have h_tri1 : |iteratedDeriv m (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x -
        (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤
        |iteratedDeriv m (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| +
          |(s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := abs_sub _ _
    have h_tri2 : |iteratedDeriv m (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x - iteratedDeriv m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤
        |iteratedDeriv m (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x| + |iteratedDeriv m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := abs_sub _ _
    have h_mul : |(s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| =
        |s - s₀| * |iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| := abs_mul _ _
    have h1 : |iteratedDeriv m (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ B :=
      le_trans (h_sem_basic.2.2 (u s) m x) (hB s hs)
    have h2 : |iteratedDeriv m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT m (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      h_sem_basic.2.2 (u s₀) m x
    have h3 : |iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      h_sem_basic.2.2 v₀ m x
    have h4 : |s - s₀| * |iteratedDeriv m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ η * cinfSeminormT m (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hs h3 (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hη)
    dsimp [M]
    linarith
  let L : ℝ := 8 * 8 ^ 8
  have hL_pos : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have h_c0_abs : ∀ (g : CinfT) (σ₀ : ℝ), 0 < σ₀ → σ₀ ≤ 1 →
      cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
        (52 / σ₀ ^ 3) * ‖ιT g‖ + 4 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 * cinfSeminormT 10 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro g σ₀ hσ₀_pos hσ₀_le1
    have hσ₀_ne : σ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ₀_pos
    let Λ : ℝ := 1 / σ₀
    have hΛ_ge1 : 1 ≤ Λ := (one_le_div hσ₀_pos).mpr hσ₀_le1
    have h_step1 := h_interp_step.1 Λ hΛ_ge1 g
    have h_Λ_3 : 26 * Λ ^ 3 = 26 / σ₀ ^ 3 := by
      dsimp [Λ]
      field_simp
    have h_Λ_div : 2 / Λ = 2 * σ₀ := by
      dsimp [Λ]
      field_simp
    rw [h_Λ_3, h_Λ_div] at h_step1
    have h_step2 := h_interp_step.2 8 0 g (L * σ₀) (mul_pos hL_pos hσ₀_pos)
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_step2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * σ₀)
    have h_c1 : (2 * σ₀) * (2 * 8 ^ 8 / (L * σ₀)) = 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [L]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_c2 : (2 * σ₀) * (L * σ₀) ^ (8 + 1) = 2 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 := by ring
    have h_exp : (2 * σ₀) * ((2 * 8 ^ 8 / (L * σ₀)) * cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
        (L * σ₀) ^ (8 + 1) * cinfSeminormT (0 + 8 + 2) (g : ℝ → ℝ)) =
        (1 / 2) * cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          2 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 * cinfSeminormT 10 (g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
      change (2 * σ₀) * ((2 * 8 ^ 8 / (L * σ₀)) * cinfSeminormT 0 (g : ℝ → ℝ) +
          (L * σ₀) ^ (8 + 1) * cinfSeminormT 10 (g : ℝ → ℝ)) = _
      rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, h_c1, ← mul_assoc, h_c2]
    rw [h_exp, zero_add] at h_mul
    have h_52 : (52 / σ₀ ^ 3) * ‖ιT g‖ = 2 * ((26 / σ₀ ^ 3) * ‖ιT g‖) := by ring
    linarith
  have h_unweighted : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ min η 1 →
      cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ K * |s - s₀| * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨M₁₀, hM₁₀_nn, hM₁₀⟩ := h_r_sem 10
      refine ⟨52 * A + 4 * L ^ 9 * M₁₀, by positivity, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      by_cases h_eq : s = s₀
      · subst h_eq
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero, h_sqrt_zero]
        have h0 := hr₀_sem 0
        linarith
      · let h : ℝ := |s - s₀|
        have hh_pos : 0 < h := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq)
        have hh_nn : 0 ≤ h := le_of_lt hh_pos
        have hh_η : h ≤ η := le_trans hs (min_le_left _ _)
        have hh_1 : h ≤ 1 := le_trans hs (min_le_right _ _)
        let σ₀ : ℝ := Real.sqrt^[3] h
        have hσ₀_pos : 0 < σ₀ := h_sqrt_pos 3 h hh_pos
        have hσ₀_nn : 0 ≤ σ₀ := le_of_lt hσ₀_pos
        have hσ₀_le1 : σ₀ ≤ 1 := h_sqrt_le_one 3 h hh_nn hh_1
        have hσ₀_sq : σ₀ ^ 2 = Real.sqrt^[2] h := h_sqrt_sq 2 h hh_nn
        have hσ₀_4 : (σ₀ ^ 2) ^ 2 = Real.sqrt h := by
          rw [hσ₀_sq]
          exact h_sqrt_sq 1 h hh_nn
        have hσ₀_8 : σ₀ ^ 8 = h := h_sqrt_pow 3 h hh_nn
        have hσ₀_10 : σ₀ ^ 10 = h * σ₀ ^ 2 := by
          calc σ₀ ^ 10
            _ = σ₀ ^ 8 * σ₀ ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = h * σ₀ ^ 2 := by rw [hσ₀_8]
        have hσ₀_sq_le : σ₀ ^ 2 ≤ σ₀ := by nlinarith
        have h_hm1_s : ‖ιT (r s)‖ ≤ A * h * σ₀ ^ 4 := by
          calc ‖ιT (r s)‖
            _ ≤ A * h * Real.sqrt h := h_hm1 s hh_η
            _ = A * h * (σ₀ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [← hσ₀_4]
            _ = A * h * σ₀ ^ 4 := by ring
        have h_t1 : (52 / σ₀ ^ 3) * ‖ιT (r s)‖ ≤ 52 * A * h * σ₀ := by
          calc (52 / σ₀ ^ 3) * ‖ιT (r s)‖
            _ ≤ (52 / σ₀ ^ 3) * (A * h * σ₀ ^ 4) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hm1_s (by positivity)
            _ = 52 * A * h * σ₀ := by
              have : σ₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ₀_pos
              field_simp
        have h_t2 : 4 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 * cinfSeminormT 10 (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
            4 * L ^ 9 * M₁₀ * h * σ₀ := by
          calc 4 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 * cinfSeminormT 10 (r s : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ 4 * L ^ 9 * σ₀ ^ 10 * M₁₀ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM₁₀ s hh_η) (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * L ^ 9 * M₁₀ * h * σ₀ ^ 2 := by
              rw [hσ₀_10]
              ring
            _ ≤ 4 * L ^ 9 * M₁₀ * h * σ₀ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσ₀_sq_le (by positivity)
        have h_abs := h_c0_abs (r s) σ₀ hσ₀_pos hσ₀_le1
        change cinfSeminormT 0 (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ (52 * A + 4 * L ^ 9 * M₁₀) * h * σ₀
        linarith
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨K_n, hK_n_nn, hK_n⟩ := ih
      let m : ℕ := 2 ^ (n + 4)
      obtain ⟨M, hM_nn, hM⟩ := h_r_sem (n + m + 2)
      refine ⟨2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ m * K_n + M, by positivity, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      by_cases h_eq : s = s₀
      · subst h_eq
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero, h_sqrt_zero]
        have h0 := hr₀_sem (n + 1)
        linarith
      · let h : ℝ := |s - s₀|
        have hh_pos : 0 < h := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq)
        have hh_nn : 0 ≤ h := le_of_lt hh_pos
        have hh_η : h ≤ η := le_trans hs (min_le_left _ _)
        let σ : ℝ := Real.sqrt^[n + 4] h
        have hσ_pos : 0 < σ := h_sqrt_pos (n + 4) h hh_pos
        have hσ_sq : σ ^ 2 = Real.sqrt^[n + 3] h := h_sqrt_sq (n + 3) h hh_nn
        have hσ_m : σ ^ m = h := h_sqrt_pow (n + 4) h hh_nn
        have hσ_m1 : σ ^ (m + 1) = h * σ := by rw [pow_succ, hσ_m]
        have h_step := h_interp_step.2 m n (r s) σ hσ_pos
        have h_t1 : (2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤
            2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ m * K_n * h * σ := by
          calc (2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ (2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * (K_n * h * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] h)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK_n s hs) (by positivity)
            _ = (2 * 8 ^ m / σ) * (K_n * h * σ ^ 2) := by rw [← hσ_sq]
            _ = 2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ m * K_n * h * σ := by
              have : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ_pos
              field_simp
        have h_t2 : σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + m + 2) (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ M * h * σ := by
          calc σ ^ (m + 1) * cinfSeminormT (n + m + 2) (r s : ℝ → ℝ)
            _ ≤ σ ^ (m + 1) * M :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM s hh_η) (by positivity)
            _ = (h * σ) * M := by rw [hσ_m1]
            _ = M * h * σ := by ring
        change cinfSeminormT (n + 1) (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ (2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ m * K_n + M) * h * σ
        linarith
  intro n ε hε
  obtain ⟨K, hK_nn, hK⟩ := h_unweighted n
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|)
  have hF_cont : Continuous F :=
    continuous_const.mul ((h_sqrt_cont (n + 3)).comp (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
  have hF_zero : F s₀ = 0 := by
    change K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s₀ - s₀|) = 0
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, h_sqrt_zero, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂_pos, h_close⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hF_cont.continuousAt ε hε
  let η' : ℝ := min (min η 1) η₂
  have hη'_pos : 0 < η' := lt_min (lt_min hη one_pos) hη₂_pos
  refine ⟨η', hη'_pos, ?_⟩
  intro s hs x
  have hs_le : |s - s₀| ≤ min η 1 := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_left _ _))
  have hs_η₂ : |s - s₀| < η₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_right _ _)
  have hFs_lt : F s < ε := by
    have h_dist := h_close (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hF_zero, sub_zero] at h_dist
    exact (abs_lt.mp h_dist).2
  have h_pt : |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
      (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    rw [← h_iter_r s n x]
    exact h_sem_basic.2.2 (r s) n x
  have h_sem_bd : cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ F s * |s - s₀| := by
    calc cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ)
      _ ≤ K * |s - s₀| * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) := hK s hs_le
      _ = F s * |s - s₀| := by
        dsimp [F]
        ring
  calc |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) y - (u s₀ : ℝ → ℝ) y) x -
        (s - s₀) * iteratedDeriv n (v₀ : ℝ → ℝ) x|
    _ ≤ cinfSeminormT n (r s : ℝ → ℝ) := h_pt
    _ ≤ F s * |s - s₀| := h_sem_bd
    _ ≤ ε * |s - s₀| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hFs_lt) (abs_nonneg _)

import Mathlib
import KdVLine
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-!
# KdV is well-posed in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` (Killip–Vişan, Theorem 1.1, circle case)

Formal statement of the circle (periodic) case of

> **Theorem 1.1 (Global well-posedness).** The equation (KdV)
> `d/dt q = -q''' + 6 q q'` is globally well-posed for initial data in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` in the
> following sense: the solution map extends uniquely from Schwartz space to a jointly
> continuous map `Φ : ℝ × H⁻¹ → H⁻¹`. Moreover, for each initial data `q ∈ H⁻¹`, the orbit
> `{Φ(t,q) : t ∈ ℝ}` is uniformly bounded and equicontinuous in `H⁻¹`.

The paper treats this case in §6 ("The periodic case"). There it says that Sections 3–5 carry
over once Section 2 (the diagonal Green's function) has been redone, and once the lack of
scaling symmetry has been handled by the coupled condition (6.1)
`κ ≥ 1, κ^{-1/2} ‖q‖_{H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)} ≤ δ`.

R. Killip and M. Vişan, *KdV is well-posed in `H⁻¹`*, Ann. of Math. (2) **190** (2019),
249–305, arXiv:1802.04851. The informal source is `KdV_killip_visan_informal.md` in this
folder. This file is the circle analogue of `KdV_well_posed.lean`, the line case.

## Layout of this file

* **Part I: line-case results, imported.** `import KdVLine` brings in the complete, verified
  proof of the line case (`KdV_well_posed_final_proof.lean`, built as the module `KdVLine`):
  every definition of `KdV_well_posed.lean`, the auxiliary definitions (`GreenODE`, …, `RegN`)
  and all 115 theorems, including `KdV.kdv_well_posed_H_minus_one`, in namespace `KdV`. They
  are *proved* there, not assumed, so they may be used freely and add no axioms beyond
  `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. Only `kdvRHS` appears in the torus statement.
  (This replaces the earlier verbatim copy of the line-case definitions.)

* **Part II: the circle `ℝ/ℤ`.** These are the torus definitions and the main theorem. All
  torus names end in `T` (or are `fourierCircle`), so they cannot be confused with the line
  names of Part I.

## Notion of solution on the circle (as in the paper)

* **Schwartz space on `ℝ/ℤ`.** As the paper says, "On the circle `ℝ/ℤ`, Schwartz space is
  coincident with `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)`". We realise `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` as the set `CinfT` of smooth,
  1-periodic, real-valued functions on `ℝ`.

* **Smooth solutions.** A *smooth solution* is a curve `u : ℝ → C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` such that
  `(t, x) ↦ u(t)(x)` is jointly `C^∞` on `ℝ × ℝ`, and `∂ₜ u(t,x) = -∂ₓ³u(t,x) + 6 u ∂ₓu` holds at
  every point. The circle is compact, so joint smoothness on `ℝ × ℝ/ℤ` is the same as `u`
  being a `C^∞` curve in the Fréchet space `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)`. This is the same notion as "curve in
  Schwartz space" in the line file. Mathlib has no Fréchet-space type for `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)`, so
  joint smoothness is the cleanest faithful encoding.

* **`H⁻¹` solutions** are unique limits of smooth solutions, exactly as in the line case.

* **Classical input is assumed, not proved (conditional statement).** As on the line, the
  paper takes classical well-posedness of (KdV) for smooth periodic data for granted
  (Bona–Smith, Kato, Sjöberg, Temam; Bourgain covers even `L²(ℝ/ℤ)`). The main theorem
  therefore takes global existence (`h_exists`) and uniqueness (`h_unique`) of smooth
  solutions as *hypotheses*. Both are true classical theorems, so the statement is not
  vacuous. They are deliberately theorem hypotheses rather than `axiom`s. As on the line,
  smooth dependence on the data is *not* assumed.

## How `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` and equicontinuity are encoded

* **Fourier convention (paper §1.2).** `q̂(ξ) = ∫₀¹ e^{-iξx} q(x) dx` for `ξ ∈ 2πℤ`. We index
  by `n ∈ ℤ`, with `ξ = 2πn`.

* **The space.** The paper's norm is `‖q‖²_{H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)} = ∑_{ξ ∈ 2πℤ} (4 + ξ²)⁻¹ |q̂(ξ)|²`, so
  `q ↦ (n ↦ (4 + (2πn)²)^{-1/2} q̂(2πn))` is a linear isometry from real `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` into
  `ℓ²(ℤ; ℂ)`. We realise `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` as the closure of the image of `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` under this
  isometry. Smooth functions are dense, so this is isometrically isomorphic to the paper's
  `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`, and it is literally the completion of `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` in the `H⁻¹` norm.

* **Equicontinuity (paper Definition 4.1, (4.1)).** Translation by `h` multiplies `q̂(ξ)` by
  `e^{iξh}`. So, for the profile `f` of `q`,
  `‖q(· + h) - q‖²_{H⁻¹} = ∑ₙ |e^{2πinh} - 1|² |f(n)|²`. This is (4.1) on the circle.

* **Junk value.** The embedding is defined with a `dite` on `Memℓp`, returning `0` otherwise.
  For smooth periodic inputs the membership always holds.

Remark: the circle is compact, so bounded + equicontinuous orbits are exactly precompact
orbits (paper, after Theorem 1.1). We state Theorem 1.1 as written, with bounded +
equicontinuous.
-/

/-! # Part II. The circle `ℝ/ℤ`

## The phase space `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` and smooth solutions -/

open scoped ContDiff in
/-- `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)`, the paper's "Schwartz space" on the circle, realised as the smooth 1-periodic
real-valued functions on `ℝ`. -/
def CinfT : Set (ℝ → ℝ) :=
  {f | ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ Function.Periodic f 1}

open scoped ContDiff in
/-- A global smooth solution of (KdV) on the circle: a curve `u : ℝ → C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` such that
`(t, x) ↦ u(t)(x)` is jointly `C^∞` on `ℝ × ℝ` (equivalently, since `ℝ/ℤ` is compact, `u` is
a `C^∞` curve in the Fréchet space `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)`). It must satisfy
`∂ₜ u(t,x) = -∂ₓ³u(t,x) + 6 u(t,x) ∂ₓu(t,x)` at every `(t, x)`. -/
def IsSmoothSolutionT (u : ℝ → CinfT) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (u p.1 : ℝ → ℝ) p.2) ∧
    ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (u s : ℝ → ℝ) x) (kdvRHS (u t : ℝ → ℝ) x) t

/-! ## The space `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` -/

/-- The Fourier coefficient on the circle with the paper's normalisation
`q̂(ξ) = ∫₀¹ e^{-iξx} q(x) dx`, evaluated at `ξ = 2πn`. -/
def fourierCircle (q : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (-(((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)

/-- The `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` profile `n ↦ (4 + (2πn)²)^{-1/2} q̂(2πn)`. Its `ℓ²(ℤ)` norm is
`‖q‖_{H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)}`. -/
def hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt (4 + (2 * π * n) ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ) * fourierCircle q n

/-- The isometric embedding of a smooth periodic function into `ℓ²(ℤ; ℂ)` via its `H⁻¹`
profile (junk value `0` if the profile were not square summable, which never happens). -/
def toHm1T (q : CinfT) : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
  if h : Memℓp (hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ)) 2 then ⟨hm1ProfileT (q : ℝ → ℝ), h⟩ else 0

/-- Real `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`, realised (isometrically) as the closure in `ℓ²(ℤ; ℂ)` of the `H⁻¹`
profiles of real smooth 1-periodic functions, i.e. the completion of `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` in the `H⁻¹`
norm. -/
def Hm1T : Submodule ℝ (lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) :=
  (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1T)).topologicalClosure

/-- The embedding `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ) → H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`. -/
def ιT (q : CinfT) : Hm1T :=
  ⟨toHm1T q, Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨q, rfl⟩)⟩

/-! ## Equicontinuity and the extension property -/

/-- `‖q(· + h) - q‖²_{H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)}` expressed through the `H⁻¹` profile `f` of `q`:
`∑ₙ |e^{2πinh} - 1|² |f(n)|²`. -/
def translateDiffSqT (f : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) (h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℤ, ‖(Complex.exp (((2 * π * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1) * f n‖ ^ 2

/-- Equicontinuity in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` (paper Definition 4.1): `q(· + h) → q` in `H⁻¹` as
`h → 0`, uniformly for `q ∈ Q`. -/
def EquicontinuousHm1T (Q : Set Hm1T) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ h : ℝ, |h| < δ →
    translateDiffSqT (q : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) h < ε

/-- `Φ` extends the smooth solution map: for every smooth solution `u`,
`Φ(t, u(0)) = u(t)` in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` for all `t`. -/
def ExtendsSmoothFlowT (Φ : ℝ × Hm1T → Hm1T) : Prop :=
  ∀ u : ℝ → CinfT, IsSmoothSolutionT u → ∀ t : ℝ, Φ (t, ιT (u 0)) = ιT (u t)

/-! ## Main theorem -/

/-- **Killip–Vişan, Theorem 1.1 (circle case).** KdV is globally well-posed in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`.
Assume the classical theory for smooth periodic data, which the paper takes for granted:
global existence `h_exists` and uniqueness `h_unique` of smooth solutions. Then the solution
map extends uniquely from `C^∞(ℝ/ℤ)` to a jointly continuous map
`Φ : ℝ × H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ) → H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`. Moreover, for each `q ∈ H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)` the orbit
`{Φ(t, q) : t ∈ ℝ}` is uniformly bounded and equicontinuous in `H⁻¹(ℝ/ℤ)`. -/
